Existing outdoor benchmarks either lack sufficient photorealism or complexity, resulting in a considerable gap from real-world urban environments. 360CityArena is built on a realistic reconstruction of the Akihabara district in Tokyo, Japan, using 602 360-degree video segments covering 85 streets, and consists of 175 meticulously human-crafted tasks. It encompasses three task categories: Environment Understanding, Path Reasoning, and Spatial Reasoning, covering fundamental abilities required for urban exploration, such as localization, landmark search, path planning, and relational spatial reasoning, thereby enabling comprehensive evaluation in realistic urban scenes. Our evaluation using state-of-the-art LMM-based agents shows that even the strongest model, Gemini 2.5 Flash, performs far below human level (human: 77.3% vs. Gemini 2.5 Flash: 17.1%), revealing substantial challenges that remain in city-scale embodied navigation and reasoning. 360CityArena provides a necessary and challenging testbed for photorealistic urban-district navigation and spatial reasoning.

</details>


### [83] [Resolution Meets Reduction: Efficient Visual Context for 3D Radiology Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08713v1)
*Jonathan Suprijadi,Raphael Stock,Moritz Langenberg,David Zimmerer,Kim-Celine Kahl,Stefan Denner,Yannick Kirchhoff,Karol Gotkowski,Maximilian Rokuss,Jeremias Traub,Tassilo Wald,Constantin Ulrich,Klaus Maier-Hein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了视觉语言模型在3D CT体积放射学报告生成中的视觉token预算分配问题，评估了四种视觉编码器、五种token压缩投影器和五种指令微调LLM在两大CT报告数据集上的表现。研究发现解剖引导的感兴趣区域裁剪是最一致的策略，将临床macro F1平均提升3.7点（Primus编码器）；PerceiverResampler与高分辨率Curia特征结合时表现最佳。最佳配置在CT-RATE和Merlin测试集上分别达到49.5和49.0的临床macro F1，实现最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将视觉语言模型应用于完整的3D CT体积时，现代视觉基础编码器每张扫描可产生数万个视觉token，导致输入LLM的视觉序列成为主要计算瓶颈。虽然通过视觉到语言投影器可以压缩序列以降低计算量，但过度压缩可能丢失临床相关细节；而有效压缩则能在保持下游token数固定的同时容纳更高分辨率输入。如何跨输入视野、空间分辨率和视觉-语言投影来分配视觉token预算仍是一个悬而未决的设计问题。

Method: 系统性评估包含：(1) 四种异构视觉编码器（CNN和ViT两种架构类型）；(2) 五种token缩减投影器（最高64倍压缩）以及一个不缩减的MLP投影器作为基线；(3) 五种指令微调的LLM（参数量1.7B至4B）。实验在CT-RATE和Merlin两个大规模CT报告数据集上进行，在匹配LLM token预算的条件下对比不同策略。

Result: 在匹配LLM token预算时，解剖引导的感兴趣区域裁剪是最一致的策略，在20种设置中的19种提升了临床macro F1，3D ViT Primus编码器平均提升3.7点，基于切片的2D ViT Curia编码器平均提升1.1点。提高输入分辨率的效果强烈依赖投影器类型：PerceiverResampler与更高分辨率的Curia特征搭配时在两个数据集上均产生最强配置。最佳配置在CT-RATE上达到49.5、Merlin上达到49.0的临床macro F1，实现最先进水平。

Conclusion: 视觉token预算的分配方式对3D CT放射学报告生成的性能有显著影响。解剖引导的区域裁剪是跨不同编码器、投影器和LLM组合中最稳健的提升策略；分辨率与投影器的搭配关系存在强耦合，需要联合优化。本文为全3D CT体积上的放射学报告生成提供了系统性的设计指导，并将在发表后公开代码和模型。

Abstract: Vision-language models offer a promising path toward automating radiology report generation, but applying them to full 3D CT volumes poses substantial computational challenges. Modern foundation vision encoders (VEs) can produce tens of thousands of vision tokens per scan, making the visual sequence passed to the large language model (LLM) a primary computational bottleneck. Vision-to-language projectors can compress this sequence to reduce computation, but may discard clinically relevant detail; conversely, effective compression can accommodate higher-resolution inputs while keeping the downstream token count fixed. How this vision-token budget should be allocated across input field of view, spatial resolution, and vision-to-language projection therefore remains an open design question. We systematically evaluate four heterogeneous VEs (CNN- and ViT-based), five token-reducing projectors at up to 64x compression alongside a non-reducing MLP projector baseline, and five instruction-tuned LLMs (1.7B--4B) on two large-scale CT report datasets (CT-RATE and Merlin). At matched LLM token budgets, anatomy-guided region of interest cropping is the most consistent strategy, improving clinical macro F1 in 19 of 20 settings by +3.7 points on average for the 3D ViT Primus encoder and +1.1 for the slice-based 2D ViT Curia encoder. Increasing input resolution further is strongly projector-dependent: the PerceiverResampler, paired with higher-resolution Curia features, yields the strongest configuration in the resolution study on both datasets. Our best configurations achieve state-of-the-art clinical macro F1 on the test sets, reaching 49.5 on CT-RATE and 49.0 on Merlin. Code and models will be published upon publication.

</details>


### [84] [OccAnyScene: Towards Unified Indoor-Outdoor 3D Occupancy Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08696v2)
*Junjie Liu,Wanshui Gan,Zitong Dai,Guiping Cao,Yan Li,Ke Chen,Dongmei Jiang,Xiangyuan Lan,Jianguo Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了跨场景3D语义占用预测新任务，要求单一模型同时处理室内外异构场景（不同相机、空间范围、体素规格和语义标签体系），并设计了基于像素-视锥体中心高斯框架的OccAnyScene方法，在室内和室外数据集上均取得最先进结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的3D语义占用预测方法通常针对固定场景类型和固定占用协议进行特化，难以泛化到异构的室内外场景。真实场景中相机配置、空间尺度、体素规格和语义类别体系差异巨大，需要一种统一的框架来打破这种特化限制。

Method: 提出OccAnyScene框架，包含：1）Pixel-Aligned Frustum Feature Aggregation，为每个特征像素构建相机感知的视锥体查询；2）Frustum-Parameterized Gaussian Construction，将每个查询解码为多个高斯，其位置和尺寸由预测的像素深度及对应视锥体几何约束。该框架基于预训练的深度基础模型。

Result: 在室内Occ-ScanNet上达到59.92% mIoU，在室外SurroundOcc-nuScenes上达到23.06% mIoU，均刷新最先进水平。

Conclusion: 以像素-视锥体为中心的高斯框架有效实现了度量一致且场景自适应的图像到3D提升，证明单一模型能够统一处理跨场景的3D语义占用预测任务。

Abstract: 3D occupancy prediction is fundamental to scene understanding, yet existing 3D semantic occupancy methods are typically specialized to fixed scene types and occupancy protocols. We introduce Cross-Scene 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction, a new task setting which requires a single model to handle heterogeneous indoor and outdoor scenes with varying cameras, spatial ranges, voxel specifications, and semantic taxonomies. This setting poses a fundamental challenge: achieving metric-consistent yet scene-adaptive image-to-3D lifting across varying camera configurations and scene scales. To address this challenge, we propose OccAnyScene, a pixel-frustum-centered Gaussian framework built upon a pretrained depth foundation model. Specifically, the framework employs Pixel-Aligned Frustum Feature Aggregation to construct a camera-aware frustum query for each feature pixel, and Frustum-Parameterized Gaussian Construction to decode each query into multiple Gaussians whose positions and sizes are constrained by the predicted pixel depth and corresponding frustum geometry. OccAnyScene sets new state-of-the-art results, achieving 59.92% mIoU on the indoor Occ-ScanNet and 23.06% mIoU on the outdoor SurroundOcc-nuScenes.

</details>


### [85] [FiRe: Fixed-Noise Refinement for Visual Counterfactual Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08664v1)
*Yan Zeng,Changlu Guo,Oskar Kristoffersen,Anders Nymark Christensen,Morten Rieger Hannemose,Anders Bjorholm Dahl*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FiRe框架，通过固定噪声水平迭代细化取代长反向去噪轨迹，实现高效、可控的视觉反事实解释生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于DDPM的反事实解释方法沿长反向去噪轨迹进行分类器引导编辑，存在噪声水平变化导致语义可编辑性与空间控制难以平衡的问题；且可编辑状态带噪声而目标分类器训练于干净图像，需代价高昂的递归去噪或低质量单步估计。

Method: FiRe将输入映射到固定噪声水平并在该水平上迭代细化。具体包括：(1) 将Pixel Mean Flow适配到反事实解释任务，实现从噪声状态直接预测干净图像，供分类器引导使用；(2) 引入三种特定控制机制：动态双掩码策略控制编辑累积区域、自适应引导控制可见变化、早停控制细化终止时机。

Result: 在三个数据集上的五个任务中，相比最强近期基线，FiRe实现约3倍推理加速和8倍FLOPs减少，同时达到相当或最先进的反事实质量问题。

Conclusion: 通过固定噪声细化框架，FiRe成功在保持反事实编辑质量的同时大幅提升计算效率，验证了固定噪声水平迭代策略在视觉反事实解释中的有效性。

Abstract: Visual counterfactual explanations aim to change classifier decisions through realistic and localized edits while preserving decision-irrelevant content. Existing DDPM-based methods typically perform classifier-guided editing along a long reverse denoising trajectory. The changing noise levels make semantic editability and spatial control difficult to balance, and the editable state is noisy, whereas the target classifier is trained on clean images. As a result, these methods require either costly recursive denoising or low-quality one-step estimates to obtain classifier-facing clean images. We propose FiRe, a Fixed-noise Refinement framework for visual counterfactual explanations. Rather than following a reverse denoising trajectory, FiRe maps the input to a fixed noise level and iteratively refines the noisy state at that level. To provide clean images for classifier guidance, FiRe first adapts Pixel Mean Flow to visual counterfactual explanation, enabling direct clean-image prediction from noisy states. To make fixed-noise refinement produce minimal and localized counterfactual edits, FiRe introduces three FiRe-specific controls: a dynamic dual-mask strategy, adaptive guidance, and early stopping, which determine where edits accumulate, which changes become visible, and when refinement stops. Experiments on five tasks across three datasets show that, compared with the strongest recent baseline, FiRe achieves about 3$\times$ faster online inference and 8$\times$ fewer FLOPs while obtaining comparable or state-of-the-art counterfactual quality.

</details>


### [86] [Agentic Visual Reasoning in Whole-Slide Pathology Images via Active Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08648v1)
*Jingyun Chen,Fengchun Liu,Linghan Cai,Songhan Jiang,Shenjin Huang,Hongpeng Wang,Lequan Yu,Yongbing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AdaptivePath是一种主动感知框架，将全切片病理图像的证据采集形式化为序贯决策过程，通过Navigator学习基于异常驱动的导航策略，结合Morphology Interpreter、Deliberator和Arbiter三个模块实现跨尺度的层级化稀疏观察与视觉推理，在WSI和区域病理VQA基准上取得SOTA零样本性能，并在癌症亚型分类和病理医生诊断效用研究中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有WSI方法存在两方面不足：一是将密集采样补丁压缩为全局表示，削弱了预测与形态学之间的关联；二是依赖启发式区域选择的预训练视觉-语言模型，缺乏病理学训练的观察策略。因此需要一种能够主动选择观测位置和空间范围、并建立预测与形态学可溯性联系的方法。

Method: AdaptivePath由四个核心组件构成：(1) Navigator：学习与问题无关的异常驱动导航策略，从病理医生标注的标签中学习选择观察位置和空间范围，通过交替表征学习和PPO策略优化进行训练，并用几何与外观一致性目标微调以稳定聚焦轨迹；推理时在有限ROI预算下从低到高倍率层级化采集稀疏观测。(2) Morphology Interpreter：将观测转换为问题条件化的证据。(3) Deliberator：跨倍率评估证据并修正中间答案。(4) Arbiter：整合推演历史产生最终答案。

Result: AdaptivePath在WSI和区域病理VQA基准上取得SOTA零样本性能；在六个TCGA队列的癌症亚型分类任务中达到80.14%准确率；在盲态诊断效用研究中，使用AdaptivePath选择观察序列的病理医生达到82.9%准确率。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，学习得到的主动感知机制能够在千兆像素病理切片上实现有效且可追溯的视觉推理，验证了将证据采集建模为序贯决策这一范式的有效性。

Abstract: Whole-slide visual reasoning requires identifying sparse diagnostic evidence in gigapixel pathology slides and integrating observations across spatial scales. Existing WSI methods either compress densely sampled patches into global representations or use pretrained vision-language models with heuristic region selection, weakening links between predictions and morphology or lacking pathology-trained observation policies. We present AdaptivePath, an active-perception framework that formulates WSI evidence acquisition as sequential decision making. The Navigator learns question-agnostic abnormality-driven navigation from pathologist-reviewed labels to select observation locations and spatial extents, avoiding costly question-specific trajectory annotations. We train this policy through alternating representation learning and proximal policy optimization, followed by fine-tuning with geometric and appearance consistency objectives to stabilize focus trajectories. During inference, the Navigator hierarchically acquires sparse observations from low to high magnification under a limited ROI budget. A Morphology Interpreter converts observations into question-conditioned evidence, while the Deliberator evaluates evidence and revises intermediate answers across magnifications. The Arbiter integrates deliberation history to produce final answers. AdaptivePath achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on WSI and region pathology VQA benchmarks and reaches 80.14% accuracy for cancer subtype classification across six TCGA cohorts. In a blinded diagnostic-utility study, pathologists using AdaptivePath-selected observation sequences achieve 82.9% accuracy. These results demonstrate that learned active perception enables effective and traceable visual reasoning over gigapixel pathology slides.

</details>


### [87] [VADER: Adaptive Debiasing for Hallucination Mitigation in Video Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08622v1)
*Dong Xing,Jiaxin Chen,Hang Yang,Peixun Liu,Qiushi Yang,Yuqing Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VADER是一个无需训练的框架，通过两个互补模块（视觉焦点重分配VFR和选择性证据擦除SEE）对大型视频语言模型进行证据重加权去偏，缓解模型在视频理解中"流畅但无证据支撑"的响应问题，在多个VideoLLM上显著提升事件级定位与时间一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视频语言模型在开放视频理解中表现强劲，但常产生流畅却缺乏视频证据支撑的回答。现有训练无关方法存在两大局限：全局固定视觉干预无法适应视频依赖的融合路径，而输入扰动构建的对比分支可被跨帧冗余补偿。因此需要一种自适应、难以被帧间冗余补偿的去偏方法。

Method: 提出VADER框架，包含两个互补模块：1) 视觉焦点重分配（VFR）自动为每个视频-问题输入实例化干预策略，通过诊断逐层视觉到文本证据流，确定干预位置并推导如何将softmax前的注意力从系统token块重新分配到视频token块；2) 选择性证据擦除（SEE）独立掩蔽每帧中高重要性视觉token，构建难以被邻近帧补偿的先验偏置分支，然后通过对比解码降低在选择性证据擦除后仍保持高置信度的预测权重。

Result: 在多个VideoLLM上，VADER在事件级基础和时间一致性任务上均取得显著改进。在LLaVA-Video-7B上，EventHallusion基准达到72.60%准确率。

Conclusion: VADER通过视频自适应的证据重加权去偏，有效解决了全局固定干预和对比分支可补偿两大问题，验证了自适应干预与难补偿擦除相结合的策略对提升视频语言模型可靠性的有效性。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in open-ended video understanding, yet they remain prone to fluent responses unsupported by video evidence. Existing training-free methods typically apply a globally fixed visual intervention or construct a contrastive branch through input perturbation. The former cannot accommodate video-dependent fusion paths, while the latter can be compensated by cross-frame redundancy. We therefore propose Video-Adaptive Debiasing via Evidence Reweighting (VADER), a training-free framework with two complementary modules. Visual Focus Reallocation (VFR) automatically instantiates an intervention policy for each video-question input: it diagnoses layer-wise visual-to-text evidence flow, determines where to intervene, and derives how strongly to reallocate pre-softmax attention from system-token to video-token blocks. Selective Evidence Erasure (SEE) independently masks high-importance visual tokens in every frame, constructing a prior-biased branch that is difficult to compensate through neighboring frames. Contrastive decoding then down-weights predictions that remain confident after selective evidence erasure. Across multiple VideoLLMs, VADER yields substantial improvements on event-level grounding and temporal consistency; on LLaVA-Video-7B, it reaches 72.60% accuracy on EventHallusion.

</details>


### [88] [Population-Scalable Multi-Agent World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08600v1)
*Renjie Zhao,Yuxiang Wu,Mingyu Zhang,Jiaxin Li,Sisi Li,Yimin Sheng,Tianxi Tan,Zhenkai Zhang,Jianyi Zhu,Yong-Lu Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Khora，一种可扩展的多智能体世界模型，通过将世界状态演化与视觉渲染解耦，并采用群体无关的渲染机制，使得模型在推理时无需重新训练即可扩展到任意数量的智能体，实现近似线性的实际扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型在多智能体环境中通常假设训练和推理时智能体数量固定，这限制了推理时的可扩展性。核心洞察是：跨视角一致性应源自不预设智能体数量的共享世界状态演化，而智能体特定观测应通过统一渲染接口查询该状态生成。

Method: Khora框架将世界状态演化与视觉渲染解耦，引入群体无关的渲染机制以整合其他智能体的信息。跨视角一致性通过共享世界状态维持，而非在昂贵的视频生成器内进行密集的观测流交互，从而支持任意数量智能体的查询。

Result: 定性实验表明该方法能泛化到未见过的智能体数量，同时保持视觉质量和多智能体一致性。此外实现了实时交互系统，展示了可扩展开放世界模拟的能力，并实现了近似线性的实际扩展速度。

Conclusion: Khora通过架构上的解耦设计有效解决了多智能体世界模型的可扩展性问题，在推理时支持任意数量智能体的加入而无需重新训练，为开放世界多智能体模拟提供了可行的规模化方案。

Abstract: World models have recently achieved impressive progress in visual prediction and interactive generation, but extending them to multi-agent environments introduces a fundamental scalability challenge. Existing methods generally assume a fixed number of agents during training and inference, which ties the model to a pre-determined agent population and limits inference-time scalability. Our key insight is that cross-view consistency should arise from a shared world state whose evolution does not assume a predefined number of agents, while agent-specific observations should be generated by querying this state through a unified rendering interface. Based on this insight, we propose Khora, a scalable multi-agent world model that supports inference-time expansion to arbitrary numbers of agents without retraining. Our framework decouples world-state evolution from visual rendering and introduces a population-agnostic rendering mechanism for incorporating other agent information. This design maintains cross-view consistency through the shared world state rather than through dense interactions among observation streams inside the expensive video generator, enabling approximately linear practical scaling with the number of queried views. Qualitative experiments demonstrate that our approach generalizes to unseen numbers of agents while maintaining visual quality and multi-agent consistency. We further implement a real-time interactive system to demonstrate scalable open-world simulation.

</details>


### [89] [Goal-oriented Navigation Instruction Generation with Tour Video Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08596v1)
*Fangdi Li,Juncheng Liao,Changxu Cheng,Jiazhi Wang,Senda Chen,Tao Wang,Wuyue Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VideoNIG，一个目标导向的视频接地导航指令生成任务，从自我中心旅游视频、初始观察和文本/视觉目标生成逐步导航指令，无需图或地图等中间表示。文中构建了包含60K旅游视频和37K多模态提示的仿真基准，并提出一个两阶段课程学习框架（Action Warmup + Complexity Progression）来解决该任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将导航指令生成（NIG）主要视为视觉语言导航（VLN）的辅助任务，用于数据增强或多任务学习。然而，从紧凑的环境先验生成导航指令需要精细的空间推理能力，特别是当目标路线不完全遵循演示路径时，这对当前多模态模型仍具挑战性。因此需要一个独立、目标导向且接地于视频的NIG任务定义。

Method: 提出VideoNIG任务，基于自我中心旅游视频和初始观察生成导航指令。构建60K视频、37K提示（含渐进难度）的仿真基准，提出结合文本相似度、基于选择的空间一致性测试和下游导航执行的诊断评估协议。解决方案为两阶段课程学习框架：第一阶段Action Warmup用于空间动作-视角对齐，第二阶段Complexity Progression采用探索难度递增的轨迹进行长时程导航推理。

Result: 实验表明现有多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在VideoNIG上表现困难，而所提出的方法在多个互补诊断指标上显著提升指令质量。将VideoNIG生成的指令与VLN智能体集成，验证了该任务形式可支持端到端导航执行。

Conclusion: VideoNIG将NIG重新定义为一个独立的目标导向视频接地任务，通过课程学习框架有效提升了多模态模型的导航指令生成能力，并证明了该任务可作为端到端导航的可行中间环节。

Abstract: Navigation Instruction Generation (NIG) aims to produce step-by-step natural language instructions for navigation guidance. Existing studies primarily treat NIG as an auxiliary task for vision-andlanguage navigation (VLN), focusing on data augmentation or multi-task learning. However, generating navigation instructions from compact environmental priors requires meticulous spatial reasoning, especially when the target route does not simply follow the demonstrated tour, and remains challenging for current multimodal models. In this work, we introduce VideoNIG, a goal-oriented video-grounded NIG task that generates navigation instructions from ego-centric tour videos, an initial observation, and a textual or visual goal, without relying on intermediate representations such as graphs and maps. We instantiate VideoNIG in a controlled simulator benchmark with 60K tour videos across continuous indoor environments and 37K multimodal prompts with progressive difficulty levels. We further introduce a diagnostic evaluation protocol that combines text similarity, choice-based spatial consistency tests, and downstream navigation execution. To address this task, we propose a two-stage Curriculum Learning framework that decomposes the learning into foundational motion perception and long-horizon navigation reasoning. Specifically, we first employ Action Warmup for spatial action-view alignment, followed by Complexity Progression using trajectories with increasing exploratory difficulty. Extensive experiments show that existing MLLMs struggle with VideoNIG, while our approach significantly improves instruction quality across complementary diagnostic metrics. Finally, integrating VideoNIG-generated instructions with a VLN agent demonstrates the executability of this task formulation for end-to-end navigation.

</details>


### [90] [RobustDefect-LLM: Explainable and Robustness-Aware Industrial Surface Defect Classification with Decision Support and AI-Assisted Reporting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08589v1)
*Nazlıcan Düşünmez,Halûk Gümüşkaya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RobustDefect-LLM，一个集成了深度学习分类、可视化证据、置信度感知决策支持、受控AI辅助报告、可追溯存储和移动交互的统一工业表面缺陷检测框架。在NEU-DET数据集上评估了四种CNN模型，MobileNetV3-Large以99.26%的准确率表现最佳，但该系统在图像退化下性能显著下降，需人工审查策略来保证可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业表面缺陷检测需要集成式的质量控制系统，而非孤立的算法模型。现有系统缺乏对分类结果的可视化解释、置信度感知的决策路由、AI辅助报告生成和移动端交互的统一整合，且对鲁棒性缺乏明确的评估方法。

Method: 采用迁移学习方法评估四种CNN架构（ResNet50、EfficientNet-B0、DenseNet121、MobileNetV3-Large）在六类NEU-DET数据集上的表现。通过bootstrap置信区间和McNemar检验进行统计评估；在受控图像退化条件下评估鲁棒性；用Grad-CAM提供视觉证据；设定置信度阈值（<0.90）和top-2 margin阈值（<0.10）进行人工审查路由；最后对报告生成进行确定性一致性检查。

Result: MobileNetV3-Large达到最高测试准确率99.26%（宏F1=0.9926，bootstrap 95% CI: 0.9815-1.0000），CPU单次前向传播0.060秒（16.66 FPS）。在轻度合成退化下准确率降至87.78%，较强退化下低于40%。保守审查策略实现12.22%自动覆盖率和100%选择性准确率（33例，95% CI: 89.43%-100.00%），所有观测到的分类错误均被路由至人工审查。100份生成报告全部通过一致性检查，平均延迟1.66秒。

Conclusion: 集成工作流的可行性得到验证，但作者强调需要进一步校准、重复评估和真实工业环境验证。系统对严重图像质量退化敏感，且选择性审查策略的自动覆盖率较低，说明距离实际工业部署仍有差距。

Abstract: This paper presents RobustDefect-LLM, an industrial surface-defect inspection framework integrating deep-learning classification, operator-facing visual evidence, confidence-aware decision support, controlled AI-assisted reporting, traceable storage, and mobile interaction in a unified quality-control workflow. Here, robustness-aware denotes explicit evaluation under controlled image degradation and confidence-aware review routing, not an intrinsic robustness guarantee. Four transfer-learning-based convolutional neural networks, ResNet50, EfficientNet-B0, DenseNet121, and MobileNetV3-Large, were evaluated on 1,799 images from the six-class NEU-DET dataset using fixed training, validation, and held-out in-domain test partitions. MobileNetV3-Large achieved the highest numerical test accuracy (99.26%) and macro F1-score (0.9926), with a bootstrap 95% accuracy CI of 0.9815-1.0000. An exact paired McNemar test found no significant difference from DenseNet121 (p = 1.000). The selected model averaged 0.060 s per CPU forward pass (16.66 FPS). Under combined synthetic degradation, accuracy fell to 87.78% at mild intensity and below 40% at stronger intensities, revealing sensitivity to severe image-quality deterioration. Grad-CAM supplied visual evidence, while predictions with confidence below 0.90 or a top-2 margin below 0.10 were routed to HUMAN REVIEW. This conservative policy provided 12.22% automatic coverage and 100% observed selective accuracy among 33 eligible cases (95% CI: 89.43%-100.00%), while routing both observed classification errors to review. Under nominal controlled conditions, all 100 generated reports passed deterministic consistency checks, with a mean latency of 1.66 s. Results support the feasibility of the integrated workflow while emphasizing the need for calibration, repeated evaluation, and real-world industrial validation.

</details>


### [91] [CDGC-Net: 3D Medical Image Segmentation with Cooperative Dual-Scale Self-Attention and Grouped Channel Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08575v1)
*Zheyang Jing,Qin Lu,Jianwang Li,Yujie Yang,Chen Yi,Shaofeng Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CDGC-Net，一种3D医学图像分割网络，通过合作双尺度空间注意力（CDSA）和分组层级通道注意力（GHCA）在同一特征层面同时建模局部细节与长程解剖上下文，并在Synapse、ACDC、BraTS、LA四个数据集上取得优于现有方法的分割精度，同时相比UNETR++显著降低参数量和计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D医学图像分割方法通常在分离的模块或特征级别上建模全局与局部特征，并对通道进行独立重标定，导致全局上下文与局部边界之间存在语义不匹配、通道关系建模不足、空间-通道交互弱以及特征表示冗余等问题。

Method: 提出CDGC-Net，其核心是CDGC块：1) 合作双尺度空间自注意力（CDSA）将注意力头分配到并行的局部窗口分支和全局稀疏分支，在同一特征级别捕捉细粒度空间细节与长程解剖上下文；2) 分组层级通道注意力（GHCA）将通道分为r组，建模组内与跨组依赖关系；3) CDSA与GHCA共享同一key投影以保持特征参考一致性；4) 残差特征对齐整合细化特征与原始表示。

Result: 在Synapse、ACDC、BraTS、LA数据集上平均DSC分别达到86.96%、92.91%、82.56%、93.52%，较次优方法分别提升0.39、0.47、0.17、0.32个百分点。模型参数量25.83M、FLOPs 28.62G（输入64×128×128），相比UNETR++分别降低39.87%和40.30%。

Conclusion: CDGC-Net通过在同一特征层面协同双尺度空间注意力与分组层级通道建模，在分割精度与计算复杂度之间取得了有利的平衡，验证了协同空间-通道建模在3D医学图像分割中的有效性。

Abstract: Accurate 3D medical image segmentation requires the integration of long-range anatomical context with fine boundary detail. Existing methods often model global and local features in separate modules or feature levels and perform channel recalibration independently. This may cause semantic mismatch between global context and local boundaries, insufficient channel relationship modeling, weak spatial-channel interaction, and redundant representations. We propose CDGC-Net, a 3D medical image segmentation network that combines cooperative dual-scale spatial attention with grouped hierarchical channel modeling. With-in each CDGC block, Cooperative Dual-Scale Self-Attention (CDSA) assigns attention heads to parallel local-window and global-sparse branches. The two branches capture fine spatial details and long-range anatomical context at the same feature level. Their outputs are concatenated into an $N\times C$ spatial representation and directly passed to Grouped Hierarchical Channel Attention (GHCA). GHCA organizes the channels into $r$ groups and models both within-group and cross-group dependencies. CDSA and GHCA reuse a shared key projection to maintain a consistent feature reference. Residual feature alignment subsequently integrates the refined features with the original representation. On the Synapse, ACDC, BraTS, and LA datasets, CDGC-Net achieved mean DSC values of 86.96\%, 92.91\%, 82.56\%, and 93.52\%, respectively, exceeding the next-highest reported values by 0.39, 0.47, 0.17, and 0.32 percentage points. CDGC-Net contains 25.83M parameters and 28.62G FLOPs for an input size of $64\times128\times128$, reducing these quantities by 39.87\% and 40.30\%, respectively, relative to UNETR++. These results indicate a favorable trade-off between segmentation accuracy and computational complexity.

</details>


### [92] [MotionCraft: Latent World Modeling with Sparse Attention for Visual Upscaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08553v1)
*Rong Fu,Chunlei Meng,Yangchen Zeng,Xiaowen Ma,Yongtai Liu,Wangyu Wu,Shuo Yin,Zijian Zhang,Sicheng Li,Yingrui Ji,Chenhao Wang,Simon Fong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MotionCraft是一个可控制的视频超分辨率（VSR）框架，将恢复任务建模为受世界模型启发的运动感知潜在状态预测，结合自适应稀疏注意力与显式用户可访问的控制接口，实现了在流式约束下的时间一致、高质量重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VSR方法在局部细节保真、长距离时空建模、感知真实感和效率之间存在权衡：卷积对齐方法在大运动或复杂退化下表现不佳，基于Transformer的方法计算开销大，潜在空间或扩散方法需要专门的时间约束以保持一致性。需要一个兼具可控制性、时间一致性和效率的统一框架。

Method: MotionCraft由三个核心组件构成：(1) 鲁棒运动融合模块，用于处理运动信息；(2) 潜在世界Transformer（Latent World Transformer），在保持局部性的同时实现有目标的非局部交互，通过自适应稀疏注意力平衡计算效率与建模能力；(3) 紧凑的条件解码器，在流式约束下输出时间一致的高质量重建。整体将超分辨率形式化为类似世界模型的运动感知潜在状态预测，并提供显式用户控制接口。

Result: 实证评估表明，MotionCraft在重建质量和感知性能方面均表现出色，同时能够在时间平滑度和重建保真度之间提供可预测的权衡，验证了其可控性设计。

Conclusion: MotionCraft通过结合世界模型启发的运动感知潜在状态预测、自适应稀疏注意力与用户可控接口，有效弥合了传统VSR方法在局部细节、长距离建模、感知质量和效率之间的鸿沟，提供了一种可预测权衡的实用解决方案。

Abstract: Video super-resolution (VSR) aims to recover high-fidelity high-resolution videos from low-resolution inputs and is central to applications ranging from mobile capture to streaming and archival restoration. Existing approaches trade off among local-detail fidelity, long-range spatio-temporal modeling, perceptual realism, and efficiency: convolutional alignment techniques preserve local structure but suffer when motion is large or degradations are complex; transformer-based methods capture long-range dependencies yet require architectural or algorithmic adaptations to remain computationally feasible; and recent latent or diffusion-based generators synthesize rich texture but require specialized temporal constraints to maintain coherence. We present MotionCraft, a controllable VSR framework that formulates restoration as motion-aware latent state prediction inspired by world models and integrates adaptive sparse attention with an explicit user-accessible control interface. MotionCraft combines robust motion fusion, a Latent World Transformer that balances locality and targeted non-local interactions, and a compact conditional decoder to deliver temporally consistent, high-quality reconstructions under streaming constraints. Empirical evaluations show that MotionCraft achieves strong reconstruction and perceptual performance while enabling predictable trade-offs between temporal smoothness and reconstruction fidelity.

</details>


### [93] [ERF-GS: Reconstructing Fast Motion from Disjoint Event-RGB Viewpoints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08531v1)
*Xiaoyang Bai,Zhenyang Li,Weiwei Xu,Edmund Y. Lam,Yifan Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ERF-GS框架，将事件相机信息融入3D高斯溅射（3DGS）的优化和致密化阶段，以实现快速运动场景的高保真动态三维重建，并在存在运动模糊和低帧率的真实场景数据上超越现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于帧式视频的动态三维重建方法在处理快速运动物体（如体育赛事、动物摄影）时面临挑战，运动模糊和低帧率导致重建精度下降，亟需利用事件相机的高时间分辨率优势来提升性能。

Method: ERF-GS框架将事件信息同时整合进高斯溅射的优化与致密化两个阶段，利用事件传感器的高帧率特性辅助动态场景重建；采用真实仿真设置训练，使事件学习部分与RGB输入解耦，从而适应复杂布局、低帧率及严重运动模糊的自然视频场景。

Result: 在Neu3D和Nvidia数据集的不同变体（包含模糊RGB帧和不重叠的RGB-事件视点）上，ERF-GS均优于4DGS基线和同期方法E-D3DGS。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 事件-RGB融合策略能有效解决快速运动场景的动态重建难题，且与RGB解耦的事件学习设计增强了方法的泛化能力，使其适用于真实世界的复杂自然视频。

Abstract: Deep learning-driven representations such as neural radiance fields (NeRFs) and 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) have revolutionized the field of dynamic 3D scene reconstruction with improved visual precision and scalability. However, the reconstruction of fast-moving objects remains a challenge; existing methods based on conventional frame-based videos often struggle in scenarios such as sports events and animal videography. We propose an event-RGB fusion Gaussian splatting (ERF-GS) framework that integrates event information into both optimization and densification stages of the Gaussian splatting pipeline, taking advantage of novel event sensors with high frame-rate. Unlike many other event-assisted scene reconstruction methods, ERF-GS was developed using realistic simulation settings and realizes event-based learning detached from RGB inputs. This design enables its application beyond straightforward synthetic data into the realm of natural video with complex layout, low frame rates and severe motion blur. Our experiments show that ERF-GS outperforms both the 4DGS baseline and the concurrent E-D3DGS on different variants of the Neu3D and Nvidia datasets which include blurry RGB frames and disjoint RGB-event viewpoints. Our code is available at https://github.com/andrewbxy/ERF-GS.

</details>


### [94] [Towards Adaptive Super-Resolution and Quality Assessment via Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08508v1)
*Ajeet Kumar Verma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于测试时自适应（TTA）的统一框架，用于解决真实场景下的视频超分辨率和感知质量建模问题。研究包含三个核心贡献：基于TTA的无参考视频质量评估框架、适用于屏幕内容超分辨率的Transformer架构、以及无需高分辨率真值即可选择性优化文本与非文本区域的区域感知TTA策略。实验证明其在多种基准上均能稳定提升感知质量和可读性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频超分辨率（VSR）方法在面对未知退化（由异构设备、编解码器和网络环境引起）时泛化能力不足，而真实场景中的退化类型往往无法提前预知，需要一种无需重新训练或高质量监督即可提升鲁棒性和感知质量的新范式。

Method: 1) 提出基于TTA的无参考视频质量评估框架，利用自适应质量预测为VSR在未见失真下提供感知引导；2) 设计基于Transformer的屏幕内容超分辨率架构，保留文本清晰度和结构保真度；3) 引入区域感知的TTA策略，无需高分辨率真值即可选择性优化文本与非文本区域。

Result: 在多个不同类型的基准数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法在感知质量和可读性方面均取得了一致的改善，验证了TTA范式在真实场景VSR中的有效性。

Conclusion: 该研究验证了测试时自适应作为统一范式在真实视频超分辨率中的可行性，并提出了迈向能够跨未知域泛化的全自适应视频增强系统的未来研究方向。

Abstract: This paper presents doctoral research on adaptive video super-resolution and perceptual quality modeling under real-world conditions. Existing video super-resolution (VSR) methods struggle to generalize under unknown degradations arising from heterogeneous devices, codecs, and network environments. We address this challenge through test-time adaptation (TTA), a unified paradigm that improves robustness and perceptual quality without retraining or high-quality supervision. Specifically, we: 1) propose a TTA-based framework for no-reference video quality assessment (VQA), where adapted quality predictions provide perceptual guidance for VSR under unseen distortions; 2) develop a transformer-based architecture for screen-content super-resolution that preserves text clarity and structural fidelity; and 3) introduce a region-aware TTA strategy that selectively refines text and non-text regions without requiring high-resolution ground truth. Experimental results across diverse benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in perceptual quality and readability. We also outline ongoing work toward fully adaptive video enhancement systems capable of generalizing across unseen domains.

</details>


### [95] [RayLift: Lifting Complementary Ray-Wise Evidence with 3D Geometry Priors for Semantic Scene Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08476v1)
*Meng Wang,Hongxia Yu,Wenzhe He,Xingdong Song,Huilong Pi,Jiapeng Zhang,Ruihui Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RayLift框架，利用立体几何作为度量参考并结合互补射线证据，自适应恢复可靠的3D结构，在SemanticKITTI和SSCBench-KITTI-360上取得优于现有方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于相机的3D语义场景补全（SSC）方法往往将立体深度估计视为确定性几何约束，导致深度不确定性和局部对应误差直接传播到体素表示中，影响场景理解的可靠性。

Method: RayLift包含三个核心模块：1) Complementary Context Encoder从冻结的3D视觉基础模型中提取几何感知先验以丰富场景上下文；2) Depth Ray Evidence Lifter联合建模几何不相似性、深度置信度和空间不确定性，沿每条相机射线自适应采样和加权候选表面位置；3) Semantic-Aware Voxel Integrator通过显式建模射线证据的空间支持将其注入体素特征。

Result: 在SemanticKITTI和SSCBench-KITTI-360数据集上的大量实验表明，RayLift取得了有竞争力的性能，并一致优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过将立体几何作为度量参考而非确定性约束，并引入互补射线证据进行自适应结构恢复，能够有效缓解深度不确定性带来的负面影响，提升3D语义场景补全的准确性。

Abstract: Camera-based 3D semantic scene completion (SSC) provides comprehensive scene understanding for autonomous driving and robotics. However, existing methods often treat stereo depth estimates as deterministic geometric constraints, causing depth uncertainty and local correspondence errors to propagate directly into voxel representations. To address this issue, we propose RayLift, a framework that uses stereo geometry as a metric reference while incorporating complementary ray evidence to recover reliable 3D structures adaptively. RayLift first employs a Complementary Context Encoder that extracts geometry-aware priors from a frozen 3D vision foundation model, thereby enriching the scene context. It then introduces a Depth Ray Evidence Lifter module that jointly models geometric dissimilarity, depth confidence, and spatial uncertainty to adaptively sample and weight candidate surface locations along each camera ray. Finally, a Semantic-Aware Voxel Integrator injects the resulting ray evidence into voxel features by explicitly modeling their spatial support. Extensive experiments on SemanticKITTI and SSCBench-KITTI-360 demonstrate that RayLift achieves competitive performance and consistently outperforms existing methods.

</details>


### [96] [InstructionCrafter: Generating Consistent and High-Fidelity Visual Instructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08460v1)
*Shun Okamoto,Satoshi Iizuka,Kazuhiro Fukui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出InstructionCrafter，一个基于扩散模型的框架，用于根据文本任务指令生成逐步视觉指令图像序列。其核心思想是通过"空间层冻结训练"和"指令感知适配器"来分离时间/指令对齐与逐帧视觉质量的优化，同时满足步骤忠实性、跨图一致性和逐帧视觉质量三个属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从文本指令生成逐步视觉指令（图像序列）需要同时满足三个属性：步骤忠实性（step faithfulness）、跨图像一致性（cross-image consistency）和逐帧视觉质量（per-frame visual quality）。现有方法难以同时满足这三者：文本到图像生成方法因独立采样而破坏一致性；在低质量视频上微调会降低逐帧质量；冻结主干网络则缺乏多步骤理解能力。

Method: InstructionCrafter基于预训练的视频扩散主干构建，采用两种关键策略：(1) 空间冻结训练——冻结控制逐帧细节的空间层，仅更新时间层和文本条件路径，以学习指令语义和步骤间关系，从而保留生成先验以保证逐帧质量，并将可训练参数减少约50%；(2) 两个轻量级适配器——Consistent Adapter聚合整个指令序列和相邻步骤的文本线索以保持物体身份和属性的一致性；Context-Aware Temporal Adapter将交叉注意力输出转换为时间自注意力的偏置，显式地传播帧间关系。

Result: 在两个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在步骤忠实性、跨图像一致性和逐帧视觉质量上实现了最先进的整体性能，同时显著减少了噪声、模糊和虚假字幕。

Conclusion: 通过解耦时间/指令对齐与逐帧视觉质量的优化，InstructionCrafter能在保持高视觉质量的同时实现步骤忠实和跨帧一致，为逐步视觉指令生成提供了有效的解决方案，且代码和训练模型将公开发布。

Abstract: Given textual task instructions, generating step-by-step visual instructions as an image sequence requires the simultaneous satisfaction of multiple properties, specifically step faithfulness, cross-image consistency, and per-frame visual quality. Existing text-to-image generation approaches rarely meet all three properties, owing to independent sampling that breaks consistency, finetuning on low-quality video that degrades per-frame quality, and frozen backbones that lack multi-step understanding. In this work, we propose InstructionCrafter, a diffusion-based framework with the key idea of separating the optimization of temporal and instructional alignment from per-frame visual quality via (1) spatial-freeze training and (2) instruction-aware adapters. Built on a pretrained video diffusion backbone, InstructionCrafter freezes the spatial layers that control per-frame detail and updates only temporal and text-conditioning pathways to learn instruction semantics and inter-step relations, which preserves the generative prior for per-frame quality and reduces trainable parameters by about 50 percent compared with full finetuning. We also introduce two lightweight adapters that enhance the model's understanding of instructional context. The Consistent Adapter aggregates textual cues from the entire instruction sequence and from neighboring steps to keep object identity and attributes consistent across frames, and the Context-Aware Temporal Adapter converts cross-attention outputs into biases for temporal self-attention, explicitly propagating inter-frame relations. Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art overall performance on step faithfulness, cross-image consistency, and per-frame visual quality while significantly reducing noise, blur, and spurious subtitles. Our code and trained models will be publicly available.

</details>


### [97] [Anatomically Consistent Cross-Contrast Super-Resolution of Anisotropic Brain T2w MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08401v1)
*Mengqi Shen,Haicheng Wang,Meghna Trivedi,Tony J. Wang,Yuanguang Xu,Yingyan Zeng,Yading Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VIPP-SR是一种无需各向同性T2w金标准即可恢复各向异性T2w脑MRI层间分辨率的跨对比度引导超分辨率框架。该方法利用VIP-GAN学习T1c到T2w的局部解剖对应关系，从轴位、冠状位和矢状位三个正交视图生成T2w估计，再通过基于投影的优化在保持解剖一致性的同时融合三个视图。在BraTS-MET和BraTS-GLI（零样本）上，该方法将下游分割的平均Dice从0.330提升至0.465、从0.473提升至0.563，消融实验表明层间自一致性是主要增益来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: T2w脑MRI虽然提供重要的流体敏感软组织对比度，但采集时体素各向异性，导致冠状面和矢状面视图模糊或呈阶梯状，影响小结构辨识以及下游3D分析。现有的各向同性T2w金标准难以获取，因此需要在没有各向同性参考的情况下恢复T2w容积的层间分辨率。

Method: VIPP-SR包含三个核心部分：（1）训练视图无关的分块生成器VIP-GAN，从高分辨率轴位切片学习T1c到T2w的局部解剖对应关系；（2）将训练好的生成器分别应用于T1c容积的轴位、冠状位和矢状位视图，生成三个正交方向的T2w估计，其中形状保持分块和最深跳连移除用于减少视图特定捷径，促使生成器学习分块局部表示以实现零样本层间迁移；（3）基于投影的优化融合三个视图体积，通过平衡层间自一致性与各视图数据保真度来强制解剖一致性。

Result: 在BraTS-MET测试集上，VIPP-SR将下游分割平均Dice从0.330提升至0.465；在无需重新训练的BraTS-GLI队列上零样本将Dice从0.473提升至0.563。消融研究证实层间自一致性是性能提升的主要来源。

Conclusion: VIPP-SR证明了仅利用高分辨率轴位T1c-T2w配对的跨对比度学习，结合多视图投影优化，可以在无各向同性T2w金标准的条件下有效恢复各向异性T2w容积的层间分辨率，提升下游分割性能，并具有良好的跨队列泛化能力。

Abstract: T2-weighted (T2w) brain MRI provides fluid-sensitive soft-tissue contrast that is important for neuro-oncology and radiotherapy planning. However, T2w scans are acquired with anisotropic voxels and appear blurred or stair-stepped on coronal and sagittal views, which obscures small structures and weakens any downstream 3D analysis. We propose VIPP-SR (View-Independent Patched Projection Super-Resolution), a cross-contrast guided super-resolution framework that restores the inter-plane resolution of an existing anisotropic T2w volume without an isotropic ground-truth T2w. VIPP-SR first trains a view-independent patched generator (VIP-GAN) to learn local T1c-to-T2w anatomical correspondence from high-resolution axial slices. The trained generator is then applied to axial, coronal, and sagittal views of the T1c volume to generate three orthogonal T2w estimates. Shape-preserving patching and deepest-skip removal reduce view-specific shortcuts, thereby constraining the generator to learn patch-local representations and enabling the zero-shot inter-plane transfer. Central to VIPP-SR, a projection-based optimization then enforces anatomical consistency across the three view-specific volumes, fusing them by balancing inter-plane self-consistency against per-view data fidelity. The generator is trained on BraTS-MET and evaluated on both the held-out BraTS-MET testing set and the BraTS-GLI cohort without retraining, assessing the cross-cohort generalizability. The results validate that VIPP-SR improves downstream segmentation over the real anisotropic T2w baseline, raising mean-label Dice from 0.330 to 0.465 on BraTS-MET and, zero-shot, from 0.473 to 0.563 on BraTS-GLI and ablation studies identify inter-plane self-consistency as the main source of the gain.

</details>


### [98] [DoRF++: Spherical Representation Learning over Doppler Radiance Fields for Robust Wi-Fi Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08381v1)
*Navid Hasanzadeh,Shahrokh Valaee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DoRF（Doppler Radiance Fields），将神经辐射场（NeRF）概念从计算机视觉引入Wi-Fi感知领域。DoRF将Wi-Fi CSI提取的多普勒速度投影建模为稀疏且多样化的虚拟相机视角，推断潜在的3D运动序列，并将其投影到单位球面上的等角网格，形成运动的球面表示。在此基础上，DoRF++进一步采用球面Transformer进行活动分类，在跨用户泛化准确率上显著优于现有Wi-Fi HAR方法，尤其在单多天线接收AP的困难手势场景下表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wi-Fi CSI用于被动、无设备、隐私保护的活动与手势识别虽受关注，但跨用户和未知条件下的可靠泛化仍是主要挑战，阻碍了Wi-Fi感知在真实世界的实际部署应用。现有的基于多普勒速度投影的HAR方法虽然在泛化性上有所提升，但仍不足以应对真实世界的多变环境。

Method: DoRF借鉴NeRF思想，将CSI导出的多普勒速度投影视为人类运动的稀疏虚拟相机视图，推断一个潜在3D运动序列，其沿学习到的有效多普勒方向的投影可解释CSI观测。恢复的运动随后投影到单位球面的等角方向网格上，产生运动的三维球面表示。DoRF++在此球面表示上引入球面Transformer进行活动分类。

Result: 在自采集的手势数据集上，DoRF++在跨用户泛化准确率上显著优于最先进的Wi-Fi HAR方法，尤其在单个多天线接收AP设置下的困难手势识别中表现突出。

Conclusion: DoRF/DoRF++验证了将神经辐射场概念从视觉领域迁移到Wi-Fi感知的可行性与有效性，为利用球面几何进行人类运动建模和跨用户泛化提供了新范式，有望推动Wi-Fi感知在真实世界的落地应用。

Abstract: Motivated by the IEEE 802.11bf effort to standardize advanced WLAN sensing, interest in Wi-Fi Channel State Information (CSI) for passive, device-free, and privacy-preserving activity and gesture recognition has grown rapidly. Recent studies have shown that Doppler velocity projections extracted from CSI, which directly reflect human-motion velocity, enable more robust human activity recognition (HAR) and stronger generalization across users and unseen conditions. Nevertheless, reliable generalization under real-world variability remains a major challenge, hindering the adoption of Wi-Fi sensing in real-world applications. To address this challenge, we introduce Doppler Radiance Fields (DoRF), bringing the concept of neural radiance fields (NeRF) from computer vision into Wi-Fi sensing. DoRF models Doppler velocity projections extracted from Wi-Fi CSI as sparse and diverse virtual-camera views of human motion. It then infers a latent 3D motion sequence whose projections along learned effective Doppler directions explain the CSI-derived Doppler observations. The recovered motion is subsequently projected onto an equiangular grid of directions on the unit sphere, producing a spherical representation of the underlying motion. Since DoRF naturally defines the Doppler representation on spheres, we further introduce DoRF++, a spherical-learning design that applies spherical Transformers for activity classification. Experiments on our collected hand-gesture dataset show that DoRF++ significantly outperforms state-of-the-art Wi-Fi-based HAR methods in cross-user generalization accuracy, especially for difficult gestures in settings with a single multi-antenna receiver access point (AP).

</details>


### [99] [Three Necessary Principles for Self-Supervised Visual Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08309v1)
*Nikos Giakoumoglou,Paschalis Giakoumoglou,Tania Stathaki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文论证了无标签视觉表征学习需要三个目标（跨视图语义不变性、块级空间预测、表征非退化）联合互补，并通过理论证明与受控实验表明三者缺一不可，所有主流自监督方法均可归纳为统一能量分解的特例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督视觉表征学习的方法众多，但对各训练目标（如对比对齐、空间预测、动量编码器防坍缩）各自的作用及其相互作用缺乏统一理论和严格分析，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 将三个目标形式化为观测、预测与正则化原则；通过数学证明分析恒定编码器作为全局最小解的条件、两目标的梯度互补性与结构非冲突性、动量编码器的固定点与坍缩行为；并通过受控实验逐条验证理论结论。

Result: 证明了无正则化时观测与预测结合会以恒定编码器为全局最优；观测与预测在编码器输出处梯度互补且结构上不冲突；动量编码器收敛到与在线编码器相同的固定点且不提供收敛时的坍缩保证。对比对齐仅提供自限性坍缩抵抗。每个目标都有不可替代性，所有主流自监督方法是统一能量分解的特例。

Conclusion: 三个目标必须联合才能学习有效的视觉表征，任何单独或两两组合都无法替代第三个目标；该统一框架为理解与设计自监督表征学习方法提供了理论基础。

Abstract: We argue that learning visual representations without labels requires a training signal jointly complete across three non-overlapping objectives: semantic invariance across augmented views, patch-level spatial prediction, and representational non-degeneracy. We formalize these as the observation, prediction, and regularization principles and prove (i) that combining observation and prediction without regularization admits the constant encoder as a global minimizer under negative-free alignment; (ii) that the two objectives are gradient-complementary and structurally non-conflicting at the encoder output; and (iii) that the momentum encoder converges to the same fixed point as the online encoder and provides no collapse guarantee at convergence. Contrastive alignment provides only self-limiting collapse resistance, formalized via an explicit gradient-decay argument. Dropping prediction withholds the spatial training signal by construction; dropping observation forfeits cross-view semantic invariance by construction; at the scale we study, no pair substitutes for the third. Every major self-supervised method is a special case of a single unified energy decomposition. We pair every theoretical claim with a controlled experiment, including a patch-retrieval evaluation for the spatial consequence of prediction.

</details>


### [100] [Frequency-Domain Dual-Branch Fusion for Medical Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08307v1)
*Yusra Tariq,Rakesh Chandra Joshi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种双分支频域融合模块用于医学视觉问答（Medical VQA），通过对频谱滤波进行问题条件化，自适应选择低频全局结构与高频细节，并结合冻结的BiomedCLIP编码器提取的纹理敏感与语义层特征，以及对称InfoNCE对齐和BioBART解码器，在PMC-VQA上预训练并在VQA-RAD和SLAKE上微调，实现了轻量高效的医学VQA性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学VQA的多模态融合方法主要在空间域操作，未能充分利用视觉与文本表示中互补的频率信息。医学图像中的关键诊断证据（如病灶纹理、边界锐度、弥散密度变化）在频域中具有独特表征，需要一种能够自适应利用频域信息的融合机制来提升对齐质量。

Method: 提出双分支频域融合模块，以输入问题为条件对频谱进行滤波，实现自适应选择全局低频结构和细粒度高频细节，再重建空间表示用于答案生成。从冻结的BiomedCLIP编码器的早期纹理敏感层和最终语义层提取互补特征，通过对称InfoNCE目标与问题表示对齐，随后采用BioBART解码器进行分阶段联合训练。

Result: 在PMC-VQA上预训练后，在VQA-RAD和SLAKE基准上进行微调和评估，结果表明频域感知的多模态融合有效提升了医学VQA性能，同时保持了轻量高效的架构。

Conclusion: 频率感知的多模态融合能够更好地挖掘医学图像与临床语言之间的互补信息，在保持计算效率的前提下改善医学VQA性能，验证了频域条件化滤波策略的有效性。

Abstract: Medical Visual Question Answering (VQA) requires aligning subtle visual evidence, including lesion texture, boundary sharpness, and diffuse density changes, with clinical language. Existing multimodal fusion approaches operating in the spatial domain may not fully exploit complementary frequency information present in visual and textual representations. We introduce a dual-branch frequency-domain fusion module that conditions spectral filtering on the input question, enabling adaptive selection of global low-frequency structure and fine-grained high-frequency detail before reconstructing the spatial representation for answer generation. To provide a richer spectrum for filtering, we extract complementary features from early texture-sensitive and final semantic layers of a frozen BiomedCLIP encoder and align both with the question representation using a symmetric InfoNCE objective prior to staged joint training with a BioBART decoder. We pretrain the proposed model on PMC-VQA and fine-tune it on the VQA-RAD and SLAKE benchmarks, demonstrating that frequency-aware multimodal fusion improves medical VQA performance while maintaining a lightweight and efficient architecture.

</details>


### [101] [VTO: Visual Tool Orchestration for Video Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08219v1)
*Rui Wang,Yeteng Wu,Xianling Zhang,Mengshi Qi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VTO，一个基于过程监督强化学习的视频异常检测（VAD）多模态智能体框架。VTO通过基础模型驱动的认知评估器提供上下文感知语义反馈，并结合过程监督认知对齐实现细粒度逐步监督，显式惩罚逻辑截断并奖励完整因果链，从而优化多步推理策略。作者还构建了包含12个专业视觉工具的层次化工具集VAD-Tool及其基准，实验表明VTO在工具调度上比基线方法绝对精度提升最高10.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统深度学习方法在跨场景泛化上存在根本性局限；现有依赖监督微调的多模态智能体难以处理复杂工具编排；标准强化学习因粗粒度结果奖励导致推理过早终止。因此需要一种能动态探索环境并提供细粒度逐步监督的过程监督强化学习框架。

Method: VTO框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 基础模型驱动的认知评估器，提供上下文感知的语义反馈；(2) 过程监督认知对齐（Process-Supervised Cognitive Alignment），提供细粒度的逐步监督。通过显式惩罚逻辑截断并奖励完整因果链，智能体得以优化多步推理策略以进行相互关联的工具编排。此外，构建了VAD-Tool层次化视觉工具集（12个专业视觉工具，覆盖实体追踪到高危险检测）及相应基准。

Result: 在VAD-Tool基准上的大量实验表明，VTO显著优于基线方法，在工具调度任务上取得了最高10.2%的绝对准确率提升。

Conclusion: VTO通过过程监督强化学习范式有效解决了现有VAD多模态智能体在复杂工具编排方面的不足，验证了细粒度逐步监督和动态环境交互对提升视频异常检测性能的有效性，并提供了公开的工具集与基准以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is a critical yet challenging task due to the complex and diverse nature of real-world scenarios. Traditional deep learning approaches are fundamentally limited by poor generalization across diverse scenarios. While multimodal agents offer a promising tool-learning paradigm for VAD, current systems relying on supervised fine-tuning struggle with complex orchestration, and standard reinforcement learning often causes premature termination due to coarse-grained outcome rewards. To address these challenges, we propose VTO, a process-supervised reinforcement learning framework. Moving beyond static tool usage, VTO enables the agent to dynamically explore and interact with the environment. Specifically, we introduce a foundation model-driven cognitive evaluator to provide context-aware semantic feedback, which is seamlessly integrated into a Process-Supervised Cognitive Alignment that delivers fine-grained, step-wise supervision. By explicitly penalizing logical truncation and rewarding complete causal chains, the agent optimizes its multi-step reasoning policy for interrelated tool orchestration. To support our proposed framework, we meticulously crafted VAD-Tool, a hierarchical visual tool set comprising 12 specialized vision tools spanning from entity tracking to high-stakes hazard detection, and established the corresponding benchmark for rigorous multi-step reasoning evaluation. Extensive experiments on VAD-Tool demonstrate that VTO significantly outperforms baselines, achieving up to a 10.2\% absolute accuracy improvement in tool scheduling. Code and data are available at https://github.com/MICLAB-BUPT/VTO.

</details>


### [102] [Wiener Representation Filtering for VLM Hallucination Suppression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08167v1)
*Ameen Ali,Tamim Zoabi,Lidor Brami,Lior Wolf*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需训练的、事后表示编辑技术来抑制视觉语言模型（VLM）中的对象幻觉。该方法在语言骨干的表示空间中操作，通过对配对数据集进行一次性离线校准估计协方差结构，仅需前向传播和二阶统计量，不涉及梯度更新或微调。通过将隐藏状态建模为真实与幻觉分量的叠加，推导出Wiener型估计器，闭式给出最优增益，并经特征分解实现满足稳定性准则的模态逐步衰减。校正仅应用于选定深层的前馈输出投影，推理时模型保持不变且速度相同。在LLaVA-1.5、MiniGPT-4、Gemma3、mPLUG-Owl2上的CHAIR、POPE、MME基准中一致减少对象幻觉，同时保持流畅性和响应质量，并在TempCompass视频基准和离散扩散语言模型上展示泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM虽在开放描述和视觉QA上表现出色，但经常描述图像中不存在的对象、属性或关系（即对象幻觉）。现有缓解方法往往需要微调或训练期间干预，作者希望提出一种轻量、无需训练的后期校正方案，在保持推理效率和模型不变的前提下抑制幻觉。

Method: 方法核心包括：(1) 在语言骨干的表示空间中，将隐藏状态建模为真实信息与幻觉关联分量的叠加；(2) 利用小型配对数据集的真实与幻觉表示，通过前向传播计算二阶统计量（协方差矩阵），推导出闭式最优增益的Wiener型估计器；(3) 对滤波器进行特征分解，实现逐模态衰减，并施加稳定性准则使滤波器对估计噪声连续响应；(4) 将校正一次性吸收到模型已有权重中，仅修改选定深层的前馈输出投影矩阵，推理时无需额外计算开销。

Result: 在LLaVA-1.5、MiniGPT-4、Gemma3和mPLUG-Owl2四个模型上，CHAIR、POPE、MME三个基准中一致降低对象幻觉，同时保持描述流畅性和整体响应质量。在TempCompass视频理解基准上同样有效，并推广到离散扩散语言模型中的接地对话，证明在时间视频推理和多步序列级去噪场景中表示过滤也能减少幻觉。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过离线校准得到的闭式Wiener型滤波器可以直接嵌入VLM现有权重中，在推理时无额外成本地抑制对象幻觉。方法的训练自由、模型无关特性使其具有广泛适用性，不仅能处理静止图像幻觉，还能推广到视频推理和离散扩散语言模型等更复杂场景，为VLM幻觉缓解提供了轻量高效的实用方案。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) excel at open-ended captioning and visual QA but often describe objects, attributes, or relations absent from the image, a phenomenon known as object hallucination. We propose a {training-free, post-hoc representation editing technique} that operates in the representation space of the language backbone. The method performs a lightweight, one-time offline calibration on a modest paired dataset to estimate the required covariance structures, using only forward passes and empirical second-order statistics with no gradient updates or fine-tuning, after which the correction is absorbed directly into the model's existing weights. By modeling hidden states as a superposition of truthful and hallucination-associated components, we derive a Wiener-type estimator whose optimal gains are given in closed form from the covariances of paired truthful and hallucinated representations. An eigendecomposition yields mode-wise attenuation that respects a stability criterion, i.e., the filter responds continuously to estimation noise. The correction is applied once to the feed-forward output projections of selected deeper layers, at inference time, the model runs unchanged and at the same speed. Experiments on LLaVA-1.5, MiniGPT-4, Gemma3, and mPLUG-Owl2 demonstrate consistent reductions in object hallucination on CHAIR, POPE, and MME while maintaining caption fluency and overall response quality. We further demonstrate the generality of our approach on the TempCompass video understanding benchmark and on discrete diffusion language models for grounded dialogue, showing that representation filtering reduces hallucinations even in temporal video reasoning and multi-step, sequence-wide denoising settings.

</details>


### [103] [Compositional Cross-Modality Translation via Whole-Volume Multitask Latent Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08135v1)
*Daniele Molino,Alessio Zoboli,Camillo Maria Caruso,Valerio Guarrasi,Paolo Soda*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种跨模态医学图像翻译方法，通过大规模预训练3D变分自编码器作为体积先验，将翻译问题压缩为条件流匹配问题，从而支持全容积处理和多任务联合训练。单个模型在MRI→CT、CBCT→CT和MRI→MRI等多个任务上超越或匹配任务特定基线，并展现出零样本泛化和组合式跨数据集翻译能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨模态医学图像翻译方法受两个耦合限制约束：只能处理2D切片或3D patch而非全容积，且每个翻译任务需要单独训练模型。这两个问题的根本原因在于缺乏足够强的体积先验，迫使生成模型同时学习解剖外观和跨模态映射，在配对数据规模下属于病态问题。作者旨在通过解耦这两个目标来突破这一瓶颈。

Method: 1) 利用大规模预训练的3D变分自编码器（VAE）提供紧凑的体积外观潜在表示，将翻译简化为潜在空间中的条件流匹配问题；2) 通过压缩使全容积处理变得可行，并采用分辨率感知采样策略保留原生解剖尺度；3) 在多个模态间（MRI→CT, CBCT→CT）和模态内（MRI→MRI）任务上联合训练单个统一模型，覆盖三个多中心数据集。

Result: 全容积处理在所有任务上优于基于patch的方案；多任务模型匹配任务特定基线性能的同时将N个网络替换为1个；联合训练实现零样本泛化到训练中未见过的解剖区域（与全监督模型相差仅0.15 SSIM以内）；支持从未直接监督的路径进行组合式跨数据集翻译。

Conclusion: 结合强体积先验与多任务训练是构建超越训练分布泛化的图像合成系统的可扩展路径，为通用医学图像翻译框架提供了可行性论证。

Abstract: Cross-modality medical image translation can reduce the burden of multi-modal acquisitions, yet the field remains constrained by two coupled limitations: methods operate on 2D slices or 3D patches rather than whole volumes, and train a separate model for each translation task. Both stem from a single cause, the absence of a sufficiently strong volumetric prior, which forces generative models to learn anatomical appearance and cross-modality mapping simultaneously, an ill-posed problem at the scale of available paired datasets. We propose to decouple these objectives. A large-scale pretrained 3D variational autoencoder provides a compact latent representation of volumetric appearance, reducing translation to a conditional flow-matching problem. This compression makes whole-volume processing tractable, while a resolution-aware sampling strategy preserves native anatomical scale. We train a single model jointly across inter-modality (MRI$\to$CT, CBCT$\to$CT) and intra-modality (MRI$\to$MRI) tasks over three multi-center datasets. Across all tasks, whole-volume processing outperforms its patch-based counterpart, and the multi-task model matches task-specific baselines while replacing $N$ networks with one. Crucially, joint training unlocks capabilities inaccessible to task-specific approaches: zero-shot generalization to anatomical regions unseen during training, within 0.15 SSIM of the fully supervised model, and compositional cross-dataset translation along paths never directly supervised. These results suggest that combining a strong volumetric prior with multitask training is a scalable route toward synthesis systems that generalize beyond their training distribution. Code is available at https://github.com/arco-group/Whole-Volume-Latent-FM.

</details>


### [104] [EvBS: Event-guided Blur Synthesis for Domain-adaptive Motion Deblurring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08066v1)
*Junsik Jung,Seokryun Choi,Yoonki Cho,Woo Jae Kim,Andrew Jeong,Sung-Eui Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EvBS，一个基于事件相机的运动模糊合成框架，通过解耦运动与视觉内容，生成多样化的训练对来校准预训练去模糊模型以适应目标域，解决了现实场景中的域偏移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练的去模糊模型在现实场景中因训练与测试分布之间的域偏移而性能下降，现有方法受限于运动与视觉内容之间的固有纠缠，难以有效生成多样化的适应性训练数据。

Method: EvBS利用事件相机的高时间分辨率来解耦运动与视觉内容，包含两种互补策略：内在模糊合成（Intrinsic-Blur Synthesis），用自身运动模式模糊清晰内容；外在模糊合成（Extrinsic-Blur Synthesis），将模糊patch的运动转移到不同的清晰内容上。通过微调实现目标域的自适应。

Result: 多个基准上的大量实验表明，EvBS能有效增强现有去模糊模型在未见测试数据集上的鲁棒性，提升域自适应去模糊性能。

Conclusion: EvBS通过事件引导的运动-内容解耦合成，打破了自然耦合运动与内容的固有约束，生成了多样化训练对，有效提升了预训练去模糊模型的域自适应能力。

Abstract: Motion deblurring has achieved remarkable progress with deep learning, yet pre-trained deblurring models often suffer from performance degradation in real-world scenarios due to the domain shift between training and testing distributions. To remedy this, we propose EvBS, an event-guided blur synthesis framework that generates diverse training pairs for calibrating pre-trained models to the target domain. While existing methods are constrained by the inherent entanglement between motion and visual content, our method leverages the high temporal resolution of event cameras to effectively decouple them. This enables us to utilize not only the intrinsic motion that is inherent to the given content but also extrinsic motion transferred from different sources within the target domain, thereby facilitating effective adaptation via fine-tuning. Specifically, EvBS comprises two complementary strategies: Intrinsic-Blur Synthesis, which blurs sharp contents with their own motion patterns, and Extrinsic-Blur Synthesis, which transfers motion from blurry patches to distinct sharp content. This approach generates a diverse set of training pairs that break the inherent constraints of naturally coupled motion and content, resulting in enhanced domain-adaptive deblurring performance. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that EvBS effectively enhances the robustness of existing deblurring models on unseen testing datasets.

</details>


### [105] [EgoTrack3D: A Modular Framework for Egocentric 3D Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08016v1)
*Jan Kulik,Bjarni Dagur Thor Karason,Yung-Hsu Yang,Boyang Sun,Marc Pollefeys,Xi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoTrack3D是一个模块化框架，直接从第一视角RGB视频中重建并维护动态3D场景表示，通过将2D分割掩码提升到全局3D坐标系，并利用点级运动评分和体素级合并启发式来关联物体轨迹，在Aria Digital Twin数据集上相较于最强基线实现了11%的位置正确率提升，并展示了在稀疏深度和噪声观测下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从第一视角视频理解3D场景对机器人和自主导航至关重要，但快速视角变化和部分遮挡使得构建结构化表示具有挑战性。现有3D追踪和场景图构建方法主要处理显式交互或假设静态场景，无法捕捉复杂动态。

Method: EgoTrack3D采用模块化设计：将2D分割掩码提升到全局3D坐标系，使用点级运动评分机制与体素级合并启发式相结合来关联物体轨迹，从而实现静态和动态物体的持久3D追踪。

Result: 在Aria Digital Twin数据集上，EgoTrack3D相较于最强基线实现了11%的位置正确率（PCL）提升。在退化条件下（稀疏3D边界框估计替代密集深度图并结合交互引导的动态关联），系统仍能保持准确的时空表示。

Conclusion: EgoTrack3D能够从第一视角RGB视频中实现更通用的动态3D场景理解和持久追踪，同时在实际部署的噪声观测和退化条件下保持鲁棒性，为机器人导航和自主系统提供了有效的3D场景表示解决方案。

Abstract: Understanding 3D scenes from egocentric video is fundamental for robotics and autonomous navigation, yet rapid viewpoint changes and partial occlusions make building structured representations challenging. Existing 3D tracking and scene graph construction methods primarily address explicit interactions or assume static scenes, limiting their ability to capture complex dynamics. We introduce EgoTrack3D, a modular framework that reconstructs and maintains a dynamic 3D scene representation directly from egocentric RGB video. The framework lifts 2D segmentation masks into a global 3D coordinate frame, using a point-based motion scoring mechanism alongside a voxel-based merging heuristic to associate object tracks. EgoTrack3D maintains accurate representations over time, achieving an 11% improvement in percentage of correct locations (PCL) relative to the strongest baseline on the Aria Digital Twin (ADT) dataset, while addressing the more general setting of persistent 3D tracking for both static and dynamic objects. Furthermore, to demonstrate the system's robustness under degraded conditions that simulate real-world deployment constraints, we replace dense depth maps with sparse 3D bounding box estimation and integrate interaction-guided dynamic association, enabling EgoTrack3D to maintain accurate spatial representations despite noisy observations.

</details>


### [106] [Evidence-Grounded Forensic Reasoning for Detecting and Grounding Multi-Modal Media Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08009v1)
*Yichun Yeh,Yiheng Li,Xiaobo Hu,Zhen Lei,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EFR框架，通过Anchor-and-Verify推理链、可验证奖励系统和模态解耦优势路由机制，实现多模态伪造检测的可解释性与证据-结论一致性验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测方法（DGM4）产生黑盒检测结果且缺乏决策依据，而直接应用MLLM面临两个难题：解释与证据位置脱节导致不可验证的归因；强制证据-结论一致性需要主动优化，但统一训练信号无法区分定位token与分类token，导致多头联合训练不可靠。

Method: 提出基于证据接地的法证推理框架EFR。包含三个关键组件：(1) Anchor-and-Verify推理链：强制模态隔离感知后进行跨模态比较，以结论坐标为显式锚点约束下游证据在空间上对应；(2) 可验证奖励系统：在训练中强制证据-结论一致性；(3) 模态解耦优势路由机制：缓解跨预测任务间的信用分配错误。

Result: EFR在DGM4任务上达到最先进性能，且生成结构化的法证推理记录，明确将解释绑定到证据。

Conclusion: EFR通过显式锚定和验证机制成功弥合了伪造检测中解释与证据之间的鸿沟，提供了既准确又可验证的跨模态伪造检测方案。

Abstract: Fake news increasingly relies on cross-modal image-text forgeries, making transparent and verifiable reasoning chains an urgent need for Detecting and Grounding Multi-Modal Media Manipulation (DGM4). Existing methods produce black-box detection results without any decision rationale, limiting their reliability in forensic practice. Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a natural path toward explainability, but applying them to DGM4 raises two difficulties. First, models tend to generate explanations disconnected from predicted evidence locations, producing unverified attribution. Second, enforcing evidence-conclusion consistency requires active optimization, yet uniform training signals fail to distinguish localization tokens from classification tokens, making multi-head joint training unreliable. We propose a multi-modal manipulation detector based on an Evidence-Grounded Forensic Reasoning (EFR) framework. EFR introduces an Anchor-and-Verify reasoning chain that enforces modality-isolated perception before cross-modal comparison, with conclusion coordinates as explicit anchors to which downstream evidence must spatially correspond. A verifiable reward system then enforces evidence-conclusion consistency during training, while a Modality-Decoupled Advantage (MDA) routing mechanism mitigats credit misassignment across prediction tasks. Experiments show that EFR achieves state-of-the-art performance while producing structured forensic reasoning records that explicitly bind explanations to evidence.

</details>


### [107] [Advantage-Guided Gate: Reshaping Open-Ended Reasoning for Vision-Based Spatial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07987v1)
*Ling Lin,Yang Bai,Congcong Zhu,Jiangming Shi,Meng Wang,Yang Long,Jingrun Chen,Ling Shao,Huazhu Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一个优势引导的门控框架（Advantage-Guided Gating Framework），通过将多模态大模型的逐步推理建模为有限时域决策过程，引入蒙特卡洛价值评估提供中间监督信号，利用Step-Advantage Gate和Trajectory-Advantage Gate动态选择高价值推理步骤和高质量推理轨迹，显著提升MLLM在视觉空间理解与推理任务中的准确性和稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在复杂空间场景理解和推理任务中展现出潜力，但其开放式推理过程容易出现决策错误和错误累积，导致答案质量不稳定。现有方法缺乏对中间推理过程的干预和校正机制。

Method: 1) 将逐步推理建模为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程；2) 在推理树上引入蒙特卡洛价值评估生成中间监督信号；3) 设计Step-Advantage Gate和Trajectory-Advantage Gate分别动态选择高价值推理步骤和高质量完整推理轨迹；4) 通过多分支采样生成推理树进行门控的监督学习；5) 采用共享参数初始化与任务特定head相结合实现跨任务鲁棒性与多样性；6) 推理时基于问题类型贪心选择高价值前缀推理步骤和最优推理head；7) 构建Reasoning-Tree-160k数据集并执行两阶段学习。

Result: 大量实验表明该优势引导门控框架有效提升基准MLLM在视觉空间理解与推理任务上的性能，代码已开源。

Conclusion: 优势引导的门控框架通过为中间推理过程提供动态监督与干预，能够有效抑制错误累积、稳定答案质量，为MLLM的空间推理能力增强提供了一种可行且通用的训练-推理一体化方案。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in complex spatial scene understanding and reasoning tasks. However, their open-ended reasoning process is prone to decision errors and error accumulation, leading to instability in answer quality. To address this, we propose an advantage-guided gating framework that dynamically intervenes in and corrects deviations during the reasoning process. Specifically, we model step-by-step reasoning as a finite-horizon decision process and introduce Monte Carlo value evaluation on the reasoning tree to provide intermediate supervision signals. The framework includes Step-Advantage Gate and Trajectory-Advantage Gate, which dynamically select high-value reasoning steps and high-quality complete reasoning trajectories, respectively. During training, we perform supervised learning for the gates using reasoning trees generated via multi-branch sampling, and combine shared-parameter initialization with task-specific heads to achieve cross-task robustness and diversity. During inference, the model greedily selects high-value prefix reasoning steps while choosing the optimal reasoning head based on the problem type, thereby significantly improving the accuracy of the final answer. Furthermore, we constructed the Reasoning-Tree-160k dataset and performed two-stage learning on it. Extensive experiments demonstrate that this advantage-guided gating framework effectively enhances the performance of benchmark MLLMs in visual-based spatial understanding and reasoning tasks. The code is open to the public for research: https://github.com/LingLin-ll/Advantage-Guided-Gate.

</details>


### [108] [Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07981v1)
*Liangliang Zhao,Junying Wang,Danni Yang,Yifan Chang,Bin Fu,Yu Qiao,Bowen Zhou,Yihao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PhyS，一个三阶段框架，用于将物理先验蒸馏到流式世界模型中。作者构建了PhyS-120K真实世界物理交互视频数据集，通过物理感知的监督微调将物理先验注入14B双向DiT教师模型，再蒸馏到1.3B因果DiT用于少步自回归流式生成，最后使用在线强化学习和Temporal Credit Routing（TCR）机制激励物理合理的rollout。在PhysicsIQ上，PhyS相对Wan2.1-14B教师提升18.2%，相对基线方法提升14.8%-31.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式世界模型在长时程rollout中往往违反基本物理约束。现有方法将预训练的双向DiT蒸馏为少步因果生成器，但存在两个根本性局限：一是通用的双向教师模型从视觉导向的预训练中获得的物理先验有限；二是在双向到因果蒸馏过程中这些有限的物理先验进一步丢失。

Method: 三阶段框架：(1) 构建PhyS-120K数据集，包含12万个真实世界物理交互视频，覆盖刚体动力学、软体变形、流体现象和相变，并标注结构化的物体属性和因果状态转换描述；(2) 物理感知监督微调将物理先验注入14B双向DiT教师，然后蒸馏为1.3B因果DiT进行少步自回归流式生成；(3) 在线强化学习激励物理合理的rollouts，并提出Temporal Credit Routing（TCR）解决时序信用分配问题——通过重叠时序窗口评估物理一致性，将组相对优势路由到时间对齐的去噪动作。

Result: 在PhysicsIQ上，PhyS相对Wan2.1-14B教师模型提升18.2%，相对Self Forcing提升23.7%、Rolling Forcing提升14.8%、Causal Forcing提升31.4%。在VideoPhy、VideoPhy2和PhyGenBench等物理感知视频基准上也取得改进。

Conclusion: PhyS通过构建真实物理交互数据集、物理感知微调和强化学习+时序信用路由机制，有效解决了流式世界模型中物理先验不足及蒸馏过程中先验丢失的问题，在多个物理感知基准上取得显著改进。

Abstract: Streaming world models predict future visual states online while maintaining physically coherent dynamics over long horizons. However, their rollouts often violate basic physical constraints. A common approach distills pretrained bidirectional DiTs into few-step causal generators. However, this paradigm suffers from two fundamental limitations: generic bidirectional teachers acquire limited physical priors from visually oriented pretraining, and the limited priors suffer further loss during bidirectional-to-causal distillation. We present PhyS, a three-stage framework for distilling physical priors into streaming world models. To acquire physical priors from real-world interactions, we construct PhyS-120K, a dataset of 120K real-world physical-interaction videos spanning rigid-body dynamics, soft-body deformation, fluid phenomena, and phase transitions. Each video is annotated with structured descriptions of object properties and causal state transitions. Physics-aware supervised fine-tuning injects the physical priors into a bidirectional 14B DiT teacher, which we then distill into a lightweight 1.3B causal DiT for few-step autoregressive streaming generation. Finally, we use online reinforcement learning to incentivize the distilled model to generate physically plausible rollouts and further propose Temporal Credit Routing (TCR) to address temporal credit assignment. TCR evaluates physical consistency over overlapping temporal windows and routes the resulting group-relative advantages to temporally aligned denoising actions. On PhysicsIQ, PhyS improves the Wan2.1-14B teacher by 18.2\% and the Self Forcing, Rolling Forcing, and Causal Forcing by 23.7\%, 14.8\%, and 31.4\%, respectively. Results also improve the physics-aware video benchmarks VideoPhy, VideoPhy2, and PhyGenBench. The dataset, code, and more sample videos are available on our Project Page.

</details>


### [109] [SynVAR: Synergizing Spatial and Semantic Alignment in Visual Autoregressive Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07948v1)
*Zhennan Chen,Tianxing Shi,Pengcheng Xu,Kepan Nan,Qian Wang,Zili Yi,Jian Yang,Ying Tai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SynVAR是首个针对VAR（Next-Scale Prediction）范式设计的免训练增强框架，通过空间-语义协同控制策略抑制跨尺度误差传播，包含全局引导、感受野约束和高频补偿三个组件，显著提升VAR在复杂多对象多属性场景下的生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VAR因其next-scale预测范式而广受欢迎，但在处理包含多个对象和属性的复杂场景时面临严重的性能瓶颈。现有基于扩散的增强方法无法有效解决VAR特有的跨尺度误差传播与累积问题，因此亟需一个专门针对VAR范式的增强方案。

Method: 提出SynVAR，一个免训练的增强框架，包含三个关键组件：(1) 全局引导（Global guidance）——在早期阶段确保合理的空间结构；(2) 感受野约束（Receptive field constraints）——缓解早期阶段的语义混淆；(3) 高频补偿（High-frequency compensation）——恢复细粒度细节。三者构成空间-语义协同控制策略，有效抑制跨尺度传播误差。

Result: 大量定量和定性实验表明，SynVAR在增强VAR复杂场景建模能力方面取得了显著改进。

Conclusion: SynVAR通过与VAR范式深度对齐的免训练增强策略，有效解决了跨尺度误差传播问题，为VAR在复杂场景下的生成质量提供了实质性提升。

Abstract: VAR has gained widespread popularity due to its next-scale prediction paradigm. However, it faces substantial performance bottlenecks when handling complex scenes with multiple objects and attributes. Existing diffusion-based enhancement methods fail to adequately address the unique challenge of cross-scale error propagation and accumulation in VAR. To this end, we propose SynVAR, the first training-free enhancement framework specifically tailored for the VAR paradigm, which introduces a spatial-semantic collaborative control strategy to effectively suppress propagation error and improve generation quality. SynVAR comprises three key components: (1) Global guidance to ensure reasonable spatial structure in the early stages, (2) Receptive field constraints to mitigate early-stage semantic confusion, (3) High-frequency compensation to recover fine-grained details. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the significant improvements in the ability of SynVAR to enhance the VAR's capability for complex scene modeling.

</details>


### [110] [SportsGrounder: Proposal-Aided Interleaved Grounding for Dense Sports Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07932v1)
*Yizhi Li,Jiawei Jiang,Guanhong Wang,Yingcai Wu,Gaoang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SportsGrounder框架，利用开放词汇视觉专家进行交错式接地（interleaved grounding）来解决密集体育视频推理中的细粒度理解难题。通过IGF机制融合边界框坐标与视觉语义、AAS模块正则化隐藏状态以防止语言偏置，以及MPO优化策略区分干扰项，在SoccerNet和FineSports派生的新数据集上达到SOTA精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现行大规模多模态模型（LMMs）在处理密集体育视频时难以应对大量小尺度、高度交互且视觉同质化的实体（如穿着相同球衣的球员和球），由于缺乏细粒度视觉细节，模型容易过度依赖文本先验猜测答案，尤其在区分视觉相似的球员和动作时表现不佳。

Method: 1) 利用开放词汇视觉专家提取领域引导的目标候选框；2) 提出交错式接地融合（IGF）机制，逐帧整合显式边界框坐标与隐式视觉语义及全局网格特征，保持严格时间对齐并防止序列长度爆炸；3) 设计动作感知监督（AAS）模块直接正则化模型隐藏状态，强制网络学习准确的运动表征；4) 采用混合偏好优化（MPO）区分具有欺骗性的干扰项。

Result: 在从SoccerNet和FineSports构建的密集体育VQA数据集上进行的大量实验表明，SportsGrounder显著提升了细粒度推理能力，并取得了最先进的精度。

Conclusion: SportsGrounder通过将开放词汇视觉专家的接地能力与LMMs融合，有效缓解了密集体育视频推理中的视觉细节丢失和语言偏置问题，为细粒度体育视频理解提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Sports video analysis is crucial for athletic analytics and broadcasting enhancement. Dense sports video reasoning, however, demands a fine-grained understanding of numerous small-scale, highly interactive, and visually homogeneous entities (e.g., players sharing identical uniforms, the ball) across long temporal contexts. Current Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) inherently struggle with such dense visual complexities. Due to the lack of fine-grained visual details, these models often over-rely on textual priors to guess answers, especially when distinguishing visually similar actions and players. To address this, we propose \textbf{SportsGrounder}, a framework that leverages an open-vocabulary visual expert to aid interleaved grounding specifically for dense sports video reasoning. To achieve precise spatial localization, we extract domain-guided object proposals and introduce an Interleaved Grounding Fusion (IGF) mechanism. The IGF frame-by-frame integrates explicit bounding box coordinates and implicit visual semantics with global grid features. This design preserves strict temporal alignment and prevents sequence length explosion. Furthermore, we design an Action-Aware Supervision (AAS) module that directly regularizes the model's hidden states, forcing the network to learn accurate motion representations rather than relying on language bias. Optimized with Mixed Preference Optimization (MPO) to better distinguish deceptive distractors, our extensive experiments on newly curated dense sports VQA datasets (derived from SoccerNet and FineSports) demonstrate that SportsGrounder significantly improves fine-grained reasoning and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy.

</details>


### [111] [SCoPE: Training-Free Audio-Visual Event Perception via Sparse Cross-Modal Prior Exchange](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07923v1)
*Jaemo Jeong,Junho Yoon,Hyunju Kim,Dongman Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SCoPE，一个无需训练的音视频事件感知框架。针对音频-视觉事件感知中错误的"伪共激活"（FCA）问题，SCoPE让所有查询标签竞争共享证据，并通过跨模态相互引导事件选择。在LLP数据集上，使用相同的冻结CLIP+CLAP骨干，Type@seg提升7.45点、Event@seg提升5.04点，且该固定配置可直接迁移到OV-AVEBench和VGGSound-AVEL100k。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在音频-视觉事件感知中，现有无需训练的方法通过匹配冻结的音频/视觉特征与文本编码事件名来查询新事件词汇。然而相关标签共享证据，导致错误标签的得分可能不低于正确标签（即伪共激活FCA）。单一的标量阈值无法在拒绝所有错误标签的同时保留全部正确标签，而类别特定阈值虽可防止该标签成为最终预测，但FCA仍残留在底层得分向量中。因此需要一种从根本上消除FCA的框架。

Method: SCoPE是一个无需训练的框架，核心机制是：(1) 所有被查询的标签为共享证据而竞争，而非独立打分；(2) 每种模态（音频和视觉）在另一种模态中引导事件选择。作者推导了一个精确条件，说明这种竞争如何在两标签拟合中消除FCA。使用固定的冻结CLIP+CLAP骨干，无需任何训练或调参。

Result: 在LLP数据集上，与已报告的AV2A值相比，SCoPE将Type@seg提高7.45点，Event@seg提高5.04点。同一固定配置无需修改即可直接迁移到OV-AVEBench和VGGSound-AVEL100k两个数据集，表现出良好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: SCoPE通过让标签竞争共享证据并利用跨模态引导，有效消除了伪共激活问题，在多个基准上取得显著提升，且训练免费的框架具有即插即用和跨数据集迁移的实用性。

Abstract: Audio-visual event perception (AVEP) determines which events occur in a video, when they occur, and whether they are audible, visible, or both. Training-free methods query new event vocabularies by matching frozen audio and visual features with text-encoded event names. However, related labels share evidence. An incorrect label can then score at least as high as a correct one. We call this a false co-activation (FCA). No scalar cutoff can reject the incorrect label while keeping every correct one. Class-specific thresholds may prevent that label from becoming a final prediction, but the FCA remains in the underlying score vector. We introduce SCoPE, a training-free framework in which all queried labels compete for shared evidence and each modality guides event selection in the other. We derive an exact condition for when this competition removes an FCA in a two-label fit. With identical frozen CLIP+CLAP backbones on LLP, SCoPE improves Type@seg by 7.45 points and Event@seg by 5.04 points compared with the reported AV$^2$A values. The same fixed configuration transfers unchanged to OV-AVEBench and VGGSound-AVEL100k.

</details>


### [112] [SegDem: Segmentation helps Demosaicing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07916v1)
*Ping Chen,Xiangming Wang,Yongyong Chen,Jiezhang Cao,Kai Zhang,Jingyong Su,Jie Liu,Haijin Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SegDem 提出一种新的图像去马赛克框架，将图像重建与视觉理解（实例分割）视为共享场景结构的互补视角，通过跨任务解码器表示迁移实现更好的去马赛克效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有去马赛克方法大多将其视为纯像素级重建问题，依赖局部纹理、跨通道相关性和低级图像统计，忽略了重建与视觉理解本质上都源于同一物理世界这一洞察。作者认为两者推断出的结构性和物理信息应保持一致。

Method: SegDem 首先通过实例感知的结构预训练学习区域感知和边界感知的表示，然后将解码器迁移到 RAW 条件下的重建任务。此外，将分割条件和去马赛克条件的特征锚定到共享的冻结 DINOv2 表示空间，以保持跨任务的结构组织。该方法支持卷积、Transformer 和状态空间等多种骨干网络，并统一处理 Single- 和 Quad-Bayer 去马赛克。

Result: 在合成、外部和具有挑战性的数据集上进行的大量实验表明，SegDem 在不同架构和 CFA 布局下均取得了一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: 本文证明像素级重建与高级视觉理解可作为共享场景结构的互补视角，通过跨任务表示迁移和特征锚定在冻结表示空间中，能够有效提升去马赛克性能，且方法具有跨架构和跨 CFA 布局的通用性。

Abstract: Image demosaicing reconstructs a full-color image from incomplete color measurements produced by a sensor covered with a color filter array (CFA). Most existing methods formulate demosaicing as pixel-level reconstruction and mainly rely on local textures, cross-channel correlations, and low-level image statistics. Our core insight is that reconstruction and visual understanding can be viewed as complementary views of shared scene structure: both are grounded in the same underlying physical world, and therefore the structural and physical information inferred from an image should remain consistent across the two tasks. We instantiate this idea with instance segmentation and propose \emph{SegDem}, a cross-task decoder representation transfer framework for demosaicing. SegDem first learns region- and boundary-aware representations through instance-aware structural pretraining and then transfers the decoder to RAW-conditioned reconstruction. Segmentation- and demosaicing-conditioned features are further anchored to a shared frozen DINOv2 representation space to preserve structural organization across tasks. We instantiate SegDem with convolutional, Transformer-based, and state-space backbones for unified Single- and Quad-Bayer demosaicing. Extensive experiments on synthetic, external, and challenging datasets demonstrate consistent improvements across different architectures and CFA layouts.

</details>


### [113] [UniScale: Arbitrary-Scale Industrial Anomaly Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07864v2)
*Shilei Zeng,Linxin Guan,Xurui Li,Yaohan Tang,Yu Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出UniScale，一个统一的训练和推理框架，用于任意尺度的高保真工业异常生成。通过错误抑制的多尺度训练（EMT）策略解决扩散模型中极端下采样导致的小尺度异常信息丢失问题，并采用生成-后融合去噪（Generation-then-Fusion Denoising）策略将异常生成与背景集成解耦。实验表明该方法在异常生成质量和下游检测性能上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业异常检测面临真实异常样本匮乏的挑战。虽然生成模型被用于创建异常数据，但现有方法在处理小尺度异常时仍然失效，原因是扩散模型的极端下采样导致小异常信息在潜在空间中丢失。

Method: 1) 训练阶段：提出Error-Suppressed Multi-Scale Training (EMT)策略，使模型学习丰富的、位置感知的异常纹理，同时抑制上采样引入的插值误差，确保模型既能学习小尺度异常，又对常规尺度异常保持有效。2) 推理阶段：提出Generation-then-Fusion Denoising，将异常生成与背景集成解耦，防止小尺度异常被淹没。

Result: 在VisA上IS(a)指标相对提升45.86%（从1.81到2.64），在MVTec AD 2上提升37.70%（从1.22到1.68）；下游像素级IoU在VisA上提升4.22%，AUROC在MVTec AD 2上提升6.55%。

Conclusion: UniScale在任意尺度的工业异常生成质量和下游检测性能上均优于现有最先进方法，代码已开源。

Abstract: Industrial anomaly inspection faces a major challenge due to the lack of real-world anomaly samples. While generative models are used to create anomaly data, existing methods still struggle when handling small-scale anomalies. This failure occurs because extreme downsampling in diffusion models causes the information of small anomalies to be lost in the latent space. To address this, we introduce UniScale, a unified training and inference framework for high-fidelity industrial anomaly generation across arbitrary scales. During training, we introduce an Error-Suppressed Multi-Scale Training (EMT) strategy, which enables the model to learn the rich location-aware textures of anomalies, while suppressing upsampling-induced interpolation errors in texture acquisition, ensuring the model is capable of learning small-scale anomalies, while remaining effective for regular scale anomalies. For inference, we propose Generation-then-Fusion Denoising. It decouples anomaly generation from background integration, preventing small anomalies from being overwhelmed. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art competitors in both anomaly generation quality and downstream detection performance. It achieves a relative IS(a) improvement of 45.86% (from 1.81 to 2.64) on VisA and 37.70% (from 1.22 to 1.68) on MVTec AD 2, while also improving the downstream pixel-level IoU by 4.22% on VisA and AUROC by 6.55% on MVTec AD 2. Code is available at https://github.com/HUST-SLOW/UniScale.

</details>


### [114] [LHSDet: High-Resolution AI-Generated Image Detection via Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07863v1)
*Qian Yao,Jun-Jie Huang,Yongjun Wang,Luming Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LHSDet，一种基于视觉问答框架的高分辨率AI生成图像检测器，通过三分支架构（低层视觉分支、高层视觉分支、语义文本分支）提取多模态互补特征，有效捕捉高分辨率AI图像中的低层纹理细节和高层语义伪影，在多种扩散模型和自回归模型上均取得高检测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测方法通常对图像进行下采样，容易忽略高分辨率AI生成图像中关键的低层纹理细节，限制检测性能；同时未知生成模型的不断涌现使得大规模预训练数据集难以获取。

Method: LHSDet将AI生成图像检测任务形式化为视觉问答问题，采用微调的视觉-语言框架挖掘视觉与文本模态的互补信息。具体包含三个分支：(1)低层视觉分支，聚合非重叠patch提取局部纹理线索；(2)高层视觉分支，基于SigLIP2进行全局感知特征提取；(3)语义文本分支，利用BLIP-2生成图像描述。此外，重新设计了视觉编码器以更好地捕捉AI生成图像中的低层和高层伪影。

Result: 大量实验表明，LHSDet在包括扩散模型和自回归模型在内的多种生成模型上均实现了高检测精度和鲁棒性能。

Conclusion: 通过融合低层视觉纹理、高层全局感知和语义文本的多模态互补特征，LHSDet有效解决了高分辨率AI生成图像检测中下采样导致的细节丢失问题，并在面对未知生成模型时展现出强大的泛化能力。
