### [210] [Estimating Media Mix Models with Demand-Marketing Interactions: A Constrained Genetic Algorithm Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10229v1)
*J. S. T. Wong,G. Hughes,Y. Bao,H. Dai,V. Giagos,H. M. Fernanda,H. O. Bakan,K. Passmore*

Main category: stat.AP

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种媒体组合建模（MMM）的新型扩展方法，引入营销活动与消费者潜在需求之间的乘法交互作用，使营销效果能够随需求条件变化。针对由此产生的识别问题，开发了受约束的遗传算法优化方案以实现稳健估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准MMM框架假设媒体与基线需求驱动因素具有可加性和独立效应，但现实中营销效力会随市场需求的实时状况而变化，因此需要一种允许营销效果随需求条件动态变化的模型结构。

Method: 提出了在MMM中引入营销活动与消费者需求之间的乘法交互项；通过模拟研究评估识别问题的性质与严重性（包括偏差评估）；开发了基于受约束遗传算法的优化方法，同时纳入经济上有意义的参数约束以缓解估计偏差。

Result: 通过综合模拟研究分析了该结构的识别问题所导致的估计偏差及其对统计推断的影响；所提出的受约束遗传算法方法能够同时缓解识别偏误，并在真实数据应用中展现更高的估计精度，同时支持商业约束下的预算分配决策。

Conclusion: 所提出的约束遗传算法优化框架有效解决了乘法交互MMM模型的识别难题，在提升估计精度的同时兼顾了经济约束和商业实务需求，为预算分配决策提供了更可靠的建模工具。

Abstract: This paper proposes a novel extension to Media Mix Modeling (MMM) that introduces a multiplicative interaction between marketing activity and underlying consumer demand. Unlike standard MMM frameworks that assume additive and independent effects of media and baseline demand drivers, our specification allows marketing effectiveness to vary with prevailing demand conditions. However, the proposed structure introduces significant statistical challenges, particularly identifiability issues that can lead to unstable and biased parameter estimates. Using comprehensive simulation studies, we analyze the nature and severity of these identification issues through bias assessment and their implications for statistical inference. To address these issues, we develop a constrained genetic algorithm optimization approach which facilitates robust estimation that simultaneously mitigates biases arising from the aforementioned issues. The proposed approach also offers flexibility to incorporate economically meaningful parameter constraints. Finally, the proposed methodology is applied to real-world data to demonstrate its effectiveness in enhancing estimation accuracy while taking into account additional commercial constraints, facilitating budget allocation decisions.

</details>


### [211] [Longitudinal Bayesian networks for assessing team performance in the National Basketball Association](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09824v1)
*Gabriel Calvo,Francisco Palmí-Perales,Carmen Armero,Virgilio Gómez-Rubio*

Main category: stat.AP

TL;DR: 提出了一种用于篮球团队表现纵向分析的贝叶斯图形建模框架，基于贝叶斯网络将随机变量表示为纵向随机过程，提出三种基线模型（静态贝叶斯网络、自回归动态贝叶斯网络、隐马尔可夫结构动态贝叶斯网络），并以费城76人队2005-06赛季的真实数据进行了案例分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 篮球团队表现的评估需要整合多种信息源，而近年来体育领域数据量和数据质量显著提升。传统方法难以充分捕捉篮球团队表现随时间变化的纵向特征，因此需要一种能够显式建模纵向随机过程的贝叶斯图形框架。

Method: 提出基于贝叶斯网络的图形建模框架，将感兴趣的随机变量节点表示为纵向随机过程。设计了三种基线纵向模型：（1）静态贝叶斯网络；（2）具有连续比赛间自回归结构的动态贝叶斯网络；（3）基于隐马尔可夫结构的动态贝叶斯网络。通过真实体育分析案例（NBA费城76人队2005-06赛季）进行验证，分析变量包括球员参与、上场时间、造犯规次数以及一、二、三分球的出手与命中数据。

Result: 通过费城76人队2005-06赛季的真实数据案例，展示了该贝叶斯图形框架在篮球团队纵向表现分析中的可行性和实用性，三种基线模型均得到了应用和比较。

Conclusion: 该研究为篮球团队表现的纵向分析提供了一种灵活的贝叶斯图形建模框架，能够显式捕捉变量随时间演变的随机动态结构，为体育分析领域提供了新的方法论工具。三种基线模型为不同场景下的纵向表现建模提供了选择基础。

Abstract: Assessing the performance of a basketball team requires the consideration of multiple sources of information. In recent years, the volume and the quality of data generated in sport has increased considerably, particularly in basketball. In this work, we propose a Bayesian graphical modelling framework for the longitudinal analysis of basketball team performance. The framework is based on Bayesian networks that explicitly represent the nodes, that is, the random variables of interest, as longitudinal stochastic processes. We propose three baseline longitudinal models: a static Bayesian network, a dynamic Bayesian network with an autoregressive structure between successive games, and a dynamic Bayesian network based on a hidden Markov structure. We illustrate the proposed framework through a real-world sports analytics case study involving the Philadelphia 76ers of the National Basketball Association (NBA) during the 2005--06 season. The analysis includes player participation, minutes played, fouls drawn, and one-, two-, and three-point shots attempted and made.

</details>


### [212] [Real-time anomaly detection in base station testbeds via scalable kernel density estimation framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08373v1)
*Justyna Witulska,Marcin Szczukiewicz,Artur Tabaka,Rafał Sarniak,Ireneusz Jabłoński,Agnieszka Wyłomańska,Dominik Dulas*

Main category: stat.AP

TL;DR: 本文提出CALM和AggCALM两个无监督异常检测框架，用于大规模电信测试基础设施中的实时异常检测。CALM基于核密度估计和bootstrap阈值进行单测试台级别的异常检测，AggCALM则聚合多个测试台的局部异常信号以检测全局性异常并缓解告警疲劳。方法在模拟多变量数据和真实基站测试平台数据上验证了有效性，无需标注数据即可实现及时、灵活、准确的异常检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模电信测试基础设施日益复杂，资源分配或准备过程中的错误常表现为时间序列指标的突变或状态变化，但现有方法难以在无标注数据的真实环境中进行高效、可扩展的实时异常检测。

Method: 提出CALM，一种基于核密度估计（KDE）和bootstrap阈值化的非参数方法，可在单测试台级别进行单变量和多变量异常检测；进一步提出AggCALM聚合框架，整合多个测试台的局部异常信号以检测统计显著的全局异常，同时抑制告警疲劳。

Result: 在模拟多变量数据和来自大规模基站测试平台的真实数据上进行评估，证明该框架能够实现及时、灵活且准确的异常检测，且无需标注数据。

Conclusion: 该框架在电信测试实验室环境中无需标签即可可靠支持复杂测试环境的运行，并且可推广至其他应用领域（如状态监测），作为诊断信号的异常检测预处理步骤。

Abstract: Large-scale testing infrastructures are critical for validating telecommunication systems, yet their growing complexity makes efficient resource utilization and anomaly detection increasingly challenging. In reservation-based testbed environments, errors in resource allocation or preparation often manifest as abrupt spikes or regime changes in time-based metrics. This paper proposes a scalable, unsupervised framework for real-time anomaly detection in such environments. We introduce CALM (Continuous Anomaly Localization for univariate and Multivariate data), a nonparametric method based on kernel density estimation and bootstrap-based thresholding, designed for anomaly detection at the individual testbed level. To address system-wide visibility, we further propose AggCALM, an aggregation framework that consolidates local anomaly signals across multiple testbeds to detect statistically significant global anomalies while mitigating alarm fatigue. The methodology is evaluated using simulated multivariate data and real-world data from a large-scale base station testing platform. Results demonstrate that the proposed framework enables timely, flexible, and accurate anomaly detection without requiring labeled data, supporting reliable operation of complex test environments. Although the proposed methodology is presented within the context of a telecommunication testing labs, it can be effectively used to other applications, such as condition monitoring, where anomaly detection serves as a pivotal pre-processing step for diagnostic signals.

</details>


### [213] [Longitudinal wearable monitoring and polygenic risk for incident major depressive disorder in the All of Us Research Program](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06063v1)
*Yuezhou Zhang,Amos A. Folarin,Rongrong Zhong,Hyunju Kim,Shaoxiong Sun,Callum Stewart,Richard JB Dobson*

Main category: stat.AP

TL;DR: 本研究整合了基因组、电子健康记录和纵向Fitbit可穿戴设备数据，分析了3,030名欧洲血统成年人的多基因风险评分（PRS）、数字表型特征（身体活动与睡眠）及其交互作用对抑郁症（MDD）发病风险的影响，发现遗传易感性与可穿戴行为特征互补，且两者存在交互作用，整合模型将C-index从0.637提升至0.705。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 抑郁症发病风险同时反映稳定的遗传易感性和动态的行为模式，但以往研究很少利用长期真实世界客观数据将这两个维度联合考察，缺乏在自然环境中对遗传与行为交互作用的纵向研究。

Method: 基于All of Us研究项目中3,030名欧洲血统成年人的数据（其中284人在180天基线期后发生EHR记录的MDD事件），使用时变Cox比例风险模型分析MDD多基因风险评分（PRS）、每月可穿戴设备衍生的身体活动和睡眠特征，以及可穿戴特征与MDD PRS之间的交互作用对MDD发病风险的影响，并通过PRS分层风险比曲线和序贯模型比较评估判别能力。

Result: 较高的MDD PRS、较少的每日步数、较低的轻度与剧烈身体活动、较低的睡眠效率和较大的睡眠时长变异性与更高的MDD发病风险相关。久坐时间和睡眠时长变异性与MDD PRS存在交互作用，PRS较高者表现出更强的风险关联。PRS分层曲线表明，高PRS个体需要更有利的行为水平（如更高步数和更稳定睡眠）才能达到与低PRS个体相当的风险。序贯整合MDD PRS、基线可穿戴特征、月度可穿戴特征及交互作用后，C-index从0.637提升至0.705。

Conclusion: 研究支持遗传易感性与纵向真实世界行为监测在MDD发病风险刻画中的互补价值，提示遗传信息与数字表型结合可用于个性化风险监测和预防，为未来的遗传知情数字表型研究奠定基础。

Abstract: Major depressive disorder (MDD) risk reflects both stable inherited liability and dynamic behavioral patterns, yet these dimensions are rarely examined together using long-term objective data in real-world settings. Here, we integrated genomic, electronic health record (EHR), and longitudinal Fitbit wearable data from 3,030 adults of genetically inferred European ancestry in the All of Us Research Program, 284 of whom developed EHR-recorded incident MDD after a 180-day baseline period. Time-varying Cox models examined associations of MDD polygenic risk scores (PRS), monthly wearable-derived physical activity and sleep features, and interactions between wearable features and MDD PRS with incident MDD. Higher MDD PRS, lower daily steps, lower light and vigorous physical activity, lower sleep efficiency, and greater sleep duration variability were associated with higher risk of EHR-recorded incident MDD. The associations of sedentary time and sleep duration variability with incident MDD differed across MDD PRS levels, with stronger risk associations among participants with higher MDD PRS. PRS-stratified hazard ratio curves further indicated that comparable estimated risk corresponded to more favorable behavioral levels (such as higher daily step counts and more stable sleep) among participants with higher MDD PRS than among those with lower MDD PRS. Sequentially integrating MDD PRS, baseline wearable features, monthly wearable features, and selected interactions between wearable features and MDD PRS increased model discrimination, with the C-index increasing from 0.637 to 0.705. These findings support the complementary value of inherited liability and longitudinal real-world behavioral monitoring for incident MDD risk characterization and may inform future work on genetically informed digital phenotyping for personalized risk monitoring and prevention.

</details>

### [214] [Active movement of foraging sea turtles generates anomalous looping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07448v1)
*Vijay Kumar,Vladimir V. Palyulin,Perla Roman-Torres,Christophe Eizaguirre,Rainer Klages*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 本文利用卫星跟踪数据为西非沿岸觅食的蠵龟构建了随机广义朗之万方程，发现其运动呈现大规模环路特征，这些环路不能在海洋洋流或手性效应下解释，并在中等时间尺度上产生类似Lévy步行的超扩散行为，揭示了一种基于环路的主动异常搜索运动模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动物运动路径呈现复杂模式，现有模型（相关随机游走、Lévy步行、主动粒子动力学）无法整合从实验轨迹中提取的长期非马尔可夫记忆信息，因此亟需构建数据驱动的数学模型来理解这些复杂运动模式。

Method: 从蠵龟的卫星跟踪数据出发，构造随机广义朗之万方程，通过分析轨迹中的大规模环路结构、检验洋流和手性效应的影响，以及分析不同时间尺度上的扩散行为，来表征动物的主动运动特征。

Result: 蠵龟表现出由大规模环路表征的主动运动，这些环路维持运动在特定觅食区域内，并在中间时间尺度上产生类似Lévy步行的超扩散现象，且该现象无法由洋流或手性效应解释。

Conclusion: 识别出了一种基于环路的主动异常搜索模式，该模式广泛存在于多种动物物种的觅食行为中，可为机器人搜索策略和基于AI的元启发式优化算法提供灵感。

Abstract: Animals inhabiting diverse environments by moving across different spatial scales, from insects to birds, marine predators, mammals and even humans, often display apparently random movement paths. Over the past decade, novel biologging technologies have recorded these patterns in increasing detail, generating a wealth of experimental data. A central challenge is to understand such complex patterns by constructing data-driven mathematical models. Many animal movements depart from Brownian motion, as described by correlated random walks, Lévy walks, or active particle dynamics. Yet, these movement models do not incorporate long-term non-Markovian memory extracted from experimental trajectories. Here, we construct a stochastic generalised Langevin equation from satellite tracking data for loggerhead sea turtles (Caretta caretta) foraging off the coast of West Africa. We find that these turtles exhibit active movement characterised by large-scale loops that are not explained by ocean currents or chirality. These loops maintain movement within a specific foraging region and, over intermediate timescales, generate superdiffusion similar to Lévy walks. We thus identify a loop-based form of active anomalous search related to foraging patterns observed across a wide range of animal species, which may inspire robotic search strategies and AI-based metaheuristic optimisation algorithms.

</details>

### [215] [Set-up and Characterisation of Atmospheric Boundary Layers in the 10'x5' Wind Tunnel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07764v1)
*Sita M. Nair,Kevin Gouder*

Main category: physics.flu-dyn

TL;DR: 本论文在风洞中利用Irwin尖塔（无地板粗糙元）复现海洋大气边界层（ABL），构建了两种风廓线（国际标准共性框架廓线和英吉利海峡/北海风电场入流廓线）。通过LDA与多孔探针测量验证，结果显示多孔探针精度高（流向速度偏差<1%，标准差<5%），廓线与目标参数吻合良好，证明了Irwin尖塔是模拟海洋ABL的经济可靠方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大气边界层对暴露于大气环境中的物体具有关键影响，但真实环境测试成本高昂。因此本文旨在风洞中低成本、可靠地复现海洋大气边界层，以支持离岸风能系统的优化研究。

Method: 在风洞中利用Irwin尖塔（无地板粗糙元）生成两种海洋ABL廓线；采用激光多普勒测速仪（LDA）与多孔探针（MHP）测量流场特性，并通过展向均匀性、谱分析、归一化速度和湍流强度等指标对模拟效果进行验证。

Result: 多孔探针与LDA对比显示出较高精度：流向速度偏差小于1%，流向、展向和壁法向速度分量的标准差均在5%以内；两种廓线与目标指标（归一化速度、湍流强度）吻合良好；展向均匀性和谱分析验证了不同入流速度下模拟的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: Irwin尖塔被证明是一种成本效益高且可靠的海洋大气边界层模拟方法，为离岸风能系统的优化提供了有价值的见解。

Abstract: The Atmospheric Boundary Layer (ABL) plays a critical role in influencing objects exposed to atmospheric conditions, making its study crucial. Due to the high cost of real-world testing, this thesis focuses on replicating marine ABLs in a wind tunnel environment. Two profiles were developed: one that served as a framework for establishing commonality among the various international wind engineering standards ('Profile 1'), and a second profile, which is more suitable for modelling the inflow to wind farms in the English Channel and the North Sea ('Profile 2'). The ABLs were generated using Irwin spires without floor roughness elements, and the flow characteristics were measured using Laser Doppler Anemometry (LDA) and a multi-hole probe (MHP). MHP showed a reasonably high accuracy when compared to LDA, with less than 1% deviation in the streamwise velocity and under 5% standard deviation in the streamwise, spanwise, and wall-normal velocity components. The profiles achieved good agreement with target metrics such as normalised velocity and turbulence intensity. Spanwise uniformity and spectral analysis confirmed the robustness of the simulation across varying inflow velocities. Overall, Irwin spires proved to be a cost-effective and reliable method for simulating marine ABLs, offering valuable insights for optimising offshore wind energy systems.

</details>

### [216] [From Passive Mirrors to Active Agents: Holonic Digital Twins for Physical AI over Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06227v1)
*Christo Kurisummoottil Thomas,Omar Hashash,Walid Saad*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出HDT-Nets（全息数字孪生网络）框架，通过全息代理（holonic agents）实现实时物理AI推理。每个全息数字孪生（HDT）呈层次结构，跨越物理代理与网络边缘，在本地自主推理的同时与相邻HDT协作形成集体智能单元。框架融合因果马尔可夫毯、主动推理、范畴论和整合信息论，统一感知、行动与学习，协调多代理共享时空上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI工具（包括深度学习和生成式AI）嵌入物理系统（如机器人、车辆）时，因无法在不确定性下维持长时间跨度规划所需的世界模型，且难以泛化到未见场景而失败。现有无线网络架构优化吞吐量、延迟和可靠性，无法支持需要代理维持共享时空上下文的实时物理AI协调。

Method: 提出HDT-Nets框架：1）每个HDT采用层次结构，覆盖物理代理到网络边缘，本地自治推理同时与邻居协作；2）利用因果马尔可夫毯（跨越感知、通信、控制）确定哪些代理需要协调，并支持多域干预的反事实推理；3）主动推理通过最小化期望自由能统一感知、行动和学习，同时依据认知价值决定传输哪些信念；4）范畴论保证跨异构代理（不兼容表示）间传输的信念保持语义结构；5）整合信息论量化集体智能何时超越独立运行，以及网络智能如何通过协调学习和信息交换演化。

Result: 论文提出了一个概念性和理论性框架，论证了无线网络如何通过HDT-Nets编排物理智能，各层次机制（协同推理、反事实推理、语义保持、集体智能量化）共同支撑实时物理AI推理。结果侧重框架设计而非实验验证。

Conclusion: HDT-Nets通过全息代理网络将无线通信基础设施转变为物理AI的协调层，理论上能够突破当前AI在物理系统中可靠性不足的瓶颈。框架提供的多域推理与集体智能演化机制，为未来物理AI系统的网络架构设计提供了新范式。

Abstract: Despite advances in artificial intelligence (AI) across multiple sectors, today's AI tools, including deep learning and generative AI, still fail when embedded into physical systems, such as robots and vehicles operating under real-world physical laws. This stems from their inability to maintain reliable world models for long-horizon planning under uncertainty and generalize to unseen scenarios. In this context, wireless networks, through pervasive sensing and communication, can orchestrate physical intelligence. However, current architectures optimize throughput, latency, and reliability and cannot support real-time physical AI coordination, requiring agents to maintain shared spatiotemporal context. To address these challenges, a network of holonic digital twins (HDT-Nets) framework is proposed to deliver real-time physical AI inference through holonic agents that actively reason about their environment rather than passively mirror physical assets. Each HDT is realized as a hierarchical structure spanning the physical agent and network edge, reasoning autonomously at the local level while cooperating with neighboring HDTs to form collectively intelligent units. In HDT-Net, causal Markov blankets spanning sensing, communication, and control determine which agents must coordinate and enable counterfactual reasoning over multi-domain interventions. Active inference within these boundaries unifies perception, action, and learning by minimizing expected free energy while deciding which beliefs to transmit based on their cognitive value to the receiver. Category theory ensures that transmitted beliefs preserve semantic structure across heterogeneous agents with incompatible representations. Finally, integrated information theory quantifies when collective intelligence exceeds independent operation and how network intelligence evolves through coordinated learning and information exchange.

</details>

### [217] [MAJEPPA: Morphing and Assessing in a Unified Piano Performance Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.11026v1)
*Jinwen Zhou,Huan Zhang,Weixi Zhai,Jinhua Liang,Aidan O. T. Hogg,Simon Dixon*

Main category: eess.AS

TL;DR: 提出MAJEPPA，一个自监督框架，用于学习涵盖从初学者练习到 virtuoso 演奏会录音全技能谱系的钢琴表演表征。通过MAJEPPA数据集（约4000条标注录音，覆盖六个专业水平和六种录音场景），采用联合目标（next-token prediction + InfoNCE + supervised contrastive loss）进行建模，并在新基准EVPMR上验证了该模型在生成和理解两个维度的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有钢琴表演表征模型通常只覆盖单一技能水平或单一场景，无法泛化到从初学者到专业演奏家的完整技能谱系，缺乏统一的生成与理解框架。

Method: 1) 构建MAJEPPA数据集，包含约4000条标注录音，覆盖六个专业水平和六种录音场景。2) 采用单一预训练MIDI自回归模型，通过联合目标训练：next-token prediction负责条件生成，InfoNCE和监督对比损失在联合嵌入空间中对齐抽象乐谱与表演表征。

Result: 在EVPMR基准上（涵盖质量评估、竞赛排名、错误分类和技术分类等下游任务）验证了所学表征的有效性，表明该模型能在统一框架下同时生成和理解钢琴表演。

Conclusion: MAJEPPA展示了向真实世界钢琴表演空间通用模型方向的进展，通过单一框架实现跨技能水平的生成与理解能力。

Abstract: We present MAJEPPA, a self-supervised framework to learn piano performance representations that span the full skill spectrum, from beginner practice sessions to virtuoso concert recordings. We curate the MAJEPPA dataset, comprising ~4,000 annotated recordings across six expertise levels and six recording contexts. We adapt a single pre-trained MIDI autoregressive model with a joint objective: next-token prediction learns score-conditioned performance generation at various skill levels, while InfoNCE and supervised contrastive losses align abstract score and performance representations in a joint embedding space. The proposed model both generates and understands performances in a unified framework. By introducing the EVPMR benchmark, a suite of downstream tasks spanning quality assessment, competition ranking, mistake and technique classification, we evaluate the learnt representations, demonstrating progress towards a real-world model for the piano performance space.

</details>


### [218] [Neural Array-Generic Direction-of-Arrival Estimation Exploiting Array Transfer Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09425v1)
*Mikko Heikkinen,Archontis Politis,Konstantinos Drossos,Tuomas Virtanen*

Main category: eess.AS

TL;DR: 本文提出一个阵列泛化的神经DoA估计框架，利用实测或仿真的复方向阵列传输函数（ATFs）作为元数据，通过分离的卷积编码器和交叉注意力机制融合多通道频谱图与ATF信息，在模拟2D和3D定位任务中能泛化到未见过的麦克风阵列（包括类手机配置）而性能无明显下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习的DoA估计算法通常与训练时使用的麦克风阵列强绑定，在部署到未见设备时泛化性能差，缺乏对阵列几何无关的通用估计框架。

Method: 采用实测或仿真的复方向阵列传输函数（ATFs）作为与真实多麦克风设备匹配的元数据；使用分离的卷积编码器分别处理多通道频谱图和ATF元数据；通过交叉注意力机制融合两种表征；以多源笛卡尔向量输出形式预测声源方向。

Result: 在混响和扩散性嘈杂噪声条件下的模拟2D和3D定位任务中，该方法能够泛化到训练中未见过的阵列（包括类似手机的配置）而性能无明显劣化，同时与传统方法和基于学习的基线方法相比保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 该框架通过ATF元数据与注意力机制实现阵列无关的神经DoA估计，有效解决了深度学习方法对麦克风阵列的过拟合问题，为实际多设备场景的声源定位提供了可行的通用方案。

Abstract: Direction-of-arrival (DoA) estimation is a key component of multichannel audio processing, yet many deep learning approaches remain tied to the microphone arrays used during training and generalize poorly to unseen devices. This paper proposes an array-generic neural DoA estimation framework using measured or simulated complex directional array transfer functions (ATFs) matched to real-world multi-microphone devices. The method processes multichannel spectrograms and ATF metadata with separate convolutional encoders, fuses the resulting representations through cross-attention, and predicts source directions using a multi-source Cartesian vector output formulation. Experiments on simulated 2D and 3D localization tasks under reverberation and diffuse babble noise show that the proposed approach generalizes to previously unseen arrays, including mobile-phone-like configurations, without major performance degradation, while remaining competitive with conventional and learning-based baselines.

</details>


### [219] [LSEAD: A Privacy-Preserving LLM-Based Speech Analysis Framework for Early Alzheimer's Disease Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07378v1)
*Xin Wang,Yingchao Huang,Yuhan Su,Shanshan Yao,Wei Peng*

Main category: eess.AS

TL;DR: 提出LSEAD框架，利用预训练开源大语言模型提取语音转录文本嵌入，结合PCA降维，实现隐私保护的、非侵入性的早期阿尔茨海默病语音筛查，在ADReSS20和ADReSSo2021基准上准确率最高提升5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿尔茨海默病早期诊断对及时干预至关重要，现有检测方法多为侵入性或成本高，在真实临床场景中难以推广。语音筛查具有非侵入、低成本的优势，但需更强大的语言表征能力以提升检测精度，同时需兼顾隐私保护需求。

Method: LSEAD框架包含三个核心步骤：首先自动转录语音录音；其次使用本地部署的预训练开源LLM提取文本嵌入；然后通过主成分分析（PCA）降维，最后进行分类。整个过程仅依赖语音转录文本和本地模型，无需外部数据交换，保障隐私安全。

Result: 在ADReSS20和ADReSSo2021两个基准数据集上评估，LLM嵌入跨数据集泛化表现良好，与现有方法相比AD分类准确率最高提升5%，尤其在早期阶段检测中效果显著。

Conclusion: LSEAD提供了一种实用、安全且可扩展的早期AD筛查方案，兼顾检测精度与隐私保护，适合真实临床场景应用。

Abstract: Early diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease (AD) is critical for enabling timely interventions that may slow disease progression and improve patient outcomes. There is a growing need for AD detection methods that are non-invasive and cost-effective, especially in real-world clinical settings with diverse patient populations and recording conditions. Speech-based screening addresses these needs by using natural speech collected without specialized equipment. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have improved speech analysis by providing rich linguistic representations and strong generalization. In this study, we propose LSEAD, a speech-based AD detection framework using pretrained open-source LLMs. Speech recordings are automatically transcribed, and text embeddings are extracted using locally deployed LLMs. Principal component analysis (PCA) is applied to reduce dimensionality before classification. Because the framework relies only on speech transcripts and locally deployed models, it supports privacy-preserving AD risk assessment without external data exchange. We evaluate LSEAD on the ADReSS20 and ADReSSo2021 benchmark datasets. Experimental results show that LLM-based embeddings generalize well across datasets and improve AD classification accuracy by up to 5 percent over existing methods, especially for early-stage detection. These results demonstrate that LSEAD provides a practical, secure, and scalable approach for early AD screening.

</details>


### [220] [Assessing AI-generated music detection in real-world broadcast monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07359v1)
*David López-Ayala,Fernando García de la Cruz,Pablo Zinemanas,Emilio Molina,Martín Rocamora*

Main category: eess.AS

TL;DR: 本文提出BAMM数据集（40小时真实电视录制的AI音乐监测数据集），并评估CNN检测器在三种场景（干净前景音乐、合成广播、真实广播）下的表现。结果显示模型在干净场景近乎完美，但在真实广播条件下显著退化，揭示当前CNN检测方法在广播监控领域存在严重的领域差距，不足以实现可靠检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI生成音乐在广播媒体中日益普及，引发透明度与公平补偿问题；已有研究虽报告了广播场景下的性能退化，但仅基于合成广播数据评估，缺乏真实广播条件下的验证，存在critical domain gap。

Method: 构建BAMM数据集（40小时真实电视录制，含AI生成与人类创作音乐）；对比干净训练与广播训练的CNN变体，在三个渐进困难场景（CFM、STB、RTB）中进行评估。

Result: 两种模型在CFM上接近完美，在合成广播条件下显著退化；广播定向训练相比干净训练有所改善但性能仍有限；在真实广播条件（RTB/BAMM）下进一步退化，且AI生成与人类音乐得分严重重叠。

Conclusion: 当前基于CNN的检测器在广播监控中不足以实现可靠的AI生成音乐检测，暴露了关键领域差距，需要新的训练方法或模型架构来解决真实广播条件下的检测难题。

Abstract: The proliferation of AI-generated music in broadcast media raises concerns about transparency and fair compensation, but reliable detection under real broadcast conditions remains unresolved. Existing studies report substantial performance degradation in this domain, yet their evaluations are limited to synthetic broadcast data. To address this gap, we introduce BAMM (Broadcast AI-Music Monitoring), a 40-hour dataset of real-world television recordings containing AI-generated and human-made music. We compare clean-trained and broadcast-trained CNN variants across three progressively more challenging scenarios: Clean Foreground Music (CFM), Synthetic TV Broadcast (STB), and Real TV Broadcast (RTB). Both models achieve near-perfect performance on CFM but degrade substantially under synthetic broadcast conditions. Broadcast-oriented training improves robustness compared with clean training, although performance remains limited. On RTB, evaluated using BAMM, both models degrade further and show substantial score overlap between AI-generated and human-made music. These results expose a critical domain gap and show that current training approaches on CNN-based detectors remain insufficient for reliable AI-generated music detection in broadcast monitoring.

</details>

### [221] [Self-Knowledge Retrieval Augmented Generation Framework for Patent Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.11030v1)
*Jian Zhang,Songlin Lei,Zhuohao Yang,Bangli Liu,Ziwei Wang,Xufeng Weng,Gehan Amaratunga,Yu Lin,Hongwei Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自知识检索增强生成（self-knowledge RAG）框架，引导大语言模型自动提取专利中的关键技术实体并构建层级本体结构，实现查询扩展与精确检索，结合FAISS检索与生成式匹配机制，在真实专利数据集上显著提升了检索与匹配精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专利文档结构复杂、技术术语密集且包含多模态信息，传统方法难以准确识别专利间的细微差异；现有的LLM专利匹配方法依赖领域预训练或指令微调，存在人工标注成本高和灾难性遗忘问题；RAG方法虽引入外部知识，但未能充分发挥LLM自动解析专利和挖掘深层语义关系的能力。

Method: 提出self-knowledge RAG框架：1）引导LLM从专利匹配查询中自主提取关键技术实体并构建层级本体结构；2）利用自知识实现查询扩展；3）集成FAISS向量检索与生成式匹配机制，增强模型对专利创新的理解，提升检索与匹配精度。

Result: 在真实专利数据集上的实验结果展示了该方法在专利检索与匹配方面的卓越性能，验证了其有效性与应用潜力。

Conclusion: 该self-knowledge RAG框架成功克服了现有方法的局限，通过让LLM自主解析专利并挖掘深层语义关系，显著提升了专利检索与匹配的准确率，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Patent retrieval and matching based on large language models (LLMs) play a vital role in intellectual property protection. However, due to the complex structure of patent documents, dense technical terminology, and multi-modal information, traditional methods struggle to accurately identify subtle differences between patents. Existing LLM-based patent matching approaches typically rely on domain-specific pretrained or instruction tuning, which often entail high manual labeling costs and catastrophic forgetting. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods introduce external knowledge they fail to fully leverage LLM's capability to automatically parse patents and mine deep semantic relationships. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a self-knowledge RAG framework that guides LLMs to autonomously extract key technical entities and construct hierarchical ontological structures from patent matching queries, thereby enabling query expansion and precise retrieval. The method integrates the FAISS retrieval with a generative matching mechanism, leveraging self-knowledge to enhance the model's understanding of patent innovations and significantly improve retrieval and matching accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate the outstanding performance of the proposed method on real-world patent datasets, validating its effectiveness and application potential.

</details>


### [222] [ENTLORE: A Graph-Grounded Benchmark for Latent Organizational Reasoning in Enterprise Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10679v1)
*Akrin Zheng,Alexander Wu,Alaia Liu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出ENTLORE，一个基于图构建的企业问答基准框架，用于评估模型从日常文档中恢复隐含组织关系（即潜在组织推理）的能力。基准包含2,341篇文档、907个问题，跨越显式查找、跨源组合和潜在组织推理三类任务。实验发现即使供给黄金文档，潜在推理问题仍有30.4%无法回答，表明企业QA不仅依赖文档检索，还取决于隐含组织关系能否被利用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有企业问答基准虽然提供多源证据，但通常预先定义了答案路径，只测试已陈述事实的组合，而非从语料中缺失的目标关系中恢复隐含的组织关系。这种'潜在组织推理'能力未被现有基准覆盖，需要一个新的基准来评估。

Method: ENTLORE框架从日常文档、权威组织表和运营记录三类来源重建经审计的企业世界。通过版本化的组织规范在真值图中认证派生关系，实现完整黄金答案和证明证书。发布版本仅暴露文档语料，隐藏私有结构和目标关系。结构化的发布世界被组织为诱导实体图或可导航知识库进行评估。

Result: ENTLORE包含2,341篇文档、907个问题，在56种模型和访问配置下评估。结构化图谱形式（诱导实体图或知识库）取得最强可部署结果。但即使提供黄金文档，潜在推理问题仍有30.4%无法回答，而显式查询和组合问题分别为12.6%和6.2%。

Conclusion: 企业问答不仅依赖文档召回，还取决于隐含组织关系能否被有效利用。当前模型在潜在组织推理上存在明显短板，为未来企业QA系统设计提供了重要挑战和方向。

Abstract: Enterprise question answering is framed as retrieving internal documents and generating grounded answers. Routine enterprise records, however, are work by-products in which required organizational relations remain implicit across heterogeneous sources. Existing benchmarks provide realistic multi-source evidence, but often materialize a predefined answer path and therefore test the composition of stated facts rather than recovery of a target relation absent from the corpus. We call the latter capability latent organizational reasoning. We introduce ENTLORE, a graph-grounded benchmark construction framework that reconstructs an audited enterprise world from routine documents, authoritative organizational tables, and operational records. Versioned organizational conventions certify derived relations in a truth graph, enabling complete golden answers and proof certificates. The aligned anonymized release exposes only the document corpus while withholding private structure and target relations. ENTLORE contains 2,341 documents from three source types and 907 questions spanning explicit lookup, cross-source composition, and latent organizational reasoning, evaluated across 56 model and access configurations. Structuring the released world as an induced entity graph or navigable knowledge base gives the strongest deployable results. Yet supplying gold documents still leaves 30.4% of latent questions unanswered, versus 12.6% and 6.2% for explicit and compositional questions. Enterprise QA therefore depends not only on document recall, but also on whether implicit organizational relations become usable. The benchmark, data, and code are publicly available at ENTLORE.

</details>


### [223] [ConnectionMind: Leveraging Social Networks and Large Language Models for Personalized Recommendation at Meta](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10187v1)
*Haoyu Han,Yuming Liu,Lei Huang,Lizhu Zhang,Jiliang Tang,Xiangjun Fan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: ConnectionMind是Meta提出的生产级推荐框架，将社交网络图谱与LLM推理能力紧密结合，通过异构图上的路径发现将推荐建模为图推理问题，采用SFT+RL两阶段训练策略，已在Meta大规模推荐管线中部署并在线上A/B测试中提升了0.43%的视频观看时长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统推荐模型往往忽略社交关系信号或将其独立处理，缺乏将多关系上下文（好友、群组、创作者交互）与异构内容（文本、视频）进行整合推理的能力，难以实现细粒度的个性化推荐。

Method: 构建连接用户、物品、好友、群组和创作者页面的异构图，将推荐建模为从用户到候选物品的个性化路径发现的图推理问题；使用LLM-based策略在图结构上进行推理并指导推荐决策；采用两阶段训练：先在大规模用户-物品交互轨迹上进行SFT初始化推理策略，再通过端到端RL优化模型在社交图上的推理能力。

Result: 在多个真实数据集上的实验证明了ConnectionMind相比代表性基线的有效性；已在Meta大规模推荐管线中部署，在线A/B测试显示视频观看时长提升了0.43%。

Conclusion: ConnectionMind证明了将社交图结构与LLM推理能力深度融合是可行的生产级方案，能在真实推荐系统中带来可量化的业务收益，展示了社交感知的推理式推荐在实际部署中的价值。

Abstract: Modern recommendation systems on social media platforms such as Meta must model complex social relationships, including friendships, group memberships, and creator interactions, alongside massive and heterogeneous content such as text and video. Traditional recommendation models, however, often omit these signals or treat them independently, lacking the reasoning capability to integrate multi-relational context for fine-grained personalization. We present ConnectionMind, a production-ready recommendation framework that tightly integrates the social network structure with large language models (LLMs) to enable scalable, interpretable, and reasoning-aware personalization in Meta. ConnectionMind constructs a heterogeneous graph connecting users, items, friends, groups, and creator pages, and formulates recommendation as a graph reasoning problem: discovering personalized paths from users to candidate items. An LLM-based policy is employed to reason over these graph structures and guide recommendation decisions. To train the system at scale, ConnectionMind adopts a two-stage learning strategy. We first perform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on large-scale user-item interaction trajectories to initialize the reasoning policy, followed by end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) to refine the model's ability to reason over social graphs for personalized recommendation. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of ConnectionMind compared to representative baselines. More importantly, ConnectionMind has been deployed in Meta's large-scale recommendation pipeline and has been evaluated through online A/B tests, achieving a 0.43% improvement in video watch time. These results demonstrate measurable real-world impact in a production recommendation system.

</details>


### [224] [Search over the Visual World: Persistent Visual Memory, Layered Indexes, and Source-Grounded Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08075v1)
*Sankalp Nagaonkar,Rohit Garg,Ankit Raj,Ashish Choithani,Ashutosh Trivedi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出视频检索是一个基础设施问题，而非简单的排序问题。作者构建了面向视觉世界搜索的概念与形式化模型，包括分析器定义的场景（analyzer-defined scenes）、持久化理解产物、共享源时间的共存场景空间（visual memory），以及能力声明的索引。该模型通过VideoDB数据格式（VDB）在生产环境中实现，并提供类型化的搜索接口，覆盖规划检索、状态化调查、直接访问和接地综合。在9800+查询、四个公开数据集上的语义检索对比中，通用组件流水线在Recall@1/@3/@10上优于商业视频原生引擎（73.09/83.39/91.20 vs 65.75/77.13/89.10），仅在Recall@50上略低于基线（96.07 vs 96.42）。结论是当前视觉世界检索质量更受系统设计而非视频专属预训练影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频检索系统假设有界语料库并返回排好序的文件或时间戳，但面向摄像头、屏幕、流媒体和档案的智能体面临不同问题：观测持续到达、模型在不同时间粒度下解释、上下文选择不能重放完整视觉记录、结果必须连接可检查的源证据。作者认为这类检索本质上是基础设施问题，无法简化为对视频文件的排序。

Method: 作者提出视觉世界搜索的概念与形式化模型，核心概念包括：分析器定义的场景、持久化理解产物、作为共享源时间上共存场景空间的视觉记忆，以及能力声明的索引；并明确区分记忆（保留全部内容）、上下文（为任务选择的内容）和证据（作为依据的源区间）。该模型通过VDB数据格式在生产中实现，提供类型化搜索表面，支持规划检索、状态化调查、直接访问和接地综合，将分割、采样、模型选择、嵌入和排序视为系统决策，并将实时流作为一等公民。

Result: 在四个公开数据集上使用9800+查询进行的语义检索对比中，通用组件流水线在宏平均Recall@1/@3/@10上达到73.09/83.39/91.20，优于商业视频原生引擎的65.75/77.13/89.10；而基线在Recall@50上更高（96.42 vs 96.07）。这表明视觉世界的检索质量主要由系统设计而非视频专属预训练决定。

Conclusion: 检索视觉世界的质量当前更多取决于系统设计而非视频专属预训练，视觉记忆基础设施能够在保持可播放、源接地证据为一等公民的前提下实现这一目标。作者主张采用模型无关的基础设施而非提供固定API的视频原生基础模型。

Abstract: Most video-retrieval systems assume a bounded corpus and return ranked files or timestamps. Agents operating over cameras, screens, streams, and archives face a different systems problem: observations arrive continuously; models interpret them at different temporal granularities; context must be selected without replaying the complete visual record; and results must stay connected to inspectable source evidence. We argue that search over such a corpus is an infrastructure problem that cannot be reduced to ranking video files. We develop a conceptual and formal model of search over the visual world built on analyzer-defined scenes, persistent understanding artifacts, visual memory as coexisting scene spaces over shared source time, and capability-declared indexes, distinguishing memory (everything retained), context (what is selected for a task), and evidence (the source intervals that ground it). The VideoDB data format (VDB) realizes this model in production, exposed through a typed search surface spanning planned retrieval, stateful investigation, direct access, and grounded synthesis. We contrast this model-agnostic infrastructure, where segmentation, sampling, model choice, embeddings, and ranking are system decisions and live streams are first-class sources, with video-native foundation models offered as fixed APIs. In a semantic-retrieval comparison against a commercial video-native engine spanning 9,800+ queries over four public datasets, a pipeline of general-purpose components achieves higher macro-averaged Recall@1/@3/@10 (73.09/83.39/91.20 versus 65.75/77.13/89.10), while the baseline is higher at Recall@50 (96.42 versus 96.07). Retrieval quality over the visual world is today governed more by system design than by video-specific pretraining, and visual-memory infrastructure can deliver it while keeping playable, source-grounded evidence first-class.

</details>


### [225] [Give the Long-tail More SPACE: Promoting Provider Fairness in Next POI Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07998v1)
*Anran Zhang,Jiaqi Jiang,jiahui Jin,Yuhan Zhao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SPACE是一个模型无关的框架，通过虚拟用户生成来提升POI推荐中长尾POI的曝光率，同时兼顾用户执行约束和POI资源供应约束，在不修改现有推荐器架构的前提下提升提供者公平性并保持推荐精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流POI推荐模型倾向于将曝光集中在少数热门POI上，导致长尾商家系统性曝光不足。虽然提供者公平性已引起关注，但直接将现有公平性技术应用于POI推荐存在两个问题：用户面临执行约束（物理可达性等），POI面临资源供应约束（容量限制等）。

Method: SPACE由三个阶段组成：(1) 社区推断，捕捉异构的用户执行约束；(2) 不平衡最优传输分配，在POI特定供应预算下决定每个长尾POI应从哪些社区获得多少虚拟用户；(3) 约束引导的潜空间扩散，生成POI条件化的、社区一致的虚拟用户嵌入。

Result: 在三个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，SPACE在多个骨干模型上显著提升了提供者公平性，同时维持并常常改善了推荐准确性。

Conclusion: SPACE通过虚拟用户生成的方式，在显式可行性和供应控制下有效改善了长尾POI曝光，为POI推荐中的提供者公平性提供了可落地、模型无关的解决方案。

Abstract: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation predicts users' future destinations from historical mobility sequences and has become a key component of location-based services. However, mainstream models often concentrate exposure on a small set of popular POIs, leaving long-tail merchants systematically under-exposed. While provider fairness has recently attracted increasing attention, directly applying existing provider-fairness techniques to POI recommendation is problematic: (i) users face execution constraints; and (ii) POIs face resource supply constraints. To address this, we propose SPACE (Supply- and Physics-Aware Conditional Embedding generation), a model-agnostic framework that improves long-tail POI exposure via virtual user generation under explicit feasibility and supply control. SPACE consists of three stages: (1) community inference to capture heterogeneous user execution constraints; (2) unbalanced optimal-transport allocation to decide how many virtual users each tail POI should receive from which communities under POI-specific supply budgets; and (3) constraint-guided latent diffusion to generate POI-conditional, community-consistent virtual user embeddings. The generated user-POI pairs can be seamlessly used to train existing recommenders without modifying their architectures. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that SPACE substantially improves provider fairness while maintaining and often improving recommendation accuracy across multiple backbone models. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Anniran1/SPACE-main.

</details>


### [226] [Hierarchical Quantization with Domain-Adaptive Sparse Routing for Generative Cross-Domain Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06997v1)
*Haiying He,Xiaopeng Li,Yuchen Gu,Kuo Cai,Bo Chen,Jingtong Gao,Yejing Wang,Derong Xu,Ruiming Tang,Guorui Zhou,Han Li,Xiangyu Zhao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出HD-Rec，一种用于跨域推荐（CDR）的统一生成式推荐框架。它通过层级域感知量化器（全局共享粗粒度码本+自适应路由细粒度码本）构建语义ID，引入域自适应稀疏混合专家模块（持续激活的共享专家+动态选择的专家），并设计了跨粒度路由一致性目标函数来提升多token物品表征的一致性。在三个公开跨域推荐基准上优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐（GenRec）在单域上表现优异，但扩展到跨域推荐时面临挑战：一个统一模型需要同时容纳来自不同域的异构物品语义和行为模式。现有方法依赖全局共享表征或轻量级域适应，其容量不足以在不同语义粒度上建模异构模式。

Method: 1) 层级域感知量化器（Hierarchical Domain-Aware Quantizer）：利用全局共享的粗粒度码本和自适应路由的细粒度码本来构造语义标识符；2) 域自适应稀疏MoE模块：持续激活的共享专家+动态选择的专门化专家的组合；3) 跨粒度路由一致性目标：将token级路由决策约束到item级共识，提升多token表示的一致性。

Result: 在三个公开的跨域推荐基准数据集上，HD-Rec一致性地优于竞争的序列推荐、生成式推荐和跨域推荐基线方法。

Conclusion: HD-Rec通过层级化的域感知量化与域自适应稀疏专家路由，有效解决了统一生成式模型在跨域异构语义和异构行为模式下的建模容量不足问题，为跨域生成式推荐提供了有效范式的验证。

Abstract: Generative Recommendation (GenRec) represents a promising paradigm that achieves remarkable empirical success by encoding items as compact Semantic IDs (SIDs) and modeling user behavior via next-token prediction across diverse recommendation scenarios. Extending this paradigm to cross-domain recommendation is challenging because a unified model must accommodate heterogeneous item semantics and behavioral patterns across domains. Existing methods commonly rely on globally shared representations or lightweight domain adaptation, which may provide insufficient capacity for modeling heterogeneous patterns at different semantic granularities. To address these challenges, we propose HD-Rec, a unified generative framework for cross-domain recommendation. HD-Rec employs a hierarchical domain-aware quantizer that constructs semantic identifiers using globally shared coarse-level codebooks and adaptively routed fine-level codebooks. It further introduces a domain-adaptive sparse mixture-of-experts module that combines a continuously activated shared expert with a dynamically selected specialized expert. To improve the coherence of multi-token item representations, we develop a cross-granularity routing consistency objective that regularizes token-level routing decisions toward their item-level consensus. Experiments on three public cross-domain recommendation benchmarks show that HD-Rec consistently improves over competitive sequential, generative, and cross-domain recommendation baselines.

</details>

### [227] [How Roadside Units Enhance Intersection Safety? Cooperative Autonomous Driving System Design and A Proof of Concept](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09144v1)
*Taoyuan Yu,Kui Wang,Zongdian Li,Tao Yu,Walid Saad,Kei Sakaguchi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种基于数字孪生（DT）的车-基础设施-车（V2I2V）协作系统，部署在路侧单元（RSU）上，通过分层强化学习（HRL）框架实现智能交叉路口下网联自动驾驶车辆（CAV）的集中式协同控制，消除盲区并提升安全性与通行效率。仿真与真实概念验证（PoC）实验均验证了系统有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交叉路口是城市道路网络中最危险的区域之一，由于异质交通参与者混行和视线受限，常导致严重交通冲突。现有方法难以在动态复杂环境中同时兼顾安全与效率，需要一种能够消除盲区、集中协调CAV的系统架构。

Method: 提出V2I2V协作系统：架构上集成云端全局数字孪生（宏观引导）与RSU本地数字孪生（实时操作）；控制层面采用分层强化学习（HRL）框架，结合离线预训练与在线微调，实现鲁棒的协同控制。

Result: 仿真实验在真实通信与交通约束下保证高安全、高效率和高平顺性；PoC实验中RSU中心控制回路决策延迟约42ms，行人安全停车距离保持8.5m，同时缩短停车时长与整体通行时间。

Conclusion: 所提出的系统在智能交叉路口展现出鲁棒且可扩展的性能，兼顾了交通安全与通行效率，具备实际部署价值。

Abstract: Intersections remain one of the most hazardous locations in urban road networks, where heterogeneous traffic participants and limited visibility frequently lead to severe traffic conflicts. In this paper, a vehicle-to-infrastructure-to-vehicle (V2I2V) cooperative system is proposed for improving road safety and traffic efficiency by using digital twins (DTs) deployed on roadside units (RSUs) to eliminate blind spots and centrally coordinate connected and automated vehicles (CAVs) in smart intersections. The proposed system integrates cloud-based global DTs for macroscopic guidance and RSU-based local DTs for real-time operations. Within this architecture, a hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) framework combines offline pre-training with online fine-tuning to achieve robust cooperative control. Experimental results show that the proposed system achieves substantial improvements in safety and efficiency in simulation experiments and real-world proof-of-concept (PoC) trials. In simulations, our system ensures high safety, efficiency, and smoothness under realistic communications and traffic constraints. In PoC trials, the RSU-centric control loop achieves a decision-making latency of approximately 42 ms and maintains a safe stopping distance of 8.5 m for pedestrians, while also shortening stop duration and overall traversal time. These results indicate that the proposed system provides robust and scalable performance at smart intersections.

</details>


### [228] [ML-Based Hierarchical Prediction for Practical Energy Scheduling in Dynamic NTN-WPT Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08804v1)
*Zhanyu Ju,Wenchi Cheng*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将无线能量传输（WPT）集成到非地面网络（NTN）中的能量调度方法，通过三层预测框架（状态预测层、交互映射层、决策层）结合GNN、多目标强化学习（MORL）和多智能体PPO算法，联合优化能量效率、任务完成率和任务等待时间，实现低地球轨道卫星向地面用户设备的能量传输调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着长距离无线能量传输和天基能源技术的进步，将WPT集成到非地面网络（NTN-WPT）成为下一代无线网络的有前景方案。然而，由于卫星和用户设备的移动性以及随机传播效应带来的信道不确定性，能量调度的挑战十分严峻，需要一种能够同时优化能量效率、任务完成率和任务等待时间等多种竞争性目标的调度方法。

Method: 将联合优化问题分解为三个子问题，构建三层预测框架：1）状态预测层利用机器学习预测用户设备和卫星状态；2）交互映射层采用图神经网络（GNN）建模能量传输效率；3）决策层确定能量分配方案。采用多目标强化学习（MORL）将多目标标量化加权求和为单目标问题，并提出融合自注意力机制与多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）的深度学习模型来改善多目标平衡。

Result: 仿真结果表明，所提方法相比基线方法实现了更好的整体权衡，在保持竞争力的任务完成率和能量效率的同时降低了任务等待时间，并且在高度可变的条件下保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 提出的NTN-WPT能量调度方法通过分层预测框架和MORL技术有效解决了多目标调度难题，在能量效率、任务完成率和任务等待时间之间取得了更优的平衡，并能适应高度变化的信道条件，为下一代无线网络中空间能量传输的实际部署提供了有力支撑。

Abstract: With advancements in long-distance wireless power transfer (WPT) and space-based energy technologies, integrating WPT into non-terrestrial networks (NTNs), referred to as NTN-WPT, is emerging as a promising approach for next-generation wireless networks. This paper proposes an energy-scheduling approach that jointly optimizes energy efficiency, task completion rate, and task waiting time for power transfer from low Earth orbit satellites to terrestrial mobile user devices (UDs). To address scheduling challenges caused by satellite and UD mobility and channel uncertainty from stochastic propagation effects, we decompose the problem into three subproblems within a three-layer predictive framework: 1) a state prediction layer forecasts UD and satellite states; 2) an interaction mapping layer uses a graph neural network (GNN) to model energy transfer efficiency; and 3) a decision-making layer determines the energy allocation plan. Distinct machine learning (ML) methods are tailored to each layer. To balance the competing objectives, we adopt a multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) technique that scalarizes them into a weighted-sum reward, transforming the multi-objective problem into a tractable single-objective problem. We further introduce a multi-agent deep learning model integrating self-attention with multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO) to improve objective balancing. Simulation results show that the proposed approach achieves a better overall trade-off than baseline methods, maintaining competitive task completion rates and energy efficiency while reducing task waiting times, and remains robust under highly variable conditions.

</details>


### [229] [Information-Aware Model Predictive Control for Satellite Inspection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07765v2)
*Sarah E. Clees,Sean Phillips,Christopher Petersen*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于模型预测控制（MPC）的自主航天器巡检框架，将估计协方差嵌入控制目标中，通过对偶控制与协方差控制思想，使轨迹在满足安全和输入约束的同时主动降低目标航天器特征点的估计不确定性并改善可观测性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统制导与控制方法将估计与控制解耦，导致生成的轨迹无法显式优化传感几何构型，难以在巡检任务中主动获取高质量测量信息。

Method: 采用Hill-Clohessy-Wiltshire相对运动方程，建立线性卡尔曼滤波器下的估计协方差演化模型，将协方差动态嵌入MPC目标函数（基于对偶控制和协方差控制思想），并设置控制输入约束、相对距离约束和终端最大协方差约束。

Result: 数值仿真表明该框架能够生成可行的巡检轨迹，在满足输入和安全约束的同时主动降低目标上感兴趣点的估计协方差。初始条件网格分析进一步揭示了可行性及轨迹价值函数对初始条件和约束激活情况的依赖性。

Conclusion: 将估计协方差直接纳入MPC优化框架可有效提升自主航天器巡检的传感质量与可观测性，为估计与控制联合优化的轨迹规划提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Autonomous spacecraft inspection requires trajectories that satisfy safety and control constraints while enabling the collection of informative measurements about a target spacecraft. Traditional guidance and control methods typically decouple estimation from control, resulting in trajectories that do not explicitly optimize sensing geometry. This work presents a model predictive control (MPC) framework that incorporates estimation covariance in the control objective using a formulation inspired by dual control and covariance steering. The estimation covariance evolves according to a linear Kalman filter, and the measurement model depends on the relative geometry between the agent spacecraft and the target. By embedding the covariance dynamics within the MPC problem, the resulting trajectories account for measurement quality, actively reduce uncertainty, and improve observability in the estimated features of the target. The problem is formulated using relative motion dynamics via the Hill-Clohessy-Wiltshire equations with constraints on control input, relative distance, and terminal maximum covariance. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed framework generates feasible inspection trajectories that actively reduce estimation covariance of points of interest on a target while satisfying input and safety constraints of the agent. A mesh analysis of initial conditions further illustrates how feasibility and the value function of the trajectory depend on the initial conditions and constraint activity.

</details>


### [230] [Topology Inference for Immune System Networks by Using Cell Amount Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07403v1)
*Yushan Li,Rikard Forlin,Dimos V. Dimarogonas,Petter Brodin*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于受限二次规划的拓扑推断方法，用于从细胞清除实验中推断免疫细胞群的相互作用拓扑结构。方法利用细胞数量的三个性质（状态非负性、比率收敛、拓扑权重的三元符号）构建简化模型，并在有限数据条件下实现有效的拓扑推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 免疫细胞相互作用的拓扑推断面临两个核心挑战：一是缺乏标准的细胞相互作用解析模型，二是实验成本高导致可用数据极为有限。作者希望通过利用实验中的常见知识和观察来克服这些困难。

Method: 首先基于实验中的共同知识和观察，刻画细胞相互作用过程中细胞数量的三个性质：状态非负性、基于比率的收敛性、拓扑权重的三元符号。然后构建一个结构简单且解析便利的新模型，并推导该模型满足这三个性质的充分条件。最后，基于所构建的模型，提出一个约束二次规划方法，从有限数量的数据对中推断拓扑结构。

Result: 在实验数据上的验证表明了所提出的拓扑推断方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该研究通过利用生物学先验知识构建简化模型，结合约束优化方法，成功在有限数据条件下实现了免疫细胞拓扑推断，为该领域提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent years have witnessed the advanced development of topology inference research, which helps elucidate the interaction relationships of components in many biological networks. This paper focuses on inferring the topology of a group of immune cells, based on the collected data from cell-depletion based experiments. The problem is very challenging due to i) the lack of standard analytical models for the cell interactions, and ii) the restrictive data availability determined by the huge experiment and time costs. To address these issues, we first leverage certain common knowledge and observations on the experiments to characterize three properties on the cell amounts during the interaction process: state non-negativity, ratio-based convergence, and triple signs of topology weights. Then, we construct a new model with simple structure and analytical convenience, and obtain sufficient conditions for the model to accommodate all three properties. Finally, based on the constructed model, we propose a constrained quadratic programming method to infer the topology from limited number of data pairs. Validation on experiment data demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

</details>

### [231] [A Special Point Skeleton Reconstruction Algorithm for Dynamic Multiobjective Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06096v1)
*GuangXian Gan,MinRong Chen*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于特殊点骨架重构的动态多目标进化算法（SPSR-DMOEA），通过提取当前环境的质心、膝点和极端点，预测其在下一环境中的位置，并利用质心与其他锚点的连接及非质心锚点间的最小生成树构建预测骨架，沿骨架边均匀生成候选解并施加正交扰动，以更好地利用代表性解间的结构关系来应对环境变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态多目标优化算法主要依赖个体迁移或独立特殊点采样来应对环境变化，未能充分利用代表性解之间的结构关系，导致环境变化后的预测和搜索效率有限。

Method: 首先从当前环境的Pareto最优解集中提取质心、膝点和极端点，并根据跨连续环境的运动速度自适应预测这些特殊点在新环境中的位置；然后在决策空间中连接质心与其他锚点，并在非质心锚点间构造最小生成树，形成可描述整体种群结构的预测骨架；根据骨架边长度按比例分配个体数量，沿每条边均匀生成候选解，并引入随机正交扰动以扩展骨架周围的搜索区域。

Result: 在DF动态多目标基准测试套件上的实验结果表明，该方法在动态跟踪能力方面表现出有效性。

Conclusion: SPSR-DMOEA通过挖掘代表性解间的结构关系构建预测骨架，能够有效提升动态多目标优化中的环境变化响应能力与跟踪性能。

Abstract: To address the issue that existing dynamic multi-objective optimization algorithms mainly rely on individual migration or independent special point sampling after environmental changes, while failing to fully exploit the structural relationships among representative solutions, a Special Point Skeleton Reconstruction based Dynamic Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm (SPSR-DMOEA) is proposed. First, the centroid, knee points, and extreme points are extracted from the Pareto optimal solution set of the current environment, and their positions in the new environment are adaptively predicted according to their movement velocities across consecutive environments. Subsequently, in the decision space, the centroid is connected with other anchor points, and a minimum spanning tree is constructed among the non-centroid anchor points, thereby establishing a prediction skeleton capable of describing the overall population structure. According to the lengths of the skeleton edges, the number of individuals allocated to each edge is determined proportionally. Candidate solutions are uniformly generated along each edge, and random orthogonal perturbations are introduced to expand the search region around the skeleton. Experimental results on the DF dynamic multi-objective benchmark suite demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in dynamic tracking capability.

</details>

### [232] [RepoOMP: Repository-Aware Hotspot OpenMP Parallelization via Dependency-Aware Context Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05855v1)
*Yongjie Qian,Ke Gao,Zhibin Zhang,Shaohui Peng,Ling Li*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: RepoOMP是一个混合框架，通过构建多粒度属性性能图(MAP)和结构化转换上下文(STC)来恢复并行化相关证据，并将热点在确定性规则和LLM代理之间路由，从而解决成熟代码库中OpenMP并行化的非局部证据难题。在951个热点上评估，372个被接受，平均加速比达8.23x(NPB)和8.96x(BOTS)，真实热点中位数加速比2.25x。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成熟代码库中的OpenMP并行化很难，因为循环安全性和优化收益往往依赖于非局部证据。基于规则的工具在合法性无法本地证明时会欠并行化，而基于代理的方法在检索遗漏关键依赖或包含无关代码时变得不稳定。

Method: RepoOMP采用混合框架：1) 构建多粒度属性性能图(MAP)来恢复并行化相关证据；2) 将热点在确定性规则和LLM代理之间路由；3) 构建结构化转换上下文(STC)，在暴露依赖事实的同时避免向模型泛滥无关仓库文本。

Result: 在951个热点(NPB、BOTS、FFmpeg、NCNN、GROMACS)上评估，372个热点通过编译、负载特定检查和正向加速验证，包括330个真实仓库热点。平均加速比NPB为8.23x、BOTS为8.96x；九个详细真实内核交叉骨干平均5.25x，加速比提升18-28%，代理端token成本降低47-68%。330个真实热点的中位数加速为2.25x。

Conclusion: RepoOMP提供了一种证据引导的工作流，能够在仓库环境中有效进行热点并行化，在保持高接受率的同时显著提升加速比并降低LLM代理的token成本。

Abstract: OpenMP parallelization of hotspots in mature repositories remains difficult because loop safety and optimization payoff often depend on non-local evidence. Rule-based tools under-parallelize when legality is not locally provable, while agent-based approaches become unstable when retrieval misses decisive dependencies or includes irrelevant code. We present RepoOMP, a hybrid framework that recovers parallelization-relevant evidence before generation. RepoOMP builds a Multi-granularity Attributes Performance graph (MAP), routes hotspots between deterministic rules and an LLM agent, and constructs a Structured Transformation Context (STC) that exposes dependency facts without flooding the model with unrelated repository text. We evaluate RepoOMP on 951 profiled hotspots from NPB, BOTS, FFmpeg, NCNN, and GROMACS. Under compilation, workload-specific checks, and positive speedup, 372 hotspots are accepted, including 330 real-world repository hotspots. RepoOMP achieves average speedups of $8.23\times$ on NPB and $8.96\times$ on BOTS. For the nine detailed real-world kernels used in matched-backbone and robustness analyses, RepoOMP reaches a cross-backbone mean of $5.25\times$, improves speedup by 18--28\%, and reduces agent-side token cost by 47--68\% relative to the unstructured Claude Code baseline. Across 330 accepted real-world hotspots, median speedup is $2.25\times$. Overall, RepoOMP provides an evidence-guided workflow for hotspot parallelization in repository settings. The open-source repository is available at https://github.com/Qlalq/RepoOMP_Simplified.

</details>

### [233] [Robust Unit Commitment in District Heating Networks: Chance-Constrained and CVaR Optimization Under Demand Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10899v1)
*Annika Buchholz,Janina Zittel,Thorsten Koch*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对区域供热网络运行规划中热需求不确定性问题，将机会约束规划（CC）和条件风险价值（CVaR）优化方法适配到混合整数机组组合问题中，结合贝叶斯模型生成热需求预测分布，在柏林真实数据和合成基准实例上评估两种不确定性处理方法的解质量、风险暴露和计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 区域供热网络是能源转型的关键组成部分，但其运行规划面临热需求显著不确定性的挑战，需要在保持系统可靠性的前提下解决这一波动性问题。

Method: 将机会约束规划（CC）和条件风险价值（CVaR）优化适配到区域供热网络的混合整数机组组合问题中；使用贝叶斯模型生成热需求时间序列，显式量化预测不确定性并产生预测分布作为网络优化的输入；CC方法限制未满足需求概率，CVaR方法惩罚分布尾部的严重短缺。

Result: 在柏林区域供热网络真实数据以及不同规模的合成基准实例上，比较了两种不确定性处理方法在解质量、风险暴露和计算效率方面的表现。

Conclusion: 两种鲁棒优化方法均能在需求不确定性下计算最优机组组合调度方案，但各有不同的风险-解质量-计算成本权衡特性，为区域供热网络的可靠运行规划提供了有效的方法论支撑。

Abstract: While district heating networks are a key component of the energy transition, their operational planning is challenging due to substantial uncertainty in heat demand. We address this volatility without compromising system reliability. By adapting chance-constrained programming (CC) and conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) optimization to the mixed-integer unit-commitment problem for district-heating networks, we can compute optimal unit-commitment schedules under demand uncertainty. We generate heat demand time series using a Bayesian model, which explicitly quantifies forecasting uncertainty and yields predictive distributions as input to the network optimization. To handle the inherent uncertainty in heat demand, we apply both robust optimization approaches: chance-constrained programming limits the probability of unmet demand, while CVaR optimization penalizes severe shortfalls in the tail of the distribution. We evaluate the approaches both on real-world data from the Berlin district heating network and on a benchmark set of synthetic, realistically parameterized instances of varying sizes. The results compare the two uncertainty-handling methods with respect to solution quality, risk exposure, and computational effort.

</details>


### [234] [An inverse mixed-integer optimization framework for learning interpretable models of expert decision making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05585v1)
*Anurag Holani,Rishabh Gupta,John Wassick,Qi Zhang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种逆优化方法，从专家观察到的决策行为中联合学习其感知成本（偏好）和决策规则，并通过三个案例研究（排班、生产计划、实际路径规划）验证了该方法在捕捉和复现专家决策方面的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专家决策策略通常隐含且难以显式表达，但理解并转移这种知识对于培训新手、提升人机系统性能以及实现全自主系统至关重要。因此需要从专家观察到的决策中学习一个可解释的模型来捕捉其决策过程。

Method: 提出一种逆优化（inverse optimization）方法，构建一个联合学习框架，同时估计决策者的感知成本（偏好）和决策规则，两者共同作用于对专家行为的学习与建模。

Result: 通过三个案例研究（班次分配问题、生产计划问题和实际路径规划问题）展示了方法的通用性。结果表明，同时建模感知成本和决策规则可获得更好的预测性能，验证了该框架在捕捉和复现专家决策方面具有更大的灵活性。

Conclusion: 同时学习感知成本与决策规则的逆优化框架能够更有效地捕捉专家决策过程，在多个领域具有广泛适用性，为专家知识转移和自主系统开发提供了有价值的方法基础。

Abstract: Understanding how experts make decisions and being able to transfer that knowledge is important, especially in complex engineering applications. It is highly valuable for training novices, improving the performance of human-machine systems, and potentially enabling fully autonomous systems that perform as well as human experts. However, an expert's decision-making strategy, developed through years of experience, is often not directly accessible, since the implicit preferences and decision rules involved can be difficult to specify explicitly. This has motivated the use of observed decisions made by the expert to learn an interpretable model that captures the expert's decision-making process. In this work, we develop an inverse optimization approach to jointly learn the decision-maker's preferences (or perceived costs) and the decision rules governing their choices. We demonstrate the general applicability of our approach using three case studies that consider a shift assignment problem, a production planning problem, and a real-world routing problem, respectively. Across these case studies, modeling both perceived costs and decision rules leads to better predictions, highlighting the value of the proposed framework and its greater flexibility in capturing and replicating expert decision making.

</details>

### [235] [Modeling and Interpreting Correlations, Null Distributions and Significance Levels in Neural Tracking of Natural Stimuli](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10887v1)
*Simon Geirnaert,Alexander Bertrand,Tom Francart,Jonas Vanthornhout*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文指出神经追踪相关性的幅度不仅取决于大脑追踪刺激的强度，还取决于被相关信号的统计特性，因此必须与零分布比较才能有意义地解释。作者证明常见的随机化程序隐含不同的零假设，并提出刺激-反应错位（stimulus-response misalignment）作为最合适的选择。引入基于Fisher变换后正态分布的半参数模型，仅需3-5分钟数据即可获得准确的显著性水平，并提出零归一化追踪分数（null-normalized tracking score）作为可解释的统一度量。在121名被试的EEG连续语音数据上验证，该框架可逆转基于原始相关性的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经追踪相关性的大小不仅反映大脑对刺激的跟踪强度，还受信号统计特性的影响（例如窄带语音包络即使信息量低也容易产生高相关），导致原始相关性的比较在特征、模型或设置之间产生误导性结论。因此需要一种能够正确解释相关性意义、区分真实追踪与统计假象的方法论。

Method: 提出三种关键方法：（1）比较不同随机化程序构造零分布的方式，论证刺激-响应错位（stimulus-response misalignment）是最实用且最合适的零假设；（2）引入半参数模型，利用Fisher变换后的正态分布从少量数据（3-5分钟）准确估计显著性水平，并可跨分析窗口长度预测；（3）提出零归一化追踪分数（null-normalized tracking score），将特征和模型置于统一可比的尺度上，与广泛使用的match-mismatch准确性直接关联。EEG验证使用121名听连续语音的被试数据。

Result: 在121名被试的EEG连续语音实验中，该框架揭示了原始相关性结论被逆转的情况（即某些特征在原始相关性中看似追踪强度高，但在零归一化后表现不佳或相反），证明原始相关性分析可能导致实质性的解释错误，而所提出的半参数零分布方法和零归一化分数提供了高效、可靠且可解释的替代方案。

Conclusion: 神经追踪相关性的解释必须建立在其零分布之上，零归一化追踪分数提供了将特征、模型置于共同尺度的可解释度量，是神经追踪分析中更严谨、更高效的方法论选择。

Abstract: Neural tracking - the time-locking of neural responses to continuous stimuli such as speech, music, and video - is widely used to study how the brain processes natural input. Tracking strength is typically quantified as the correlation between the recorded neural response and the stimulus, decoded and/or encoded through data-driven models, and this correlation is routinely used to compare stimulus features, models, or settings. However, its magnitude depends not only on how strongly the brain tracks the stimulus, but also on the statistical properties of the signals being correlated. For example, a smallband speech envelope carrying almost no information about speech content yields among the highest correlations, simply because it is easier to reconstruct. Meaningful interpretation therefore requires comparing each correlation to its null distribution: the correlations expected without any stimulus-response relationship. We show that the randomization procedures commonly used to construct this null distribution are not interchangeable: each implicitly encodes a different null hypothesis, and we motivate stimulus-response misalignment as the most practical and appropriate choice. Because reliable null distributions require many permutations, we introduce a semi-parametric model using the normal distribution after the Fisher transform that yields accurate significance levels from only 3-5 min of data and predicts them across analysis window lengths. Building on this, we propose the null-normalized tracking score, an interpretable measure placing features and models on a common scale, which relates directly to the widely used match-mismatch accuracy. Applied to EEG from 121 participants listening to continuous speech, the framework reverses conclusions drawn from raw correlations, providing an efficient and principled methodology for interpreting neural tracking correlations.

</details>


### [236] [Complexity and Stability of Neural Activity Across Aging and Neurodegenerative Disease](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05882v1)
*Junjie Yu,Jianyu Zhang,Zian Pei,Xue Shi,Yumei Liu,Xin Jiang,Quanying Liu,Yi Guo*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 该论文提出以分布视角量化EEG神经表征的时间稳定性，使用Wasserstein距离衡量各窗口活动模式的分布稳定性，并结合固有维度（intrinsic dimensionality）刻画表征复杂度。在多任务、全生命周期和临床EEG数据集上发现：神经表征呈现受约束的条件特异性稳定而非无约束漂移；更高维度与更低稳定性相关；后脑区维度更高但稳定性更低；健康老化伴随维度升高和稳定性降低，而轻度认知障碍和阿尔茨海默病则两者同时塌缩。该框架可作为追踪认知老化和神经退行性疾病的敏感生物标志物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG信号即使在固定的认知状态下也会持续波动，关键科学问题在于大脑是否随时间仍重复使用相似的活动模式来表征信息。作者试图从分布层面回答这一问题，而非仅关注瞬时信号。

Method: 将EEG建模为加窗活动模式的分布，使用Wasserstein距离量化这些分布在时间上的稳定性；同时通过固有维度估计表征空间的复杂度。在多个数据集（多任务、生命周期、临床）上联合分析稳定性和维度，并考察其空间组织模式。

Result: 神经表征表现出受约束的条件特异性稳定而非无约束漂移；固有维度越高，时间稳定性越低；两个指标均呈现可重复的空间组织（后脑区维度更高、稳定性更低）；健康老化表现为维度上升和稳定性下降，而轻度认知障碍和阿尔茨海默病表现为两者同时塌缩。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了分布层面的框架来理解认知、老化和疾病中的神经稳定性，并提出了一种量化神经表征稳定性的原则性方法，在临床中可作为追踪认知老化和神经退行性疾病的敏感生物标志物。

Abstract: Objective: EEG signals fluctuate continuously even within a fixed cognitive state, but an important question is whether the brain still reuses similar activity patterns to represent information over time. Methods: To address this, we model EEG as distributions of windowed activity patterns and quantify their temporal stability using Wasserstein distance, while intrinsic dimensionality captures representational complexity. Results: Across multi-task, lifespan, and clinical EEG datasets, we find that neural representations show constrained, condition-specific stability rather than unconstrained drift. Higher intrinsic dimensionality is consistently associated with lower stability, suggesting that richer representational spaces are less reproducible over time. Both measures exhibit reproducible spatial organization, with posterior regions showing higher dimensionality and lower stability than frontal regions. Healthy aging is characterized by increased dimensionality and reduced stability, whereas mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer's disease show a joint collapse of both. Conclusions: These findings provide a distribution-level framework for understanding neural stability across cognition, aging, and disease. Significance: This framework offers a principled approach to quantifying neural representational stability, with potential utility as a sensitive biomarker for tracking cognitive aging and neurodegeneration in clinical settings.

</details>

### [237] [Surgical WAM: A World-Action Model for Data-Efficient Surgical Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.11204v1)
*Wenrui Bao,Tianyun Jiang,Zhiben Chen,Ser-Nam Lim,Peter D. Peng,Yuzhang Shang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Surgical World-Action Model (Surgical WAM)，一种基于Cosmos Policy的统一生成式模型，通过无动作视频预训练学习手术视觉动态，再在固定数量的动作标注数据上微调，从而实现闭环手术机器人操作。在四个仿真手术操作任务上，视频预训练将平均成功率从63.5%提升至77.8%，PegTransfer任务最高提升20个百分点，证明无动作视频能为手术机器人控制提供可迁移的视觉动态先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术机器人操作策略的学习受限于动作标注演示数据的稀缺性：遥操作dVRK同步运动学数据采集成本高昂，而手术任务又要求精确的接触处理、长时程推理和双臂协调。内窥镜视频相对廉价且丰富，现有手术世界模型仅将视频用于仿真或策略评估，很少将学到的动态转化为闭环控制。核心问题是：在固定动作标注预算下，无动作视频预训练能否提升闭环手术操作性能。

Method: Surgical WAM基于Cosmos Policy构建统一的生成式模型，联合预测未来内窥镜观测和可执行的手术机器人动作片段。训练分为两阶段：首先从无动作视频中学习手术视觉动态，然后在固定的动作标注预算上进行微调。部署时作为闭环变时域控制器使用，执行预测动作片段的前缀，并根据新的观测重新规划。

Result: 在四个仿真手术操作任务上，视频预训练将平均成功率从63.5%提升至77.8%；其中PegTransfer任务取得20个百分点的绝对提升，在接触密集型（contact-rich）和双臂协调任务上改进最为显著。

Conclusion: 无动作视频能够提供可迁移的视觉动态先验，用于在有限动作监督下学习手术机器人控制，验证了数据高效的视频预训练是扩展手术机器人学习的实用路径。

Abstract: Learning reliable surgical manipulation policies is bottlenecked by the scarcity of action-labeled demonstrations: teleoperated surgical robot (e.g., dVRK) trajectories with synchronized kinematics are costly to collect, while surgical tasks demand precise contact handling, long-horizon reasoning, and bimanual coordination. Endoscopic video is comparatively inexpensive and abundant relative to synchronized video--kinematics trajectories, and a natural way to exploit it is to learn world models of surgical scenes. However, existing surgical world models use video primarily for simulation or policy evaluation, and rarely translate the learned dynamics into closed-loop control. This gap raises our central question: under a fixed budget of action-labeled demonstrations, does action-free video pretraining improve closed-loop surgical manipulation? To answer it, we introduce the Surgical World-Action Model (Surgical WAM), a unified generative model built on Cosmos Policy that jointly predicts future endoscopic observations and executable surgical robot action chunks. Surgical WAM first learns surgical visual dynamics from action-free video and is then fine-tuned on the fixed action-labeled budget; at deployment, it acts as a closed-loop, receding-horizon controller that executes a short prefix of each predicted action chunk and replans from the resulting observation. On a suite of four simulated surgical manipulation tasks, video pretraining improves the average success rate from 63.5% to 77.8%, including an absolute gain of 20 percentage points on PegTransfer, with the largest improvements on contact-rich and bimanual tasks. These results demonstrate that action-free video provides transferable visual dynamics priors for learning surgical robot control with limited action supervision, positioning data-efficient video pretraining as a practical path toward scaling up surgical robot learning.

</details>


### [238] [Aerial Layouting: Design and Control of a Compliant and Actuated End-Effector for Precise In-flight Marking on Ceilings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10987v1)
*Christian Lanegger,Marco Ruggia,Marco Tognon,Lionel Ott,Roland Siegwart*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种配备"智能"末端执行器的新型空中机器人系统，采用稳定性优化的Gough-Stewart机构，可在不依赖精确建模或复杂控制的情况下，实现毫米级精度的空中交互任务（如在天花板上画线）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然空中机器人在动态飞行等任务中已实现厘米级精度，但诸如建筑工地划线、推滑等接触交互任务需要毫米级定位精度，当前的空中机器人系统难以达到这一精度水平。

Method: 设计了一种新型空中系统，包括空中载具和配备稳定性优化的Gough-Stewart机构的"智能"末端执行器。设计过程融入了柔顺性、多接触点、驱动和自包含等关键原则。

Result: 实验验证了末端执行器各设计选择的必要性，并成功演示了在空中机器人无需精确建模或复杂控制的情况下，以毫米级精度在天花板上可靠地标记线条。

Conclusion: 通过末端执行器的巧妙设计，可以在不依赖高精度空中机器人本体控制的前提下实现毫米级操作精度，为空中接触交互任务提供了可行的技术方案。

Abstract: Aerial robots have demonstrated impressive feats of precise control, such as dynamic flight through openings or highly complex choreographies. Despite the accuracy needed for these tasks, there are problems that require levels of precision that are challenging to achieve today. One such problem is aerial interaction. Advances in aerial robot design and control have made such contact-based tasks possible and opened up research into challenging real-world tasks, including contact-based inspection. However, while centimetre accuracy is sufficient and achievable for inspection tasks, the positioning accuracy needed for other problems, such as layouting on construction sites or general push-and-slide tasks, is millimetres. To achieve such a high precision, we propose a new aerial system composed of an aerial vehicle equipped with a novel "smart" end-effector leveraging a stability-optimized Gough-Stewart mechanism. We present its design process and features incorporating the principles of compliance, multiple contact points, actuation, and self-containment. In experiments, we verify that the design choices made for our novel end-effector are necessary to obtain the desired positioning precision. Furthermore, we demonstrate that we can reliably mark lines on ceilings with millimetre accuracy without the need for precise modeling or sophisticated control of the aerial robot.

</details>


### [239] [Flex-$π$: A Multi-Stream World-Action Model with Compute Flexibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10860v1)
*Ge Yan,Jinghao Liu,Yuzhi Fan,Lei Cai,Minwen Liao,Jesse Zhang,Dieter Fox*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Flex-π，一个6B参数的世界-动作模型（WAM），在不需额外传感器、预训练或推理延迟的前提下，发现冻结的视频生成VAE能几乎无损地编码3D点图和DINO语义，从而在共享潜在空间中联合去噪RGB、3D几何与物体语义及动作，实现演示高效且强泛化的双臂灵巧操作策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型几乎都只预测RGB潜在特征并仅以像素重建为目标训练，缺乏对3D几何和物体语义等操作所需信号的显式监督，导致策略在精确灵巧操作任务中表现受限。

Method: 1) 发现冻结的视频生成VAE同时能几乎无损地编码3D点图和DINO语义，无需额外点图专项训练；2) 将RGB、3D几何与DINO语义投影到共享潜在空间，与动作一起在Mixture-of-Transformers主干中联合去噪；3) 采用逐流dropout与跨模态强制策略，使单一训练权重可按需运行任意模态子集，从快速纯动作模式到完整联合生成模式均可用。

Result: 在真实世界灵巧、精确的双臂操作任务中，分布内外均以2-7倍优势超过最强基线，具备出色的演示效率与泛化能力，且推理速度比π_0.5更快。

Conclusion: RGB的免费午餐式的隐式点图/Semantics编码使WAM能够在不增加任何成本的情况下获得3D几何与语义监督，显著提升机器人操作策略的样本效率与泛化，并支持灵活的多流运行模式。

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) predict the future to act better, but nearly all of them predict only RGB latents, trained purely for pixel reconstruction, with no explicit signal for the 3D geometry or object semantics manipulation needs. We find a surprising free lunch: the same frozen video-generation VAE that encodes RGB also encodes 3D pointmaps almost losslessly, with no pointmap-specific training at all. This lets us supervise Flex-$π$, a 6B-parameter WAM, on 3D geometry and object-centric DINO semantics alongside RGB, at no cost in new sensors, new pre-training, or inference latency. Every visual signal is projected into this shared latent space and denoised jointly with actions inside a Mixture-of-Transformers backbone; per-stream dropout with cross-modality forcing then lets a single trained checkpoint run on any subset of these streams, from a fast action-only mode to full joint generation. The result is a policy that is exceptionally demonstration-efficient and generalizes well, beating the strongest baselines by up to 2-7$\times$ on dexterous, precise, real-world bimanual manipulation tasks both in and out of distribution, all while running faster than $π_{0.5}$. Our project website: https://flex-pi.github.io/

</details>


### [240] [AECNav: Active Evidence Consolidation for Efficient Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Object Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10817v1)
*Guanlin Liu,Shaobin Ling,Renyuan Liu,Zeying Gong,Junjie Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出AECNav，一个无需训练的零样本目标导航（ZSON）流水线，将任务重构为证据驱动的感知-决策问题，通过证据门控感知、证据整合与主动证据获取三个组件，在HM3D-v2、HM3D-OVON和MP3D数据集上分别达到84.7%、57.3%和51.3%的SOTA成功率，并在四足机器人上以约5Hz频率实现95%成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本目标导航（ZSON）在开放词汇场景中面临高延迟和有限准确性问题，根源在于冗余的感知流水线（多阶段重复计算）以及缺乏可靠证据来进行目标确认（视觉相似干扰物造成虚假置信）。

Method: AECNav由三个组件构成：i) 证据门控感知（Evidence-gated perception），在所有推理阶段共享编码以建立统一语义基础并消除冗余计算；ii) 证据整合（Evidence consolidation），将检测结果聚合为簇级对数几率信念（cluster-level log-odds beliefs），明确区分真实目标支持与视觉相似干扰物的虚假置信，并将期望检测的缺失视为负面证据；iii) 主动证据获取（Active evidence acquisition），通过选择以最小遍历代价最大化信息增益的前沿点，在弱语义线索下维持高效探索。

Result: AECNav在HM3D-v2、HM3D-OVON和MP3D上分别取得84.7%、57.3%和51.3%的SOTA成功率，推理开销显著降低；在物理四足机器人上，40次试验中达到95%成功率，运行频率约5Hz。

Conclusion: AECNav证明了将ZSON重构为证据驱动的感知到决策问题能够同时提升成功率与推理效率，训练无关的设计使其具备良好的泛化性和实际部署可行性。

Abstract: Zero-shot object-goal navigation (ZSON) in open-vocabulary scenarios is challenging, as it requires a robot to locate an arbitrarily specified object in an unseen environment without task-specific training. Currently, the task still suffers from high latency and limited accuracy due to redundant perception pipelines and insufficient evidence for reliable target confirmation. In this letter, we reframe ZSON as an evidence-driven perception-to-decision problem and present AECNav, a training-free pipeline built on three components: i) Evidence-gated perception, which utilizes a shared encoding across all reasoning stages to establish a unified semantic basis and eliminate redundant computations; ii) Evidence consolidation, which aggregates detections into cluster-level log-odds beliefs. This explicitly separates genuine target support from the false confidence of visually similar distractors, while treating the absence of expected detections as negative evidence; and iii) Active evidence acquisition, which sustains productive exploration under weak semantic cues by selecting frontiers that maximize information gain at minimal traversal cost. As a result, AECNav significantly outperforms previous methods and achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 84.7%, 57.3%, and 51.3% on HM3D-v2, HM3D-OVON, and MP3D, respectively, with substantially lower inference overhead, and attains 95% success across 40 trials on a physical quadruped robot at roughly 5Hz. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

</details>


### [241] [JEPA-WAM: Stage-Level Joint-Embedding Prediction for World-Action Models in Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10780v1)
*Xiao Liu,Yuguang Yang,Xi Wang,Kai Jiang,Cheng Chi,Yong Xu,Wenchao Ding,Yilun Chen,Yan Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出JEPA-WAM，一种通过将阶段级语义未来预测与短期物理未来执行相结合的世界动作模型，用于通用机器人操作任务。在50个RoboTwin 2.0任务中达到90.25%的成功率，并将成功执行的平均步数减少5.97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通用机器人策略通常将未来表示为固定的短视频-动作块，仅能捕捉局部场景演化用于动作执行，但无法显式描述任务从当前阶段进展到下一阶段的阶段级未来。作者认为需要区分两种互补的未来：短期物理未来（局部场景演化）和阶段级语义未来（任务进度表征），以提升机器人操作任务的表现和效率。

Method: 作者引入JEPA-WAM，在基于Motus的世界动作模型（WAM）基础上增强Stage-JEPA模块。Stage-JEPA是一个目标条件的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）预测器：给定当前观测和任务指令，使用冻结的V-JEPA2编码器提取当前状态表征，预测下一推断阶段的潜在目标表征。该方法将阶段级语义未来预测与原有短期物理未来的动作执行能力结合。

Result: 在干净和随机化环境下的50个RoboTwin 2.0任务中，JEPA-WAM达到90.25%的总体成功成功率，相比最强基线，成功rollout中的平均执行步数减少5.97%。

Conclusion: 阶段级语义未来作为短期物理未来的互补表征，能够显式建模任务进度，从而提升通用机器人策略的成功率和执行效率。JEPA架构的潜在空间预测为实现高效任务级规划提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Generalist robot policies aim to map multimodal observations and linguistic task instructions to actions across diverse tasks. However, existing methods typically represent the future as a fixed, short video-action chunk. This short-term future captures local scene evolution for action execution, but it does not explicitly describe the stage-level future that specifies how a task should progress from its current stage to the next. We therefore distinguish two complementary futures for robot manipulation: a short-term physical future to capture local scene evolution and a stage-level semantic future to represent task progress. We introduce JEPA-WAM, which augments a Motus-based World Action Model (WAM) with Stage-JEPA, a goal-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) predictor. Given the current observation and task instruction, Stage-JEPA uses a frozen V-JEPA2 encoder to extract the current-state representation and predicts the latent target of the next inferred stage. Across 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks in clean and randomized environments, JEPA-WAM achieves 90.25% overall success and reduces the mean number of execution steps in successful rollouts by 5.97% relative to the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [242] [Embodied Multimodal Grounding for Open-Vocabulary Mobile Manipulation via Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10756v1)
*Huosen Ou,Dongni Song,Yuncong Wang,Tao Zhou,Yiding Ji*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个具身多模态接地方案，整合多视角语义3D高斯泼溅（Semantic-3DGS）、可达性感知的基座定位与扩散式视觉-语言-动作策略，实现开放词汇目标接地的少样本家庭操作。在50次真实机器人实验中，系统长时程成功率60%，优于PointVLA（40%）与DexVLA（28%），并在重度杂乱场景、高度偏移等条件下表现出显著的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身移动操作需要在执行前将语言、视觉观察、三维场景结构与动作可行性对齐。现有VLA方法在杂乱环境、遮挡、视角变化和具身约束下鲁棒性不足，且缺乏显式可刷新的3D语义接地机制。

Method: 该方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 任务驱动的局部Semantic-3DGS作为共享接口，统一主动感知、语言条件3D定位、障碍感知场景推理、基座准备与动作模型语义条件化；(2) 可达性感知的基座定位策略；(3) 扩散式视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。为保留预训练动作先验，3D语义线索仅注入到后期动作专家模块（late action-expert blocks）。

Result: 在50次扩展真实机器人评估中：(1) 长时程任务成功率60%，对比PointVLA 40%、DexVLA 28%；(2) 重度杂乱操作成功率74%，对比单视角变体52%、PointVLA 46%；(3) 75cm高度偏移下保持75%成功率；(4) 消除了光照引发的错误抓取。

Conclusion: 显式、可刷新的3D语义接地能显著提升在杂乱、遮挡、视角变化和具身约束下的操作鲁棒性，表明将3D语义信息注入动作模型是提升具身操作能力的关键方向。

Abstract: Embodied mobile manipulation requires language, visual observations, three-dimensional scene structure, and action feasibility to be aligned before execution. We study open-vocabulary target grounding with few-shot manipulation in local household workspaces and present an embodied multimodal grounding framework that integrates active multi-view Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (Semantic-3DGS), reachability-aware base positioning, and a diffusion-based vision-language-action policy. A task-driven local Semantic-3DGS serves as a shared interface across active sensing, language-conditioned 3D localization, obstacle-aware scene reasoning, base preparation, and semantic conditioning of the action model. To preserve pretrained action priors, the 3D semantic cues are injected only into the late action-expert blocks. In expanded 50-trial real-robot evaluations against representative vision-language-action (VLA) approaches, the full system achieves 60% long-horizon success compared with 40% for PointVLA and 28% for DexVLA, and reaches 74% success in heavily cluttered manipulation compared with 52% for the single-view variant and 46% for PointVLA. It also maintains 75% success under a 75 cm height shift and eliminates photo-induced false grasps. These results indicate that explicit, refreshable 3D semantic grounding can improve robustness under clutter, occlusion, viewpoint variation, and embodiment constraints.

</details>


### [243] [Toward the Cognitive--Physical Limits of Embodied Intelligence through a World-Model-Centric Autonomous Racing Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10618v1)
*Zitong Shan,Baichuan Lou,Yanxin Zhou,Shuge Wu,Xianqi He,Bolin Zhao,Sheng Zhao,Zhouheng Li,Chee Kiong Ong,King Ho Holden Li,Chen Lv*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种以世界模型为中心的自主赛车智能体，通过在极限条件下联合建模和优化认知与物理边界，实现了88.3%的交互成功率，并在高速（256.3 km/h）和高峰值侧向加速度（26.8 m/s²）的真实车辆场景中验证了该方法的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数具身智能系统仅在保守安全裕度或中等交互状态下被评估，其在极端条件下的能力边界尚未被充分理解。自主赛车作为严苛测试平台（高频定位感知、对抗性交互、近饱和车辆动力学、严格安全约束），现有系统虽能推进高速性能，但很少联合建模和细化认知与物理极限。

Method: 提出以世界模型为中心的自主赛车智能体框架：(1) 从近极限成功与失败数据中学习预测性世界模型，捕捉交互演化、自身动力学和可行运动边界；(2) 将世界状态构建、前瞻推理和近极限控制耦合于闭环细化过程中。训练数据来自真实车辆自主赛车，包含高保真定位与感知在最高256.3 km/h速度采集。

Result: 在完整规模的模拟赛车中，训练良好的世界模型中心智能体在多种具有挑战性的模拟赛车场景中达到88.3%交互成功率。闭环细化进一步提升了认知-物理极限利用率、失败模式恢复能力以及在不同条件和未知赛道上的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 结果表明了一种边界感知方法论：世界模型帮助具身智能体表征、预测并持续细化其能力边界，从而为更安全的真实世界部署提供支撑。
