Abstract: Embodied artificial intelligence aims to develop agents that perceive, reason, and act through continuous interaction with the physical world. However, most embodied systems are still evaluated within conservative safety margins or moderate interaction regimes, leaving their capability boundaries under extreme conditions insufficiently understood. Autonomous racing provides a stringent testbed by combining high-frequency localization and perception, adversarial interaction, near-saturated vehicle dynamics, and strict safety constraints. Existing systems push high-speed performance but rarely model and refine cognitive and physical limits jointly. Here we show that a world-model-centric autonomous racing agent provides a concrete step toward exploring these coupled limits. The framework learns predictive world models from near-limit successes and failures to capture interaction evolution, ego dynamics, and feasible-motion boundaries, coupling world-state construction, future-aware reasoning, and near-limit control in a closed-loop refinement process. Training data were collected from real-vehicle autonomous racing, where the onboard system maintained robust localization and perception at speeds up to 256.3 km/h and peak lateral acceleration of 26.8 m/s$^2$. In full-scale simulated racing, the well trained world-model-centric agent achieves an 88.3% interaction success rate across various challenging simulated racing scenarios. Closed-loop refinement of the world model and policy further improved utilization of cognitive-physical limits, recovery from failure modes, and generalization across varying conditions and unseen circuits. These results suggest a boundary-aware methodology in which world models help embodied agents represent, predict, and continually refine their capability boundaries for safer real-world deployment.

</details>


### [244] [BooST: Bridging Semantics and Motions for Efficient Skill Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10600v1)
*Jusuk Lee,Daesol Cho,Jonghun Shin,Seungyeon Yoo,Jonghae Park,Taekbeom Lee,H. Jin Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出BooST，一个两阶段框架，通过跨模态VQ-VAE统一捕捉语义意图（what）和运动动力学（how），并将其蒸馏为轻量级策略，以满足技能迁移的三个关键需求：跨任务/域泛化、对视觉和动态扰动的鲁棒性以及实际部署的高效性。实验证明其在少样本适应、跨域技能迁移和动态视觉干扰鲁棒性方面表现优越。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能抽象方法通常只能满足"什么语义意图"或"如何运动动力学"中的单一属性，导致技能迁移不完整，形成弱先验，需要大量域内数据进行下游适应。需要一种能同时捕获语义和运动、满足泛化、鲁棒和高效三个需求的统一方法。

Method: BooST采用两阶段框架：第一阶段利用跨模态VQ-VAE（矢量量化变分自编码器）同时捕获语义意图和运动动力学，生成统一的技能表示；第二阶段将该表示蒸馏为轻量级策略，用于高效的下游任务适应。

Result: 在仿真和真实机器人环境中，BooST在少样本适应、跨域技能迁移和对动态视觉干扰的鲁棒性方面均优于现有方法，同时保持轻量且表达力强的设计，适合真实世界部署。

Conclusion: 通过显式桥接语义和运动两个层面，BooST能够同时满足技能泛化、鲁棒性和部署效率三个需求，解决了现有方法只能覆盖部分属性的问题，为机器人技能迁移提供了更完整的解决方案。

Abstract: Skill abstraction---the process of learning reusable and temporally extended behaviors---has emerged as a key paradigm for improving sample efficiency and generalization in robot learning. For efficient skill transfer to real robots, learned skills must generalize across tasks and domains, remain robust to visual and dynamic perturbations, and be efficient enough for practical deployment. However, existing methods typically satisfy only a subset of these properties, as they capture either high-level semantic intent (what) or low-level motion dynamics (how). This incomplete skill transfer yields weak priors for policy learning, thereby demanding substantial in-domain data for downstream adaptation. To address these challenges, we introduce BooST, a two-stage framework that explicitly bridges semantics and motions to satisfy all three desiderata. BooST first leverages a cross-modal VQ-VAE to capture both semantic intent and motion dynamics, yielding a unified skill representation. It then distills this representation into a lightweight policy for efficient downstream adaptation to new tasks. Extensive experiments across simulation and real-robot settings demonstrate that BooST achieves superior few-shot adaptation, cross-domain skill transfer, and robustness to dynamic visual distractors, while maintaining a lightweight yet expressive design suitable for real-world deployment.

</details>


### [245] [JitTrack: Onboard Multi-Object Tracking Against Viewpoint Jitter for Agile UAVs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10485v1)
*Yachun Shan,Feitian Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出JitTrack，一种面向敏捷无人机上的主动多目标跟踪框架，通过语义精炼、运动感知查询修正和运动启发去噪训练策略来应对相机自运动引起的视角抖动，并构建了感知-规划-控制闭环跟踪管线，在公开基准和真实飞行实验中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 敏捷无人机上的多目标跟踪面临严重视角抖动（由相机自运动引起），导致目标跨帧位移大、关联不准确、跟踪性能下降。现有UAV MOT方法主要基于离线基准评估，未考虑真实机载部署的实际需求（如对相机运动的鲁棒性和主动目标跟随）。

Method: 基于查询式Transformer跟踪器构建JitTrack框架，包含三个核心组件：(1)语义精炼（semantic refinement）以改进新出现目标的检测；(2)运动感知查询修正（motion-aware query rectification）补偿视角抖动导致的目标错位；(3)运动启发去噪训练策略（motion-inspired denoising training）模拟相机运动模式进行鲁棒监督。此外构建了感知-规划-控制闭环跟踪管线实现真实世界部署。

Result: 在公开UAV MOT基准上相比基线方法取得一致改进，真实飞行实验验证了JitTrack在视角抖动下进行鲁棒机载视觉跟踪的有效性和实用性。

Conclusion: JitTrack通过融合运动感知与语义信息，有效解决了无人机相机自运动带来的多目标跟踪挑战，并成功实现了从算法设计到真实机载部署的完整闭环，为敏捷无人机上的鲁棒多目标跟踪提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Multi-object tracking (MOT) onboard agile unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) remains challenging due to severe viewpoint jitter induced by camera ego-motion. Rapid attitude changes during flight often lead to significant target displacement across frames, causing inaccurate target association and degraded tracking performance. Existing UAV MOT methods are primarily evaluated on offline benchmarks and seldom address the practical requirements of real-world onboard deployment, including robustness to camera motion and active target following. To address these challenges, we propose JitTrack, an active onboard multi-object tracking framework that accommodates drone dynamics and camera ego-motion. Built upon a query-based transformer tracker, JitTrack introduces semantic refinement to improve the detection of emerging targets, motion-aware query rectification to compensate for target misalignment caused by viewpoint jitter, and a motion-inspired denoising training strategy that simulates camera motion patterns for robust supervision. Furthermore, we develop a perception-planning-control closed-loop tracking pipeline for real-world deployment, enabling collision-free and physically feasible target following on agile UAVs. Extensive experiments on public UAV MOT benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over the baseline method, while real-world flight experiments validate the effectiveness and practicality of JitTrack for robust onboard visual tracking under viewpoint jitter.

</details>


### [246] [PBD-AG: Persistent Baseline-Delta Active Graphs with Uncertainty-Aware Inspection for Long-Horizon Service Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10449v1)
*Shuo Bao,Wei Dong,Shuyue Zhang,Ming Shang,Yuchen Huang,Han Yu,Chengjie Xu,Yiheng Bi,Kai Sun,Fuchun Sun,Xinzhou Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PBD-AG提出一种持久基线-动态活动图框架，将机器人验证的稳定固定装置与可修订的动态物体事件解耦，通过自主探索引导基线、层级化物体信念、可靠性加权状态及几何可见性门控，实现长时程服务机器人在未知环境中的可追溯世界模型构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法存在三类局限：在线建图会累积定位与观测误差；静态场景表示无法捕捉持久的物体变化；整体视觉-语言预测缺乏可验证的3D几何证据。长时程服务机器人需要能够自主构建并在环境变化时修订的持久世界模型。

Method: PBD-AG框架包含：(a)自主引导结构基线的机载探索；(b)对发现的固定装置进行检查以锚定层级化物体信念；(c)在几何、语义、身份、存在及支撑关系上维护可靠性加权物体状态；(d)利用几何可见性门控缓解遮挡下的错误删除；(e)图条件策略选择检查视点，平衡目标覆盖率、移动成本、碰撞风险与冗余观测。

Result: 在多种环境及受控动态评估下的仿真实验中，PBD-AG在聚合粗粒度固定装置F1分数上优于能力匹配的对照组，并展现出更强的身份连续性与事件召回率。物理机器人定性演示验证了与机载传感的集成及可追溯世界模型的可用性。

Conclusion: PBD-AG为长时程机器人感知提供了一种可追溯的持久世界模型范式，通过解耦稳定与动态元素，在动态环境中保持物体身份连续性与可靠的事件感知，为后续研究提供了可复现的项目页面。

Abstract: Long-horizon service robots require persistent world models that can be built autonomously in unseen environments and revised as task-relevant objects change. Existing methods rely on online mapping, which accumulates localization and observation errors, static scene representations that cannot capture persistent object changes, or holistic vision-language predictions that lack verifiable 3D geometric evidence. We present PBD-AG, a persistent baseline-delta active graph framework that decouples robot-verified stable fixtures from revisable dynamic object events. Under our framework, the robot autonomously bootstraps the structural baseline from onboard exploration and inspects discovered fixtures to ground hierarchical object beliefs. PBD-AG maintains reliability-weighted object states over geometry, semantics, identity, existence, and support relations, utilizing a geometric visibility gate to mitigate false deletions under occlusion. Inspection viewpoints are selected by a graph-conditioned policy that balances target coverage, travel cost, collision risk, and redundant observation. Simulation experiments in multiple environments and under controlled dynamic evaluation show higher aggregate coarse-fixture F1 than capability-matched controls, as well as stronger identity continuity and event recall. A qualitative physical-robot demonstration further illustrates integration with onboard sensing, providing a traceable world model for long-horizon robotic perception.The project page of PBD-AG is available at https://shuobao214.github.io/PBD-AG/

</details>


### [247] [Real-World Cooperative Bimanual Dexterous Grasp of Large Objects from Single-View Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10383v1)
*Ziming Li,Mingxuan Wu,Jiaqi Zhang,Hongfei Li,Yan Gan,Deqiang Ouyang,Ning Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个真实世界的双臂灵巧抓取框架，包含多模态数据集、基于DDPM的抓取配置生成模块以及集成运动规划与在线抓取精化的执行策略，可从单视角点云生成可执行的双臂抓取动作，在双机械臂机器人上对不同几何形状和姿态的未见物体实现了高成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数现有研究聚焦于双臂的顺序操作而非协同抓取，且针对双臂协同抓取的方法大多局限于仿真环境。这源于获取完整3D物体模型和生成物理上可行的抓取动作十分困难。作者旨在弥合这一差距，在真实世界中实现双臂灵巧抓取。

Method: 框架包含三个核心部分：(1) 一个多模态数据集，采集关节角度、视觉观测和力信号；(2) 一个基于去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）的模块，从分割点云生成关节级抓取配置；(3) 一个集成了运动规划与在线抓取精化的执行策略，确保物理稳定性和可行性。该方法从单视角输入即可综合出可执行的双臂抓取动作，减少了对完整3D物体模型的依赖。

Result: 在双臂机器人上进行的实验表明，该方法对包含不同几何形状和姿态的未见过物体实现了高抓取成功率；消融研究也验证了系统中各关键组件的贡献。

Conclusion: 该工作通过引入扩散模型驱动的生成方法和多模态数据支撑，成功将双臂协同灵巧抓取从仿真拓展到真实世界，在降低对完整3D模型依赖的同时保持了稳定可靠的物理执行性能。

Abstract: Bimanual dexterous grasping of large objects is a critical challenge in robotic manipulation. However, most existing studies focus on sequential manipulation rather than cooperative grasping, and methods addressing such bimanual tasks have largely been limited to simulation. These limitations stem from the difficulty of acquiring full 3D object models and generating physically plausible grasping actions. To fill this gap, we propose a real-world bimanual grasping framework that includes: a multimodal dataset capturing joint angles, visual observations and force signals; a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM)-based module that generates joint-level grasp configurations from segmented point clouds; and an execution strategy that integrates motion planning with online grasp refinement to ensure physical stability and feasibility. Our approach enables the synthesis of executable bimanual grasps from single-view inputs, reducing dependence on complete 3D object models and ensuring stable real-world performance. Experiments on a dual-arm robot demonstrate high success rates across unseen objects with varying geometries and poses, and ablation studies confirm the contributions of key components of our system.

</details>


### [248] [A Neural Network Based Teleoperation for Remote Controlled Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10367v1)
*Ning Ding,Azim Eskandarian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向车辆直接遥操作的单侧遥操作框架，集成波变量(WV)方法保证随机时延下的被动稳定性，并结合自适应径向基函数网络(RBFN)主动补偿车辆不确定性。仿真对比PID、LQR、MPC及NMPC表明RBFN在抗未建模扰动方面更具鲁棒性，且执行时间比MPC/NMPC低数个数量级；1/10缩比车辆+4G网络的硬件在环实验验证了系统的实际可行性、安全性与轨迹跟踪鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车辆直接遥操作面临通信时延以及操作者无法感知未建模环境扰动（如空气阻力、侧倾角）与强非线性轮胎-路面动力学的关键技术瓶颈，现有方案缺乏兼顾稳定性保障与实时补偿能力的统一框架。

Method: 提出定制化的单侧遥操作框架：采用波变量(WV)方法在随机时延下被动保障系统稳定性；采用自适应径向基函数网络(RBFN)主动补偿车辆特定不确定性，设计针对车辆纵横向动力学解耦的自适应律（不同于面向双侧机械臂的现有WV-神经网络架构）；相比模型重负载的预测控制器，RBFN为无模型方案，支持快速在线自适应且计算开销低。

Result: 仿真基准测试中，RBFN相比PID、LQR、MPC和NMPC在未建模扰动下展现出更强的鲁棒性，执行时间较MPC/NMPC低约数个数量级，适合资源受限的车辆边缘计算；基于4G网络的1/10缩比车辆硬件在环实验验证了系统在物理路面不确定性下的实际可行性、安全性与稳健轨迹跟踪。

Conclusion: 所提出的WV+RBFN单侧遥操作框架能同时解决随机通信时延稳定性与车辆不确定性补偿两大核心问题，兼具理论保障与工程实用性，为车联网环境下资源受限的边缘遥操作提供了高效、鲁棒且可部署的解决方案。

Abstract: Direct teleoperation of vehicles faces critical technical bottlenecks: communication latency and the operator's inability to physically perceive unmodeled environmental disturbances (e.g., aerodynamic drag, bank angles) coupled with highly nonlinear tire-road dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose a tailored unilateral teleoperation framework. The system integrates the Wave Variable (WV) approach to passively guarantee stability under stochastic delays, and an adaptive Radial Basis Function Network (RBFN) to actively compensate for vehicle-specific uncertainties. Unlike existing WV-neural network architectures designed for bilateral robotic arms, our framework features decoupled adaptive laws specifically designed for vehicle longitudinal and lateral dynamics. Furthermore, compared to model-heavy predictive controllers, the model-free RBFN offers rapid online adaptation without heavy computational overhead. Building upon our preliminary theoretical formulation, this brief paper presents comprehensive comparative analyses and real-world hardware validations. Simulation benchmarks against PID, LQR, MPC, and NMPC demonstrate that the RBFN achieves superior robustness against unmodeled disturbances while requiring orders of magnitude less execution time than MPC and NMPC, making it ideal for resource-constrained vehicle edge computing. Finally, hardware-in-the-loop experiments using a 1/10th scale vehicle over a 4G network validate the system's practical feasibility, safety, and robust trajectory tracking under physical road uncertainties.

</details>


### [249] [FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10232v1)
*Quanquan Peng,Yutong Liang,Rui Yan,Nicklas Hansen,Xiaolong Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出FACT，一种因果世界-动作模型（World-Action Model），通过动作条件化的未来视频和任务进度预测，将失败轨迹纳入训练，使世界模型能预测不良动作的后果，从而在模拟和真实双手机器人操作任务中优于多种现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAMs）主要依赖成功演示进行训练，缺乏预测失败/不良动作后果的能力。这导致模型对未来结果存在成功偏差，在动作生成时无法借助对坏动作后果的理解来做出更好的决策。作者希望让世界模型不仅能从成功中学习，也能从失败中学习。

Method: FACT引入动作条件化的因果接口：模型同时预测未来视频和任务进度，且二者都以来回执行的动作为条件。该接口使失败rollout也能监督动作后果，将坏动作转化为有效的未来预测目标而非被丢弃。失败感知训练让进度预测器同时感知成功与失败的动作结果，推理时可利用该进度得分对候选动作进行评分筛选。

Result: 在模拟和真实世界双手机器人操作任务上的大量实验表明，FACT优于许多现有基线；随着更多失败数据被纳入训练，其性能持续提升；同时有效减少了在不良动作下对未来产生成功偏差性幻觉的问题。

Conclusion: FACT证明将失败轨迹作为训练信号引入世界-动作模型是可行且有效的，动作条件化的因果预测接口可以使模型对成功和失败后果都有准确的认知，从而提升动作生成质量与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Recent world-action models (WAMs) show that co-training policies with future prediction can provide physical priors for action generation. Building on the future-prediction ability of video models, many WAMs generate future videos and recover actions with inverse-dynamics models, or use these predicted videos as goal conditions for action generation. In both cases, the world model is trained mostly on successful demonstrations and has little reason to predict the consequences of bad actions. We introduce FACT, a causal World-Action Model that predicts future video and task progress conditioned on the executed action. This action-conditioned interface allows failure rollouts to supervise action consequences, turning bad actions into valid future targets rather than being discarded. Failure-aware training makes the progress predictor aware of both successful and failed action outcomes, which can optionally be used to score sampled action candidates at inference. Extensive experiments on simulation and real-world bimanual manipulation tasks show that FACT outperforms many existing baselines, improves as failure data are incorporated into training, and reduces success-biased future hallucination under bad actions. See more details at https://fact-wam.github.io/

</details>


### [250] [Energy-Structured Latent World Models with Neural Time Fields for Physically Constistent Open-World Motion Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09876v1)
*Yapeng Liu,Yuanzhao Zhai,Bo Ding,Huaimin Wang,Lin Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出能量结构化潜世界模型（ELWM），通过将潜状态显式地承载能量和动量信息，并通过耗散与控制端口保证因果转换，实现物理一致的轨迹预测；并进一步构建物理条件神经时间场（PC-NTF），将ELWM集成到到达时间场中生成物理感知的导航策略，显著降低碰撞率并提升导航成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在世界模型学习无约束的未来表征，其中隐含的物理知识无法被显式提取和重用，导致在开放世界导航中的可靠性和物理一致性不足。作者希望通过在潜空间中显式嵌入物理结构（能量和动量）来解决这一根本性问题。

Method: 提出ELWM：潜状态显式携带能量与动量，通过耗散端口和控制端口保证严格因果关系转换，在多模态RGB-D和惯性交互历史上训练以保障物理一致预测。进一步提出PC-NTF作为技术基石，利用Eikonal方程将ELWM整合进到达时间场，生成物理信息化的导航策略。

Result: 在保留场景上的评估显示：运动预测NRMSE从0.36降至0.29；导航成功率从81.3%提升至89.7%，SPL从0.64提升至0.73；物理碰撞率从12.1%降至5.8%；Eikonal残差从0.083降至0.031。

Conclusion: 在潜空间中嵌入显式物理结构能够在预测世界模型与安全、动态可行的运动规划之间架起内在桥梁，证明了物理知识的结构化表征是提高具身智能体在开放世界导航中可靠性和安全性的有效途径。

Abstract: Physically consistent motion planning remains a fundamental challenge in embodied AI, as generated trajectories must strictly conform to real-world execution dynamics. While latent world models offer a promising approach by predicting these dynamics, existing methods learn unconstrained future representations where absorbed physics remains implicit. Therefore, they fail to form reusable physical knowledge, which compromises reliability in unpredictable open-world navigation. To address this, we propose a novel Energy-Structured Latent World Model (ELWM). Our key idea is to structure the ELWM latent state to explicitly carry energy and momentum, ensuring strictly causal transitions via dissipation and control ports. Trained on multimodal RGB-D and inertial interaction histories, our model guarantees physically consistent predictions. We further implement this for motion planning by constructing Physics-Conditioned Neural Time Fields (PC-NTF), a key technical cornerstone that integrates ELWM into an arrival time field via the Eikonal equation to yield a physically-informed navigation policy. Across held-out scenes, our evaluation reveals significant improvements. Compared to generic latent models, PC-NTF reduces 0.8-s motion-prediction NRMSE from 0.36 to 0.29. Against Active Neural Time Fields, it improves navigation success from 81.3% to 89.7% and SPL from 0.64 to 0.73, while cutting the physical collision rate from 12.1% to 5.8% and the Eikonal residual from 0.083 to 0.031. Beyond these targeted gains, our results demonstrate that embedding explicit physical structures into latent spaces intrinsically bridges the gap between predictive world models and safe, dynamically feasible motion planning.

</details>


### [251] [RynnValue: Scaling Robotic Value Foundation Models with Temporal Distance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09853v1)
*Dongchi Huang,Hongyin Zhang,Bohan Hou,Siteng Huang,Zhian Su,Hang Guo,Tong Lu,Zhaofeng Xu,Jiahao Tang,Jianfei Yang,Donglin Wang,Peixi Peng,Mingxiu Chen,Deli Zhao,Xin Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出RynnValue，一个基于时间距离（temporal distance）作为监督信号的开源价值基础模型，用于机器人操作任务。它利用时间戳直接推导时间距离标签，无需偏好或进度标注，在7,000+小时/约300万个指令条件片段上训练，在RBM-EVAL-OOD基准上Kendall's tau_a达到0.675，超越全偏好监督SOTA（0.655），并通过势函数整形将真实世界策略成功率从52.5%提升至72.5%（在线）和从63.8%提升至82.5%（离线）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用奖励模型正成为机器人学习扩展的瓶颈，但如何从大规模异构语料中学习价值相关能力仍未被充分探索。现有方法将监督信号绑定到任务内部锚点（如偏好、归一化进度），这些锚点无法在不同形态和数据源之间干净地迁移。因此需要一种可扩展、跨域可迁移的奖励学习范式。

Method: RynnValue将时间距离（即从观测到语言指定目标的定向代价）替代原有锚点作为监督目标。由于时间距离标签可直接从时间戳派生，无需偏好或进度注释，从而实现大规模扩展。为了保证大规模时间价值学习的可靠性，论文结合了三种技术：随机时间采样（random temporal sampling）、时间顺序洗牌（temporal-order shuffling）和值隔离注意力（value-isolation attention），以抑制会使预测对失败和回归不敏感的捷径。最终通过势函数整形（potential-based shaping）将学习到的价值转化为密集奖励。

Result: RynnValue在不使用偏好标签的情况下，在RBM-EVAL-OOD上达到平均Kendall's tau_a 0.675，超过全偏好监督SOTA（0.655），是仅进度监督基线（0.292）的两倍多，并能零样本泛化到未见任务、形态和视角。转化为密集奖励后，真实世界策略成功率从52.5%提升至72.5%（在线），从63.8%提升至82.5%（离线）。

Conclusion: 实验结果确立了时间距离作为一种可扩展的监督目标以及通用机器人策略的实用奖励接口，为从大规模异构语料中学习价值基础模型提供了一条不依赖人为偏好标注的可行路径。

Abstract: General-purpose reward models are increasingly the bottleneck for scaling robot learning, yet the recipe for learning value-related capabilities from large-scale heterogeneous corpora remains underexplored. Existing approaches tie supervision to task-internal anchors such as preferences or normalized progress, none of which transfer cleanly across embodiments and data sources. We introduce RynnValue, an open-source value foundation model for robotic manipulation that replaces these anchors with temporal distance, the directed cost-to-go from an observation to the language-specified goal. Because temporal-distance labels can be derived directly from timestamps, RynnValue scales to over 7,000 hours and roughly 3M instruction-conditioned clips without preference or progress annotations. To make temporal-value learning reliable at scale, we combine random temporal sampling, temporal-order shuffling, and value-isolation attention, suppressing shortcuts that would leave predictions insensitive to failures and regressions. Trained without preference labels, RynnValue attains an average Kendall's tau_a of 0.675 on RBM-EVAL-OOD, surpassing the fully preference-supervised state of the art (0.655) and more than doubling a progress-only counterpart (0.292), while generalizing zero-shot to unseen tasks, embodiments, and viewpoints. Converted into dense rewards via potential-based shaping, it raises real-world policy success from 52.5% to 72.5% online and from 63.8% to 82.5% offline. These results establish temporal distance as a scalable supervision target and practical reward interface for generalist robot policies.

</details>


### [252] [SLIM-0.5B: Learning Action-Grounded Predictive Latents for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09771v1)
*Jingkai Wang,Zihan Tang,Gu Zhang,Mingyu Cao,Jiapeng Chen,Jingjiao Zhao,Xiansheng Chen,Pengwei Wang,Lemao Liu,Dejing Dou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SLIM，一个仅0.5B参数的紧凑型潜在交互策略模型，通过自监督掩码轨迹预测学习动作引导的潜在表示，在多个仿真基准和真实环境评测中，以更少的参数、更低的推理延迟和GPU内存消耗，达到或超越大规模VLA和世界动作模型基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略依赖大规模多模态骨干网络，在每一步控制中同时进行感知、语言条件化和动作生成，大量计算能力被用于开放域语义理解，而连续机器人操作主要需要观测、动作及其引起转变的紧凑表示。像素级世界模型虽然提供另一路径，但预测与控制无关的视觉细节可能成本过高且不必要。

Method: SLIM通过以下方式实现：1）学习动作接地（action-grounded）的潜在表示，同时捕获动作条件化的未来转变和解释观测变化的动作；2）采用自监督掩码轨迹预测，结合动作重建与未来潜在预测来学习这些表示；3）使用紧凑的Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）骨干网络建模观测潜在与动作token之间的交互；4）使用流匹配（flow matching）训练语言条件化的动作生成策略。

Result: 在仿真基准和真实世界评测中，SLIM以更少的参数（0.5B）、无需额外的具身预训练、更低的推理延迟和显著更低的GPU内存使用，匹配或超越了代表性的大规模VLA和世界动作模型基线。

Conclusion: 动作接地的潜在交互模型为机器人操作提供了一种高效替代方案：相较于依赖大规模多模态骨干的VLA策略，紧凑的潜在级世界模型既能捕获动作与轨迹转变的关键信息，又在参数规模、推理效率和资源占用方面具有明显优势，验证了"少即是多"的设计理念在机器人大策略中的地位。

Abstract: Vision-language-action policies rely on large multimodal backbones to jointly perform perception, language conditioning, and action generation at every control step. Much of this capacity supports open-domain semantics, whereas continuous robot manipulation primarily requires compact representations of observations, actions, and the transitions induced by actions. Pixel-level world models provide another route, but predicting visual details irrelevant to control can be unnecessarily expensive. We propose SLIM (Self-supervised Latent Interaction Model), a compact 0.5B-parameter latent interaction policy. SLIM learns action-grounded predictive latents that capture both action-conditioned future transitions and the actions that explain observed changes. SLIM learns these representations through self-supervised masked trajectory prediction, combining action reconstruction with future-latent prediction. A compact Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone models interactions between observation latents and action tokens. The resulting policy is trained with flow matching for language-conditioned action generation. Across simulation benchmarks and real-world evaluation, SLIM matches or exceeds representative large-scale VLA and world-action-model baselines with fewer parameters, no additional embodied pretraining, lower inference latency, and substantially lower GPU memory usage.

</details>


### [253] [Efficient Real-World Online Reinforcement Learning for Robot Manipulation via Centralized Training and Critic Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09762v1)
*Changhao Li,Yifang Zhang,Heng Zhang,Davide Torielli,Damiano Gasperini,Arturo Laurenzi,Luca Muratore,Arash Ajoudani,Nikos Tsagarakis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个统一框架HIL-HARC，将集中训练与分散执行（CTDE）和混合奖励架构（HRA）结合，用于真实世界在线强化学习的机器人操作策略训练。通过共享集中式多头评论家（分解为任务头与抓取头），处理多智能体同时训练带来的非平稳性问题，并在维度级域随机化下显著提升样本效率和策略性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界在线强化学习可避免模拟到现实的差距，并通过人机交互实现持续策略优化。然而，现有方法仅支持较小的随机化范围，且多智能体并发训练会产生非平稳性问题，限制了实际应用中的学习效果和泛化能力。

Method: 提出一个统一框架，融合集中训练与分散执行（CTDE）和混合奖励架构（HRA）。多个执行者共享一个集中式多头评论家，评论家被分解为任务头（对应稀疏任务奖励）和抓取头（对应基于势能的抓取奖励）。重新推导评论家与行动者目标函数，利用分解的Q值，并显式考虑离散夹爪策略的类别动作分布。

Result: 在维度级域随机化（比先前工作大约5-25倍）下，在网球拾取放置、香蕉拾取放置、锅重置和模拟积木重定位任务中，相对最先进的基线方法，成功率分别从60%提升到80%、从60%提升到90%、从25%提升到95%，并成功完成了基线始终失败的任务。

Conclusion: 实验证明所提出的框架大幅提升了样本效率和策略性能，验证了CTDE与混合奖励架构结合在真实世界多智能体强化学习中的有效性。

Abstract: Real-world online reinforcement learning (RL) provides a promising approach for training robotic manipulation policies directly in the physical world, avoiding the sim-to-real gap and enabling continuous policy refinement through human-in-the-loop interaction. Recent methods have demonstrated sample-efficient learning through human intervention but remain limited to small randomization ranges and encounter challenges with the non-stationarity induced by concurrently training multiple agents. To address these limitations, we introduce a unified framework that combines centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) and a Hybrid Reward Architecture (HRA). This enables multiple actors to share a centralized multi-head critic. The critic is decomposed into task and grasp heads, corresponding to the sparse task reward and a potential-based grasping reward, respectively. We accordingly reformulate the critic and actor objectives to exploit the decomposed Q-values while explicitly accounting for the categorical action distribution of the discrete gripper policy. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework substantially improves both sample efficiency and policy performance. We validate our approach on two robotic arms and a simulated humanoid robot across tennis ball and banana pick-and-place, pot reset, and simulated block relocation tasks under dimension-wise domain randomization, approximately 5-25x larger than those considered in prior work. Compared with a state-of-the-art baseline, our method improves the success rate from 60% to 80% on tennis ball pick-and-place, from 60% to 90% on banana pick-and-place, and from 25% to 95% on simulated block relocation, while also successfully accomplishing a task where the baseline consistently fails. Videos and more details are available at our project website: https://hil-harc.github.io/.

</details>


### [254] [FactorDrive: Adaptive Multi-Step Reasoning Driven by Planning-Critical Factors for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09591v1)
*Guolei Huang,Tengfei She,Yuxuan Lu,Yao Huang,Yuqi Ye,Yongjun Shen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了FactorDrive，一个端到端自动驾驶框架，通过规划关键因子（PCFs）驱动的自适应多步推理来提升规划性能。该方法包含三个关键部分：大规模驾驶域指令微调建立基础驾驶知识、PCF-CoT数据集将规划推理锚定在轨迹相关的空间-物理证据上并围绕场景特定的PCFs组织推理、以及QS-GRPO算法用MCTS搜索结合GRPO优化推理路径，从而提升轨迹规划质量。在nuScenes和NAVSIM基准上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM自动驾驶方法未能充分将空间-物理证据整合到规划推理中，推理适应性是粗粒度的，不能满足场景特定的规划需求；此外，推理路径优化这一方向在自动驾驶后训练中尚未被探索。这三个局限性共同构成了本文的出发点。

Method: 1) 大规模驾驶领域指令微调，建立基础驾驶知识；2) 构建PCF-CoT数据集，将推理锚定于轨迹相关的空间-物理证据，并围绕场景特定PCFs组织推理，使推理路径的组成和深度自适应适配不同规划需求；3) 提出QS-GRPO，用轨迹级规划奖励引导MCTS搜索更高规划质量的推理路径，再通过GRPO优化策略。

Result: 在开放环基准nuScenes和面向闭环的NAVSIM基准上进行的大量实验表明，FactorDrive取得了最先进的规划性能。

Conclusion: FactorDrive通过将空间-物理证据引入规划推理、实现场景自适应推理深度以及用搜索优化的后训练策略这一完整方案，证明了自适应多步推理在提升端到端自动驾驶规划质量方面的有效性。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced scene understanding and enabled explicit reasoning in end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing methods insufficiently integrate spatial-physical evidence into planning reasoning, while reasoning adaptation remains coarse-grained and falls short of scene-specific planning demands. Furthermore, reasoning-path optimization for higher planning quality remains largely unexplored in autonomous-driving post-training. To address these limitations, we propose FactorDrive, an end-to-end autonomous driving framework for adaptive multi-step reasoning driven by planning-critical factors (PCFs). We first perform large-scale driving-domain instruction tuning to establish foundational driving knowledge. Building on this foundation, we construct PCF-CoT, a chain-of-thought (CoT) dataset that grounds planning reasoning in trajectory-relevant spatial-physical evidence and organizes reasoning around scene-specific PCFs, enabling the composition and depth of reasoning paths to adapt to different planning demands. We further introduce Quality Search-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization (QS-GRPO), which guides Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with trajectory-level planning rewards to discover reasoning paths with higher planning quality and uses the resulting responses to optimize the policy through GRPO, thereby improving trajectory planning performance. Extensive experiments on both open-loop (nuScenes) and closed-loop-oriented (NAVSIM) benchmarks demonstrate that FactorDrive achieves state-of-the-art planning performance.

</details>


### [255] [TDMA Based Communications Control Co-Design for Cooperative Carrying: Delay Calibration and Sampling-Rate Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09556v1)
*Zahra Seifaei,Maximilian Luebke,Torsten Reissland,Danial Dehghani,Norman Franchi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究多机器人协作运输系统中，通过基于网络延迟的自适应采样时间调整与策略性领导者轮换，在保持控制稳定性的同时公平分配无线负载。基于MuJoCo物理仿真与真实无线建模，评估三种控制方案，发现动态采样能降低通信开销且不影响控制性能，而领导者轮换能显著改善空气时间分配的公平性，且对团队承载能力影响可忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人团队执行协作运输时面临根本性挑战：在保持稳定控制的同时维持通信效率。有限的无线通信资源下，如何在控制性能与通信开销之间取得平衡，并公平分配无线资源，是部署实际机器人团队亟需解决的问题。

Method: 使用MuJoCo物理仿真并结合现实无线建模（包括时分多址、介质访问控制、抖动、队列和丢包），评估三种控制方法：固定采样+静态领导、动态采样+静态领导、动态采样+轮换领导。动态采样根据测量的网络延迟自适应调整采样时间，领导者轮换策略则通过轮换领导角色来重新分配网络负载。

Result: 动态采样在不牺牲控制性能的前提下有效降低通信开销；轮换领导者角色显著改善了空气时间分配的公平性，且对团队承载能力的影响可以忽略不计。

Conclusion: 该工作是首批联合研究动态采样、领导者轮换与无线协议交互在物理现实多机器人协作中的应用，为通信资源有限的真实世界多机器人协同部署提供了实用指导。

Abstract: Multi robot teams performing cooperative transportation face a fundamental challenge: maintaining stable control while keeping communications efficient. This paper investigates how adaptive sampling time adjustment informed by measured network delay and strategic leader rotation can distribute wireless load fairly across the team. We use physics based simulation in MuJoCo with realistic wireless modeling, including time division multiple access, medium access control, jitter, queueing, and packet loss, to evaluate three control approaches: fixed sampling with static leadership, dynamic sampling with static leadership, and dynamic sampling with rotating leadership. Our results reveal an important trade off: dynamic sampling effectively reduces communications overhead without compromising control performance, while rotating the leader role meaningfully improves how fairly airtime is distributed all with negligible impact on the team carrying ability. to the best of our knowledge, being among the first to jointly examine dynamic sampling, rotating leadership, and wireless protocol interactions in physicsrealistic multi robot cooperation, this work provides practical guidance for deploying coordinated robotic teams in real world settings where communications resources are limited.

</details>


### [256] [HarnessWAM: Bridging Prediction and Deliberation in World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09516v1)
*Zhaopeng Gu,Bingke Zhu,Tianxi Lin,Guibo Zhu,Yingying Chen,Kai Wang,Tingyu Yuan,Chaoyang Zhao,Zhaowen Li,Peng Su,Jinqiao Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出HarnessWAM框架，通过外部结构化状态维护和闭环智能体决策，弥补World Action Models（WAMs）在有限时域预测与全局规划之间的"预测-深思鸿沟"，在RoboMemArena和RoboCerebra基准上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WAMs虽然联合学习环境动力学与机器人动作，但其有限时域的预测和动作生成不足以应对复杂具身任务所需的全局规划、跨阶段状态维护、执行验证和失败恢复。这种能力不匹配被定义为WAMs的"预测-深思鸿沟"（prediction-deliberation gap）。

Method: HarnessWAM包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于VLM的任务管理器，维护证据驱动的场景信念和结构化任务图；(2) 能力条件化的可执行空间投影，将开放语义规划约束为满足任务依赖、体态约束和WAM能力边界的原子技能序列；(3) 事件驱动的双时间尺度反馈环，轻量级进度估计器提供高频执行证据，任务管理器在关键里程碑处综合当前观测、任务状态和交互历史进行深思决策（推进任务、获取观测、修订计划或局部恢复）。

Result: 在RoboMemArena上全任务成功率达59.6%、子任务成功率达69.9%，在RoboCerebra Ideal上SR达23.7%，均达到SOTA水平。

Conclusion: 模型外部（model-external）的结构化状态维护与闭环智能体决策能有效将WAMs的局部控制能力扩展为可规划、可验证、可恢复的具身任务执行。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly learn environmental dynamics and robot actions, introducing priors over physical evolution into embodied control. However, finite-horizon prediction and action generation are insufficient for complex embodied tasks that require global planning, cross-stage state maintenance, execution verification, and failure recovery. We refer to this mismatch as the prediction-deliberation gap of WAMs. To address this gap, we propose HarnessWAM, an agentic framework for WAMs. HarnessWAM employs a vision-language-model-based Task Manager to maintain an evidence-grounded scene belief and a structured task graph. A capability-conditioned executable-space projection further constrains open-ended semantic plans into sequences of atomic skills that satisfy task dependencies, embodiment-state constraints, and the capability boundary of the underlying WAM. During execution, HarnessWAM operates through an event-driven, dual-timescale feedback loop: a lightweight progress estimator continuously provides high-frequency execution evidence, while the Task Manager deliberates at salient milestones by jointly considering the current observation, task state, and interaction history to determine whether to advance the task, acquire additional observations, revise the plan, or initiate local recovery. This mechanism enables the robot to recover its state after a subtask failure and resume execution without discarding previously acquired scene knowledge. HarnessWAM achieves state-of-the-art full-task and subtask success rates of 59.6% and 69.9% on RoboMemArena, and an SR of 23.7% on RoboCerebra Ideal. These results demonstrate that model-external structured state maintenance and closed-loop agentic decision making can effectively extend the local control capabilities of WAMs into embodied task execution that is plannable, verifiable, and recoverable.

</details>


### [257] [Rethink Before You Execute: Adaptive Execution for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09492v1)
*Feng Ye,Yiming Zhao,Yong Yu,Hongxu Zhou,Yong Pan,Yuan Xue,Peng Jia,Chuanmin Jia*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TempoWAM 是一种轻量级即插即用的执行方案，通过在线监控任务进度来自适应调整世界动作模型（WAM）的重规划时机，替代固定的执行前缀，在多个基准和真实机器人任务上提升了效率-成功率的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WAM 在每次推理时生成动作块并执行固定前缀后再重规划，但这种固定执行时域与执行动态不匹配——块可靠性随任务阶段变化，何时重规划应取决于累积执行结果而非步数。

Method: TempoWAM 包含两个核心组件：1) 循环进度监视器（Recurrent Progress Monitor），从当前观测、任务指令、剩余动作和执行历史估计任务进度；2) 自适应执行协议（Adaptive Execution Protocol），评估当前块是否推进任务来决定是否重规划。通过任务相关的校准因子和在线自适应弥合训练-部署差距。

Result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 和真实世界任务上，TempoWAM 一致改善了 WAM 执行的效率-成功率权衡。真实机器人上，简单任务减少 26.9% 的 WAM 推理次数且保持成功率，困难任务成功率提升 13.3 个百分点。

Conclusion: 基于进度监测的自适应重规划比固定执行时长更符合任务执行动态，能有效提升 WAM 的执行效率和成功率，并具备跨仿真与现实场景的泛化能力。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future actions and the evolution of the environment. At each inference, a WAM generates a chunk of actions and the robot executes a fixed prefix before replanning. We argue that this fixed execution horizon is poorly matched to execution dynamics: the chunk reliability varies across task stages, so when to replan depends on the result of accumulated execution, not on the step counts. We propose TempoWAM (Timing Execution by Monitoring Progress Online), a lightweight plug-and-play execution scheme for WAMs. A Recurrent Progress Monitor first estimates task progress from the current observation, task instruction, remaining actions, and execution history; and an Adaptive Execution Protocol then evaluates whether the chunk is advancing the task to decide if replanning is needed. To bridge the training-deployment gap, the protocol is calibrated by a task-dependent calibration factor with online adaptation. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and real-world tasks show that TempoWAM consistently improves the efficiency-success trade-off of WAM execution. On real robots, it reduces WAM inferences by 26.9% on easy tasks while maintaining success, and improves success by 13.3 points on difficult tasks.

</details>


### [258] [Beyond the Plane: Coupling Planar Vehicle Dynamics with Three-Dimensional Road Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09402v1)
*Simon Sagmeister,Phillip Pitschi,Nico Haja,Markus Lienkamp*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种将二维平面车辆动力学模型与真实三维道路几何耦合的新方法，通过在二维车辆状态与三维空间表示之间进行变换，并计算道路几何引起的力与力矩施加到平面模型中，从而在无需放弃简单平面模型的情况下，缩小平面仿真与真实三维道路之间的差距，并在拉斯维加斯赛车场高速数据及合成赛道上得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶系统的开发与测试依赖于精确的车辆动力学仿真，但大多数车辆动力学模型是二维的，而真实道路是三维的。三维道路几何（如倾斜弯道）会对轮胎法向力产生显著影响（例如拉斯维加斯赛道可增加66%以上的轮胎法向力），导致高精度的平面模型也难以准确复现真实车辆行为。虽然存在三维车辆动力学解决方案，但其计算昂贵、复杂且很少被采用。

Method: 该论文提出一种新颖的耦合方法：将平面车辆动力学模型的车辆状态从二维平面变换到对应的三维空间表示；同时计算由道路几何诱导的力与力矩，并将其施加回平面车辆模型。该方法以开源软件形式提供，便于采用。

Result: 在拉斯维加斯赛车场使用全尺寸赛车的高速数据进行验证，并在合成赛道上展示了该方法在边缘情况下的准确性。结果表明该方法能够在不放弃简单平面模型的情况下，弥合平面仿真与真实三维道路之间的差距。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法成功地将平面车辆动力学模型与真实三维道路几何进行耦合，在保持平面模型简洁性和计算效率的同时，显著提升了在三维道路条件下的仿真精度，并通过开源实现促进实际应用。

Abstract: Simulation is crucial for developing and testing autonomous driving systems. In particular, the development of localization and control algorithms relies on an accurate vehicle dynamics simulation. However, most vehicle dynamics models are two-dimensional while real-world roads are three-dimensional. For example, effects from the three-dimensional road geometry on the Las Vegas Motor Speedway can increase the normal forces on the tires by more than 66% compared to the nominal load at standstill. As a result, even highly detailed planar vehicle dynamics models struggle to accurately reproduce the real vehicle's behavior. While solutions for three-dimensional vehicle dynamics exist, they are rarely adopted, computationally expensive, and complex. To address this issue, we present a novel method to couple planar vehicle dynamics models with real-world three-dimensional road geometry. We transform the planar vehicle state from the vehicle model's two-dimensional plane to its corresponding representation in three-dimensional space. Additionally, we calculate road-geometry-induced forces and moments and apply them to the planar vehicle model. We validate our approach using high-speed data recorded with a full-scale race car on the banked Las Vegas Motor Speedway. Furthermore, on synthetic tracks, we show that our method yields accurate results even in edge cases. Together, our results demonstrate that the gap between planar simulation and real-world three-dimensional roads can be closed without abandoning simpler planar models. To simplify adoption of our method, we provide the implementation as open-source software on github.com/TUMFTM/3d-road-geometry-coupling.

</details>


### [259] [JEPA-WAM: Learning Vision-Language-Action Policies with Joint-Embedding World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09381v1)
*Yihan Lin,Jiawei He,Shifeng Bao,Chen Zhao,Yang Li,Xiaobo Wang,Yan Wang,Cheng Chi,Jing Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: JEPA-WAM是一种在预训练V-JEPA空间中构建的潜在世界动作模型，通过共享预测器将潜在状态转移预测与动作生成耦合，在LIBERO-Plus上达到79.2%的最优结果（无需大规模机器人策略预训练），其π0.5实例化版本达到86.3%的最佳整体性能，并在仿真和真实世界操作任务中展现出强大的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显式建模状态转移对鲁棒机器人控制有益，但视频生成式世界动作模型（WAMs）部署成本高；现有潜在WAMs虽然避免了显式未来生成，但往往压缩了预测表征，或将预测建模与动作生成所用的表征分离，导致预测能力无法有效服务于动作控制。

Method: JEPA-WAM在预训练的V-JEPA特征空间中构建潜在世界动作模型，通过共享预测器将潜在转移预测与连续动作生成耦合。它预测一个空间结构化的联合当前-未来目标，捕捉当前与未来观测之间任务共享的视觉时间结构，同时保留密集patch级对应。转移监督通过共享预测器直接塑造骨干网络，并从中提取专用表征用于动作预测。该设计也可实例化到预训练的VLA策略中，保留其原有感知和动作通路。

Result: 在LIBERO-Plus上，JEPA-WAM达到79.2%，是无需大规模机器人策略预训练的最佳结果；其预训练的π0.5实例化达到86.3%，为最佳整体性能。在RoboTwin 2.0和真实世界双臂操作实验中进一步展示了在视觉与空间偏移下的强大泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过在V-JEPA空间中构建共享预测器的潜在WAM，JEPA-WAM成功将状态转移预测与动作生成紧密耦合，既避免了视频生成的高部署成本，又使预测监督直接改善动作表征，在多项基准和真实世界中展现出最优性能与强泛化能力，且可无缝集成到现有VLA策略中。

Abstract: Robust robot control benefits from explicitly modeling state transitions, but video-generation world action models (WAMs) introduce substantial deployment cost. Existing latent WAMs avoid explicit future generation, but often compress predictive representations or separate predictive modeling from the representations used for action generation. We introduce JEPA-WAM, a latent WAM built in a pretrained V-JEPA space, which couples latent transition prediction with continuous action generation through a shared predictor. JEPA-WAM predicts a spatially structured joint current-future target that captures task-shared visual temporal structure between current and future observations, while preserving dense patch-level correspondence. Through the shared predictor, transition supervision directly shapes the backbone, from which dedicated representations are extracted for action prediction. The same design can also be instantiated in pretrained VLA policies while preserving their original perception and action pathways. On LIBERO-Plus, JEPA-WAM achieves 79.2%, the best result without large-scale robot-policy pretraining, while its pretrained $π_{0.5}$ instantiation reaches 86.3%, achieving the best overall performance. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and real-world bimanual manipulation further demonstrate strong generalization under visual and spatial shifts.

</details>


### [260] [WorldSimProbe: Diagnosing Simulator Faithfulness in Action-Conditioned World Models for Embodied Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09298v1)
*Peterson Co,Sicheng Hu,Chunxuan Jiao,Hongyang Cheng,Yulin Luo,Yijie Xu,Sixiang Chen,Zhongxia Zhao,Zihao Wang,DaFeng Chi,Peidong Liu,YuTong Chen,Henghua Liu,Zhihao Yuan,Huizhu Jia,Yuzheng Zhuang,Tianle Zhang,Liang Lin,Huajie Tan,Shanghang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出可观测模拟器契约（Observable Simulator Contract），定义任何动作条件物理模拟器应满足的最低要求：动作必须引发相应智能体运动，环境响应必须基于该真实运动。基于此契约，作者引入WorldSimProbe评估套件，包含五个受控测试域，并在18,000多个实例上评估六个开源ACWM模型，揭示动作-运动对应、交互接地和动力学方面的系统性失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的动作条件世界模型（ACWM）评估过分强调视觉质量、任务结果或粗略的 rollout 级响应，没有直接检验模拟器保真度，导致其作为可扩展预测模拟器（用于规划、策略评估和数据生成）的适用性难以确证。需要一个直接测试模拟器保真度而非任务表现的评估范式。

Method: 形式化Observable Simulator Contract——最小契约要求（动作引发对应运动、环境响应基于该运动）；提出WorldSimProbe，包含五个受控套件：局部控制敏感性、全局轨迹变化、异构来源动作、交互接地、动力学。各套件配备专用评估器，检验模拟器相对校准、稠密动作-运动对应、虚假交互接地、原始层级动力学。在六个开源ACWM上运行超过18,000个实例测试。

Result: WorldSimProbe揭示了系统性动作实现退化（跨控制变化）、交互接地与动力学中的结构化失败，以及基准信号与人工判断和下游结果的一致性。六个ACWM模型在各项测试中均表现出不同模式的能力缺陷。

Conclusion: 基于能力导向的评估框架为诊断ACWM模拟器保真度提供了透明、标准化的范式，超越了粗粒度的任务导向评估，有助于推动ACWM向真正可用的物理仿真器方向发展。

Abstract: Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) promise to provide embodied AI with scalable predictive simulators for planning, policy evaluation, and data generation. Realizing this promise requires precise action-conditioned transitions rather than merely plausible outputs. Yet their applicability remains difficult to establish because prevailing evaluations emphasize visual quality, task outcomes, or coarse rollout-level responsiveness without directly testing simulator fidelity. To address this gap, we evaluate ACWMs through the observable capabilities expected of physical simulators. Accordingly, we formalize Observable Simulator Contract, a minimal contract that any action-conditioned physical simulator should satisfy: supplied actions must induce corresponding agent motion, and environment responses must be grounded in that realized motion. To operationalize this contract, we introduce WorldSimProbe, comprising five controlled suites spanning local control sensitivity, global trajectory variation, source-diverse actions, interaction grounding, and dynamics. Suite-specific evaluators assess simulator-relative calibration, dense action-to-motion correspondence, false-interaction grounding, and primitive-level dynamics. We evaluate six open-source ACWMs on more than 18,000 instances across RoboTwin, ManiSkill, and LIBERO. World-SimProbe reveals systematic action-realization degradation across control variation, structured failures in interaction grounding and dynamics, and benchmark signals consistent with human judgments and downstream outcomes. Together, this capability-based framework provides a transparent, and standardized paradigm for diagnosing ACWM simulator fidelity beyond coarse, task-directed evaluation.

</details>


### [261] [SpeedTuning: Speeding Up Policy Execution with Lightweight Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09138v2)
*David D. Yuan,Tony Z. Zhao,Kaylee Burns,Chelsea Finn*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SpeedTuning，一个基于强化学习的框架，通过学习预测动作的最优执行速度来加速机器人操作策略，在不额外收集数据的情况下实现超过2.4倍的加速，同时保持足够的任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习型机器人策略虽具泛化潜力，但实际部署常受限于执行速度过慢。模仿学习策略受硬件和示教者操作速度的固有约束，且缺乏加速已有策略的成熟方法，执行速度与任务成功率之间的经验关系也尚未被充分探索。

Method: SpeedTuning是一个强化学习框架，学习预测动作的最优执行速度，以此补充基础策略，无需额外的数据收集。

Result: SpeedTuning在多种动态与精细任务（倾倒、抛掷、抓取）上实现了超过2.4倍的执行速度提升，同时保持足够的成功率，优于原任务策略和固定速度线性插值等简单加速方法。

Conclusion: SpeedTuning证明了在不额外收集数据的前提下，通过强化学习学习最优速度预测可以显著提升真实机器人操作策略的执行速度且不显著牺牲成功率，为模仿学习策略加速提供了有效且鲁棒的解决方案。

Abstract: While learned robotic policies hold promise for advancing generalizable manipulation, their practical deployment is often hindered by suboptimal execution speeds. Imitation learning policies are inherently limited by hardware constraints and the speed of the operator during data collection. In addition, there are no established methods for accelerating policies learned via imitation, and the empirical relationship between execution speed and task success remains underexplored. To address these issues, we introduce SpeedTuning, a reinforcement learning framework specifically designed to enhance the speed of manipulation policies. SpeedTuning learns to predict the optimal execution speed for actions, thereby complementing a base policy without necessitating additional data collection. We provide empirical evidence that SpeedTuning achieves substantial improvements in execution speed, exceeding 2.4x speed-up, while preserving an adequate success rate compared to both the original task policy and straightforward speed-up methods such as linear interpolation at a fixed speed. We evaluate our approach across a diverse set of dynamic and precise tasks, including pouring, throwing, and picking, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness in enhancing real-world robotic manipulation. Videos and code are available at https://daivdyuan.github.io/speed-tuning/

</details>


### [262] [Trajectory Divergence Horizon Decision for Reliable Dual-Arm Surgical Subtask Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09125v1)
*Mingwu Su,Guankun Wang,Jinsong Lin,Rulin Zhou,Ziyi Hao,Zhiwei Fang,Huxin Gao,Jiewen Lai,Jiazheng Wang,Fan Zhang,Hongliang Ren*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出TDHD（轨迹发散视界决策）机制，解决手术机器人中VLA模型因固定长度开环动作序列导致累积误差的问题。通过在测试时用flow-matching生成轨迹间的发散度估计逐步动作可靠性，并用双阈值规则截断执行以触发及时重规划。在真实的达芬奇式双臂平台上（600条遥操作演示）验证，针操作成功率从55%提升至60%，组织操作从55%提升至80%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术机器人采用率上升伴随临床工作量增加，需要自主化解决重复性操作子任务。虽然VLA模型提供了将视觉感知、语言理解和动作生成统一起来的框架，但现有VLA策略依赖固定长度的开环动作序列，场景变化时会产生累积误差和潜在的手术风险。因此需要一种自适应执行视界决策机制来提升VLA策略在手术操作中的可靠部署。

Method: 1) 将手术VLA部署形式化为自适应执行视界决策问题；2) 提出TDHD机制：在测试时通过测量两个flow-matching生成轨迹在微小噪声扰动下的发散度来估计逐步动作可靠性；3) 使用双阈值规则截断执行并触发及时重规划；4) 构建真实的达芬奇式双臂基准，配备同步多视角感知和语言指令；5) 收集600条遥操作演示，覆盖针（reach, pick, regrasp）和组织（reach, lift, resection）操作套件。

Result: 在真实硬件上每个任务设置进行20次试验，TDHD相比最新VLA基线持续提升性能：针操作成功率从55%提升到60%，组织操作成功率从55%提升到80%，且在最终操作阶段增益最大。

Conclusion: 自适应执行控制对于VLA模型在手术机器人操作中的可靠部署至关重要，TDHD机制有效缓解了固定长度开环动作导致的累积误差问题，显著提升了手术操作成功率，尤其在复杂操作的后半段。

Abstract: Surgical robotic systems are increasingly being adopted as clinical workload rises, motivating autonomous solutions for repetitive manipulation subtasks. Learning-based controllers improve generalization compared with rule-based and analytic approaches, but most are trained for individual tasks and remain difficult to reuse across procedures. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a unified framework that integrates visual perception, language grounding, and action generation, offering a promising path toward more composable surgical autonomy. However, existing VLA policies rely on fixed-length open-loop action sequences, where changing scene conditions can lead to accumulated errors and potential risks in surgical manipulation. To mitigate this issue, we formulate surgical VLA deployment as an adaptive execution-horizon decision problem and propose Trajectory Divergence Horizon Decision (TDHD), a test-time mechanism that estimates step-wise action reliability by measuring the divergence between two flow-matching-generated trajectories under small noise perturbations and truncates execution using a dual-threshold rule to trigger timely replanning. We further establish a real-world da Vinci-like dual-arm benchmark with synchronized multi-view perception and language instructions, and collect 600 teleoperated demonstrations across needle (reach, pick, regrasp) and tissue (reach, lift, resection) manipulation suites. On real hardware with 20 trials per task setting, TDHD consistently improves performance over the latest VLA baselines: success increases from 55\% to 60\% for needle manipulation and from 55\% to 80\% for tissue manipulation, with the largest gains observed in the final manipulation stages. These results highlight the importance of adaptive execution control for reliable deployment of VLA models in surgical robotic manipulation.

</details>


### [263] [SHRIMP: Iterative Refinement of Robot Task Plans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08884v1)
*Mya Schroder,Yuna Hwang,Callie Y. Kim,Leqian Cheng,Jeffrey Li-cheng Liu,Chenchen Zheng,Xinning He,Bilge Mutlu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SHRIMP是一个利用自然语言自动生成层次化机器人原始动作计划，并通过用户重提示和显式修正进行迭代修订的系统，同时支持仿真验证与实物机器人执行。用户研究（n=35）表明该系统提升了用户的感知控制感和机器人透明度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协作机器人已广泛应用于制造、农业和医疗等领域，但编程或适配机器人行为通常需要机器人专业知识，大多数终端用户不具备这些技能。虽然大语言模型使自然语言到任务计划的翻译成为可能，但语言任务规范存在语义歧义，且生成模型对语言指令如何转化为机器人动作缺乏透明性，用户难以在执行前验证计划。

Method: 提出SHRIMP系统：(1) 使用自然语言自动生成层次化机器人原始动作计划；(2) 支持用户通过重提示和显式修正对计划进行迭代修订；(3) 在每次修订后允许用户在仿真中验证计划；(4) 用户满意后在实体机器人上执行。通过35名参与者进行桌面厨房任务规划的用户研究进行验证。

Result: 用户研究（n=35）验证了SHRIMP能够提升用户的感知控制感，并增强机器人的透明度。

Conclusion: SHRIMP通过结合层次化计划生成、迭代修订和仿真验证机制，有效解决了自然语言任务规范中的语义歧义和模型透明度不足的问题，改善了人机交互体验。

Abstract: As collaborative robots have entered domains such as manufacturing, agriculture, and healthcare, programming or adapting robot behavior typically requires robotic expertise that most end users lack. Natural language lowers this barrier. Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have made it feasible to translate natural language into robot task plans. However, language-based task specification suffers from semantic ambiguity, and generative models lack transparency for how language instructions become robot actions, making it difficult for users to validate the plan before execution. To address these issues, we introduce SHRIMP, a system that allows users to automatically generate a hierarchical robot primitive plan using natural language and iteratively revise their plan through re-prompting and explicit correction. At each revision, SHRIMP allows users to validate their plan in simulation, and once satisfied, execute it on the physical robot. Through a user study involving participants planning tabletop kitchen tasks (n=35), we validate that SHRIMP improves perceived control and enhances robot transparency. System videos and source code are available at https://wisc-hci.github.io/SHRIMP.

</details>


### [264] [SG-WAM: Text-Grounded and Spatial-aware Semantic Guidance for World-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08839v1)
*Junjie He,Junfeng Li,Zhide Zhong,Haodong Yan,Ruixin Li,Yangyang Zheng,Jiaguan Zhu,Tianran Zhang,Yuqiao Du,Wen Chen,Shunbo Zhou,Haoang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SG-WAM，一种语义引导方法，利用视觉语言模型(VLM)作为语义规划器，为世界动作模型(WAM)注入文本接地和空间感知的语义预判，从而增强其指令跟随能力，使未来视频生成和动作预测与语言指令保持一致。实验在仿真和真实世界均验证了其优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型(WAMs)主要依赖视觉线索而非语言指令来生成未来视频和动作，因为现成的文本编码器独立于视觉观察嵌入指令，导致预测的视频与对应语言指令存在语义错位，进而降低动作预测的准确性。

Method: 训练一个基于VLM的规划器来预测两种语义预判：1) 文本接地语义预判(识别正确的目标物体以对齐指令)和2) 空间感知语义预判(提供用于精确操作的三维场景几何信息)。随后将这些预判作为高层语义引导注入世界动作模型，确保未来视频生成和动作预测都严格遵循语言指令。

Result: 在仿真和真实世界的大量实验表明，SG-WAM在精确操作和指令跟随能力上均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过VLM语义规划器的引导，能够有效增强世界动作模型的指令接地能力，实现更精确的操控和更强的指令跟随性能。

Abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation. However, most existing WAMs generate future videos and actions by relying mainly on visual cues rather than language instructions, since off-the-shelf text encoders embed instructions independently of visual observations. As a result, the videos predicted by these WAMs are often semantically misaligned with their corresponding language instructions, which degrades the accuracy of the predicted actions. To overcome this limitation, we propose SG-WAM, a semantic guidance method for world-action models that leverages a vision-language model (VLM) as a semantic planner to enhance the instruction-grounding capacity of world-action models. Specifically, we train a VLM-based planner to predict text-grounded and spatial-aware semantic foresight. The text-grounded semantic foresight grounds the instruction by identifying the correct target objects, and the spatial-aware semantic foresight provides the scene geometry for precise manipulation. We then inject this foresight into the world-action model as high-level semantic guidance, ensuring that both future-video generation and action prediction faithfully follow the language instruction. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate the superiority of our semantic guidance method, showcasing precise manipulation and strong instruction-following capabilities.

</details>


### [265] [OnEvoMemory: Evolving Memory through Online Robot Rollouts for Pretrained Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08749v1)
*Zhongxi Chen,Shenqi Zong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OnEvoMemory是一种面向预训练机器人策略（VLA）的价值引导记忆模块，通过维护近期上下文、高价值经验和关键过渡事件，并利用离线演示初始化记忆先验、在线成功/失败轨迹进化记忆选择，以提升长时程操作任务中策略对子任务跟踪和关键交互事件的感知能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程机器人操作要求策略能够跟踪已完成的子任务和关键交互事件，但现有记忆机制过度依赖外部模型或预设的更新规则，缺乏自主学习和自适应选择哪些经验应被保留的能力。

Method: 提出OnEvoMemory价值引导记忆模块：(1)维护三类记忆——近期上下文、高价值经验、显著状态转换；(2)从轨迹结果中学习哪些经验应被保留；(3)离线演示初始化记忆先验；(4)在线成功与失败的回放数据精化记忆选择，帮助策略识别任务阶段转换并避免重复已完成子任务。

Result: 在长时程操作基准实验上，OnEvoMemory通过离线初始化和在线记忆进化两种机制均提升了基础VLA策略的性能。

Conclusion: 价值引导的记忆模块能够有效提升预训练策略在长时程操作中的表现，其离线先验与在线进化的双重机制为构建更灵活的自适应记忆系统提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires policies to track completed subtasks and critical interaction events. However, existing memory mechanisms heavily rely on external models or predefined update rules. To address this, we propose OnEvoMemory, a value-guided memory module for pretrained robot policies. It maintains recent context, high-value experiences, and salient transitions, while learning which experiences should be retained from trajectory outcomes. Offline demonstrations initialize the memory prior, whereas successful and unsuccessful online rollouts refine memory selection, helping the policy recognize task-stage transitions and avoid repeating completed subtasks. Experiments on long-horizon manipulation benchmarks show that OnEvoMemory improves the performance of the base VLA policy through both offline initialization and online memory evolution.

</details>


### [266] [WA-SpecDec: World-Aware Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08725v1)
*Zikang Wen,Yuning Zhang,Dong Yuan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: WA-SpecDec是一个世界感知的投机解码框架，通过在世界模型注入VLA预填充阶段，生成共享的世界感知预填充状态，用于草稿提议和目标验证，在不改变宽松接受规则的前提下提升任务成功率并降低近接触失败率，在匹配成功率的操作点上实现1.5倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA投机解码中的token级接受松弛是场景无关的——固定的token距离容忍度在不同状态下将相同的动作token偏差视为同等安全，但自由空间中的无害偏差在接触附近可能导致碰撞或抓取失败。需要引入世界模型感知的场景意识来区分不同物理场景下的动作偏差风险。

Method: WA-SpecDec在世界模型指导下，于VLA预填充阶段注入物理场景感知信息，生成共享的世界感知预填充状态，同时供草稿提议和目标验证两个阶段使用，不改变原有的宽松接受规则。

Result: 在三种最先进的宽松接受方案上，WA-SpecDec在更宽松的松弛条件下保持了更高的任务成功率并支持更长的接受前缀；在匹配成功率的操作点上，较单纯VLA投机解码实现了1.5倍加速，平均降低近接触失败率18.6%。

Conclusion: 通过将世界模型注入VLA预填充阶段，WA-SpecDec证明场景感知的宽松接受能够在不牺牲任务成功率的前提下实现更激进的投机解码加速，为VLA策略的闭环延迟优化提供了新方向。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies generate robot controls autoregressively, making closed-loop latency dominated by repeated target-model forward passes. Speculative decoding reduces this cost by verifying blocks of draft action tokens in parallel, and recent VLA methods further relax token-level acceptance because small differences in action-token space often map to similar continuous controls. However, this relaxation remains scene-agnostic. A fixed token-distance tolerance treats the same action-token deviation as equally safe across states, although deviations that are harmless in free space can cause collisions or grasp failures near contact. We propose WA-SpecDec, a world-aware speculative decoding framework that injects world-model-derived physical scene awareness during the VLA prefill stage, producing shared world-aware prefill states for draft proposal and target verification without changing the relaxed acceptance rule. Across three state-of-the-art relaxed acceptance schemes, WA-SpecDec preserves higher task success under looser relaxation and enables longer accepted prefixes. At comparable-success operating points, WA-SpecDec achieves a 1.5x matched-success speedup over VLA speculative decoding alone and reduces near-contact failure (NCF) by 18.6% on average relative to the corresponding speculative baselines.

</details>


### [267] [Vid2WAM: Distilling Video Diffusion Priors into World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08558v1)
*Chenhao Qiu,Ruixiang Wang,Runyi Zhao,Sixu Lin,Songen Gu,Shufeng Nan,Guiliang Liu,Kui Jia,Yanwei Fu,Simo Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Vid2WAM提出了一种离线蒸馏框架，将大规模视频基础模型的视觉扩散先验蒸馏到紧凑的World Action Model（WAM）学生模型中，通过任务条件未来滚动预测和逆动力学模型生成伪动作进行监督，克服了对昂贵专家示范的依赖，同时提升新任务泛化与数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: World Action Models（WAMs）通过联合建模未来视觉动态和动作来提升机器人策略学习，但其可扩展性和泛化能力受限于对昂贵专家示范数据的依赖。作者质疑未来监督必须来源于目标任务的专家轨迹这一前提，探索是否可以从大规模视频模型中蒸馏监督信号。

Method: Vid2WAM通过两条互补通道进行蒸馏：(1) 任务条件未来生成（task-conditioned future rollouts）直接监督学生模型的未来预测分支；(2) 逆动力学模型（inverse dynamics model）从视频中恢复具身特定的伪动作用于动作学习。为稳健整合合成与真实监督，引入源感知残差动作适配（source-aware residual action adaptation），在共享动作骨干上学习源特定修正以缓解噪声伪动作干扰。推理时丢弃视频教师和逆动力学模型，仅保留WAM学生。

Result: 仿真与真实世界实验表明，Vid2WAM在有限专家示范下提升了新任务泛化和数据效率，同时保持低延迟推理性能。

Conclusion: Vid2WAM验证了未来监督可以从大规模视频基础模型中蒸馏而来，无需依赖目标任务专家轨迹，为WAM的扩展提供了一条资源高效路径，实现了泛化能力与部署效率之间的良好平衡。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by jointly modeling future visual dynamics and actions. However, their scalability and generalization remain constrained by their reliance on costly expert demonstrations. We challenge this by asking whether future supervision for WAMs must originate from target-task expert trajectories. In this paper, we propose Vid2WAM, an offline distillation framework that transfers visual diffusion priors from a large video foundation model into a compact WAM student. Given an observation and language instruction, Vid2WAM distills supervision through two complementary channels: task-conditioned future rollouts directly supervise the student's future prediction branch, while an inverse dynamics model recovers embodiment-specific pseudo-actions for action learning. To robustly integrate synthetic and real supervision, we introduce source-aware residual action adaptation that learns source-specific corrections around a shared action backbone and mitigates interference from noisy pseudo-actions. During inference, both the video teacher and inverse dynamics model are discarded, leaving only the WAM student for efficient deployment. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that Vid2WAM improves novel-task generalization and data efficiency under limited expert demonstrations while preserving low-latency inference.

</details>


### [268] [Action- and Language-Conditioned Video Assessment for Embodied Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08273v1)
*Hwanhee Kim,Jaehyun Jang,Seungmin Cha,Hyeonseo Yun,Donghoon Lee,Chang D. Yoo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ALVA是一种基于动作和语言条件的视频评估器，利用预训练VLM两步流程：先对帧间视觉转换进行动作条件化摘要，再根据指令评估摘要生成离散的轨迹级进度评分，为视觉具身智能体提供可解释的任务进度反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉具身智能体在执行多步自然语言指令时需要反馈机制来评估完整轨迹的任务进度。传统的基于最终帧匹配或连续嵌入相似度的方法可能忽略决定指令是否完成所需的关键中间转换，因此需要一种更全面的轨迹级评估方法。

Method: ALVA使用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）分两阶段工作：第一阶段对帧到帧的视觉转换进行摘要，并以此动作执行序列为条件；第二阶段根据自然语言指令评估生成的摘要，输出离散的轨迹级进度分数。该方法在3D模拟家庭环境中进行评估。

Result: 在模拟3D家庭环境中，ALVA表现出保守的评估模式，具有接近零的假阳性率。当用作闭环策略优化的终端反馈时，它比静态图像和基于嵌入的视觉基线提供更有效的反馈，并缩小了与真实标签oracle之间的性能差距。

Conclusion: 结果支持将动作和语言条件化的视频评估作为所评估的模拟具身控制任务中一种可解释的反馈机制，能够更准确地判断指令完成度并提供有效的闭环优化反馈。

Abstract: Vision-based embodied agents executing multi-step natural language instructions require feedback mechanisms that assess task progress over complete trajectories. Conventional approaches based on final-frame matching or continuous embedding similarity may overlook intermediate transitions that are necessary for determining whether an instruction has been completed. We propose ALVA (Action- and Language-Conditioned Video Assessment), a trajectory evaluator that conditions its assessment on visual observations, the executed action sequence, and the natural language instruction. The method uses a pre-trained vision-language model (VLM) in two stages: it first summarizes frame-to-frame visual transitions conditioned on the executed actions and then assesses the generated summary with respect to the instruction to produce a discrete trajectory-level progress score. In simulated 3D household environments, ALVA exhibits a conservative assessment pattern with near-zero false-positive rates. When used as terminal feedback for closed-loop policy optimization, it provides more effective feedback than the evaluated static image and embedding-based visual baselines and reduces the performance gap to a ground-truth oracle. These results support action- and language-conditioned video assessment as an interpretable feedback mechanism for the evaluated simulated embodied-control tasks.

</details>


### [269] [SurgWMBench: A Vision-Based Benchmark for World-Modeling Surgical Instrument Motion Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08070v1)
*Huanrong Liu,Weiliang Huang,Bob Zhang,Weichao Cai,Chunlin Tian,Qingbiao Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SurgWMBench，一个基于视觉的基准测试，用于评估外科手术世界模型在短期运动规划与动力学预测方面的能力，弥补现有指标（如FVD）与器械运动规划之间不对齐的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手术视频理解方法侧重识别当前步骤或模仿专家演示，缺乏对器械运动如何重塑后续手术状态的显式建模；而器械运动预测方法又无法捕捉未来手术视频状态的耦合演化。此外，现有手术世界模型研究主要关注视觉生成质量，使用FVD等指标，这些指标与器械运动规划不匹配，且缺乏公共数据集和标准化评估协议。

Method: 提出SurgWMBench基准测试框架，输入为术中图像序列和历史器械轨迹，评估两个关键能力：(1) 近未来器械运动预测的几何准确性和时间连贯性；(2) 在连续滚动推理或输入扰动下的稳定性。

Result: 论文介绍SurgWMBench作为手术运动规划与动力学预测的基准基础设施，提供标准化评估协议来量化模型在器械轨迹预测方面的可操作性。

Conclusion: SurgWMBench填补了手术世界模型在运动中心评估方面的空白，促进模型从仅关注视觉生成向支持可操作的手术运动规划方向发展。

Abstract: Reliable surgical planning requires models that move beyond recognizing the current surgical step or imitating expert demonstrations, and instead anticipate how instrument motion reshapes subsequent operative states. Most surgical video understanding methods focus on recognizing phases, actions, or workflow states, while providing limited support for explicitly modeling instrument motion. Conversely, existing tool motion prediction methods can forecast instrument trajectories, but they generally do not capture the coupled evolution of future surgical video states. World models offer a natural framework for jointly modeling visual state transitions and instrument motion dynamics. However, existing surgical world model studies remain largely centered on visual generation quality, relying on generation-oriented metrics such as FVD and CD-FVD. These metrics are poorly aligned with instrument motion planning, as they do not directly measure whether predicted trajectories are geometrically accurate, temporally coherent, or actionable for downstream planning. This limitation is partly structural, since the field lacks public datasets and standardized evaluation protocols that provide the benchmarking infrastructure needed to assess motion-centric capabilities in surgical world models. In this paper, we introduce SurgWMBench, a vision-based benchmark for short-horizon surgical motion planning and dynamics prediction. Given intraoperative image sequences and historical instrument trajectory, SurgWMBench evaluates both near-future instrument motion prediction and stability under continuous rollout or input perturbations.

</details>


### [270] [PhysX-CoT: Structured Physical Reasoning from a Single Image to Simulation-Ready 3D Assets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08053v1)
*Jie Huang,Xiaohe Li,Jiahao Li,Fangli Mou,Chen Qian,Yuqiang Fang,Junhao Fan,Kaixin Zhang,Zide Fan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PhysX-CoT将单图像3D资产生成重新定义为显式结构化物理推理过程，通过有序、机器可解析的部件级状态轨迹（涵盖分解、2D/3D grounding、关系、粗略几何和表面线索）进行独立监督、几何条件约束和奖励目标，实现超越现有基线的几何、尺度及物理属性指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的单图像3D资产生成通常被视为视觉语言模型输出序列化资产的过程，这种输出中心视角存在局限：部件放置与局部形状在全局坐标令牌流中纠缠，中间物理状态从未被暴露用于监督、条件约束或验证，限制了图像到3D的推理能力。

Method: PhysX-CoT将生成过程建模为显式的结构化物理推理轨迹，包含分解、2D/3D grounding、关系、粗略几何和表面线索等部件级状态。几何被分解为3D盒子携带放置信息和局部编码携带形状信息；CoT对齐的GRPO优化解析有效性、grounding、几何、放置和物理一致性。所有学习基线在统一协议下使用相同骨干网络、数据和冻结解码器重新训练。

Result: 在统一评估协议下，PhysX-CoT在几何、尺度和物理属性指标上优于最接近的全任务基线。Oracle、令牌匹配和状态顺序控制实验证明显式状态是功能性而非装饰性的；在Unreal Engine 5中生成的资产具有高有效性的解析、碰撞和关节运动能力。

Conclusion: 通过将单图像3D资产生成构建为显式且可监督的结构化物理推理过程，PhysX-CoT证明了暴露中间物理状态对于提升生成质量的有效性，为图像到3D资产生成提供了一种可验证、可解释的替代范式。

Abstract: Simulation-ready 3D assets are central to robotics and embodied AI. Generating them from a single image is usually framed as a vision-language model that emits a serialized asset for a decoder to turn into geometry and physical fields, leaving the image-to-3D reasoning implicit. We argue the limiting factor is this output-centric view: part placement and local shape are entangled in one global-coordinate token stream, and the intermediate physical states are never exposed for supervision, conditioning, or verification. PhysX-CoT instead casts single-image asset generation as an explicit structured physical reasoning process, an ordered and machine-parseable trajectory of part-level states covering decomposition, 2D and 3D grounding, relations, coarse geometry, and surface cues that we separately supervise, use to condition geometry, and treat as reward targets. Geometry is factorized so that 3D boxes carry placement and local codes carry shape, and CoT-aligned GRPO optimizes parse validity, grounding, geometry, placement, and physical consistency. Under a unified protocol that retrains all learned baselines on the same backbone, data, and frozen decoder, PhysX-CoT outperforms the closest full-task baseline across geometry, scale, and physical-attribute metrics. Oracle, token-matched, and state-order controls show the explicit states are functional rather than cosmetic, and in Unreal Engine~5 the generated assets parse, collide, and articulate at high validity.

</details>


### [271] [DA-NBV: A Direction-Aware Next-Best-View Planner for Efficient 3D Reconstruction of Ships at Sea](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08025v1)
*Jiaming Chen,Juntao Yang,Zhentao Zou,Qi Ming,Yi Yu,Zhihang Zhong,Xue Yang,Xue Jiang,Yue Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出DA-NBV，一种方向感知的下一最佳视角规划策略，用于海上船只的高质量三维重建。该方法在传统占据状态基础上引入方向观测统计，通过可学习的Position Advantage Field (PAF)指导视角选择，并采用局部约束动作空间和非线性覆盖形状奖励提升扫描效率。实验表明，在不同海况下，该方法相比现有方法将重建完整度提升约3个百分点，Chamfer距离降低43%，同时具备更高的路径效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海上船只三维重建对海事监管、损伤评估和自主海事作业至关重要，但现有高质量数据采集依赖人工设计的轨迹或熟练操作员，成本高且难以规模化。现有NBV策略主要建模空间占据而忽视方向观测历史，而船只的复杂上层结构和严重自遮挡需要多视角观测，方向覆盖不足会导致重建不完整。此外，海上波浪引起的升沉、横摇和纵摇不断改变船只姿态与表面可见性，风扰动和有限机载功率也对扫描效率提出更高要求。

Method: DA-NBV的核心思路是在传统占据状态之上增强方向观测统计信息。具体包含三个关键设计：(1) 可学习的Position Advantage Field (PAF)，利用方向信息指导视角选择；(2) 局部约束动作空间，限制扫描动作范围以提升效率；(3) 非线性覆盖形状奖励，用于引导更高效的覆盖策略。同时构建了面向船只的SeaShip-3D数据集和可配置海况仿真环境，以支持变海况下的训练与评估。

Result: 在不同升沉、横摇和纵摇条件下，DA-NBV相比基线方法将重建完整度提升约3个百分点，Chamfer距离降低43%，并实现了更高的路径（扫描）效率。

Conclusion: 通过融入方向感知信息，DA-NBV有效解决了海上船只因复杂上层结构和自遮挡导致的重建不完整问题，在多变海况下显著提升了重建质量与扫描效率，为海上自主三维重建提供了一种更高效、可规模化的解决方案。

Abstract: Accurate 3D reconstruction of ships at sea is important for maritime supervision, damage assessment, and autonomous maritime operations. Although 3D reconstruction has advanced considerably, high-quality data acquisition still largely relies on manually designed trajectories or skilled operators, resulting in high costs and limited scalability. Next-best-view (NBV) planning automates this process by selecting subsequent viewpoints based on the current state. However, existing NBV policies mainly model spatial occupancy while overlooking directional observation history. This limitation is particularly problematic for ships: their complex superstructures and severe self-occlusions require observations from multiple viewpoints, and insufficient directional coverage often yields incomplete reconstructions. These challenges are further amplified at sea, where wave-induced heave, roll, and pitch continuously alter the ship's pose and surface visibility. Meanwhile, wind disturbances and limited onboard power impose stricter requirements on scanning efficiency. To address these challenges, we propose DA-NBV, a direction-aware NBV policy that augments the conventional occupancy state with directional observation statistics. We introduce a learnable Position Advantage Field (PAF) that uses directional information to guide viewpoint selection. The policy further adopts a locally constrained action space and a nonlinear coverage-shaping reward to improve scanning efficiency. We also develop the ship-oriented SeaShip-3D dataset and a configurable sea-state simulation environment. Experiments under varying heave, roll, and pitch conditions show that DA-NBV improves reconstruction completeness by approximately 3 percentage points and reduces Chamfer distance by 43% while achieving higher path efficiency.

</details>


### [272] [4D-WAM: Infusing Spatiotemporal Awareness into World Action Models through Trajectory Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08023v1)
*Lishan Yang,Wenxuan Song,Xi Wang,Pingyue Sheng,Zheng Fang,Ziyang Zhou,Junjie He,Haodong Yan,Jiayi Chen,Nan Sun,Qiao Sun,Lingqiao Liu,Yan Wang,Yuxiang Gao,Feras Dayoub,Haoang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出4D-WAM，一种与模型无关的训练策略，通过表示对齐将3D轨迹场的时空知识注入世界动作模型（WAMs），引入运动对齐和目标对齐两个互补目标，使WAMs学习轨迹级别的时空表示，在分布内和分布外实验中显著提升空间理解、执行精度、鲁棒性、泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的世界动作模型（WAMs）通常在2D像素空间中表示视频，与机器人动作执行的3D空间之间存在表示鸿沟。虽然近期3D方法引入了3D信息，但未能充分利用3D结构的动态特性，缺乏对3D轨迹时空动态的完整建模。

Method: 提出4D-WAM训练策略，通过表示对齐将3D轨迹场中的时空知识注入WAMs。包含两个互补目标：1）运动对齐（motion alignment），对齐相邻帧间的时序特征变化，促使模型在训练中建立局部4D感知；2）目标对齐（destination alignment），通过最小化源帧与最终目的地之间注意力相似分布的差距，引导模型推断最终目的地。两者结合提供局部运动监督和长时程目标引导。

Result: 在多种基础模型上的分布内和分布外实验中，4D-WAM在空间理解、执行精度、鲁棒性、泛化能力和多样性方面均取得显著提升。

Conclusion: 4D-WAM通过双目标对齐策略成功弥合了2D像素表示与3D动作空间之间的鸿沟，为WAMs注入了轨迹级别的时空表示能力，是一种模型无关、可广泛适用的训练改进方案。

Abstract: Building on recent advances in world models, World Action Models (WAMs) jointly model video prediction and action generation. However, they typically represent videos in 2D pixel space, creating a representation gap with 3D space in which robotic actions are executed. Recent 3D approaches introduce 3D information, but fail to fully exploit the dynamics of 3D structures. In this work, we propose 4D-WAM, a model-agnostic training strategy that injects spatiotemporal knowledge from 3D trajectory fields into WAMs through representation alignment. To this end, we introduce two complementary objectives: 1) motion alignment, which aligns temporal feature variations across adjacent frames and encourages the model to build local 4D awareness during training, and 2) destination alignment, which guides the model to infer the final destination from the source frame by minimizing the gap between their attention-like similarity distributions. Together, these objectives provide both local motion supervision and long-horizon goal guidance, enabling WAMs to learn trajectory-level spatiotemporal representations. Extensive in-distribution and out-of-distribution experiments across different base models demonstrate the model's improvements in spatial understanding, execution precision, robustness, generalization, and versatility.

</details>


### [273] [Learning Fault-Tolerant Locomotion with Adaptive Gait Timing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07328v1)
*Giovanbattista Gravina,Luca Rossini,Carlo Rizzardo,Arturo Laurenzi,Nikos Tsagarakis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度强化学习的容错运动控制方法，用于四足机器人在执行器功率损失下的自适应步态调整，通过非对称actor-critic架构和可学习步态频率参数实现稳定的故障后行走。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬件故障要求腿式机器人快速重组协调与步态时序以维持稳定性和机动性，但大型四足机器人由于质量大、驱动极限紧，难以采用小型平台上常见的激进高频补偿策略，亟需针对大型四足平台的容错运动控制方法。

Method: 采用深度强化学习框架，构建非对称actor-critic架构：训练时critic可获取特权信息，actor则从本体感受观测中学习重建对应的隐式表示，并通过潜在对齐损失（latent-alignment loss）促进actor与critic表示的一致性；同时在动作空间中引入可学习的步态频率参数，以自适应调整步态时序应对地形变化和执行器退化。

Result: 方法在高保真仿真中的复杂地形上得到验证，并在68 kg四足机器人的平坦地面真实世界实验中成功应用。

Conclusion: 该框架通过特权学习的隐表示重建与可学习步态频率扩展，使大型四足机器人在执行器功率损失下无需预定义故障腿策略即可保持运动稳定性，为大型腿式平台的容错控制提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Hardware failures require legged robots to rapidly reorganize coordination and gait timing to maintain stability and mobility. This is particularly challenging for larger quadrupeds, where increased mass and tighter actuation limits reduce the feasibility of aggressive, high-frequency compensation strategies often observed on smaller platforms. In this work, we propose a deep reinforcement learning approach for fault-tolerant locomotion under actuator power loss. The method employs an asymmetric actor-critic architecture in which the critic has access to privileged information during training, while the actor learns to reconstruct a corresponding latent representation from proprioceptive observations. We introduce a latent-alignment loss that encourages consistency between actor and critic representations. Additionally, we augment the action space with a learnable gait frequency parameter, enabling adaptive gait timing in response to terrain variations and actuator degradation without predefined faulty-leg strategies. The approach is validated in high-fidelity simulation on uneven terrain and real-world experiments on flat ground using a 68 kg quadruped robot.

</details>


### [274] [TEMPO: Semantic-Action Decoupled RL Post-Training for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07314v1)
*Ziheng Liu,Quantao Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TEMPO是一个面向VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型的语义-动作解耦双时间尺度强化学习后训练框架，通过冻结视觉-语言骨干网络，仅对语义投影层和低级动作专家采用不同频率的独立RL优化循环进行微调，从而在稳定高层语义表征的同时高效学习控制反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型后训练方法存在不足：SFT容易产生分布不匹配问题；已有的RL后训练方法对所有模型组件采用单一统一的更新策略，忽略了不同组件（如语义表征层与动作层）的功能角色差异，导致训练效率与稳定性欠佳。

Method: TEMPO冻结预训练的视觉-语言骨干网络以保留通用语义表征，仅将适配限制在两个组件上，分别为语义投影层和低级动作专家，并对二者设置独立的RL优化循环。两个组件以不同频率更新：语义投影层低频更新以维持潜在动作的稳定性，动作专家高频更新以快速融入在线交互的控制反馈。

Result: 在CALVIN基准和真实世界操控任务上的实验表明，TEMPO一致性地超越了预训练SOTA VLA模型和RL后训练基线，在两个真实世界任务上达到并保持了更高的评估奖励。

Conclusion: 解耦的RL微调策略能够防止快速的策略更新破坏高层语义表征，同时仍允许动作专家高效地从在线反馈中学习，验证了按组件功能角色差异化地设计RL后训练更新策略的有效性。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are commonly adapted to downstream manipulation tasks via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or online reinforcement learning (RL) post-training. SFT is prone to distribution mismatch, and existing RL approaches typically apply a single, uniform update strategy to all model components, ignoring their distinct functional roles. We propose TEMPO, a semantic-action decoupled, two-timescale RL post-training framework for VLA models. TEMPO freezes the pretrained vision-language backbone to preserve general semantic representations, and restricts adaptation to two components with dedicated RL optimization loops: the semantic projection layer and the low-level action expert. We update them at different rates--the semantic projection layer infrequently, to keep the latent action stable, and the action expert frequently, to rapidly incorporate control feedback from online interaction. This decoupling RL fine-tuning strategy prevents fast policy updates from destabilizing high-level semantic representations while still allowing the action expert to learn efficiently from online feedback. Experiments on the CALVIN benchmark and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that TEMPO consistently outperforms both pretrained state-of-the-art VLA models and the RL post-training baseline, while reaching and maintaining higher evaluation rewards on two real-world tasks.

</details>


### [275] [AutoIntervene: Calibrated Intervention for Action-Chunking Imitation Learning Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07065v1)
*Jinhe Tang,Weiming Zhi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出AutoIntervene，一种在线框架，在部署期间基于视觉-动作支持记忆评估动作块与当前状态的一致性，从而在动作块策略与操作员之间选择性切换控制权，并利用干预片段进行后续策略更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动作块视觉运动策略虽然能提升时间一致性，但感知误差和执行漂移会使机器人偏离示教分布，而策略仍生成平滑但与当前状态不一致的动作块，缺乏有效的在线监控与干预机制。

Method: AutoIntervene构建成功任务执行的视觉-动作支持记忆，结合视觉相似性和动作一致性评估候选动作块；采用相局部支持指导策略到操作员的切换，全局支持指导操作员恢复后的策略回归；从留出专家演示的评估分数经验分位数校准双向切换阈值，避免手动调参；保留成功rollout中的干预片段作为矫正监督用于后续策略更新。

Result: 在真实双臂操作任务上，AutoIntervene相比手动干预取得了更高的自适应后任务成功率和更低的操作员控制时间。

Conclusion: 通过数据驱动的自动干预框架，可以在部署时有效识别策略失效状态并及时切换控制，同时利用干预数据改善策略，实现更高成功率与更低人工介入成本。

Abstract: Action-chunking visuomotor policies learn from demonstrations and improve temporal consistency by predicting short action sequences rather than single-step commands. Yet perception errors and execution drift can move the robot outside the demonstration distribution, while the policy continues to produce smooth action chunks that are inconsistent with the observed state. We present AutoIntervene, an online framework that selectively transfers control between an action-chunking policy and an operator during deployment. AutoIntervene evaluates proposed chunks against a visual-action support memory built from successful task executions, combining visual similarity with consistency between proposed and reference actions. Phase-local support governs policy-to-operator transfer within the current task phase, whereas global support governs the return to policy control after operator recovery. We calibrate separate switching thresholds for the two directions from empirical quantiles of evaluation-level scores on held-out expert demonstrations, avoiding direct manual tuning of score cutoffs. Intervention segments retained from successful rollouts target learner-induced states and provide corrective supervision for subsequent policy updates. Experiments on real-world bimanual manipulation tasks show higher post-adaptation task success and lower operator-control time than manual intervention. Videos and additional results are available at https://aus.bot/research/autointervene/.

</details>


### [276] [Benchmarking and Reasoning Distillation of Large Language Models for Feedback Controller Design in Complex Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07004v1)
*Zhongchao Zhou,Yixuan Xie,Wenwei Yu,Yuxi Lu,Yaonan Zhu,Qian Niu,Yutaka Matsuo,Yusuke Iwasawa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了CoDyControlBench基准，包含132个系统配置和五个评估维度，用于评估LLM在反馈控制器设计方面的能力。对六个SOTA LLM（三个商业模型和三个开源模型）进行了评估，GPT以94.8%的设计成功率领先，Qwen最低为50.0%。通过推理蒸馏开发的1.5B参数轻量级模型在基准上表现优于基线和答案蒸馏模型，并在气动人工肌肉驱动机器臂的三次物理试验中成功实现目标跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然LLM在科学领域展现了显著能力，但反馈控制器设计仍未被充分探索。现有基准主要关注线性单自由度系统和大型API托管模型，无法反映复杂控制器设计任务的性能，也未探讨边缘部署的可行性。
