To address this limitation, we propose AirFlow, a pollutant-aware dual-stream framework that operates on station multivariate observations without additional graph propagation or predefined signal decomposition. Specifically, AirFlow designs two novel blocks: (1) a statistic-guided normalization routing mechanism that selects a normalization path for each pollutant according to its 24-hour autocorrelation and distribution drift; and (2) a hierarchical dual-stream state model that combines multi-scale state space propagation with learnable response coefficients, where gated bidirectional cross-attention exchanges information and adaptively fuses the resulting representations. Experiments on real-world data from multiple cities show that AirFlow achieves the best performance in 34 of 36 metrics comparisons, with reductions of up to 11.11% root mean square error over the state-of-the-art baseline. AirFlow also requires only 0.0483M parameters and 0.0215G FLOPs, achieving high forecasting accuracy with low computational overhead.

</details>


### [336] [Model Discovery Agent: LLM-assisted Bayesian experiment design for data-efficient discovery of mechanistic world models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09696v2)
*Kevin Murphy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出模型发现智能体（MDA），将大语言模型作为候选结构提议者，与序贯蒙特卡洛、基于模拟的推断和信息价值等贝叶斯工具耦合，以极少的干预实验数据发现潜在机制性世界模型，并在物理、化学和生物学三个基准上达到新的SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测干预性"如果"问题（即从未采取的行动的结果）需要机制性因果模型而非曲线拟合，而学习此类模型需要实验，因为被动数据无法识别机制。实验成本高昂，因此核心挑战是数据效率。

Method: MDA将大语言模型作为候选结构提议者，与贝叶斯工具结合：序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）用于参数和结构后验推断，基于模拟的推断（SBI）处理不可处理的似然，信息价值（VoI）用于实验设计。MDA在M-open设定下运行：当真实模型不在当前假设类中时，预测性检查会标记不足并促使提议者用新模型扩展假设空间。发现与设计相互强化：设计步骤识别发现步骤提出的机制，识别的机制改善预测，从而从剩余残差中发现更多内容。

Result: 在三个基准上——涵盖物理（DPbench）、化学（CHEMbench）和生物学（HHbench，新创建的偏观测单神经元电生理学基准）——MDA在数据高效模型学习和可靠的干预预测能力方面设置了新的SOTA。

Conclusion: 发现与设计相互强化：主动实验设计有助于识别LLM提议的机制，而识别出的机制又能提升预测能力，支持从残差中发现更多新机制，从而在极少干预实验中实现高效、可靠的机制性世界模型学习。

Abstract: Predicting the answer to interventional ``what if'' questions --- the outcome of an action never taken --- requires a \emph{mechanistic}, causal model, not a curve fit; and learning such a model requires \emph{experiments}, because passive data leaves its mechanisms unidentified. Experiments are expensive, so the central problem is \emph{data efficiency}. We present the Model Discovery Agent (MDA), which couples a large language model (LLM), used as a \emph{proposer} of candidate structures, with standard Bayesian machinery --- sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) for parameter and structure posteriors, simulation-based inference (SBI) for intractable likelihoods, and value-of-information (VoI) for experiment design --- to discover latent mechanistic world models from few interventions. MDA operates in the M-open setting: when the truth lies outside the current hypothesis class, a predictive check flags the inadequacy and the proposer expands the hypothesis space with a new model whose parameters are then identified by designed experiments. We show that \emph{discovery and design reinforce}: the design step identifies the mechanism the discovery step proposes, and the identified mechanism improves predictions, enabling further discoveries from the remaining unexplained residuals. On three different benchmarks --- covering physics (\DPbench, \citep{wiemann2026discoverphysics}), chemistry (\CHEMbench, \citep{kabra2026autoscilab}) and biology (\HHbench, a new partially observed single-neuron electrophysiology benchmark we create) --- we show that MDA sets a new SOTA in terms of data-efficient model learning and reliable interventional prediction ability.

</details>


### [337] [Open Evaluation Agent: Efficient and Promptable Evaluation of Visual Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09666v1)
*Shulin Tian,Ziqi Huang,Fan Zhang,Hongyuan Zhu,Yu Qiao,Ziwei Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Evaluation Agent框架，模拟人类快速形成印象的策略，通过动态多轮交互高效评估文本生成图像/视频模型，将评估时间降至传统方法的10%且保持可比结果；同时引入Open-EA（基于EA-CoT-10K语料训练的EA-3B本地规划模型），减少对专有后端的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉生成模型评估需要采样数百上千张图像或视频，计算成本高昂；且现有评估方法依赖僵化的流程管线，忽视具体用户需求，仅提供数值结果而缺乏清晰解释。

Method: 1) 构建Evaluation Agent框架：将自然语言评估请求分解为子方面，生成目标提示词，从被评估模型采样，调用合适的评估工具，基于观察证据迭代更新计划，覆盖预定义基准维度和开放用户关注点。2) 构建EA-CoT-10K语料（多轮评估回滚产生的历史条件逐步骤指令微调记录），训练EA-3B（基于Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct）作为本地规划骨干，保持结构化推理、工具调用和摘要协议。

Result: Evaluation Agent将评估时间降至传统方法的10%且结果相当；API-based agent在T2I/T2V基准和开放查询上验证有效；Open-EA在四个域内和三个域外T2V生成器家族上评估，显示学习策略具有部分跨家族迁移能力。

Conclusion: Evaluation Agent框架实现了高效、可提示、可解释且可扩展的视觉生成模型评估；同时验证了通过指令微调训练本地规划骨干的可行性，虽存在部分跨域迁移限制，但减少了专有后端依赖。

Abstract: Recent advances in visual generative models have enabled high-quality image and video generation, but evaluating these models often demands sampling hundreds or thousands of images or videos, which is computationally expensive. Existing evaluation methods also rely on rigid pipelines that overlook specific user needs and provide numerical results without clear explanations. Mimicking how humans quickly form impressions of a model's capabilities from only a few samples, we propose the Evaluation Agent framework, which employs human-like strategies for efficient, dynamic, multi-round evaluations, offering detailed, user-tailored analyses. Given a natural-language evaluation request, the agent decomposes it into sub-aspects, generates targeted prompts, samples images or videos from the evaluated model, invokes suitable evaluation tools, and iteratively updates its plan from the observed evidence, covering both predefined benchmark dimensions and open-ended user concerns. The framework is thus efficient, promptable, explainable, and scalable across models and tools. Experiments show that Evaluation Agent reduces evaluation time to 10% of traditional methods while delivering comparable results. We further introduce Open Evaluation Agent (Open-EA) by constructing EA-CoT-10K, a corpus of history-conditioned step-level instruction-tuning records derived from multi-round evaluation rollouts, and training EA-3B from Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct as a local planning backbone that preserves the structured reasoning, tool invocation, and summary protocol of the API-based agent while reducing dependence on proprietary backbones. Experiments validate the API-based agent on established T2I/T2V benchmarks and open-ended queries, and evaluate Open-EA on four in-domain and three out-of-domain T2V generator families, showing partial cross-family transfer of the learned policy.

</details>


### [338] [CoRCi: Cross-Reconstruction of Coherent Interests Modeling in Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09580v1)
*Qingtian Bian,Tieying Li,Marcus de Carvalho,Jiaxing Xu,Hui Fang,Yiping Ke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CoRCi，一个双目标跨域序列推荐框架。通过跨重构（Cross-Reconstruction）直接从预编码的特定领域表示生成混合域表示，并使用单一序列级域无关损失训练，配合FocalNCE损失来抑制域间差异，在四个真实数据集上显著优于现有SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CDSR方法将领域特定序列按时间顺序合并为混合域序列，但使用独立的编码器并通过逐领域损失聚合训练，这会放大跨域差异并破坏域不变兴趣的一致性，尤其在Seq2Seq的查询-目标对来自不同领域时问题更为突出。

Method: CoRCi包含两个核心模块：(1) Cross-Reconstruction：通过交叉注意力直接从预编码的特定领域表示生成混合域表示，避免了对混合域序列使用独立编码器；(2) FocalNCE：将Focal Loss嵌入到混合域InfoNCE目标中，对与查询同域的负样本赋予更高惩罚权重，从而强化域不变对齐。

Result: 在四个真实数据集上的大量实验表明，CoRCi在所有指标上持续优于现有最先进的CDSR方法，且取得了统计学上显著的性能提升。

Conclusion: 通过统一、域无关的序列级损失训练混合域表示，并利用FocalNCE抑制域间干扰，CoRCi有效解决了CDSR中域不变兴趣连贯性被破坏的问题，验证了跨重构和焦点损失设计的有效性。

Abstract: Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation (CDSR) aims to alleviate data sparsity by transferring dynamic user interests across related domains. A key challenge lies in effectively bridging these domains. In single-domain modeling, models cannot distinguish between domain-specific and domain-invariant interests. Recent methods merge domain-specific sequences chronologically into a mixed-domain sequence to capture domain-invariant knowledge. However, they typically deploy separate encoders for the mixed-domain sequence and train them with per-domain loss aggregation. This workflow magnifies inter-domain discrepancies and disrupts domain-invariant interest coherence, especially when query target pairs in Seq2Seq originate from different domains. In this paper, we present CoRCi (Cross-Reconstruction for Coherent Interest), a dual-target CDSR framework that tackles these drawbacks. Specifically, CoRCi proposes a Cross-Reconstruction approach that generates mixed-domain representations directly from pre-encoded specific-domain representations via cross-attention. The generated representations are then trained using a single, sequence-level, domain-agnostic loss to preserve the coherence of domain-invariant interests. To further suppress domain discrepancies in mixed-domain modeling, CoRCi introduces FocalNCE, which embeds Focal Loss into the preceding mixed-domain InfoNCE objective. The new loss assigns higher penalties to negatives drawn from the same domain as the query, thereby strengthening domain-invariant alignment. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets demonstrate that CoRCi consistently outperforms state-of-the-art CDSR counterparts, achieving statistically significant gains across all metrics.

</details>


### [339] [verdi: retrieval is not transfer for continual world model optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09537v1)
*Junyu Wu,Shiqin Nie,Youyi Kou,Baohua Yin,Guocai Yao,Qingyu Chen,Jingheng Ma,Shiji Zhou,Hongyong Song,Mingchen Zhuge,Sen Cui,Changshui Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VERDI提出了一种持续性的"证据许可"世界模型优化框架，核心观点是"检索不等于迁移"：一个模型上验证过的策略对另一模型仅是优化假设，需经目标侧实验验证后才成为可迁移知识。系统通过共享推理时探针构建优化指纹、检索相关经验作为排序假设、在冻结的目标侧验证器下验证后才纳入可重用证据，并通过邻近指纹矛盾触发探针进化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础世界模型在规划、模拟和具身智能方面取得显著进展，但面向用户指定目标优化预训练世界模型仍然困难：每次优化任务往往从头重新发现优化策略，已有知识很少迁移到下一个模型。现有研究智能体虽能自动化优化循环，但将成功策略视为可直接复用的食谱，缺乏对何时适合迁移的原则性保障。核心问题是"检索不等于迁移"——一个模型上验证过的策略对另一个模型至多只是优化假设。

Method: VERDI框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 通过共享推理时探针刻画每个世界模型，构建优化指纹（Optimization Fingerprint）；(2) 检索相关的先验经验，将其作为排序后的假设（ranked hypotheses）；(3) 在冻结的目标侧验证器（frozen target-side verifier）下验证每个候选假设，通过验证的才被接纳为可重用证据。此外，邻近指纹间的矛盾会触发探针进化，持续精炼诊断表征本身，形成闭环的持续性学习机制。

Result: 在Ctrl-World、Cosmos系列和RoboCoin上的实验表明：VERDI将搜索成本降低68%，GPU成本降低69%，负迁移从0.34降至0.06，并以83%的符号准确率预测迁移结果。

Conclusion: VERDI验证了"证据许可"原则的有效性：通过检索假设与目标侧实验验证的严格分离，实现跨世界模型的知识迁移，同时显著抑制负迁移，为持续世界模型优化提供了一个有原则、可扩展的框架。

Abstract: Foundation world models have made remarkable progress in planning, simulation, and embodied intelligence. However, optimizing a pretrained world model toward a user-specified objective remains difficult: each campaign typically rediscovers optimization strategies from scratch, and the resulting knowledge rarely transfers to the next model. Existing research agents automate the optimization loop but treat successful strategies as directly reusable recipes, without principled safeguards for when transfer is appropriate. We argue instead that retrieval is not transfer: a strategy validated on one model is at best an optimization hypothesis for another, and becomes transferable knowledge only after target-side experimental valida- tion. Guided by this principle, we propose VERDI , a continual framework for evidence-licensed world model optimization. VERDI characterizes each world model through shared inference-time probes to construct an Optimization Fin- gerprint, retrieves relevant prior experience as ranked hypotheses, and validates every candidate under a frozen target-side verifier before admitting it as reusable evidence; contradictions among nearby fingerprints further trigger probe evolution, continually refining the diagnostic representation itself. Experiments on Ctrl-World, the Cosmos family, and RoboCoin show that VERDI reduces search cost by 68%, GPU cost by 69%, and negative transfer from 0.34 to 0.06, while predicting transfer outcomes with 83% sign accuracy.

</details>


### [340] [Renormalising Generative Models for Active Inference: Foundations, Derivations, and Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09512v1)
*Karim Zaghw,Andrew Pashea,Marc Pritsch,Wouter Nuijten,Karl Friston,Lancelot Da Costa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对Renormalising Generative Models (RGMs)框架难以复现和适配的问题，提供了一份自包含、推导导向的完整理论阐述，并给出了开放、经过验证的实现，从而降低实践门槛，提升框架的透明性、可审计性和可复现性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动推理（active inference）为感知、学习和行动提供了统一框架，但将离散主动推理模型扩展到丰富的时空域仍很困难。RGMs通过跨时空尺度组合离散生成模型来应对这一挑战，但其数学论述过于紧凑，参考实现又深度嵌入特定软件环境，大量算法细节未明确说明，导致框架难以完全复现和适配。

Method: 本文通过三个方面解决问题：（1）提供自包含的、推导导向的RGM理论阐述，涵盖层级构建、层级内部信念与行动更新、层间信息传递机制；（2）提供开放且经过验证的实现，与理论对应；（3）在已发表方程与实现存在侧重差异时，明确说明这些选择及其对建模的后果，将理论与原始实现语境分离。

Result: 文章澄清了RGM的理论框架并使其脱离原始的特定实现环境，降低了入门的技术壁垒，使RGM更加透明、可审计和可复现，为后续在机器学习基准上进行定量评估和开发提供了基础。

Conclusion: 通过将RGM的理论阐述与实现语境解耦并补充开放实现，本文提升了该框架的可获取性和可验证性，为主动推理模型在丰富时空域中的更广泛应用铺平了道路。

Abstract: Active inference offers a unified framework for perception, learning, and action, but scaling discrete active-inference models to rich spatial and temporal domains remains difficult. Renormalising generative models (RGMs) address this challenge by composing discrete generative models across spatial and temporal scales, coarse-graining lower-level states and paths into higher-level causes for objects, events, and action. However, fully reproducing and adapting the framework remains difficult: the mathematical exposition is compact, and the reference implementations are deeply integrated within specialized software environments, leaving many algorithmic details implicit. This paper addresses these challenges by providing a self-contained, derivation-oriented account of RGMs together with an open, verified implementation. We explain how the hierarchy is built, how beliefs and actions are updated within it, and how information is passed between levels. Where the published equations and implementation differ in emphasis, we make those choices explicit and explain their modelling consequences. By clarifying the theory and separating it from its original implementation context, this work lowers practical barriers to entry and makes RGMs more transparent, auditable, and reproducible, providing a foundation for future quantitative evaluation and development on machine-learning benchmarks.

</details>


### [341] [Listen, See and Track: Spatio-Temporal Audio-Visual Sound Event Reasoning for Omni-Modal Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09435v1)
*Zhi Zeng,Cheng Zhang,Zesheng Yang,Rendong Pi,Jiaying Wu,Di Zhang,Zihan Ma,Guodong Li,Zhou Yang,Yu Xiang,Yifei Zheng,Minnan Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ST-OmniQA基准和ST-Omni-R1模型，用于时空音视频问答任务。ST-OmniQA包含40K全景视频与同步一阶Ambisonics音频，以及400K问答对，覆盖四层能力（声音事件识别、到达方向、声源距离、运动轨迹与时间对齐的音视频推理）。ST-Omni-R1集成FOA导出的语义与轨迹表示及全景视觉上下文，通过渐进式课程学习和推理树强化学习训练，在ST-OmniQA上达到77.83%的平均语义准确率（最佳基线仅37.28%），并在三个公共空间音频基准上展示出良好的迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频-语言模型通常将片段表示为全局声学事件，缺乏对动态声源时空属性的理解；视觉-语言模型则缺少空间音频线索，无法定位和追踪单个声源。作者旨在填补这一能力空白，推动更全面的时空音频视觉理解。

Method: 构建ST-OmniQA基准，基于全景视频与同步FOA（一阶Ambisonics）音频，包含40K视频和400K问答对，按四层能力梯度组织。提出ST-Omni-R1模型，融合FOA产生的语义表示与轨迹表示以及全景视觉上下文，采用渐进式课程学习（progressive curriculum learning）和推理树强化学习（reasoning-tree reinforcement learning）进行训练。

Result: ST-Omni-R1在ST-OmniQA四层能力上平均语义准确率达77.83%，远超最佳基线37.28%。在三个公共空间音频基准上的结果进一步表明其学到的空间与运动表示具有良好的跨数据集迁移能力。

Conclusion: 本文证明融合FOA空间音频表示与全景视觉上下文、配合课程式与强化学习训练，可有效提升动态声源在时空维度上的联合理解能力，且所学表示具有泛化性，为时空音视频问答提供了新的评测标准与模型方案。

Abstract: Understanding dynamic sound sources requires jointly determining what produces a sound, where the source is located, and how it moves over time. Yet existing audio-language models often represent clips as global acoustic events, while vision-language models lack the spatial audio cues needed to localize and track individual sources. To evaluate this missing capability, we introduce ST-OmniQA, a spatio-temporal audio-visual question-answering benchmark built from panoramic videos paired with synchronized first-order Ambisonics (FOA) audio of moving sound sources. It contains 40K videos and 400K question-answer pairs organized into four capability levels covering sound-event recognition, direction of arrival, source distance, motion trajectories, and temporally grounded audio-visual reasoning. Building on this benchmark, we propose ST-Omni-R1, which integrates FOA-derived semantic and trajectory representations with panoramic visual context and is trained through progressive curriculum learning and reasoning-tree reinforcement learning. ST-Omni-R1 achieves 77.83\% average semantic accuracy across the four levels, compared with 37.28\% for the best evaluated baseline. Results on three public spatial-audio benchmarks further indicate that its learned spatial and motion representations transfer beyond ST-OmniQA.

</details>


### [342] [CircuitReason-1k: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Visual-to-Symbolic Reasoning inElectrical Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09374v1)
*Xinqi Yang,Kang An,Tengyue Wang,Zhongyu Yang,Chenxu Du,Yuanchi Zhu,Hebao Zhu,Ziliang Wang,Faqiang Qian,Yunli Yang,Qibing Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了\benchmark，一个包含1,000道真实教材问题的基准测试，用于全面评估多模态大语言模型在电路分析中从视觉到符号的完整长时推理过程。最高性能系统达到84.8%准确率，但在长时推理问题上性能持续下降，暴露了拓扑绑定、物理约定和输出传播方面的系统性缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电路分析不仅需要识别图像中的元件，还需要接地符号与标签、恢复潜在拓扑、选择物理模型、构建耦合方程、传播中间量，并保持单位、符号、方向和相位约定。现有评估难以覆盖这一完整的视觉到符号的长时推理过程，缺乏针对性的基准测试。

Method: 构建了包含1,000道真实教科书问题的基准\benchmark{}，采用证据优先的构建流程对齐问题、图形和解答；使用面向推理的分类法按电路类型和依赖深度组织问题；评估结合保守的typed scoring与身份盲化的多模型语义共识，所有问题均保留在分母中。

Result: 在三个商业聊天系统和六个开源多模态LLM上，最高得分系统达到84.8%准确率。但长时推理问题上性能持续下降，定性分析揭示了拓扑到目标的绑定失败、物理约定问题以及晚期输出传播错误等持续性缺陷。

Conclusion: \benchmark{}为衡量多模态模型能否将技术性视觉证据转化为持续的、物理上有效的符号推理提供了一个聚焦的测试平台，揭示了当前模型在完整电路推理链条上的关键瓶颈。

Abstract: Electrical circuit analysis requires more than recognizing components in an image. A solver must ground symbols and labels, recover latent topology, select a physical model, formulate coupled equations, propagate intermediate quantities, and preserve units, signs, directions, and phase conventions. We introduce \benchmark, a benchmark of 1,000 authentic textbook problems for evaluating this complete long-horizon visual-to-symbolic reasoning process. Each problem pairs one or more circuit diagrams with a self-contained question, a typed or semantically specified answer, and a reference worked solution. An evidence-first construction pipeline aligns questions, figures, and solutions, while a reasoning-oriented taxonomy organizes problems by circuit type and dependency depth. Evaluation combines conservative typed scoring with identity-blinded multi-model semantic consensus, retaining every problem in the denominator. Across three commercial chatbot systems and six open-source multimodal large language models, the highest-scoring system reaches 84.8\% accuracy. However, performance consistently deteriorates on long-horizon problems, and qualitative analysis exposes persistent failures in topology-to-target binding, physical conventions, and late-stage output propagation. \benchmark{} provides a focused testbed for measuring whether multimodal models can transform technical visual evidence into sustained, physically valid symbolic reasoning. Code are available at GitHub - CircuitReason/CircuitReason1K.

</details>


### [343] [GeoPhysAdapter: Scale-Matched Geophysical Adaptation for Cross-Domain Landslide Mapping with Vision Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09325v1)
*Zhihang Liu,Mei-Po Kwan,Jinlin Wu,Hao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了GeoPhysAdapter，一种锚定在冻结视觉基础模型上的跨域滑坡制图方法，将地形、物质和降雨触发信息限制为像素级空间引导、区域调制和事件时序强制，在像素和候选滑坡体两个决策单元上施加有界适配。在事件隔离的PILD数据集上，将决策单元提升到候选体可将误差降低23.99%，约为像素级效果的3.1倍，IoU提升0.031（相对14.2%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新发生的滑坡很少带有即时标注，跨域迁移能力决定滑坡制图对应急响应和区域风险评估的价值。视觉基础模型虽增强了表征迁移，但在未见过的区域、事件和数据源上仍会产生高置信度误报。地形、物质和降雨触发信息可以约束这类误差，但它们的支撑范围分别为局部、区域和事件尺度，重采样到10m网格会与分割决策单元错位，并加剧不确定地理上下文问题（UGCoP）。

Method: GeoPhysAdapter锚定在冻结的视觉基础模型上，将地形、物质和触发信息分别限制为密集空间引导、区域调制和事件时序强制，并在两个决策单元（像素和候选滑坡体）上施加有界适配，在支撑不足时精确回退到视觉预测。采用体级决策单元来匹配粗粒度先验的支撑范围，而非与像素对齐。

Result: 在事件隔离的PILD数据集（4个公开数据源、55个全球滑坡事件、7890个测试样本）上，70.3%的跨域误阳性质量位于近纯虚假体中，中位等效直径207m，与粗粒度先验支撑匹配而非像素。像素级适配净移除507,817个错误像素并将误差降低7.76%；将决策单元提升到候选体后，在相同样本、锚点和基线下误差降低达23.99%，约为像素级效果的3.1倍，IoU提升0.031（相对14.2%），且每受害像素可纠正9.92个像素。

Conclusion: 将决策单元提升到候选滑坡体而非像素，能够更好地与地形、物质和降雨等物理先验的空间支撑尺度对齐，从而有效抑制跨域高置信度误报，显著提升滑坡制图在未见区域上的迁移性能。数据和代码已公开。

Abstract: Newly triggered landslides rarely carry immediate annotations, so cross-domain transferability determines the value of landslide mapping for emergency response and regional risk assessment. Vision foundation models have strengthened representational transfer, yet on unseen regions, events, and data sources they still generate high-confidence false alarms. Terrain, material, and rainfall triggering can constrain such errors, but their supports are local, regional, and event-scale, so that resampling onto a 10~m grid misaligns them with the segmentation decision unit and compounds the uncertain geographic context problem (UGCoP). We propose GeoPhysAdapter, which anchors on a frozen vision foundation model, restricts terrain, material, and triggering to dense spatial guidance, regional modulation, and event-timing forcing, and applies bounded adaptation at two decision units, the pixel and the candidate landslide body, reverting exactly to the visual prediction where support is insufficient. On an event-isolated PILD dataset of four public sources, 55 global landslide events, and 7,890 test samples, 70.3% of cross-domain false-positive mass lies in near-pure spurious bodies of median equivalent diameter 207m, matching coarse-prior support rather than the pixel. Pixel-level adaptation removes a net 507,817 erroneous pixels and reduces error by 7.76%, whereas raising the decision unit to the candidate body, under identical samples, anchor, and baseline, increases error reduction to 23.99%, approximately 3.1 times the pixel-level effect, improves IoU by 0.031 (14.2% relative), and corrects 9.92 pixels per pixel harmed. The data and code are publicly available at: https://github.com/Liu-Zhihang/geophysadapter.

</details>


### [344] [CADEngBench: It Looks Like CAD, but Does It Work? Evaluating Parametric Design, Assembly Reasoning, and Physics Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09296v1)
*Harmanjot Singh,Abhra Dubey,Jorge Alejandro Amador Herrera*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CADEngBench，一个包含两个轨道的CAD工程能力基准测试。CADEngBench-P评估300个参数化零件（600个任务），涵盖B-Rep有效性、DFM检查、参数族扰动、功能编辑和线性静态FEA；CADEngBench-A评估150对装配体，涵盖关节检索、面/边接地、关节坐标系预测和运动学验证。实验发现编辑CAD远易于生成，复杂编辑和FEA匹配仍困难，装配预测往往定位正确区域但无法恢复精确关节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的CAD模型评估往往只关注外观正确性，缺乏对工程级质量（设计需求满足、参数变化响应、可控编辑、结构响应匹配、有效关节连接）的系统性评估。

Method: 构建双轨道基准：CADEngBench-P（300个参数化零件，零到CAD任务+功能编辑任务，通过B-Rep有效性、工程与DFM检查、参数族扰动、功能编辑、CalculiX线性静态FEA评估）；CADEngBench-A（150对装配体，通过排序关节检索、精确面边接地、关节坐标系预测、运动学验证评估）。

Result: 在8个多模态、可编码模型上的实验表明：编辑提供的CAD比从头生成容易得多；复杂编辑和匹配FEA仍然困难；装配预测常定位到相关区域但无法恢复记录的关节或配合实体。

Conclusion: CAD评估必须测试工程行为而非仅仅外观，CADEngBench为这一需求提供了系统性基准。

Abstract: A CAD model is not engineering-grade merely because it looks correct. It must satisfy design requirements, respond predictably to parameter changes, support controlled edits, match a reference structural response under a declared analysis, and connect to other parts through valid joints. We present CADEngBench, a two-track benchmark for these capabilities. CADEngBench-P evaluates 300 parametric parts, each used for one zero-to-CAD task and one functional-editing task (600 tasks in total), through boundary-representation (B-Rep) validity, engineering and DFM checks, parameter-family perturbations, functional editing, and matched linear-static FEA in CalculiX. CADEngBench-A evaluates 150 body pairs through ranked joint retrieval, exact face-and-edge grounding, joint-frame prediction, and kinematic verification. Across eight multimodal, code-capable models, editing supplied CAD is substantially easier than generating it, while complex edits and matched FEA remain difficult. Assembly predictions often locate the relevant region but fail to recover the recorded joint or mating entities. These results show that CAD evaluation must test engineering behavior rather than appearance alone.

</details>


### [345] [ComboShoppingBench: Evaluating LLM Agents for Budget-Constrained Basket Shopping with Coupons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09282v1)
*Adrian Li,Kelong Mao,Yudong Guo,Heming Xia,Xinwei Yang,Lirui Luo,Jace Wong,Pu Yao,Sulong Xu,Simiu Gu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ComboShoppingBench，一个面向开放但可验证的“组合购物”任务的智能体基准，在模拟商业与外卖环境中评估LLM智能体构建互补商品篮子的能力。通过探索智能体生成可行的“见证篮子”来指导任务合成（包括优惠券、预算约束、用户查询和评分标准），评估阶段结合LLM裁判（语义满意度、响应质量、声明忠实度）与确定性校验（商品ID有效性、预算合规、优惠券最优性）。实验表明即使强大的LLM智能体在该基准上表现挣扎，凸显了可靠、约束感知组合购物的巨大改进空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实购物常需要构建互补商品组合（如设备套装、备餐、活动策划、团购外卖），而非检索单一商品。此类任务需要联合推理商品兼容性、库存、店铺要求、配送费、优惠券和预算等多重约束。现有评估方法存在痛点：精确匹配指标因多个篮子可满足同一需求而不适用；纯语义评估又无法检测不可行订单、无效优惠券组合或错误支付。因此需要一个兼具开放性与可验证性的组合购物智能体基准。

Method: 提出ComboShoppingBench：任务合成阶段，利用探索智能体在模拟商业和外卖环境中构建一个可行且语义连贯的可购买商品篮子（即“见证篮子”），以此为向导生成优惠券、预算约束、用户查询和对齐的评估细则；评估阶段采用双轨机制：LLM裁判负责评估语义满意度、响应质量和声明忠实度，确定性校验负责检查商品ID有效性、预算合规性和优惠券最优性。

Result: 对多种多样化LLM智能体进行实验，结果显示即使强模型在ComboShoppingBench上也表现欠佳，说明在可靠、约束感知的组合购物任务中仍有显著的改进空间。

Conclusion: ComboShoppingBench提供了首个兼具开放性与严格可验证性的组合购物基准，揭示了当前LLM智能体在联合处理多约束购物场景（商品兼容性、预算、优惠券最优性等）时的不足，为未来在约束感知的可靠购物智能体研究指明了方向。

Abstract: Real-world shopping often requires constructing a basket of complementary items rather than retrieving a single product. Such combo-shopping tasks arise in device setup, meal preparation, event planning, and group takeout ordering, requiring joint reasoning about item compatibility, availability, store-level requirements, delivery fees, coupons, and budgets. Evaluation is challenging because multiple baskets may satisfy the same request, making exact-match metrics unsuitable, whereas semantic evaluation alone cannot detect infeasible orders, invalid coupon combinations, or incorrect payments. We introduce ComboShoppingBench, an agentic shopping benchmark for open-ended yet verifiable basket construction in a simulated commerce and takeout environment. During task synthesis, an exploration agent constructs a feasible and semantically coherent basket of purchasable products; this witness guides the generation of coupons, budget constraints, user queries, and aligned evaluation rubrics. During evaluation, LLM judges assess semantic satisfaction, response quality, and claim faithfulness, while deterministic validation checks product-ID validity, budget compliance, and coupon optimality. Experiments with diverse LLM agents demonstrate that even strong agents struggle on ComboShoppingBench, highlighting substantial room for improvement in reliable, constraint-aware combo shopping.

</details>


### [346] [P$^{3}$: Joint Program-and-Proof Planning for Verified Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09277v1)
*Zenan Li,Ziran Yang,Peiyang Song,Zhaoyu Li,Kaiyu Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出P³，一种基于LLM的智能体工作流，通过先推导统一的程序-证明联合计划，再在此共享计划下细化实现与证明脚手架，来解决验证代码生成中程序与证明分离导致的低效问题。同时引入Lean4Commit0基准，在多个基准上P³相比强基线提升4.6-11.2个百分点的求解率，并降低约40%的API成本和37%的墙钟时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有验证代码生成的工作流将程序综合与证明验证解耦为顺序流水线，先生成程序再尝试证明其正确性。这种分离的做法在实际中既低效又无效：程序在生成时未考虑其证明需求，可能 subtly 不正确或结构上难以验证，导致LLM陷入反复修补代码与证明的脆弱循环。受Dijkstra关于程序与正确性论证应协同开发的理念启发，需要一种将两者联合规划的生成方法。

Method: 提出P³智能体工作流：首先从规范中推导统一的程序-证明联合计划（涵盖实现结构和验证策略），然后在此共享计划指导下分别细化实现代码和证明脚手架（proof scaffold）。同时构建Lean4Commit0基准，从真实软件仓库提取核心API并翻译其需求（包括跨API的关系规范）为Lean任务，用于在现实场景中评估验证代码生成。

Result: 在Verina、AlgoVeri和Lean4Commit0三个基准上，使用四种前沿LLM后端，P³在每个基准-模型组合下均取得最高求解率。相比更强的基线，P³在困难子集上提升4.6-11.2个百分点的求解率，降低每任务API成本最高约40%，减少墙钟时间最高约37%。消融实验显示，联合规划相比仅实现规划带来3.3-8.3个百分点的额外增益。

Conclusion: 程序与其正确性证明应联合规划而非顺序生成。P³通过程序-证明联合计划显著提升了验证代码生成的求解率、效率和成本效益，验证了Dijkstra理念在现代LLM智能体工作流中的有效性。Lean4Commit0作为库级基准，为验证代码生成研究提供了更接近真实软件工程场景的评估平台。

Abstract: Verified code generation asks a large language model (LLM) to generate both an executable program and a machine-checkable proof that the program meets a formal specification, promising software that is correct by construction. The de facto workflow decouples the two halves of the problem: first synthesize a program, then attempt to prove it correct. We observe that this sequential pipeline can be both ineffective and inefficient in practice. A program generated without anticipating its proof can be subtly incorrect or structurally difficult to verify, forcing the LLM into brittle repair loops that alternate between patching the code and patching the proof. Inspired by Dijkstra's view that a program and its correctness argument should be developed hand in hand, we propose $P^3$, an LLM-based agentic workflow that first derives a unified program-and-proof plan from the specification, then elaborates the implementation and proof scaffold under this shared plan. To evaluate verified code generation in realistic settings, we further introduce Lean4Commit0, a repository-derived, library-level benchmark built by extracting core APIs from real-world software repositories and translating their requirements, including relational specifications across APIs, into Lean tasks. Using four frontier LLM backends, we evaluate $P^3$ on Verina, AlgoVeri, and our Lean4Commit0 benchmark, where it achieves the highest solve rate in every benchmark--model setting. Compared with the stronger baseline, it improves solve rates by 4.6--11.2 percentage points and reduces per-task API cost by up to roughly 40\% and wall-clock time by up to roughly 37\% on the difficult subset of each benchmark. A targeted ablation further shows gains of 3.3--8.3 points over implementation-only planning, isolating the benefit of planning the program and proof jointly.

</details>


### [347] [SafeSceneReason: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark Connecting Industrial Hazards with Accident Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09230v1)
*Yuanchi Zhu,Kang An,Tengyue Wang,Zhongyu Yang,Chenxu Du,Xinqi Yang,Hebao Zhu,Bokai Zhao,Tianyu Liang,Ziliang Wang,Faqiang Qian,Yunli Yang,Weiyang Shi,Qibing Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SafeSceneReason，一个多模态工业安全推理基准及配套训练语料库，通过场景中心和报告中心两条数据构建流程，生成超过12万条经验证的问答对，覆盖感知、空间与定量推理、合规评估、证据合成、因果分析和缓解决策等多种推理任务，评估显示现有视觉语言模型在工业安全推理上仍存在显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业安全理解需要超越简单的目标检测和违规识别，模型还需评估合规性、识别危险交互、解释潜在事故机制并推荐预防措施。现有安全数据集主要聚焦视觉感知或孤立的违规识别，缺乏基于证据推理的有监督数据，无法支撑更深层的安全推理能力。

Method: SafeSceneReason结合两条互补的数据构建流程：(1)场景中心流程将标注的工作场所图像转化为可执行的安全场景图，通过程序执行对象、关系和安全规则生成确定性答案；(2)报告中心流程从事故报告中提取图形和上下文证据，利用证据图、显式信息边界、多步推理路径和迭代验证构建多模态问题。资源包含110,581条已验证的场景中心问答对和13,114条精炼的报告中心问答对。

Result: 对代表性专有和开源视觉语言模型的评估显示，模型间存在显著性能差异，且在比较性推理、技术性推理和多证据推理方面存在持续性弱点，表明强大的通用视觉理解能力尚不能保证可靠的工业安全推理。

Conclusion: SafeSceneReason揭示了现有视觉语言模型在工业安全推理上的不足，为该领域提供了兼具规模化与质量保障的基准数据资源，同时也指出通用视觉理解与领域专用安全推理之间存在明显鸿沟，需要进一步的研究与提升。

Abstract: Industrial-safety understanding requires more than detecting workers, equipment, and personal protective equipment. Models must also assess compliance, identify hazardous interactions, explain potential accident mechanisms, and recommend preventive actions. Existing safety datasets primarily focus on visual perception or isolated violation recognition and provide limited supervision for evidence-grounded reasoning. We introduce SafeSceneReason, a multimodal industrial-safety reasoning benchmark and companion training corpus that connects workplace scenes with knowledge from occupational accident investigations. SafeSceneReason combines two complementary data-construction pipelines. The scene-centric pipeline converts annotated workplace images into executable safety scene graphs and generates deterministic answers through program execution over objects, relations, and safety rules. The report-centric pipeline extracts figures and contextual evidence from accident reports and constructs multimodal questions using evidence graphs, explicit information boundaries, multi-step reasoning paths, and iterative verification. The resulting resource contains 110,581 verified scene-centric question--answer pairs and 13,114 refined report-centric question--answer pairs, covering perception, spatial and quantitative reasoning, compliance assessment, evidence synthesis, causal analysis, and mitigation-oriented decision making. Evaluation of representative proprietary and open-source vision--language models reveals substantial performance differences and persistent weaknesses in comparative, technical, and multi-evidence reasoning, demonstrating that strong general visual understanding does not yet guarantee reliable industrial-safety reasoning.

</details>


### [348] [CRUISE: Vision-Language Model-Guided Uncertainty-Aware Cross-Modal Sensor Fusion for Robust Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09202v1)
*Junyao Wang,Yulin Xu,Yu Li,Pramod Khargonekar,Mohammad Abdullah Al Faruque*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CRUISE，一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的不确定性量化跨模态传感器融合框架。CRUISE利用VLM生成细粒度的像素级不确定性估计，并引入动态自适应机制建模跨模态依赖关系，从而在复杂、分布外场景下提升多传感器融合的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有不确定性感知的多模态融合方法通常依赖简单的特征级不确定性估计，在复杂的分布外场景下泛化能力不足。自动驾驶中不同传感器的可靠性随驾驶条件（如恶劣天气、能见度低）变化显著，亟需更精细的不确定性量化以指导鲁棒的跨模态融合。

Method: CRUISE框架包含两个核心组件：(1) VLM引导的不确定性量化模块，利用视觉语言模型的先验知识和上下文推理能力生成像素级细粒度不确定性估计；(2) 动态自适应机制，显式建模并捕捉跨模态依赖关系，以充分利用多传感器输入的互补特性来指导融合过程。

Result: 论文摘要中未提供具体的实验数据或定量结果，但表明CRUISE通过VLM引导的细粒度不确定性量化和动态跨模态依赖建模，相较于现有简单特征级不确定性融合方法，在复杂分布外场景下预期具有更强的泛化能力。

Conclusion: CRUISE通过引入VLM先验知识生成像素级不确定性，并结合动态自适应融合机制，为复杂驾驶条件下的跨模态感知提供了一种更鲁棒、信息更丰富的融合方案，有效克服了传统不确定性感知方法的局限。

Abstract: Modern autonomous vehicles are equipped with multiple sensors, such as cameras, LiDAR, and radar, for comprehensive environmental perception. However, robust cross-modal feature fusion remains a critical challenge, as the reliability of each sensor varies significantly across diverse real-world driving conditions, including poor visibility and adverse weather. While uncertainty quantification (UQ) mitigates this issue by allowing models to prioritize reliable signals, existing uncertainty-aware fusion methods typically rely on simple feature-level uncertainty estimates and thus often fail to generalize effectively in complex, out-of-distribution scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose CRUISE, a novel uncertainty-aware cross-modal sensor fusion framework. CRUISE integrates a vision-language model (VLM)-guided UQ module that generates fine-grained, pixel-level uncertainty estimates. By leveraging the VLM's rich prior knowledge and superior contextual reasoning, our approach provides a highly informative guide for the fusion process. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic adaptive mechanism that explicitly models and captures cross-modal dependencies, ensuring the framework fully exploits the inherent complementary nature of multi-sensor inputs.

</details>


### [349] [MELLON - Multimodal Enhanced LLM for Online Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09121v1)
*Ruiyu Li,Haoyang Cai,Zhitong Guo,Tong Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文聚焦WebShop基准，提出三种多模态增强方法（MELLON、VQAgent和Multimodal Ranker）以提升Web导航智能体在文本与图像对齐、多模态推理和规划方面的能力，其中MELLON仅训练一个epoch即使任务完成准确率提升9.26%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Web导航基线要么是单模态的，要么在处理多模态输入时缺乏强大的推理能力。本文旨在通过探索文本与图像的对齐以及多模态推理与规划能力来提升Web导航智能体的性能。

Method: 提出三种多模态增强方法：(1) MELLON（Multimodal Enhanced LLM for Online Navigation），通过多模态增强LLM实现在线导航；(2) VQAgent，利用向量量化进行多模态融合；(3) Multimodal Ranker，通过多模态排序器增强决策。在WebShop真实世界网站模拟基准上进行评估。

Result: MELLON在任务完成准确率上取得显著提升，仅经过一个epoch的训练即实现了9.26%的准确率提升。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明有必要进一步探索多模态方法在Web导航智能体中的应用，尤其应关注更广泛的训练策略和更深入的对齐机制以提升智能体有效性。

Abstract: Web navigation agents are capable of addressing various types of tasks on different websites. Current baselines on web navigation are either unimodal or lack strong reasoning abilities given multimodal inputs. Focusing on the WebShop benchmark, a real-world website simulation, we explore the alignment of text and images, as well as multimodal reasoning and planning abilities, to enhance the performance of web navigation agents. We propose three innovative multimodal enhancements: Multimodal Enhanced LLM for Online Navigation (MELLON), VQAgent, and Multimodal Ranker. MELLON demonstrates a significant improvement in task completion accuracy, with a 9.26% increase after just one epoch of training. Our findings suggest the necessity of further exploration into multimodal approaches, with a focus on more extensive training and alignment strategies to enhance the effectiveness of web navigation agents.

</details>


### [350] [RAVEN-Eval: Rubric-Guided Automatic Evaluation for AI Video Generation Models Based on LMM Preference Judgement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09111v1)
*Ziheng Jia,Jiaying Qian,Zicheng Zhang,Xiaorong Zhu,Lancheng Gao,Xiongkuo Min*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RAVEN-Eval是一个基于LMM-as-a-judge范式的自动化视频生成模型评估框架，通过150个文本生成视频任务和100个图像生成视频任务，系统收集超过4500个AI生成视频，采用任务特定评分标准的成对比较方法，并引入锚点式模型插入方法降低新模型评估成本，最终建立了包含20个高性能AIVGMs和13个LMM评委的排行榜。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI视频生成技术快速发展并进入商业应用，最先进的AIVGMs之间质量差异越来越难以用传统评价标准（如视觉保真度和语义指令遵循）区分；同时人工评估需要更多专业知识和持续注意力，标注成本大幅增加。因此需要一种能够以最少人工干预可靠区分类似AIVGMs之间细微差异的自动化评估方法。

Method: RAVEN-Eval框架包括三个核心部分：(1) 自动化任务策展和质量过滤管道，策展了150个T2V任务和100个I2V任务，收集超过4,500个AI生成视频；(2) 基于评分标准的自动化LMM偏好判断，LMM评委会根据任务特定评分标准对视频进行成对比较；(3) 锚点式模型插入方法，通过在已有评估体系中插入锚点模型来降低纳入新模型的评估成本。

Result: 对20个高性能AIVGMs进行了全面评估，同时评测了13个LMM评委的判断能力，建立了RAVEN-Eval排行榜，验证了该框架在区分先进模型间细微质量差异方面的有效性。

Conclusion: RAVEN-Eval为快速演进的AIVGMs提供了一条可扩展的自动化、可信评估路径，在保证评估可靠性的同时大幅降低了对人工干预和标注成本的依赖。

Abstract: AI video generation has advanced rapidly and entered widespread commercial use. As a result, quality differences among videos produced by state-of-the-art AI video generation models~(AIVGMs) have become increasingly difficult to discern using conventional evaluation criteria, such as visual fidelity and semantic instruction following. Meanwhile, human evaluation now requires more expertise and sustained attention, substantially increasing annotation costs. This calls for automated evaluation that can reliably distinguish fine-grained differences among advanced AIVGMs with minimal human intervention. To address this challenge, we present RAVEN-Eval, a rubric-guided automated evaluation framework for AIVGMs, built primarily on the LMM-as-a-judge paradigm. Through an automatic task curation and quality-filtering pipeline, RAVEN-Eval curates 150 text-to-video~(T2V) tasks and 100 image-to-video~(I2V) tasks, and systematically collects more than 4,500 AIGVs. At its core, RAVEN-Eval adopts rubric-guided automated LMM preference judgement, in which LMM judges conduct pairwise comparisons according to task-specific rubrics. It further introduces an anchor-based model insertion approach to reduce the evaluation cost of incorporating new models. Finally, we evaluate 20 high-performance AIVGMs, as well as the judging capabilities of 13 LMM judges, and establish the RAVEN-Eval Leaderboards. Overall, RAVEN-Eval paves a scalable path for automatic and trustworthy evaluation of rapidly evolving AIVGMs.

</details>


### [351] [Depth-Aware Implicit Neural Representation Priors for 3D Gravity Inversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08959v1)
*León Suarez-Rodriguez,Paul Goyes-Peñafiel,Javier Torres-Quintero,Henry Arguello*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种无监督的深度感知隐式神经表示方法用于三维重力反演，将密度体表示为分配给重叠深度层的多个坐标神经网络，直接从观测重力数据通过灵敏度矩阵优化，无需标注密度模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典重力反演方法病态性强，依赖显式正则化和参数调优；监督深度学习方法需要难以获得的代表性重力-密度配对数据。因此需要一种既能缓解反演病态性、又不需要标注数据的方法。

Method: 将密度体积表示为分配给重叠深度层的多个坐标神经网络，利用灵敏度矩阵直接从观测重力数据优化；采用逐层傅里叶特征、基于物理的深度增益和计划正则化提供结构先验，无需标注密度模型。

Result: 在四个合成场景中，该方法在RMSE、PSNR和SSIM指标上优于常规和神经基线方法；能恢复更紧凑、空间连贯的密度体，改善邻近异常分离，保留内部结构并重建垂直延展。野外实验中生成了与观测重力模式一致的紧凑、分离且垂直连贯的异常。

Conclusion: 所提出的深度感知公式有助于缓解重力反演中固有的深度模糊性问题。

Abstract: Gravimetry images subsurface density contrasts associated with geological structures, geothermal systems, and intrusive bodies. Recovering a three-dimensional density model from gravity observations is highly ill-posed because of its non-uniqueness, limited data coverage, and the attenuation of the gravity field with depth. Classical inversion methods rely on explicit regularization and parameter tuning, whereas supervised deep-learning approaches require representative gravity--density pairs that are rarely available. This paper proposes an unsupervised depth-aware implicit neural representation for 3D gravity inversion. The density volume is represented by multiple coordinate-based neural networks assigned to overlapping depth slabs and optimized directly from the observed gravity measurements through the sensitivity matrix. Slab-specific Fourier features, physics-based depth gains, and scheduled regularization provide structural priors without requiring labeled density models. Experiments on four synthetic scenarios show that the proposed method provides better overall performance in terms of RMSE, PSNR, and SSIM than the evaluated conventional and neural baselines. It also recovers more compact and spatially coherent density bodies, improves the separation of nearby anomalies, preserves internal structures, and reconstructs their vertical extent better. These results indicate that the proposed depth-aware formulation helps to mitigate the depth ambiguity inherent in gravity inversion. In the field experiment, where no ground-truth density model was available, the method produced compact, separated, and vertically coherent anomalies consistent with the observed gravity pattern.

</details>


### [352] [LLM Reasoning for Subjective Tasks: Failure Modes, Mitigation, and Dynamic Reasoning Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08889v1)
*Juncheng Dong,Ding Tong,Ishan Gupta,Yuyan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过大规模实证研究发现，基于数学任务的显式推理与标准RLVR训练在主观性、人类中心的工业验证任务上会退化性能，并引发"推理崩塌"现象；作者提出条件长度惩罚的后训练算法加以缓解，并进一步发现推理轨迹的效能与其社会语言学框架（推理人格）密切相关，据此提出基于上下文对齐人格的架构蓝图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐系统的个性化使得"正确性"并非二值真值，而是主观人类偏好问题。LLM作为自主验证器面临上下文感知偏好对齐的独特挑战。现有的RLVR收益主要集中在客观数学任务上，尚不清楚显式推理能否泛化到主观、以人为中心的行业规范场景，本文正是为了回答这一问题并暴露其中的根本性脆弱点。

Method: 作者在来自生产推荐平台的四个真实验证任务上，对专有和开源的多个模型进行了大规模研究。首先评估标准RLVR在主观验证任务上的表现；然后提出一种条件长度惩罚（conditional length-penalized）的后训练算法，将验证准确性与有界推理长度交织；最后构建1500个综合人格（personas）进行消融实验，量化推理轨迹的效能与人称框架的耦合关系。

Result: (1) 严格基于数学的推理轨迹会主动降低验证性能；(2) 应用标准RLVR会引发"推理崩塌"（reasoning collapse）——策略放弃深思熟虑转而进行快速启发式猜测；(3) 提出的条件长度惩罚算法能阻止崩塌并恢复性能；(4) 仅改变推理人格即可使验证准确率波动近0.38 macro-F1，证明大量主观验证错误本质上是推理风格不匹配。

Conclusion: 本文提供了针对推理崩塌的可扩展算法补丁，同时提出了一个长期架构蓝图，即将推理路由到上下文对齐的人格上，用于对齐推理模型与现实世界的主观约束，为将RLVR从客观数学任务推广到主观人类中心任务提供了理论和实践指导。

Abstract: Recommendation systems thrive on personalization, where ''correctness'' is rarely a binary truth but a matter of subjective human preference. As Large Language Models (LLMs) are deployed as autonomous verifiers of safety and quality guidelines, they face a distinctive challenge: context-aware preference alignment. Recent gains in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) are indexed mostly on objective, mathematical tasks. Through a large-scale study spanning both proprietary and open-source models on four real-world verification tasks from a production recommender platform, we ask whether explicit reasoning generalizes to subjective, human-centric industry rubrics. We expose a fundamental vulnerability: rigid, math-centric reasoning traces actively degrade verification, and applying standard RLVR triggers a phenomenon we term reasoning collapse, in which the policy abandons deliberation in favor of rapid heuristic guessing. We introduce a conditional length-penalized post-training algorithm that intertwines verification accuracy with bounded reasoning length, halting collapse and recovering performance. Finally, we show that a reasoning trace's efficacy is tightly coupled with its socio-linguistic framing: across 1500 synthesized personas, verification accuracy swings by nearly 0.38 macro-F1 depending solely on the adopted reasoning persona---evidence that much subjective-verification error is really reasoning-style mismatch. This observation motivates a mid-training architecture that routes reasoning through contextually aligned personas. This work offers both a scalable algorithmic patch and a long-term architectural blueprint for aligning reasoning models with real-world subjective constraints.

</details>


### [353] [Improving Generalization Robustness of Multimodal RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08802v1)
*Pengfei Zhou,Zhiwei Tang,Xiaopeng Peng,Chenrui Zhou,Lama Moukheiber,Yixing Ma,Bin Xu,Jiajun Song,Zhenglin Wan,Wangbo Zhao,Jiasheng Tang,Bohan Zhuang,Fan Wang,Yang You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Prompt-Invariant RLVR (PIRL)方法，解决多模态大语言模型在RLVR训练中对提示词改写或模板变化过于敏感的问题，通过动态三值奖励和基于嵌入空间对抗的一致性正则化，使模型对语义等价的扰动提示保持稳定，在压力测试和动态评估中展现出显著的鲁棒性优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管RLVR能提升多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的准确性，但其增益是脆弱的——简单的句子改写或提示模板变化即可导致性能下降。这源于标准RL目标的两个缺陷：（1）二元验证器混淆了格式与内容，无法区分错误答案与格式错误；（2）训练分布仅覆盖真实世界提示的极窄切片，导致测试时面对未见过的提示策略表现不佳。在高风险场景（如医学视觉问答）中，这种脆弱性严重阻碍了可靠部署。

Method: PIRL方法包含两个关键组件：（1）动态三值奖励（dynamic trinary reward）：将格式与语义分离，使得奖励信号能明确区分格式错误与内容错误；（2）基于嵌入空间对抗的一致性正则化（consistency regularizer）：通过对语义等价的扰动提示施加策略不变性约束，迫使模型在语义相同但表述不同的输入下产生一致行为。这两个措施共同帮助策略覆盖更广泛的语义等价提示分布。

Result: 在压力测试下，PIRL在基准上的平均准确率仅下降≤1%，而GRPO下降约3%；在动态评估中，PIRL也取得了最小的性能下降幅度。

Conclusion: PIRL通过将格式与语义分离的奖励设计以及跨扰动提示的策略不变性约束，有效增强了RLVR训练后模型的提示鲁棒性。该方法在高风险应用场景中为多模态大语言模型的可靠部署提供了更稳健的解决方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) makes Multimodal Large Language Models more accurate, but the gains are brittle: simply paraphrasing a question or changing the prompt template can degrade them, which challenges reliable deployment in high-stakes scenarios like medical VQA. We trace this to two issues of the standard RL objective. First, the binary verifier conflates format with content, so the reward signal cannot tell a wrong answer apart from a misformatted one. Second, the training distribution covers only a thin slice of the real-world prompts that the model might meet at deployment, so policies that perform well on the training distribution can behave differently under unseen prompts during test. Both failures call for a robust post-training method that helps the policy cover a broader distribution of semantically equivalent prompts, and we identify two measures that help achieve this objective: separating format from semantics in the reward, and applying policy invariance across perturbed prompts with equivalent semantics. We therefore propose Prompt-Invariant RLVR (PIRL), consisting of a dynamic trinary reward and a consistency regularizer based on an embedding-space adversary. Under stress testing, PIRL's average accuracy on benchmarks drops by only $\le 1\%$, where GRPO drops ~3%. On dynamic evaluation, PIRL also achieves the smallest performance drop.

</details>


### [354] [Aero Realtime: Fully Aligned Input-Output Streams for Low-Latency Streaming Multimodal Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08469v1)
*Kaichen Zhang,Wei Huang,Keming Wu,Bo Li,Xiaojuan Qi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Aero Realtime，一个4B参数的流式多模态模型，采用双工架构实现实时生成。模型将视频、音频和文本输出对齐到共享时间网格（约80ms音频槽），每个槽预测词元或静默词元，使输入输出同步推进，通过单一自回归目标同时学习何时响应和生成什么。推理时仅追加最新多模态槽并复用KV缓存实现高效增量执行。在4张NVIDIA A6000显卡上，20分钟连续视频流处理延迟中位数84ms、P95为173ms，保持在源时间线200ms以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流式多模态模型虽增量处理观测，但仍遵循基于轮次的prefill-then-decode模式，无法在活跃生成流中自然接入新观测（非双工）。主动式替代方案采用微轮询或外部响应门控，导致连续交互碎片化，响应时序与语言生成解耦，且不利于KV缓存友好的服务部署。作者旨在解决这些问题，实现真正的双工、主动式且硬件对齐的多模态交互。

Method: 提出双工架构：将视频、音频和文本输出对齐在共享时间网格上，每个约80ms音频槽预测词元或沉默词元，使输入输出同步推进；使用单一自回归目标同时学习响应时序与内容生成；推理时仅追加最新多模态槽、延续先前输出状态并复用KV缓存实现高效增量执行；提供完整训练与服务方案，包括实时QA构建、槽对齐监督、硬件感知分布式训练和可恢复推理。

Result: 在4张NVIDIA A6000工作站GPU上，Aero Realtime对20分钟连续流式视频保持84ms中位数和173ms P95处理延迟，始终保持在源时间线200ms以内，证明了完全对齐的输入输出建模在双工、主动式、硬件对齐多模态交互中的可行性。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了输入输出完全对齐建模的可行性，为双工、主动式和硬件对齐的多模态实时交互奠定了基础。Aero Realtime通过共享时间网格和对齐监督有效解决了非双工架构的根本限制，为流式多模态交互提供了更自然的范式。

Abstract: Existing streaming multimodal models process observations incrementally but still follow a turn-based prefill-then-decode pattern, making them non-duplex: new observations cannot naturally enter an active generation stream. Proactive alternatives use micro-turn polling or external response gates, which fragment continuous interaction, decouple response timing from language generation, and complicate KV-cache-friendly serving. We introduce Aero Realtime, a 4B streaming multimodal model with a duplex architecture for realtime generation. Aero Realtime aligns video, audio, and textual output on a shared temporal grid, where each approximately 80-ms audio slot predicts either a lexical token or a silence token. This allows input and output to advance together, enabling one autoregressive objective to learn both when to respond and what to generate. During inference, Aero Realtime appends only the newest multimodal slot, carries forward the previous output state, and reuses the KV cache for efficient incremental execution. We further provide a complete training and serving recipe, including realtime QA construction, slot-aligned supervision, hardware-aware distributed training, and resumable inference. On four NVIDIA A6000 workstation GPUs, Aero Realtime maintains 84-ms median and 173-ms P95 processing lag over 20 minutes of a continuously streamed video, remaining within 200~ms of the source timeline. These results demonstrate the feasibility of fully aligned input-output modeling for duplex, proactive, and hardware-aligned multimodal interaction.

</details>


### [355] [CAP: A Scalable Benchmark for Evaluating Cross-Site Browser Agents with Complex Actions and Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08392v1)
*Zejun Xu,Taiyi Chen,Jin Li,Yongtong Gu,Qi Cheng,Aixuan Lv,Shuai Zhu,Pengfei Zhu,Kaichen Yang,Boyu Sun,Yixian Yang,Mulong Xie,Xin Liu,Dagang Li,Xiaoteng Ma,Hongru Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了CAP基准，一个用于评估浏览器智能体的跨网站、类人网页任务基准，强调复杂的UI交互和视觉感知，在108个真实网站、24个领域的420个任务上进行评测，发现当前最先进的浏览器智能体在感知密集型交互上表现不佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有浏览器智能体基准主要评估端到端任务成功率，但忽略了真实网页浏览中的两个根本性难点：富用户界面上的复杂操作，以及动态渲染内容的视觉感知，尤其是跨多个网站的工作流场景。

Method: 提出分解-重组（decomposition-and-recomposition）流水线：首先将每个网站抽象为结构化站点卡片，捕获面向用户的功能、复杂执行操作和感知需求，然后将这些组件重组为现实的跨网站工作流。每个任务基于每个网站上的多个具体操作进行接地，支持细粒度诊断。

Result: 构建了涵盖108个真实网站、24个领域、420个任务的基准，通过可验证的agent-as-a-judge评估框架对最先进的浏览器智能体进行评测，结果显示成功率较低，且感知密集型交互是主要瓶颈。

Conclusion: 当前浏览器智能体与真实网页浏览需求之间仍存在显著差距，特别是在视觉感知方面，揭示了对感知密集型交互能力改进的迫切需求。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents that interact with the web through browsers. While recent progress has been driven by benchmarks that evaluate end-to-end task success, these evaluations largely overlook two fundamental sources of difficulty in real web browsing: complex actions over rich user interfaces and visual perception of dynamically rendered content, especially in workflows that span multiple websites. We introduce CAP, a scalable benchmark for evaluating browser agents on cross-site, human-like web tasks that require non-trivial UI interactions and visual understanding. Specifically, we adopt a decomposition-and-recomposition pipeline that first abstracts each website into a structured site card capturing user-facing functions, complex execution operations, and perceptual requirements, and then recomposes these components into realistic cross-site workflows. Each task is therefore grounded in multiple specific operations on each website, enabling fine-grained diagnosis. Built on this framework, we construct 420 tasks across 108 real-world websites and 24 domains under careful quality control. Experiments on state-of-the-art browser agents using our verifiable agent-as-a-judge evaluation framework show low success rates and reveal that perception-heavy interactions remain a major bottleneck, exposing substantial gaps between current agents and real-world web browsing demands.

</details>


### [356] [A Unified Framework for Dynamic Reward Shaping in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08158v1)
*Fouad Bahrpeyma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的解析框架，用于比较动态奖励塑形（dynamic reward shaping）及其邻近的自适应奖励机制，涵盖参数修正与状态依赖变化、加性塑形与奖励替换的区别，并从时间、信息和理论三个维度对十二种方法族进行系统分析，探讨深度强化学习管线中最优性保证的存续条件以及自适应速率与学习器稳定性之间尚未解决的矛盾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典的基于势函数的奖励塑形理论只保证固定塑形信号的最优性，但当代强化学习系统中学习器和引导信息（如价值估计、新颖性、反馈、预测模型）都会在训练过程中动态演化。自适应奖励机制已广泛存在于探索、贝叶斯推断、人在回路学习、自动奖励设计及基于基础模型的方法中，然而缺乏一个统一框架来分析这些动态奖励机制的性质和理论保证。

Method: 本研究构建了统一的解析框架，从三个层面进行区分和归类：（1）区分参数修正与状态依赖变化；（2）区分加性塑形、奖励替换与奖励相邻引导；（3）沿时间、信息和理论三个维度组织已有方法。基于该框架对十二个方法族进行比较分析，特别考察最优性保证在现代深度强化学习管线（回放缓冲区、自举评论家、奖励归一化）中的生存条件。

Result: 该框架成功将十二种方法族进行结构化比较分析，揭示了在当代深度强化学习管线（回放缓冲区、自举评论家、奖励归一化）下最优性保证得以存续的具体条件，同时识别出自适应速率与学习器稳定性之间尚未解决的耦合关系。

Conclusion: 自适应奖励机制需要一个统一的分析框架来支撑系统化研究。本文框架不仅厘清了动态奖励塑形与其他自适应奖励机制的边界，还为实践中判断最优性保证是否适用于现代深度强化学习设置提供了判据，并明确了自适应速率与学习器稳定性这一关键开放问题。

Abstract: Sparse, delayed, and weakly informative rewards remain central obstacles to efficient reinforcement learning. Reward shaping addresses these limitations by supplementing the task reward with an auxiliary signal that can accelerate learning while, in the classical setting, the original objective remains the evaluation criterion. Established theory guarantees safety for fixed shaping signals: potential-based reward shaping preserves optimal policies when the auxiliary term is the discounted difference of a time-invariant potential. In contemporary reinforcement learning systems, however, both the learner and the information available for guidance evolve during training: value estimates improve, novelty diminishes, feedback shifts, and predictive models are refined. Adaptive reward mechanisms occur across exploration, Bayesian inference, human-in-the-loop learning, automated reward design, and foundation-model-based approaches. This study introduces a unified analytical framework for comparing dynamic reward shaping and neighbouring adaptive reward mechanisms. The proposed framework distinguishes parametric revision from state-dependent variation, separates additive shaping from reward replacement and reward-adjacent guidance, and organises existing methods along temporal, informational, and theoretical dimensions. Using this framework, twelve method families are comparatively analysed. The framework further highlights the conditions under which optimality guarantees survive contemporary deep reinforcement learning pipelines, replay buffers, bootstrapped critics, and reward normalisation, while exposing the unresolved relationship between adaptation rate and learner stability.

</details>


### [357] [Explore, Map, Remember, Decide: Are Embodied VLMs Ready for Safety-Critical Scenarios?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08077v1)
*Gabriele La Malfa,Nitay Alon,Emanuele La Malfa,Reuth Mirsky,Stefan Sarkadi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个名为EMRD（探索、地图构建、记忆与决策）的安全关键型、目标驱动的评估框架，用以系统性评估好奇心驱动的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在部分可观测条件下的空间理解能力。研究发现VLMs在决策时过度依赖预训练文本先验而缺乏空间依据，空间推理在低光条件下退化但不受纹理和颜色干扰影响，且其记忆机制与人类认知模式存在根本性分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI技术越来越多地应用于安全关键场景，需要理解VLMs是否具备稳健的空间记忆并做出可靠决策。现有研究缺乏对VLMs空间理解能力在部分可观测性条件下的系统性评估，尤其是其决策依据是否为物理证据而非视觉-语言偏差、其记忆过程是否与人类认知模式一致，以及其对环境危险如何响应等方面尚属空白。

Method: 论文在原有ToS框架基础上扩展为安全关键、目标驱动的流水线EMRD（Explore, Map, Remember, and Decide）。具体方法包括：1）通过环境覆盖率与时间效率指标量化探索能力（Explore）；2）评估空间保真度（Map）；3）使用一系列心理学指标评估记忆持久性（Remember）；4）利用焦点指标衡量认知决策（Decide）。

Result: 实验结果显示：在决策能力方面，VLMs频繁基于预训练文本先验选择疏散点，但缺乏支撑其选择的空间依据；空间推理在低光照条件下显著退化，但不受纹理和颜色篡改的影响。总体表明VLM的空间推理与决策存在明显缺陷。

Conclusion: VLM的记忆机制与人类认知存在根本性分歧，这会产生不可预测的对齐风险（misalignment risks），意味着以当前VLM为基础的安全关键应用需要警惕其空间认知能力与人类期望之间的偏差。

Abstract: Theory of Space framework (ToS) assesses the spatial understanding of curiosity-driven Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under partial observability. As AI techniques are increasingly applied to safety-critical scenarios, it is crucial to understand whether VLMs possess robust spatial memory and make reliable decisions. In this paper, we assess whether VLMs' decisions are based on physical evidence or are corrupted by visual-language biases, if their memory processes align with human cognitive patterns, and how they respond to environmental hazards. We extend the ToS framework into a safety-critical, goal-driven pipeline, named Explore, Map, Remember, and Decide (EMRD). We then quantify Exploration Competence (Explore) through metrics of environmental coverage and temporal efficiency, assess Spatial Fidelity (Map), evaluate, with a suite of psychological metrics, Memory Persistence (Remember), and measure, using focal-point metrics, Cognitive Decision-Making (Decide). Our results show that in terms of decision-making capabilities, VLMs frequently select evacuation points based on pre-trained textual priors while lacking the spatial grounding to justify their choices. We also show that spatial reasoning degrades in low-light conditions, but it is not affected by texture and colour tampering. Our findings suggest that VLM memory fundamentally diverges from human cognition, creating unpredictable risks of misalignment.

</details>


### [358] [Self-Evolving Neuro-Symbolic Skills for Tool-Augmented Spatial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07955v1)
*Shi-Yu Tian,Zhuo-Xia Wang,Xuan-Yi Zhu,Zhi Zhou,Xinwei Yang,Kun-Yang Yu,Ming Yang,Yang Chen,Yu-Feng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出NeSy-Spatial,一个神经符号框架,通过将工具交互和几何操作抽象为类型化可执行原子指令,组合成Tool-Use Skills和Geometry Skills两类技能,并在推理时闭环检索执行、在演化时分析成功/失败轨迹来精炼技能结构,从而在细粒度空间推理任务上实现自我演化的空间技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在细粒度空间任务上不可靠,现有工具增强方法要么从零规划工具调用缺乏显式依赖约束,要么依赖固定流程导致冗余且泛化差。需要一种能够积累可复用经验并自适应组合的推理机制。

Method: NeSy-Spatial将工具交互和几何操作抽象为类型化可执行原子指令,组合成两类互补技能:Tool-Use Skills(组织工具执行)和Geometry Skills(结构化几何推理)。推理阶段通过闭环过程检索并执行相关技能;演化阶段分析缓存的成功与失败轨迹以精炼技能结构并剪除不可靠或不活跃条目。

Result: 在三个空间推理基准上的实验表明,NeSy-Spatial一致性地提升了推理准确率,并实现了更精确的工具利用。

Conclusion: 通过神经符号结合、技能抽象与自我演化机制,NeSy-Spatial能够有效增强大模型在细粒度空间推理任务上的可靠性与工具调用精度。

Abstract: Large vision-language models have achieved strong performance in multimodal reasoning, but they remain unreliable on fine-grained spatial tasks that demand both precise spatial perception and fine-grained geometric computation beyond end-to-end generation. Tool augmentation offers a natural solution, while existing methods either plan tool calls from scratch without explicit dependency constraints or rely on fixed pipelines that are redundant and generalize poorly across spatial tasks. An effective spatial reasoning agent should instead accumulate reusable experience and adaptively compose it for new problems. To this end, we propose NeSy-Spatial, a neuro-symbolic framework for self-evolving spatial skills. NeSy-Spatial abstracts tool interactions and geometric operations into typed executable atomic instructions and composes them into two complementary skill types: Tool-Use Skills for organizing tool execution and Geometry Skills for structured geometric reasoning. During inference, NeSy-Spatial retrieves and executes relevant skills in a closed-loop process. During evolution, it analyzes buffered successful and failed trajectories to refine skill structures and prune unreliable or inactive entries. Experiments on three spatial reasoning benchmarks show that NeSy-Spatial consistently improves reasoning accuracy with more precise tool utilization.

</details>


### [359] [TongGuOCR: A Layout-Aware and Token-Augmented OCR MLLM for Chinese Historical Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07917v2)
*Zhongheng Zhou,Yi Sun,Huiguo He,Yuyi Zhang,Peirong Zhang,Yulin Fang,Dezhi Peng,Minghui Liao,Lianwen Jin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TongGuOCR，一种面向中文历史文献的布局感知与令牌增强多模态大语言模型（MLLM），通过布局感知预处理模块构建局部连贯识别块，以及令牌增强识别模块（字符级词汇扩充+行间空间位移令牌）分别处理复杂布局和阅读顺序问题，在两个中文历史文献OCR基准上超越传统任务专用OCR模型、通用MLLM和OCR专用MLLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中文历史文献承载着宝贵的文化遗产，但大量馆藏仅以扫描图像形式存在，阻碍了全文检索、校勘和计算分析。OCR可填补这一缺口，但历史文献的复杂版面、罕见字符和非平凡阅读顺序使得准确转录极具挑战性。

Method: TongGuOCR包含两大核心模块：(1) 布局感知预处理模块（Layout-Aware Preprocessing）——构建并细化局部连贯的识别块，以保留局部上下文同时减少跨区域干扰；(2) 令牌增强识别模块（Token-Augmented Recognition）——在字符层面扩充词汇表使罕见字形获得直接的一对一令牌表示并缩短解码路径，在行间层面建模行到行的转换，注入离散的空间位移令牌引导解码器沿复杂阅读路径行进，无需精确坐标。

Result: 在两个中文历史文献OCR基准上的实验表明，TongGuOCR优于代表性传统任务专用OCR模型、通用MLLM及OCR专用MLLM。在更具挑战性的M5HisDoc基准上，TongGuOCR达到93.76的AR，并将NED从10.43降至6.15、RO-ED从7.53降至3.49（相较于各项指标的最佳竞争模型）。

Conclusion: TongGuOCR通过布局感知与令牌增强的结合，有效解决了中文历史文献OCR中复杂版面与阅读顺序的难题，展现了MLLM在此类任务上的潜力。作者提供了在线demo供进一步验证与使用。

Abstract: Chinese historical documents preserve valuable cultural heritage, but many collections remain accessible only as scanned page images, preventing full-text retrieval, collation, and computational analysis. Optical character recognition (OCR) can bridge this gap, but accurate transcription remains challenging because historical documents often contain complex layouts, rare characters, and nontrivial reading orders. We propose TongGuOCR, a layout-aware and token-augmented multimodal large language model (MLLM) for OCR of Chinese historical documents. First, a Layout-Aware Preprocessing module constructs and refines locally coherent recognition blocks to preserve local context while reducing interference across regions. Second, a Token-Augmented Recognition module augments the transcription target at two complementary levels: character-level vocabulary expansion gives each rare glyph a direct one-token representation and shortens its decoding path, while line-to-line transition modeling injects discrete spatial displacement tokens that guide the decoder along complex reading paths without requiring precise coordinates. Experiments on two Chinese historical document OCR benchmarks show that TongGuOCR outperforms representative traditional task-specific OCR models, general-purpose MLLMs, and OCR-oriented MLLMs. On the more challenging M5HisDoc benchmark, TongGuOCR achieves 93.76 AR and reduces NED from 10.43 to 6.15 and RO-ED from 7.53 to 3.49 relative to the best competing score for each metric. An online demo is available at https://jzzh2004.github.io/TongGuOCR.

</details>


### [360] [SurgLAT: Surgical Latent Attention Tracking for Depth-Aware Robotic Laparoscope Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07876v1)
*Rulin Zhou,Qiujie Song,Yujie Ma,An Wang,Wanhao Liu,Guoheng Ma,Yidu Wang,Guankun Wang,Xingrong Diao,Jiankun Wang,Chaowei Zhu,Xianming Liu,Hongliang Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SurgLAT，一个用于自主腹腔镜摄像机控制的因果在线框架，通过冻结的DINOv3编码器与状态条件空间令牌混合器提取手术证据，结合选择性因果潜在记忆模块建模短期运动连续性与长期手术意图演化，并将学习的潜在手术注意状态解码为概率注意热图与手术区域，同时引入基于虚拟轴公式的RCM约束机器人控制框架及冗余感知零空间初始化，在真实手术视频与物理机器人平台上的实验结果验证了其在遮挡、快速运动和靶区转换场景下的稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主腹腔镜摄像机控制需要对动态手术场景中外科医生的手术意图进行持续理解，而目标手术区域并非稳定物理对象，而是潜在且随时间演化的注意状态。该问题的难点在于注意状态是隐性的、时变的，缺乏显式监督信号，且需要兼顾感知与机器人控制的闭环部署。

Method: SurgLAT采用冻结DINOv3编码器提取视觉特征，通过状态条件空间令牌混合器在记忆引导的空间先验下聚合手术证据；选择性因果潜在记忆模块通过动态检索当前、近期和历史的潜在状态，同时建模短期运动连续性与长期意图演化；学习到的潜在手术注意状态被解码为概率注意热图及手术区域。机器人层面采用基于虚拟轴的RCM约束控制与冗余感知零空间初始化实现稳定平滑的运动。

Result: 在真实腹腔镜手术视频和物理机器人腹腔镜平台上验证了完整系统，实验结果表明在遮挡、快速运动和靶区转换等挑战场景下，系统能够实现稳健的在线手术区域跟踪和稳定的自主内窥镜调整。

Conclusion: 潜在手术意图建模对手术自主性具有显著有效性，SurgLAT通过因果在线框架将潜在注意状态学习与机器人控制相结合，为解决手术场景下的自主视觉引导提供了可行的技术路径。

Abstract: Autonomous laparoscopic camera control requires continuous understanding of the surgeon's operative intent in dynamic surgical scenes, where the target operative region is not a stable physical object but a latent and temporally evolving attention state. In this work, we present Surgical Latent Attention Tracking (SurgLAT), a causal online framework for latent surgical attention modeling and autonomous laparoscopic view control. SurgLAT uses a frozen DINOv3 encoder and a state-conditioned spatial token mixer to extract operative evidence under a memory-guided spatial prior, while a selective causal latent memory module jointly models short-term motion continuity and long-horizon surgical intent evolution through dynamic retrieval of current, recent, and historical latent states. The learned latent surgical attention state is decoded into a probabilistic attention heatmap and operative region for downstream endoscope guidance. Beyond perception, we further introduce a robotic deployment framework with explicit laparoscopic Remote Center of Motion (RCM) constrained control based on virtual-axis formulation, together with redundancy-aware null-space initialization for stable and smooth manipulator motion. We validate the full system on real laparoscopic surgical videos and a physical robotic laparoscope platform. Experimental results demonstrate robust online operative-region tracking and stable autonomous endoscopy adjustment under occlusion, rapid motion, and target transitions, highlighting the effectiveness of latent surgical intent modeling for surgical autonomy.

</details>


### [361] [CausalNav: Reliability-Certified Causal World Models for Control under Physical-Parameter Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07809v1)
*Yiyao Zhang,Diksha Goel,Hussain Ahmad,Shixun Huang,Jun Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CausalNav，一个基于有符号、动作条件化转移图的控制器，通过预测可靠性证书、策略裕度门和argmax一致性门来决定是否采纳模型建议，否则回退到基础控制器。在200次运行中取得最佳平均排名（1.25/10），但关键发现是模型结构保真度与下游控制收益无关，真正提升安全性的是"认证弃权"机制而非更好的预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型要有用就必须真正改变智能体的行为，要安全就必须在自己出错时拒绝改变行为。然而现有模型常忽略这两个硬币的另一面——模型预测准确不等于控制效用高，模型需要具备"知道自己何时不可靠"的能力。

Method: CausalNav围绕一个有符号、动作条件化的转移图构建控制器。部署时模拟少量干预序列，将目标误差转化为策略logit建议，并通过三重门控：尺度无关的预测可靠性证书、策略裕度门、argmax一致性门。全部通过才采纳建议，否则精确回退到自身的模型基控制器。

Result: 在CartPole-v1和离散化Pendulum-v1上（含物理参数偏移），与9个基线（transformer、recurrent、split-latent、graph、causal-induction及三种近期模型推理模块）对比，CausalNav平均排名1.25/10最优。关键诊断：图结构恢复远超随机水平（CartPole F1=0.59±0.09），但结构保真度与控制收益无相关（r=-0.15, p=0.67）；在10/10 Pendulum种子上证书选择弃权，强制 planner 会损失回报。

Conclusion: 模型预测保真度并不能预测下游控制效用；使世界模型安全可部署的关键不是更好的预测，而是经认证的弃权（certified abstention）机制。世界模型的价值与安全应通过其对行为的影响来评判，而非预测精度本身。

Abstract: A world model is only useful for physical AI if it changes what the agent does, and only safe if it declines to do so when it is wrong. We study both halves of that requirement with CausalNav, a controller built around a signed, action-conditioned transition graph over identified state coordinates. At deployment CausalNav simulates a small library of intervention sequences, converts their objective error into policy-logit advice, and admits that advice only when a scale-free predictive-reliability certificate, a policy-margin gate, and an argmax-agreement gate all pass; otherwise it falls back exactly to its own model-based base controller. We evaluate against nine controlled baselines (transformer, recurrent, split-latent, graph, causal-induction, and three recent model-based reasoning modules) on CartPole-v1 and discretized Pendulum-v1 with physical-parameter shifts, under one shared PPO trainer, one interaction budget, and ten held-out seeds (200 runs). CausalNav attains the best average rank (1.25 of ten). The diagnostic result is more informative than the ranking: the learned graph recovers structure well above chance (CartPole F1 = 0.59 +/- 0.09), yet per-seed structural fidelity is uncorrelated with per-seed control benefit (r = -0.15, p = 0.67), and the certificate abstains on 10/10 Pendulum seeds, where forcing the planner on costs return. Model fidelity did not predict downstream control utility in our setting; certified abstention, not better prediction, is what made the world model safe to deploy.

</details>


### [362] [ResidencyRL: Reinforcement Learning in Simulated Clinical Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07418v1)
*Valentin Liévin,Samuel Schmidgall,Tim Strother,Alex Bijamov,Akshay Goel,Anil Palepu,Chunjong Park,Vahid Balazadeh,Min Woo Sun,Marius Guerard,Justin Chen,Dave Steiner,Vikram Dhillon,Ibrahim Azar,Akhil Mehta,Nicholas Spetsieris,Shilpan Shah,Maen Abdelrahim,Amit Dahiya,Yun Liu,Katherine Chou,Yossi Matias,Avinatan Hassidim,Dale R. Webster,Quoc V. Le,Raia Hadsell,Joelle Barral,Carey Radebaugh,Aleksandra Faust,Shekoofeh Azizi,Mike Schaekermann,Po-Hsuan Cameron Chen,Tao Tu,David Racz,Lin Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ResidencyRL，一种通过模拟多轮临床对话（最多60轮对话和8次工具调用）来训练临床AI智能体的强化学习方法。该方法让策略智能体与能展现复杂对抗行为的LLM模拟器配对训练，并基于诊断准确性、管理质量、沟通、文档和安全的结构化奖励进行优化。在对抗条件下诊断准确率提升7.0%（88.0% vs 81.0%），漏诊红旗症状率降低31%，盲法专家临床医生在87.6%的对比中偏好训练后的智能体。该智能体在AMIE多访视基准的六个临床轴上都优于基础模型，并在AgentClinic和CRAFT-MD上表现出一致的方向性改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在静态医学基准上表现出色，但优化完整临床决策序列的方法仍不成熟。临床推理大量依赖于医患对话——一种在多轮互动中获取病史、细化诊断假设并在不确定性下做出管理决策的对话过程。因此需要开发能够优化整个临床决策序列的训练方法。

Method: ResidencyRL采用强化学习框架，将策略智能体与能够展现复杂、对抗性行为的LLM模拟器配对，在模拟的多轮临床对话（每条轨迹最多60轮对话和8次工具调用）中进行训练。训练基于与诊断准确性、管理质量、沟通、文档和安全对齐的结构化奖励信号，模拟住院医师培训中渐进自主权的成长过程。

Result: 在对抗条件下，ResidencyRL智能体的诊断准确率从81.0%提升至88.0%（提升7.0%），漏诊红旗症状率降低31%，有效缓解了过早闭合的推理缺陷。盲法专家临床医生在87.6%的并排对比中偏好该训练智能体。该智能体的程序性能力可迁移至未见基准：在AMIE多访视基准的全部六个临床轴上均优于基础模型，并在AgentClinic和CRAFT-MD上表现出一致的方向性改进。

Conclusion: 研究证明，序列临床决策能力可以通过模拟环境中的多轮强化学习有效习得，产生稳健且可泛化的能力，为临床掌握（clinical mastery）铺平了道路。但需要在真实临床工作流程中开展前瞻性验证以确定其临床实用性。

Abstract: In medical education, physicians convert academic knowledge into clinical expertise through residency: years of training across thousands of encounters, with diverse sources of feedback and progressively greater autonomy. Much of clinical reasoning relies on the patient encounter, a dialogue in which a clinician elicits history, refines diagnostic hypotheses, and decides management under uncertainty. While large language models (LLMs) excel on static medical benchmarks, methods to optimize the full sequence of clinical decisions remain underdeveloped. We present ResidencyRL, a reinforcement learning (RL) method for training clinical artificial intelligence (AI) agents through simulated multi-turn clinical encounters (up to 60 dialogue turns and 8 tool calls per trajectory). ResidencyRL pairs the policy agent with LLM simulators capable of complex, adversarial behaviors, training against a structured reward aligned to diagnostic accuracy, management quality, communication, documentation, and safety. On held-out evaluations, the ResidencyRL agent improves diagnostic accuracy by 7.0% under adversarial conditions (88.0% vs. 81.0%) and reduces missed red flag rates by 31%, demonstrating rigorous mitigation of premature closure. Blinded expert clinicians validated these gains, preferring the trained agent in 87.6% of side-by-side comparisons. The procedural competencies transfer to unseen benchmarks: the agent outperforms the base model across all six clinical axes of the AMIE multi-visit benchmark, and shows consistent directional improvements on AgentClinic and CRAFT-MD. Our findings demonstrate that sequential clinical decision-making can be effectively learned through multi-turn RL in simulation, yielding robust, generalizable capabilities, paving the way towards clinical mastery. Prospective validation with real-world workflows remains necessary to establish clinical utility.

</details>


### [363] [GeoBenchLLM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Geo-Related Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07411v1)
*Rodrigo Ferreira Rodrigues,Karim Radouane,Jose G Moreno,Lynda Tamine*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GeoBenchLLM，一个用于评估大型语言模型在地理相关任务上泛化能力的综合基准。该基准涵盖来自不同地理任务和领域的12个公开数据集，用于评估LLM在空间和时间理解方面的表现，并发现推理能力与模型规模对整体性能有显著影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型在地理数据场景中的研究通常处于同质化（单一数据集或任务）环境中，这严重限制了对模型泛化能力的深入理解，缺乏一个全面、多样化的基准来系统评估LLM的地理相关能力。

Method: 作者精心挑选了12个来自不同地理相关任务和领域的公开数据集，构建了GeoBenchLLM基准，并在一组大语言模型上进行评估，重点关注地理空间和地理时间理解能力。

Result: 实验结果表明，模型的推理能力和参数规模对整体性能有显著影响，即推理能力越强、模型规模越大，在地理任务上的表现越好。

Conclusion: GeoBenchLLM填补了LLM地理评估缺乏综合基准的空白，证明了推理能力和模型规模是影响地理任务性能的关键因素，并为后续地理大模型研究提供了公开可复现的评估工具。

Abstract: In the context of geodata, existing Large Language Models have often been studied in a homogeneous setting, which has considerably limited insights into their generalization capabilities. In this paper, we present \benchName, a comprehensive benchmark for probing LLMs on geo-related tasks. We leverage a careful selection of twelve publicly available datasets from diverse geo-related tasks and domains, and evaluate a set of LLMs on geo-spatial and temporal understanding using our benchmark. Our results show that reasoning and size have a strong impact on overall performance. GeoBenchLLM is publicly available at https://github.com/Rfr2003/GeoBenchLLM.

</details>


### [364] [WNM-3D: A World Navigation Model with 3D Scene Conditioning for Closed-Loop VLN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07267v1)
*Yuehao Huang,Yunzi Wu,Xiaotao Zhang,Xinhai Li,Jiankun Dong,Jiajun Lv,Chi Zhang,Chenjia Bai,Yong Liu,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WNM-3D是一个用于连续视觉语言导航的生成式世界导航模型，通过3D场景条件化来联合预测未来观察和行动。它使用冻结的几何编码器从单目RGB历史中提取几何感知表示，并通过3D场景到Token适配器将其转换为世界-行动扩散Transformer的固定长度前缀，以块因果注意力方式条件化未来的视频-行动块生成。实验表明其在GN-Bench上优于强VLM导航策略和2D条件化版本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM导航系统采用行动中心训练，未显式建模视觉观察在预测运动下应如何演变；而现有的连续VLN世界行动模型（WAMs）未能将联合未来视图和行动生成条件化于从观察历史推断的几何感知表示上，缺乏几何上下文约束。

Method: （1）使用冻结的前馈几何编码器从单目RGB历史中提取几何感知表示；（2）引入可训练的3D场景到Token适配器，将其转换为世界-行动扩散Transformer中固定长度的前缀；（3）通过块因果注意力以前缀条件化每个未来的视频-行动块；（4）采用三阶段训练：基于A*生成示范的监督世界行动微调、DAgger式策略访问状态适应、以及DanceGRPO闭环策略优化。

Result: 在GN-Bench上，WNM-3D在闭环导航中优于强VLM导航策略及其2D条件化对应版本；在固定近目标评估集上实现了更高的流行动一致性和更低的视觉运动误差。

Conclusion: 将3D几何感知场景表示作为共享上下文条件化未来视图和行动的联合生成，能够有效提升连续VLN中的闭环导航性能，验证了几何条件化世界行动模型的价值。

Abstract: Recent vision-language navigation (VLN) systems increasingly adapt pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) into vision-language-action (VLA) policies that map egocentric observations and language instructions directly to navigation actions. Although semantically capable, such action-centric training does not explicitly model how the agent's visual observations should evolve under its predicted motion. Generative world-action models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and actions, yet existing WAMs for continuous VLN do not condition joint future-view and action generation on geometry-aware representations inferred from the observed history. We present WNM-3D, a generative World Navigation Model with 3D scene conditioning for continuous VLN. To consolidate past observations into persistent scene context, a frozen feed-forward geometry encoder extracts geometry-aware representations from the monocular egocentric RGB history, and a trainable 3D Scene-to-Token Adapter converts them into a fixed-length prefix in the token space of the world-action Diffusion Transformer. Through block-causal attention, this prefix conditions every future video-action block, providing a shared geometric context for both future-view and action generation. We train WNM-3D through supervised world-action fine-tuning on A*-generated demonstrations, DAgger-style adaptation on policy-visited states, and DanceGRPO-based closed-loop policy optimization. Experiments on GN-Bench show that WNM-3D outperforms strong VLM-based navigation policies and its 2D-conditioned counterpart in closed-loop navigation. On a fixed near-goal evaluation set, WNM-3D also achieves higher flow-action consistency and lower visual-motion error.

</details>


### [365] [SetEasy: A Multi-Modal Classroom Engagement Assessment and Seating Optimization Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07188v1)
*Zhihao Xie,Hongye Yang,Shien Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SetEasy系统通过融合多模态传感（腕带生理数据、4K视频、环境数据）和基于修正ISEQ模型的v-Gage预测，在固定座位网格中优化课堂参与度。CP-SAT求解器在视觉可达与社会动态约束下生成每周两周期的座位规划。四周期实验（23名学生、331节课）显示RMSE从0.75降至0.53，平均参与度从0.30提升至0.70，后排低活跃模式显著减少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在全球教育同质化背景下，固定座位网格难以动态适配学生参与需求，传统座位管理缺乏数据驱动的、可解释的优化手段，亟需一种无需硬件改造即可提升课堂参与度的可持续方案。

Method: 融合腕带生理、4K视频与环境数据等多模态传感，训练基于修正ISEQ的v-Gage参与度预测模型；每周将两周预测结果映射为学生-座位效用矩阵，使用CP-SAT在视觉可达与社会动态约束下生成最优座位规划。

Result: 四周期部署（23名学生、331节课）中v-Gage在情感、行为、认知及整体维度收敛，RMSE从0.75降至0.53；优化后平均参与度从0.30升至0.70，超三分之二座位达到高参与度水平，后排低活跃模式显著减少。

Conclusion: 无需硬件变更，可解释的、数据驱动的座位策略能显著提升课堂参与度；"多模态评估+优化"范式为文化响应式、差异化的空间设计提供了可迁移、可持续的实现路径。

Abstract: SetEasy optimizes classroom engagement in fixed seating grids. It fuses multimodal sensing (wristband physiology, 4K video, environmental data) and trains a v-Gage model grounded in a revised ISEQ. Each week, two-week engagement forecasts are mapped to a student-seat utility matrix, and CP-SAT generates seating plans under visual-access and social-dynamics constraints. In a four-week deployment (23 students, 331 classes), v-Gage converged across affective, behavioral, cognitive, and overall dimensions, cutting RMSE from 0.75 to 0.53. Optimization raised mean engagement from 0.30 to 0.70, with over two-thirds of seats reaching high engagement and back-row low-activity patterns markedly reduced. These results show that, without hardware changes, interpretable, data-driven seating strategies can substantially enhance engagement. The multimodal "assessment + optimization" paradigm offers a transferable, sustainable path to culturally responsive, differentiated spatial design amid global homogenization.

</details>


### [366] [NiyamAI - An Intent-Bound AI Agent with Cryptographically Verifiable Guardrails using Zero-Knowledge Proofs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07167v1)
*Aditya Katkar,Om Karkele,Kartik Mandhane,Manisha More,Yash Kashid*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Niyam-AI框架，通过Intent Contract（SHA-256锁定允许的工具和约束）+ 隔离的Judge模型 + EZKL生成的zk-SNARK证明，将LLM Agent的安全执行变成可验证的数学证明。在Agent-SafetyBench的2000个真实场景上，F1达88.5%，假阳性率1.1%，并在McNemar检验中显著优于NeMo Guardrails、Llama Prompt Guard 2和GPT-OSS-Safeguard。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主LLM Agent面临提示注入、幻觉推理和不安全工具调用等安全威胁，现有防御依赖运行在被攻击同一机器上的系统提示或策略过滤器等软件检查，无法提供可验证的执行证明，即无法让第三方确信安全策略确实被强制执行。

Method: Niyam-AI框架包含三阶段流程：(1) 会话开始时将允许的工具和约束通过SHA-256哈希锁定为Intent Contract；(2) 每次工具调用被一个隔离的Judge模型拦截并验证，通过后由EZKL生成zk-SNARK零知识证明；(3) 只有证明验证通过后工具才执行，第三方无需访问Judge模型权重即可确认强制执行。

Result: 在Agent-SafetyBench的2000个场景上进行5折分层交叉验证，F1分数88.5%，假阳性率1.1%（bootstrap 95% CI: [85.19%, 91.88%], N=1000）。McNemar精确配对检验显示显著改进：对NeMo胜390败20，对Prompt Guard 2胜115败13，对GPT-OSS-Safeguard胜384败19，全部p<0.0001。证明生成耗时2260.6±218.4ms/次，验证耗时53.1±11.8ms。

Conclusion: Niyam-AI提供了一种既高准确率又可数学验证的安全护栏。但作者明确指出，这反映的是适应Agent-SafetyBench的分类器与零样本基线的对比，该区别在Section IV.C中讨论，提示结果可能受基准适应偏差影响。

Abstract: Giving an AI agent the ability to send emails, query databases, or execute commands is useful--until the agent is tricked into doing something it shouldn't. Prompt injection, hallucinated reasoning, and unsafe tool calls form the primary attack surface for autonomous LLM agents. Existing defenses rely on software checks like system prompts or policy filters running on the same machine the attacker targets, offering no verifiable proof of execution. We introduce Niyam-AI, a framework that makes safety enforcement provable. At session start, permitted tools and constraints are locked into an Intent Contract committed via SHA-256. Every tool call is intercepted and validated by an isolated Judge model; upon passing, a zk-SNARK proof is generated via EZKL. The tool executes only after proof verification, allowing third parties to confirm enforcement without accessing Judge model weights. Evaluating Niyam-AI on 2,000 real-world scenarios from Agent-SafetyBench against NeMo Guardrails, Meta's Llama Prompt Guard 2, and OpenAI's GPT-OSS-Safeguard using 5-fold stratified cross-validation yields an F1 score of 88.5% with a 1.1% false-positive rate (bootstrap 95% CI: [85.19%, 91.88%], N=1000). McNemar's exact paired test confirms significant improvement: Niyam-AI wins 390 discordant scenarios against NeMo (vs 20 losses), 115 against Prompt Guard 2 (vs 13), and 384 against GPT-OSS-Safeguard (vs 19) with p < 0.0001 in all cases. Proof generation adds 2260.6 +/- 218.4 ms per approved action, while verification takes 53.1 +/- 11.8 ms. Niyam-AI provides a guardrail that is both highly accurate and mathematically verifiable--though this reflects a classifier adapted to Agent-SafetyBench evaluated against zero-shot baselines, a distinction discussed in Section IV.C.

</details>


### [367] [DocMemo: Dynamic Evidence Discovery via Probabilistic Memory-Guided Retrieval for Multi-Modal Document Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07067v1)
*Hanshu Yao,Janfeng Zhong,Niu Lian,Jinpeng Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DocMemo，一个基于记忆引导的动态证据探索框架，通过三级检索状态（文档结构记忆、页面信念记忆、问题情景记忆）解决长文档理解中静态检索和跨轮记忆脆弱的问题，实现跨轮页面选择的持续优化，在3个基准上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
