### [398] [3D Molecular Representation Learning for Organic Mixtures: Viscosity and Density Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06697v1)
*Haicheng Qu,Yanyi Su,Ning Wang,Shangqian Chen,Zhifeng Gao,Jun Cheng,Qi Ou*

Main category: physics.chem-ph

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种混合物感知的3D分子表征学习策略，基于预训练分子编码器，联合编码组分结构、摩尔分数和温度，实现对有机混合物动力粘度和密度的准确预测（测试集R2分别达0.973和0.996），并能捕捉混合时粘度的非单调变化，可扩展到三元及多组分体系，为功能流体的理性配方设计提供了数据驱动工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有机混合物的粘度和密度是设计润滑剂、溶剂和传热流体等功能流体的关键性质，但现实中分子物种及组合种类繁多，穷举实验表征全参数空间不切实际，因此亟需一种能够联合考虑组分结构、摩尔分数和温度的高效预测方法。

Method: 提出一种混合物感知的3D分子表征学习策略，构建在预训练分子编码器之上，将组分分子结构、摩尔分数和温度融合编码，通过在下游任务上微调来预测有机混合物的动态粘度和密度。模型架构支持从二元体系扩展到三元及多组分混合物。

Result: 在公开的二组元有机混合物数据集上微调后，动力粘度测试集R2达0.973，密度R2达0.996，显著优于传统机器学习基线。模型能够捕捉混合时粘度的非单调变化，超越简单线性或对数混合规则。初步实验验证了模型可扩展到三元和多组分混合物，并定量分析了支链、环烷烃和芳香环等分子结构对粘度-温度行为的影响。

Conclusion: 这项工作为混合物性质预测提供了实用的数据驱动工具，加速了化学工程中功能流体的理性配方设计，尤其有助于设计具有优异粘度-温度性能的润滑剂。

Abstract: The viscosity and density of organic mixtures are essential properties for designing lubricants, solvents, and heat transfer fluids. In engineering practice, formulating a functional fluid requires understanding how these properties change with composition and temperature. However, exhaustive experimental characterization across the full parameter space is impractical due to the vast number of possible species and combinations. Here we introduce a mixture-aware 3D molecular representation learning strategy, built upon a pre-trained molecular encoder, that jointly encodes component structures, mole fractions, and temperature to achieve accurate predictions for organic mixtures. Fine-tuning on publicly available datasets covering a wide range of binary organic mixtures yields test-set R2 values of 0.973 for dynamic viscosity and 0.996 for density, significantly outperforming traditional machine learning baselines. Beyond this overall accuracy, the model captures non-monotonic viscosity changes upon mixing, surpassing simple linear or logarithmic mixing rules. The architecture is extendable to ternary and multicomponent mixtures, as verified via preliminary experiments. Using this model, we quantitatively analyze how molecular structure-branching, cycloalkane, and aromatic rings-affects viscosity-temperature behavior, which benefits the design of lubricants with superior viscosity-temperature performance. Altogether, this work provides a practical, data-driven tool for mixture property prediction, accelerating the rational formulation of functional fluids in chemical engineering.

</details>


### [399] [Physics-Grounded Materials Artificial Intelligence for Reliable Materials Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06680v1)
*Yuhang Wang,Qian Wang,Seong-Hoon Jang,Hao Li*

Main category: physics.chem-ph

TL;DR: 本文提出"物理驱动材料人工智能"（PhysMat AI）作为统一视角，将物理知识以五种互补角色（先验知识、描述符、约束、验证器、基础设施）融入材料智能系统，推动从预测模型向自主科学系统的演进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数据驱动的材料发现方法存在可解释性有限、外推能力差、与物理规律不一致等问题。由于材料行为本质上受热力学、动力学、电子结构、输运过程及运行环境支配，下一代材料智能必须超越基于相关性的预测，走向物理驱动的推理。

Method: 系统性地提出PhysMat AI框架，将物理知识通过五种互补角色整合进材料智能：物理作为先验知识（引导数据表示）、描述符（特征工程）、约束（物理可行搜索空间）、验证器（推理校验）和基础设施（知识管理）。通过催化、固态电池固态电解质和储氢材料等代表性案例进行阐述，并进一步展示AI代理如何利用这些物理感知组件实现机制引导的发现。

Result: 通过五个典型应用案例展示了物理知识如何指导数据表示、模型推理、验证流程和知识管理，并论证了AI代理能够在物理可行的搜索空间内进行机制引导的发现。

Conclusion: 材料智能应沿着从物理感知AI到物理推理AI再到物理自主AI的路线图演进，最终发展为集成物理推理、多尺度模拟、实验验证和持续知识更新的自主科学系统，实现可靠的材料发现。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming materials discovery, yet conventional data-driven approaches often suffer from limited interpretability, poor extrapolation, and inconsistency with physical laws. Since materials behavior is fundamentally governed by thermodynamics, kinetics, electronic structure, transport processes, and operating environments, the next generation of materials intelligence must move beyond correlation-based prediction toward physics-grounded reasoning. In this Perspective, we systematically discuss Physics-Grounded Materials AI (PhysMat AI) as a unifying perspective for integrating physical knowledge into materials intelligence through five complementary roles: physics as prior knowledge, descriptors, constraints, verifiers, and infrastructure. Using representative examples from catalysis, solid-state electrolytes in solid-state battery, and hydrogen-storage materials, we illustrate how physical principles guide data representation, model reasoning, validation workflows, and knowledge management. We further present how AI agents can leverage these physics-aware components to perform mechanism-guided discovery within physically feasible search spaces. Finally, we outline a developmental roadmap from physics-aware AI to physics-reasoning AI and ultimately physics-autonomous AI. Looking forward, materials intelligence should evolve from predictive models toward autonomous scientific systems capable of integrating physical reasoning, multiscale simulations, experimental validation, and continuous knowledge updating for reliable materials discovery.

</details>

### [400] [Thermal Design and Experimental Validation of a Water-Cooled Bimetallic Minichannel Beam Dump for High-Power Heavy-Ion Accelerators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09671v1)
*J. Song,N. Bultmann,M. Reaume,M. Patil,R. Quispe-Abad,W. Franklin,S. I. Eom,E. Wakai,M. Vargas Vallejo*

Main category: physics.acc-ph

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一种为FRIB（稀有同位素束流装置）高功率重离子加速器设计并实验验证的水冷双金属微通道束流捕集器。该设计采用倾斜吸收器几何结构、CuCrZr/Al2219双金属结构和2mm微通道三种关键热管理特性，并通过共轭热模型预测和17keV电子束真空实验验证，表面温度测量与计算结果在4%不确定度内一致，内部温度在15%内一致，证实该设计可在中间功率FRIB运行条件下维持吸收器温度在设计限值内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高功率重离子加速器中，束流拦截器件面临剧烈且局域化的能量沉积，这限制了主束流功率和运行可靠性，因此需要高效的热管理方案来确保束流捕集器的安全运行。

Method: 设计了集成三种关键热特性的水冷双金属微通道束流捕集器：倾斜吸收器几何以降低局部热流密度、CuCrZr/Al2219双金属结构增强热扩散并兼顾水侧兼容性、2mm宽微通道实现高对流传热。开发了共轭热模型预测表面温度、内部温度梯度、双金属界面温度、冷却剂温升和热裕度。在约5e-4托真空条件下使用17keV电子束对样机进行验证，通过红外热像仪测量表面温度，嵌入热电偶测量内部温度。

Result: 中心束流辐照条件下，计算表面温度分布与测量结果在绝对温度4%的实验不确定度内一致；内部温度测量结果在15%内合理一致，主要差异来自热电偶定位和束流位置校准的不确定性。验证模型确认微通道束流捕集器能在FRIB中间功率运行条件下将吸收器温度维持在设计限值内。

Conclusion: 实验结果证明了双金属微通道冷却方案对紧凑型、高热流密度束流捕集系统在重离子加速器设施中的有效性，为该类器件的工程设计提供了经过验证的热设计方法。

Abstract: Efficient thermal management of beam-intercepting devices is essential for high-power heavy-ion accelerators,where intense and localized energy deposition can limit primary beam power and operational reliability. This work presents the thermal design and experimental validation of a water-cooled bimetallic minichannel beam dump developed for the Facility for Rare Isotope Beams (FRIB), a leading experimental nuclear physics facility. The design integrates three key thermal features: a tilted absorber geometry to reduce local heat flux, a CuCrZr/Al2219 bimetallic structure to enhance heat spreading while maintaining water-side compatibility, and 2-mm-wide minichannels to achieve high convective heat removal. A conjugate thermal model was developed to predict surface temperature, internal temperature gradients, bimetallic-interface temperature, coolant temperature rise, and thermal margin under representative beam-loading conditions. The prototype was validated in vacuum ($\approx$5$\times 10^{-4}$ torr) using a 17-keV electron beam. Surface temperatures were measured by infrared thermography, and internal temperatures were measured using embedded thermocouples. The calculated surface temperature distributions were generally consistent with the measurements within the experimental uncertainty of 4$\%$ in absolute temperature for central beam irradiation, while internal temperature measurements showed reasonable agreement within 15$\%$, mainly due to uncertainties in thermocouple placement and beam-position calibration. The validated model confirms that the minichannel beam dump can maintain absorber temperatures within the design limit under intermediate-power FRIB operating conditions. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of bimetallic minichannel cooling for compact, high-heat-flux beam dump systems in heavy-ion accelerator facilities.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [401] [Partially Observable Learning for Multi-Platform Dispatch Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10897v1)
*Fengming Yao,Man Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出POLO框架，一个面向多平台即时配送系统的部分可观测多智能体强化学习框架，通过将每个平台-网格对建模为独立智能体、引入基于注意力的策略表示和反事实奖励塑形机制，在仅依赖平台本地观测的条件下实现了优于强基线的配送调度性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中众包骑手可同时服务于多个平台，且每个平台因隐私和运营限制只能观测到自身订单和骑手交互，形成多平台配送环境固有的部分可观测性。然而现有配送优化研究大多假设骑手完全可观测且强制接受分配，在真实多平台场景下会导致显著性能退化。

Method: POLO框架包含三个核心设计：(1) 将每个平台-网格对建模为独立智能体，仅从平台本地观测学习调度策略，贴合真实隐私和运营约束；(2) 提出基于注意力机制的策略表示，在不完整且异质的骑手信息条件下选择性聚合骑手间信息，支持高效决策；(3) 设计反事实奖励塑形机制，缓解网格间联合行动导致的非平稳性问题，使学习更稳定可扩展。同时构建了高保真模拟器以评估不同平台数量和系统规模下的调度性能。

Result: 在多种平台数量和系统规模的实验设置下，POLO在平台收入和骑手出行效率两方面均持续优于强基线方法，验证了其在真实多平台场景下的鲁棒性和有效性。

Conclusion: POLO通过部分可观测多智能体强化学习框架有效解决了多平台即时配送中的不完全观测问题，证明了在真实约束下仍可实现优越的配送调度性能，为该领域提供了新的方法论方向。

Abstract: Instant delivery platforms have become a critical component of urban logistics, increasingly relying on crowdsourced couriers to fulfill highly dynamic orders. In real-world systems, couriers are not exclusive to a single platform and may concurrently serve multiple platforms, while each platform can only observe its own orders and couriers' interactions due to privacy and operational constraints. This results in a multi-platform dispatch environment with inherent partial observability. However, most existing works on dispatch optimization assume full courier observability and mandatory assignment acceptance, causing substantial performance degradation when deployed in realistic multi-platform settings. In this paper, we propose POLO, a partially observable multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for dispatching optimization in multi-platform instant delivery systems. POLO firstly models each platform-grid pair as an independent agent that learns dispatch policies solely from platform-local observations, aligning the learning process with real-world privacy and operational constraints. To support effective decision-making under incomplete and heterogeneous courier information, POLO introduces a novel attention-based policy representation that selectively aggregates inter-courier information. Moreover, we design a counterfactual reward shaping mechanism to mitigate the non-stationarity induced by joint actions across grids, leading to more stable and scalable learning. We develop a high-fidelity simulator to evaluate dispatch performance under varying numbers of platforms and system scales. Extensive experiments demonstrate that POLO consistently outperforms strong baselines in terms of platform revenue and courier travel efficiency, highlighting its robustness and effectiveness in realistic multi-platform settings.

</details>


### [402] [FiGuRO: Intrinsic Dimension Estimation for Multi-Modal Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10857v1)
*Viktoria Schuster,Sana Tonekaboni,Caroline Uhler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FiGuRO（保真度引导的秩优化）是一个用于估计单模态和多模态数据内在维度（ID）的框架，它通过截断奇异值分解和自适应维度增减算法来学习低秩投影的维度，无需复杂辅助损失函数即可自然实现共享与私有信息的解耦。该框架在模拟和真实数据上均优于现有ID估计方法，且对超参数变化更鲁棒，还可应用于现代预训练模型实现后验解耦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态表示学习中，确定数据的复杂度（内在维度ID）对于高效且可解释的表示学习至关重要，但现有方法存在关键缺陷：它们通常是静态的、仅限单模态的，或者对比方法只能隐式地适应共享ID，无法有效处理共享与私有信息的解耦问题。

Method: FiGuRO通过截断奇异值分解（truncated SVD）学习低秩投影的维度，并设计了一种算法来判断何时在哪个潜在空间中减小或增加维度。在模型容量和超参数约束下进行维度近似，共享和私有信息的解耦作为该优化过程的涌现属性自然产生，无需依赖复杂的辅助损失函数。

Result: FiGuRO在仿真和真实数据上均优于现有ID估计技术，对超参数变化更具鲁棒性；能捕捉不同ID尺度和变化的子空间比率，成功分解共享与私有信息；并可应用于现代单模态预训练模型，实现高效的后验多模态表示解耦。

Conclusion: FiGuRO填补了多模态ID估计领域的空白，提供了一种无需复杂辅助损失即可实现共享/私有信息解耦的框架，并展示了在真实预训练模型上的实用价值。

Abstract: Determining the complexity, or Intrinsic Dimension (ID), of data is fundamental to efficient and interpretable representation learning. This is particularly challenging in multi-modal settings when trying to learn disentangled representations for shared and private information. Existing techniques leave a critical gap: they are often static, uni-modal, or in the case of contrastive methods, adapt only to the shared ID implicitly. We introduce Fidelity-Guided Rank Optimization (FiGuRO), a framework for approximating the ID of uni- and multi-modal data under constraints of model capacity and hyperparameters. FiGuRO learns the dimensions of low-rank projections using truncated singular value decomposition and an algorithm that determines when to reduce or increase dimension and in which latent space. Disentanglement of shared and private information arises as an emergent property of this optimization, eliminating the need for complex auxiliary loss functions. We demonstrate that FiGuRO outperforms existing ID estimation techniques and is more robust to hyperparameter changes. Across simulations and real-world data, FiGuRO captures distinct ID scales and varying subspace ratios, and decomposes shared and private information successfully. Furthermore, we show that FiGuRO can be applied to modern uni-modal pretrained models, enabling efficient, post-hoc disentanglement of multi-modal representations.

</details>


### [403] [ProTAGAD: A Foundation Model for TAG Anomaly Detection with Decoupled Topological and Textual Prototypes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10699v1)
*Ziyan Wang,Liwen Wu,Cheng Xie,Song Gao,Zhenli He,Xin Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向文本属性图（TAG）异常检测的解耦原型基础模型，通过构建独立的拓扑原型库和文本语义原型库来分别建模结构正常性与语义一致性，从而解决传统GNN方法中跨模态耦合导致的"模糊异常边界（BAB）"问题。在14个跨域基准数据集上取得了SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本属性图（TAG）异常检测需要同时利用拓扑结构和细粒度文本语义，但现有的GNN异常检测器采用整体式消息传递机制，在传播过程中不加区分地融合结构邻近性和文本语义，导致深度跨模态耦合。这种纠缠作为噪声放大器会掩盖微弱的异常信号，产生"模糊异常边界（BAB）"问题，使正常与异常的决策边界难以分离，且这一问题在图基础模型的跨域泛化场景中被进一步放大。

Method: 提出一种新的TAG异常检测基础模型，核心设计是解耦的拓扑原型与文本原型：构建双原型库分别独立建模结构正常性与语义一致性，从而隔离在耦合聚合过程中被稀释的异常线索。通过解耦设计避免跨模态信息在消息传递过程中的相互干扰。

Result: 在14个多样化的基准数据集上的跨域实验表明，该方法一致性地取得了SOTA性能。消融研究进一步证实了传统耦合TAG异常检测器中BAB问题的普遍存在，并验证了解耦原型设计能有效缓解该挑战。

Conclusion: 解耦的拓扑与文本原型设计是缓解耦合聚合导致异常信号稀释的关键，为TAG异常检测提供了一个更具鲁棒性和跨域泛化能力的范式。

Abstract: Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs), endowed with abundant textual content along with topological structures, have emerged as a versatile backbone for real-world anomaly detection spanning large language model security, social network moderation, and cyber threat identification. Unlike conventional Graph Anomaly Detection (GAD), which relies primarily on structural irregularities, TAG anomaly detection must jointly leverage both topological patterns and fine-grained textual semantics to capture nuanced anomalous behaviors. The current GNN-based anomaly detectors adopt holistic message-passing schemes that indiscriminately fuse structural proximity and textual semantics during propagation, leading to deep cross-modality coupling. This entanglement acts as a noise amplifier, obscuring subtle anomalous signals and directly giving rise to the Blurred-Anomaly-Boundary (BAB) issue by rendering normal-anomalous decision boundaries poorly separable. This challenge is further amplified for graph foundation models that require robust cross-domain generalization. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel foundation model for TAG anomaly detection featuring decoupled topological and textual prototypes. Our framework constructs dual prototype banks to independently model structural normality and semantic consistency, effectively isolating anomaly cues that are otherwise diluted during coupled aggregation. Extensive experiments across 14 diverse benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in cross-domain settings. Notably, the ablation studies further corroborate the prevalence of the BAB issue in conventional coupled TAG anomaly detectors, and show that our decoupled prototype design effectively mitigates this challenge.

</details>


### [404] [BREAD: Baseline-Referenced Explanations for Anomaly Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10587v1)
*Jiaqi Qiu,Rob Goedhart,Jannis Kurtz,Inez M. Zwetsloot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可扩展的、基于基线参照的AI异常检测诊断方法，该方法利用异常观测和正常基线信息进行特征归因，在均值偏移异常设定下比LIME具有更高的忠实性，并通过仿真和实际案例验证了其有效性和准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI驱动的前瞻性异常检测方法在高维非线性场景中应用广泛，但检测到异常后需要诊断方法识别导致异常的关键特征。传统SPM诊断方法针对特定检测模型设计，无法直接用于AI方法；现有模型无关的XAI方法（如LIME）存在可扩展性限制或将相关性归因于噪声特征，导致诊断精度下降。

Method: 提出一种可扩展的、基线参照（baseline-referenced）的诊断方法，同时利用异常观测和正常基线信息进行特征相关性解释。通过在均值偏移异常设定下进行数学推导，证明该方法相比LIME在检测导致异常的特征方面具有更高的忠实性（faithfulness）。

Result: 通过数学保证证明在均值偏移异常设定下所提方法比LIME更忠实；仿真研究和真实案例验证了该方法对AI前瞻性异常检测方法能够生成更忠实、更准确的诊断结果。

Conclusion: 所提出的可扩展基线参照诊断方法有效解决了现有XAI方法在AI异常检测诊断中的可扩展性和噪声归因问题，为AI-based前瞻性异常检测提供了更可靠的特征诊断机制，兼具数学保证与实证验证。

Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based prospective anomaly detection methods are increasingly deployed in high-dimensional and nonlinear settings. Among these approaches, AI-based statistical process monitoring (SPM) is widely used, providing a structured framework for prospective monitoring. Once an anomaly is detected, a diagnosis method is needed to identify the features driving the flagged observation away from normal behaviour. Traditional SPM diagnosis methods are typically designed for specific detection models and cannot be directly applied to AI-based methods. Model-agnostic explainable AI (XAI) offers a general framework for feature relevance explanation. However, existing methods suffer from scalability limitations or assign relevance to noise features, reducing diagnosis accuracy. We propose a scalable, baseline-referenced diagnosis method that uses both the anomalous observation and normal baseline information. We provide mathematical guarantees that under a mean-shift anomaly setting, the proposed method achieves higher faithfulness in detecting the features causing the anomaly compared to LIME. Simulation studies and a real-world case study validate the effectiveness of the proposed method and show that it generates more faithful and accurate diagnosis results for AI-based prospective anomaly detection methods.

</details>


### [405] [Dreamer-SAC: Off-Policy Learning in Latent World Models for Sample-Efficient Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10386v1)
*Jiazhuo Li,Linjiang Cao,Qi Liu,Xi Xiong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Dreamer-SAC框架，将循环状态空间世界模型与离线策略的SAC算法在潜空间中集成，通过真实交互与短视域生成轨迹结合、n步目标估计和多目标监督，在自动驾驶场景中显著超越DreamerV3、SAC和PPO等基线，同时大幅减少真实环境交互次数。实验揭示了rollout视域与策略性能之间的倒U型关系，以及n步目标估计优于单步TD目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶中的样本高效强化学习常受限于数据效率与模型偏差之间的权衡。虽然世界模型减少了昂贵环境交互的依赖，但在学习到的动力学上进行策略优化仍对预测误差敏感，需要一种框架在保持数据效率的同时降低模型偏差的影响。

Method: Dreamer-SAC框架：(1) 使用循环状态空间世界模型学习潜在动力学；(2) 将离线策略的SAC算法直接在潜空间中训练；(3) 结合真实交互数据与短视域生成轨迹进行训练；(4) 采用n步目标估计与多目标监督（涵盖驾驶效率和安全性）。

Result: 在自动驾驶场景中，Dreamer-SAC在驾驶效率与安全性等目标上持续优于DreamerV3、SAC和PPO等代表性基线；在显著减少真实环境交互次数的同时实现更优性能；发现rollout视域与策略性能呈倒U型关系，短视域潜空间rollout是最优折衷；n步目标估计在利用预测经验进行值学习方面比单步TD目标更有效。

Conclusion: 短视域潜空间rollout与n步目标估计的结合是平衡额外训练信号与累积模型偏差的有效方案，证明了在世界模型框架中引入离线策略算法能够同时提升样本效率和最终性能。

Abstract: Sample-efficient reinforcement learning for autonomous driving is often limited by the trade-off between data efficiency and model bias. While world models reduce the reliance on costly environment interactions, policy optimization over learned dynamics remains sensitive to prediction errors. This paper proposes the Dreamer-SAC framework, which integrates a recurrent state-space world model with an off-policy soft actor-critic algorithm trained directly in latent space. The framework uses a combination of real interactions and short-horizon generated trajectories with n-step target estimation and multi-objective supervision. Evaluated in autonomous driving scenarios with objectives encompassing driving efficiency and safety, the proposed framework consistently outperforms representative reinforcement learning baselines, including DreamerV3, SAC, and PPO, while achieving improved performance with substantially fewer real environment interactions. Experiments reveal an inverted-U relationship between rollout horizon and policy performance, where short-horizon latent rollouts achieve the best trade-off between additional training signals and accumulated model bias. Furthermore, n-step target estimation demonstrates more effectiveness over one-step temporal-difference targets in exploiting predicted experience for value learning.

</details>


### [406] [Intrinsic Structure: Spectral Identifiability for Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10172v1)
*Ashim Dhor,Pin-Yu Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次将字典学习/可解释性的原始原语置于可辨识性（identifiability）的理论基础上，通过将前向传播视为以深度为时间的受控动力系统，并用Koopman算子提升，得到有限线性实现，其谱是模型的坐标无关属性。作者证明该谱可从M个校准样本以M^{-1/2}速率恢复（至多置换一致），给出匹配的极小极大下界、重尾中位数均值变体及分离定理（非正规实现下，激活方差方向与跨深度信息方向不能重合）。在GPT-2 small、Gemma-2-2B、Qwen3-8B-Base上验证，谱处处收敛并达到预测指数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机制可解释性通过识别模型内部的回路来刻画模型，但缺乏方法判断一个回路究竟是模型的真实属性，还是发现它的方法带来的人为产物。稀疏自编码器即是典型例子：不同种子和宽度从相同激活中恢复出实质不同的特征，而缺乏理论说明这种变异性是偶然的还是结构性的。作者希望为可解释性的字典学习提供可辨识性基础。

Method: 将前向传播视为以深度为"时间"的受控动力系统，用Koopman算子将其提升为有限线性实现，其谱成为模型的坐标无关性质。提出可辨识性定理：谱可从M个校准样本以M^{-1/2}速率（至多置换意义下）恢复，并配套极小极大下界、针对重尾激活的中位数均值变体，以及分离定理：当实现非正规时，承载激活方差的方向与跨深度承载信息的方向不能重合。在真实模型上实证验证收敛性与预测指数。

Result: 在GPT-2 small、Gemma-2-2B和Qwen3-8B-Base上谱处处收敛，在Qwen3-8B-Base上达到预测指数0.506±0.031；短fall缺陷按每个单元的样本阈值坍缩到单一曲线。Koopman模式在间接宾语识别任务上优于随机方向但逊于主成分，差距随深度距离以4.1倍的速率衰减，与定理预测一致。

Conclusion: Koopman谱是具备明确误差界、可辨识且模型固有的"指纹"，而非人类可读的分解。可辨识对象与可读对象并非同一对象，这为可解释性研究提供了新的理论基准，但也暗示可辨识的数学结构与可理解的解释结构之间的天然张力。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability explains models by identifying circuits inside them, but has no way to tell whether a circuit is a property of the model or an artifact of the method that found it. Sparse autoencoders illustrate the problem: different seeds and widths recover materially different features from the same activations, and no theory says whether that variability is incidental or structural. We put dictionary learning for interpretability on an identifiability footing. Treating the forward pass as a controlled dynamical system with depth as time and lifting it with the Koopman operator yields a finite linear realisation whose \emph{spectrum} is a coordinate-free property of the model. We prove the spectrum is recoverable from $M$ calibration samples at rate $M^{-1/2}$ up to permutation - to our knowledge the first identifiability theorem for a mechanistic-interpretability primitive, with a matching minimax lower bound, a median-of-means variant for heavy-tailed activations, and a dissociation theorem: whenever the realisation is non-normal, the directions carrying activation variance and the directions carrying information across depth cannot coincide. The identifiable object and the legible object are not the same object. On GPT-2 small, Gemma-2-2B and Qwen3-8B-Base the spectrum converges everywhere and attains the predicted exponent on Qwen3-8B-Base ($0.506 \pm 0.031$); shortfalls collapse onto one curve against each cell's sample threshold. Koopman modes beat random directions but lose to principal components on indirect-object identification, with the gap decaying $4.1\times$ in depth-distance, as the theorem predicts. The Koopman spectrum is an identifiable, model-intrinsic fingerprint with a stated error bar, not a legible decomposition.

</details>


### [407] [REATS: LLM Reasoning-based Ensemble Learning for Adaptive Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10149v1)
*Xu Zhang,Chang Xu,Hui Sun,Nan Ma,Zijian Zhang,Peng Wang,Wei Wang,Li Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: REATS是一个基于LLM推理能力的智能集成路由框架，通过将原始时间序列转换为混合文本-数值表示，利用链式思维推理生成可解释的、样本自适应的集成权重，在八个基准上优于竞争性集成基线，并展现出强大的迁移学习和跨领域泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界时间序列具有多样性，没有任何单一预测模型能在所有样本上表现最优。现有集成学习方法依赖固定规则或仅基于数值输入的黑盒模型，未能利用LLM的推理能力进行可解释的权重决策，因此需要一种能够结合LLM推理来生成自适应、可解释集成权重的新方法。

Method: 提出REATS框架，包含四个核心设计：(i) 结构化输入管道，将原始时间序列转化为固定token成本的混合文本-数值表示，无需API依赖即可构建基于规则的链式思维，并附加检索到的相似样本先验；(ii) 多样化的多行权重监督方案，配合token高效的百分比表格格式，降低数值复杂度并缓解LLM幻觉；(iii) 两阶段微调框架，结合SFT与GRPO，通过倒数奖励映射将连续无界MSE差距转换为有界信号，放大近最优灵敏度，解决朴素奖励设计中的均匀灵敏度和异常值主导的压缩问题。

Result: 在八个基准数据集上，REATS优于竞争性集成基线，同时提供自然语言解释，展现出强大的迁移学习和对外部未见候选模型的域外泛化能力。

Conclusion: REATS验证了利用LLM推理能力进行可解释、样本自适应的时间序列集成学习的可行性，其两阶段微调和奖励设计策略为基于回归任务的LLM强化学习提供了有价值的参考。

Abstract: Due to the diversity of real-world time series, no single forecasting model consistently dominates across all samples. Ensemble learning addresses this by combining complementary model strengths, yet existing methods rely on fixed rules or black-box models based solely on numerical inputs, failing to leverage LLM reasoning for interpretable weighting decisions. We propose REATS, which leverages LLM reasoning capabilities as an intelligent ensemble router that jointly processes textual temporal pattern descriptions and numerical features to produce interpretable, sample-adaptive ensemble weights through chain-of-thought reasoning. To enable effective LLM-based ensembling, we study its key design choices and propose: (i) a structured input pipeline that transforms raw time series into hybrid textual--numerical representations with fixed token cost, enabling rule-based chain-of-thought construction without API dependency, augmented with retrieved similar-sample priors; (ii) a diverse multi-row weight supervision scheme coupled with a token-efficient percentage-table format that reduces numerical complexity and mitigates LLM hallucinations; and (iii) a two-stage fine-tuning framework combining SFT with GRPO, where a reciprocal reward mapping transforms the continuous unbounded MSE gap into bounded signals with amplified near-oracle sensitivity, addressing the uniform sensitivity and outlier-dominated advantage compression inherent in naive reward designs for regression-based GRPO. Experiments on eight benchmarks demonstrate that REATS outperforms competitive ensemble baselines while providing natural language explanations and demonstrating strong transfer learning and out-of-domain generalization to unseen candidate models.

</details>


### [408] [MoNo: Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator for Solving PDEs on General Geometries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09764v1)
*Zijiang Yang,Xiaomeng Wu,Dongmei Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了MoNo，一种基于多尺度最优传输的神经算子，解决PDE求解中潜在空间分配不平衡导致的token坍塌问题。其核心模块CoTAP通过熵正则化最优传输实现跨尺度平衡双向投影，在多种几何体上构建稳定分层架构，在预测精度和计算效率上均优于现有SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer的神经算子通过可学习的投影机制将空间观测映射为潜在token，但这些投影机制无法保证观测点到潜在token的稳定且平衡的分配，导致部分token被过度分配而另一些未被充分利用。这种不平衡在多尺度分层架构中被持续继承并放大，最终在深层空间中造成严重的token坍塌，限制了分层架构的设计。

Method: 提出MoNo（Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator）。核心创新为CoTAP（Cross-scale Optimal Transport Assignment and Projection），将相邻潜在空间之间的跨尺度分配建模为熵正则化最优传输问题，从而构建平衡的双向投影和稳定潜在空间。CoTAP确保了跨多个潜在空间的稳定信息传递，支持在一般几何体上构建多尺度架构，从而更高效地学习长程物理交互。

Result: 大量实验表明MoNo在预测性能和计算效率上均超过现有最先进的神经算子方法。

Conclusion: 通过最优传输理论解决潜在空间分配不平衡问题，MoNo实现了稳定、平衡的多尺度潜在空间构建，为异构几何上的PDE求解提供了兼顾精度与效率的新方案。

Abstract: Transformer-based neural operators have achieved substantial progress in solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) by projecting spatial observations into compact latent tokens and learning physical interactions in latent spaces. However, we reveal that existing learnable projection mechanisms cannot ensure stable and balanced assignments from observation points to latent tokens, causing some latent tokens to be over-assigned while others remain underutilized. This limitation further restricts the design of hierarchical architectures, as assignment imbalance is continuously inherited and amplified across latent spaces, eventually causing severe token collapse in deeper spaces. To address these issues, we propose MoNo (Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator), a progressive multiscale neural operator that efficiently solves PDEs on general geometries through stable latent-space construction. At its core is CoTAP (Cross-scale Optimal Transport Assignment and Projection), a novel latent-space construction method that formulates cross-space assignment between adjacent spaces as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, thereby constructing balanced bidirectional projections and stable latent spaces. CoTAP also ensures stable information transfer across multiple latent spaces, further enabling multiscale architectures on general geometries, which in turn support more efficient learning of long-range physical interactions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MoNo outperforms existing state-of-the-art neural operators in both prediction performance and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/ZijiangY1116/MoNo.

</details>


### [409] [Satellite Trajectory Optimization via Proximal Policy Optimization for Space Debris Avoidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09628v1)
*Logan Luna,Juan Ortiz Couder,Raul Alejandro Vargas-Acosta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于强化学习（PPO）的自主卫星碰撞规避策略，并配套开源高保真天文动力学仿真器。在1000个确定性GEO轨道场景中，该方法达到97.5%的碰撞规避成功率，远超规则基基线（20.7%）和脉冲delta-v规划基线（27.5%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着巨型星座（megaconstellations）的大规模部署，LEO和GEO轨道拥堵加剧，碎片碰撞事件频发，合警报和碰撞风险日益增多。当前基于人工或规则的传统碰撞规避方法难以扩展应对这种日益恶化的动态环境，亟需可扩展的自主解决方案。

Method: 1) 使用Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)训练强化学习自主碰撞规避策略；2) 构建开源高保真天文动力学仿真器，采用含日月第三体摄动的牛顿两体动力学、燃料依赖推力及可配置碎片场；3) 使用课程学习（curriculum learning）和整形奖励（shaped rewards），奖励设计涵盖存活性、投影距离余量和delta-v节省；4) 评估采用完全确定性管线，含共享随机种子、逐集日志和遥测导出。

Result: 在1000个确定性GEO仿真场景中，强化学习代理实现97.5%碰撞规避成功率，超越规则基基线（20.7%）和脉冲delta-v规划基线（27.5%）的显著优势。

Conclusion: 提出的强化学习自主碰撞规避方法在GEO场景中展现出远超传统方法的性能，且提供公开可复现的框架，为轨道拥挤环境下的可扩展碰撞规避提供了新路径。

Abstract: Collision avoidance systems are commonly used to avoid fragmentation events occurring in Low-Earth Orbit (LEO) and Geosynchronous Equatorial Orbit (GEO). However, these events have been growing in frequency as orbital congestion worsens with the launch of megaconstellations. Consequently, conjunction alerts and collision risks are becoming increasingly common. Current practices, which are commonly manual or rule-based, have difficulty scaling to these worsening dynamic environments. To address this intensifying situation, we propose a reinforcement-learning policy for autonomous collision avoidance, trained via Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) along with an open-source, high-fidelity astrodynamics simulator for training and evaluation. In 1,000 deterministic GEO episodes, our agent achieves a 97.5% collision avoidance success rate, outperforming traditional controllers such as a rule-based baseline (20.7% success) and an impulsive delta-v planner baseline (27.5% success). To achieve these results, we designed a simulator to train and evaluate our agent, using real-world and simulated debris. We simulate Newtonian two-body dynamics using Sun/Moon third-body perturbations, fuel-dependent thrust, and configurable debris fields. The agent is trained with curriculum learning and shaped rewards oriented toward encouraging survival, adequate projected miss distance, and delta-v conservation. Finally, our evaluation consisted of a fully deterministic pipeline, including shared seeds, per-episode logs, and telemetry exports. Our work is a publicly available framework at https://purl.org/sat-trajectory-avoidance

</details>


### [410] [Physics-Informed Machine Learning in Prognostics and Health Management: A Systematic Literature Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10047v1)
*Christopher Braun,Julian Raible,Marco F. Huber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过系统文献综述（212项研究）考察了物理信息机器学习（PIML）在预测与健康管理（PHM）中的应用，提出四类归类方案（观测偏差、归纳偏差、学习偏差和混合方法），发现PIML在各类方法中通常优于传统基线，但文献严重偏向锂离子电池和轴承，且对部分声称优势缺乏充分证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯数据驱动的机器学习模型在PHM应用中存在泛化能力差、无法推断因果关系、缺乏可解释性等固有局限；PIML通过将先验物理知识融入ML流程来缓解这些问题，但对其在PHM中的系统化应用现状缺乏全面梳理。

Method: 对212项研究进行系统文献综述；提出包含观测偏差（observational bias）、归纳偏差（inductive bias）、学习偏差（learning bias）和混合方法（hybrid approaches）的四类分类体系，并按PHM任务类别进一步对研究进行划分。

Result: 四类方法在多种资产上均一致表现出优于传统基线的预测性能，但文献高度集中于锂离子电池和轴承，且以特定问题解决方案为主；物理信息方法确实带来实际效益，但关于改善某些局限性的声称缺乏充分证据支持。

Conclusion: 未来研究应优先关注可迁移的设计模式、比较不同集成策略的基准测试，以及开发轻量级、鲁棒性强的面向在线部署的不确定性感知模型。

Abstract: In modern industry, keeping complex systems reliable, safe, and efficient hinges on Prognostics and Health Management (PHM). Machine Learning (ML) has largely driven advancements in diagnostics and prognostics, yet purely data-driven models face inherent limitations, such as poor generalization, an inability to infer causal relationships, and a lack of interpretability. Physics-Informed Machine Learning (PIML) helps mitigate these limitations by incorporating prior physical knowledge directly into the ML pipeline, thereby fostering growing interest in its application to PHM. This work investigates how PIML is being leveraged in the context of PHM through a systematic literature review of 212 studies. The review introduces a four-class classification scheme, consisting of observational bias, inductive bias, learning bias, and hybrid approaches, and further categorizes studies by PHM task. Across all four classes, the reviewed studies consistently demonstrate improved predictive performance over conventional baselines across a broad range of assets, although the literature is heavily skewed toward lithium-ion batteries and bearings, and dominated by problem-specific solutions. Overall, the review indicates that physics-informed approaches already provide tangible benefits, whereas claims of improvements concerning some of the aforementioned limitations lack sufficient supporting evidence. Future research should prioritize transferable design patterns, benchmarks comparing integration strategies, and uncertainty-aware models that are lightweight and robust enough for online deployment in real-world settings.

</details>


### [411] [Generalized Convexity and Smoothness via Conjugate Duality: Optimization Theory for Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09523v1)
*Binchuan Qi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一的深度神经网络训练优化框架，通过Legendre函数和凸共轭推广经典的凸性和光滑性假设，引入\mathcal{H}(ψ)-凸性和\mathcal{H}(Ψ)-光滑性，统一了凸/非凸、光滑/非光滑目标，并在此基础上提出了广义梯度下降（GD）和广义随机梯度下降（SGD），理论上证明了广义GD的最优学习率恰为1，并深入分析了网络架构、批大小和模型容量对收敛的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典的优化理论无法完全解释DNN训练的成功，因为传统分析依赖于可微性、凸性或光滑性等假设，而DNN目标函数往往违反这些假设。作者希望建立一个统一的优化框架来弥合理论与实际之间的鸿沟。

Method: 通过Legendre函数和凸共轭将经典凸性和光滑性推广到更一般的\mathcal{H}(ψ)-凸性和\mathcal{H}(Ψ)-光滑性，揭示了广义光滑性与凸性之间的自然对偶关系。基于这些广义性质，通过凸共轭定义广义GD和广义SGD，并提出复合优化问题的重新表述。引入梯度相关因子和模型容量风险两个指标来刻画架构和训练配置对收敛的影响。

Result: 理论上证明了广义GD的最优学习率恰为1，并为两种优化器推导了基于梯度能量的收敛速率。在广泛的多架构、多数据集、多优化器和多损失函数的实验中验证了理论界，理论预测与经验训练动态高度吻合。

Conclusion: 通过统一的广义凸性与光滑性框架，该工作为DNN训练提供了从优化理论到经验验证的完整闭环，能够定量分析架构设计和训练配置对收敛行为的影响，为理解和改进深度学习的训练过程提供了新的理论工具。

Abstract: Deep neural network (DNN) training with stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants achieves strong empirical performance, yet classical optimization theory does not fully explain this success. This limitation arises because conventional analyses rely on assumptions such as differentiability, convexity, or smoothness, which are often violated by DNN objectives. In this paper, we establish a unified optimization framework for DNN training by generalizing classical convexity and smoothness through Legendre functions and convex conjugation. Specifically, we introduce $\mathcal{H}(ψ)$-convexity and $\mathcal{H}(Ψ)$-smoothness, which unify convex and non-convex as well as smooth and non-smooth objectives within a single formalism and reveal a natural duality between generalized smoothness and convexity. Building on these generalized properties, we introduce generalized gradient descent (GD) and generalized SGD through convex conjugation. We theoretically prove that generalized GD admits an optimal learning rate of exactly $1$, and derive rigorous gradient-energy-based convergence rates for both proposed optimizers. We further reformulate DNN training as a composite optimization problem, demonstrating that its convergence relies on jointly reducing the gradient energy and controlling the induced norm of the network Jacobian. To characterize the practical influences of network architectures and training configurations, we introduce the gradient correlation factor and model capacity risk, and quantitatively analyze how architectural designs, batch size, and model capacity shape training convergence. Extensive experiments across diverse network architectures, datasets, optimizers, and loss functions validate our theoretical bounds and demonstrate precise alignment between our theoretical predictions and empirical training dynamics.

</details>


### [412] [Imaginative Generative AI: Crossing the Entropy Wall into Worlds Beyond Imitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09385v2)
*Farzan Farnia,Hossein Goli,Amin Gohari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Imaginative Generative AI (IGA)框架，将多样性纳入目标分布设计问题：通过von Neumann熵（谱多样性）作为约束，在参照分布近邻中选择具有指定谱多样性水平的分布。低于数据熵墙（Entropy Wall）时进行多样性修复，高于熵墙时实现超越数据的想象性生成，形成从模仿到想象的统一正则化路径，并推导出适用于扩散模型的无重训练推理式采样方法（IGA Guidance）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式AI模型仅以模仿数据分布为目标，既不纠正生成器丢失的多样性，也未定义生成如何超越数据本身的多样性。传统目标函数无法将"多样性水平"作为可设计的目标属性。

Method: 以生成分布核协方差算子的von Neumann熵衡量谱多样性；在KL锚定到预训练生成器的约束下，在参照分布附近选择谱熵达到指定水平的分布；推导出最优解满足自洽指数倾斜（exponential-tilt）关系，由此得到IGA Guidance——无需重训练的推理时采样方法，适用于score-based、DDPM和DDIM等采样器。

Result: 在合成数据与视觉基准上，IGA在熵墙以下成功实现多样性修复（恢复生成器丢失的变化），在熵墙以上实现受控的谱外推（产生比数据更高的表示相对谱多样性）。

Conclusion: IGA将生成从"模仿"到"想象"统一为一条单一的正则化路径，任意指定多样性水平都对应一个明确的目标i.i.d.分布，提供了可操作的想象性生成定义与配套采样算法。

Abstract: Generative AI models are primarily designed to imitate the data distribution, an objective that neither corrects diversity lost by a learned generator nor defines how generation should extend beyond the diversity of the data itself. We introduce Imaginative Generative AI (IGA), a framework that makes diversity part of the target-distribution design problem: among distributions close to a reference, IGA selects one whose spectral diversity reaches a prescribed level. Diversity is measured by the von Neumann entropy of the generated distribution's kernel covariance operator in a fixed representation space, providing a reference-free representation-guided measure of how broadly probability mass occupies embedding directions. The spectral entropy of the population data distribution defines an Entropy Wall. Below the wall, IGA performs diversity repair, recovering variation that a learned generator has lost while remaining within the diversity level of the data. Beyond the wall, the data distribution itself becomes infeasible, and IGA deliberately departs from it to produce distributions with greater representation-relative spectral diversity, an operational notion of imaginative generation. These regimes form a single regularization path from imitation to imagination and define an i.i.d. target distribution at each prescribed diversity level. We develop the theory of this entropy-constrained projection and show that, under a KL anchor to a pretrained generator, the optimum satisfies a self-consistent exponential-tilt relation. This characterization leads to IGA Guidance, a retraining-free inference-time method for score-based and diffusion models, including DDPM and DDIM samplers. Experiments on synthetic and vision benchmarks demonstrate diversity repair below the Entropy Wall and controlled spectral extrapolation beyond it.

</details>


### [413] [DOCSCHISEL: Adaptive Tool Documentation Optimization Framework for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10037v1)
*You Lu,Kun Zhang,Bihuan Chen,Xin Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过大规模实证研究发现，LLM代理的工具文档在不同信息字段上存在显著异质性，且不同字段的有效性高度依赖于任务域、LLM骨干和代理范式，没有固定的工具文档能通用。为此提出DocsChisel，一个自适应工具文档优化框架，通过分析失败执行轨迹识别文档相关的问题，并迭代地增删精炼每个工具的信息字段，相比基线任务成功率提升95.89%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注提升LLM代理的工具使用能力，但将工具文档视为固定输入。虽然近期有少量工作尝试通过重写或压缩优化工具文档，但人们对工具文档中信息如何影响不同设置下的代理性能知之甚少，缺乏系统性理解。

Method: 首先进行大规模实证研究，揭示现有工具文档信息字段的异质性及不同字段在不同任务域、LLM骨干和代理范式下的效果差异。基于此提出DocsChisel框架：分析目标LLM代理的失败执行轨迹以识别文档相关问题，并通过添加、移除和精炼每个工具的信息字段来迭代优化工具文档。

Result: DocsChisel相比原始工具文档将LLM代理任务成功率提升95.89%，相较现有基线（EasyTool和DRAFT）平均提升75.15%，同时仅产生有限的优化时间和token开销。

Conclusion: 固定工具文档无法在所有代理设置下泛化，文档优化需要考虑任务域、LLM骨干和代理范式的特异性。DocsChisel通过基于失败轨迹的自适应迭代优化方式，能够高效地提升LLM代理的工具使用性能，验证了自适应文档优化路线的有效性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on external tools to accomplish complex real-world tasks, making tool documentation a critical grounding resource for LLM agents. Existing studies mainly focus on improving the tool-use capabilities of LLM agents, while largely treating tool documentation as a fixed input. Although several recent works attempt to optimize tool documentation through rewriting or compression, little is known about how the information contained in tool documentation affects agent performance across different settings. To bridge this gap, we conduct a large-scale empirical study on tool documentation for LLM agents. Our study reveals substantial heterogeneity in the information fields provided by existing tool documentation. Moreover, the effectiveness of different information fields is highly dependent on the task domain, LLM backbone, and agent paradigm, indicating that no fixed tool documentation can consistently generalize across diverse agent settings. Motivated by these findings, we propose DocsChisel, an adaptive tool documentation optimization framework for LLM agents. DocsChisel analyzes failed execution traces of a target LLM agent to identify documentation-related issues, and iteratively optimizes tool documentation by adding, removing, and refining information fields for each tool. We evaluate DocsChisel against two state-of-the-art baselines, i.e., EasyTool and DRAFT. Experimental results show that DocsChisel improves the task success rate of LLM agents by 95.89% over the original tool documentation and by 75.15%, on average, over existing baselines, while incurring limited optimization time and token overhead

</details>


### [414] [Online Learning of Scale Parameters in Score-Driven Filters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09218v1)
*Fabrizio Lillo,Giulia Livieri,Gianluca Palmari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将得分驱动滤波器中的增益视为决策变量，研究其在线学习问题。在给定当前状态下，每个可行增益诱导一个可达的下一个状态和一步超前预测密度，因此增益选择可被视为一个以KL散度为目标的条件预测决策问题。作者建立了几何与持久性机制下的镜像更新动态遗憾界，并通过模拟和股票指数波动率面板数据展示了有界镜像增益通常优于或持平于常数增益，且避免了无界指数链接的极端尖峰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 得分驱动滤波器（如Score-driven filters）中，增益（gain）控制着更新幅度，其选择直接影响滤波与预测性能。然而增益通常被当作超参数固定设置，缺乏系统的在线学习方法。本文旨在将增益视为可学习的决策变量，从在线学习与统计决策的视角建立理论框架。

Method: 作者将增益选择建模为条件预测决策问题，目标为Kullback-Leibler损失。标量无缩放增益下，连续分数的负原始乘积构成该损失的随机梯度；正aGAS缩放仅对有效步长进行重缩放。单调可微的增益链接诱导有界增益域上的镜像下降几何，而持久性（persistence）产生向参考增益的Bregman拉力。在凸性、紧致性与正则性条件下，建立投影与折扣镜像更新的动态遗憾界。

Result: 模拟结果展示了缩放、链接几何、持久性以及坐标传输速率的作用。基于股票指数波动率的样本外面板数据表明，有界镜像增益通常匹配或优于常数增益，同时避免了无界指数链接的极端尖峰；在多危机市场中改善最为显著。

Conclusion: 该研究为得分驱动滤波器的增益提供了在线学习的理论框架与算法支撑，证明了镜像更新策略在实践中既能保持稳健性（避免极端尖峰）又能获得较好的预测性能，特别在数据动荡的多危机时期优势明显。

Abstract: Score-driven filters multiply a scaled log-likelihood score by a gain that controls the update magnitude. We treat this gain as a decision variable and study its online learning. Conditional on the current state, observation, score, and scaling rule, each admissible gain induces a reachable next state and a one-step-ahead predictive density: scalar gains govern distance along a line, while diagonal gains govern coordinatewise transmission. Gain selection is therefore a conditional predictive decision problem with a Kullback-Leibler objective. For a scalar unscaled gain, the negative raw product of consecutive scores is the stochastic gradient of this loss; positive aGAS scaling only rescales the effective step. Monotone differentiable gain links induce mirror-descent geometries on bounded gain domains, while persistence yields a Bregman pull towards a reference gain. Under convexity, compactness, and regularity conditions, we establish dynamic-regret bounds for projected and discounted mirror updates relative to time-varying, current-information comparators. Simulations illustrate the roles of scaling, link geometry, persistence, and coordinatewise transmission rates. An out-of-sample panel of equity-index volatilities shows that the bounded mirror gain generally matches or outperforms a constant gain while avoiding the extreme spikes of a nominally unbounded exponential link, with the strongest improvements observed in multi-crisis markets.

</details>


### [415] [Real Data Closes Synthetic-to-Real Gap in Optical Chemical Structure Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09100v1)
*Yani Guan,Dengpan Dong,Zi Wei,Shuang Luo,Dan Hannah,Yumin Zhang,Kang Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了光学化学结构识别（OCSR）在真实文档上的性能瓶颈。通过在混合合成渲染与标注真实图像的数据上微调21个识别器，发现标注真实训练图像是性能提升的最大驱动因素：Qwen2.5-VL在ACS基准上精确匹配率从无真实数据时的0.15提升到50.2%真实数据时的0.46。vision-tower LoRA的效果高度依赖基座模型（对Qwen无效，对InternVL3-8B提升显著，对GLM-4.1V中等）。最佳配置在clean renders上达0.96精确匹配，在ACS、CLEF-IP、UOB、USPTO上分别为0.49/0.65/0.84/0.76。基座模型间的性能差距随真实数据比例增加而缩小（70%时仅0.06）并改变排名，需联合选择基座模型与数据配比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OCSR在合成图像上看似已解决（Qwen2.5-VL-7B在合成渲染上超91%精度），但在真实文档上性能骤降（真实基准上不足16%）。作者旨在识别导致这一巨大差距的主要改进来源，并探究基座模型、真实训练数据比例和视觉塔适配策略对性能的影响。

Method: 在21个识别器上开展系统消融实验：基座VLM包括Qwen2.5-VL、InternVL3-8B、GLM-4.1V-9B；控制合成渲染结构图像与标注真实专利/期刊/手绘结构图像的混合比例（从0%到50.2%等）；变视觉塔适配策略（是否使用vision-tower LoRA）。同时进行跨化学领域的小规模验证实验（手写图像到LaTeX识别、图表到表格转换）。

Result: ①真实训练数据比例是最大影响因素：ACS上Qwen从0.15→0.37（9.5%真实数据）→0.46（50.2%）；三个基座模型均复现该趋势。②vision-tower LoRA效果依基座而异：Qwen无影响(+0.00, p=1.00)，InternVL3-8B提升+22.8~34.6pt，GLM-4.1V-9B提升+1.0~9.6pt。③最佳配置：clean renders上0.96精确匹配，ACS/CLEF-IP/UOB/USPTO上分别为0.49/0.65/0.84/0.76。④基座模型差距从无真实数据的0.21缩小到70%真实数据时的0.06，排名发生重排。

Conclusion: 视觉结构识别系统不能仅以合成图像性能来评判；真实标注数据是弥合sim-to-real差距的关键，且基座模型与真实数据配比必须联合选择而非独立优化。适配策略（如vision-tower LoRA）的价值高度依赖具体基座模型。这一规律也推广到化学之外的视觉结构识别任务（手写公式、图表解析），建议建模与适配选择应直接在目标任务上进行评估。

Abstract: Millions of chemical structures appear in patents and papers only as drawings, and using that information at scale requires reading the drawings. OCSR appears nearly solved on synthetic images yet remains difficult on real documents: the starting recognizer, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, exceeds 91% accuracy on synthetic renders but falls below 16% on three real-world benchmarks (ACS, CLEF-IP, USPTO). To identify the main source of improvement, 21 recognizers were fine-tuned on mixtures of synthetically rendered structures and labeled real depictions from patents, journal figures, and hand-drawn collections, varying the vision language model (VLM) base, the fraction of real training data, and the vision-tower adaptation strategy. Labeled real training images make the largest difference. For Qwen2.5-VL, ACS exact match rises from 0.15 with no real data to 0.37 at 9.5% and 0.46 at 50.2%; a controlled experiment across three base models reproduces the trend. A vision-tower LoRA, in contrast, does nothing for Qwen (+0.00, paired p=1.00), substantially helps InternVL3-8B (+22.8 to +34.6 pt), and modestly helps GLM-4.1V-9B (+1.0 to +9.6 pt), so its value depends on the base model. The best configuration reaches 0.96 exact match on clean renders and 0.49, 0.65, 0.84, and 0.76 on ACS, CLEF-IP, UOB, and USPTO, respectively. Gaps between base models are largest without real data (0.21), shrink to 0.06 at 70% real data, and reorder the ranking; base model and real-data mixture must therefore be selected together. Small-scale experiments on handwritten image-to-LaTeX recognition and chart-to-table conversion show that base-model rankings also vary beyond chemistry. More generally, model and adaptation choices for visual structure recognition should be evaluated on the target task.

</details>


### [416] [Twin Rollouts: Noise-Coupled Counterfactual Branching in Interactive Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08982v1)
*Yu Ma,Hongli Shi,Xinran Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在自回归视频世界模型的rollout内部进行反事实生成的理论框架。通过将事实分支与外生噪声序列耦合，以及利用自生成轨迹的精确外生噪声（使Pearl反事实程序中的abduction步骤精确成立），引入时空局部性度量来验证最小变更原则，并利用模拟器状态分岔生成可验证的奖励信号用于后训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的交互式视频世界模型虽然能够根据动作流自回归地生成rollout，但几乎全部聚焦于事实性预测，缺乏对反事实推理的支持。传统反事实生成方案（如图像编辑管线）面临外生噪声近似反演的问题，且最小变更原则难以被逐样本验证。本文旨在填补这一空白，建立一个无需学习判别器、可基于模拟器真值验证的反事实框架。

Method: 1) 形式化噪声耦合孪生rollout：事实分支与反事实分支共享已生成前缀和未来的外生噪声序列，仅在中途干预点之后的动作流上分叉。2) 由于事实分支是模型自生成的，其外生噪声可直接精确获得，使Pearl反事实程序中的abduction步骤精确而非近似。3) 提出时空局部性度量，基于模拟器真值计算，惩罚干预因果后裔之外的区域发散，将最小变更原则转化为逐样本可验证的属性。4) 在干预点分岔模拟器状态以获得真值反事实渲染，用作后训练的可验证奖励。

Result: 论文目前处于框架建立阶段，完成了形式化框架、度量定义与定位说明，实验结果尚未公布（论文指出experiments are forthcoming）。核心贡献在于理论上论证了在自生成轨迹场景下，反事实推理的abduction步骤可以精确求解，且通过噪声耦合实现了无需学习评判者的可验证性。

Conclusion: 本文为视频世界模型的反事实生成奠定了理论基础，通过噪声耦合巧妙地绕过了传统编辑管线中外生噪声近似反演的难题，并提供了基于模拟器真值的验证与奖励机制。未来实验将验证该框架在实际视频世界模型上的效果。

Abstract: Interactive video world models generate rollouts autoregressively under an action stream, yet they are trained and evaluated almost exclusively on factual prediction. We study counterfactual generation inside the rollout: given a trajectory the model has itself generated, what would have happened had the actions differed from step t* onward? We formalize noise-coupled twin rollouts --- a factual and a counterfactual branch sharing the generated prefix and the future exogenous noise sequence, diverging only in the action stream at an intervention point. Because the factual branch is self-generated, its exogenous noise is known exactly: the abduction step of Pearl's counterfactual procedure is exact by construction, sidestepping the approximate-inversion problem faced by editing-based pipelines. Noise coupling further turns the minimal-change principle into a per-sample verifiable property: we define a spatiotemporal locality metric that penalizes divergence outside the causal descendants of the intervention, computable against simulator ground truth without a learned judge. Forking the simulator state at t* yields ground-truth counterfactual re-renders, which we use as verifiable rewards for post-training. This note establishes the formal framework, metric definitions, and positioning; experiments are forthcoming.

</details>


### [417] [Math-Vision Diagrams: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Mathematical Diagram Generation Capabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08964v1)
*Harish Kashyap,Kiran Byadarhaly,Sriram Chakaravarthy,Sanyukta Tuti,Aryan Mistry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Math-Vision Diagrams，这是首个专门用于评估大语言模型（LLM）数学图表生成能力的基准测试，也是首个在同一统一框架下同时评估文本到代码和文本到图像两种生成范式的基准。该基准从Math-Vision中精选了2920个高质量竞赛问题图像，并提出了结合LLM集成与领域专家（SME）审核的新型流水线及一套评估指标。实验表明，领先的LLM在数学图表生成方面仍存在显著困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数学精确图表生成是LLM的一个关键但尚未充分探索的能力，对课程准备、问题集自动化排序和科学出版等领域有重要意义。然而，现有的基准如MathVision、MathVista主要面向数学推理，DiagramGenBenchmark和MermaidSeqBench面向通用图表生成，均未提供标准化的提示-图像对来专门评估LLM的数学图表生成能力。

Method: 该工作从Math-Vision基准中选取3040张图像中的2920张来自高质量竞赛问题且具有必要视觉上下文的图像，构建了首个数学图表生成基准。提出了一个结合LLM集成与领域专家（SME）人工审核的新颖数据流水线，并设计了一套评估指标体系，可同时评估文本到代码和文本到图像两种生成范式，且与底层编码语言或模型类型无关。

Result: 通过在该基准上测试多个领先的LLM模型，实验结果表明当前LLM在数学图表生成任务上表现不佳，揭示了这一能力上的显著短板。

Conclusion: Math-Vision Diagrams填补了数学图表生成评估基准的空白，证明了现有LLM在该任务上仍需大幅改进。所有代码、数据、筛选流水线和评估脚本将完全开源，为后续研究提供标准化评估工具。

Abstract: The generation of mathematically precise diagrams from tex- tual prompts has emerged as a critical yet underexplored capability of Large Language Models (LLMs). This has been of interest to researchers in the areas of curriculum preparation, automated ranking of problem sets, and scientific publishing. For LLMs to achieve this, it requires per- fect coordination between Spatial Reasoning, Mathematical Reasoning, and Rendering systems. While existing benchmarks such as MathVision, MathVista are built for Math Reasoning or DiagramGenBenchmark, Mer- maidSeqBench on general purpose diagram generation, no prior work provides a standardized set of prompt, image pairs that can be used to evaluate the LLMs specifically on math diagram generation. This includes fields that span both both text-to-code and text-to-image paradigms. We introduce Math-Vision Diagrams, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate LLMs on mathematical diagram generation, and the first to assess text-to-code and text-to-image generation paradigms together in a single unified setting, agnostic of the underlying coding lan- guage or model type. Building on the Math-Vision benchmark, we select a subset of 2920 images out of 3040 from high-quality competition problems with essential visual context. A novel pipeline combining an ensemble of LLMs with Subject Matter Expert (SME) curation is presented, together with a suite of evaluation metrics. Testing several leading models against this benchmark, we demonstrate that LLMs struggle with math diagram generation. All code, data, curation pipeline, and evaluation scripts will be fully open-sourced.

</details>


### [418] [Hybrid Neural-Classical Correction for Frozen Time Series Foundation Models: A Comprehensive Ablation Study on High-Frequency Stock Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08825v1)
*Kasun Dewage,Suranadi De Silva,Shankhadeep Mondal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了将冻结的TimesFM（200M参数）基础时间序列模型通过"神经-经典混合校正"框架适配到高频金融（股票开盘小时内回报预测）任务。比较了两种神经校正架构（AttnCorrect约471K参数与GatedLinear约49K参数），并结合随机森林残差学习，在10只科技股、200万数据点上进行消融实验。结果表明，混合方法相比冻结TimesFM提升池化相关系数至0.597，日均相关性提升6.4倍；经典残差学习（随机森林）贡献最大，简单神经架构在去除经典组件后反而更优，GatedLinear+RF以少9倍的神经参数实现最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础时间序列模型（如TimesFM）虽然在零样本泛化上表现出色，但在高频金融等专业领域往往表现不佳。现有研究缺乏对如何有效适配冻结的基础模型到金融领域系统性的方法与分析，因此需要对神经-经典混合校正策略进行深入研究，以指导基础模型在实际金融场景中的部署。

Method: 采用冻结TimesFM作为基础模型，在其之上设计两种神经校正架构：AttnCorrect（多头自注意力，约471K参数）和GatedLinear（低秩双线性投影+门控，约49K参数），两种架构均额外结合随机森林（Random Forest）进行残差学习。在10只大型科技股共200万个数据点上进行系统消融实验，并采用三种互补的相关系数指标（日均、跨日累积、池化）进行全面评估。

Result: 混合神经-经典方法达到0.597的池化相关系数，比冻结TimesFM提升6.4倍日均相关性。随机森林残差学习是单一组件中贡献最大的部分，其效果等同于甚至超过神经校正组件。在去除经典残差学习后，简单神经架构反而优于复杂架构。自注意力提供了神经组件中最大的独立贡献。GatedLinear+RF以比AttnCorrect+RF少9倍的神经参数实现了最佳整体性能。

Conclusion: 有效的基础模型领域适配需要精心整合神经与经典组件，二者相辅相成而非互相替代。经典方法（随机森林）在金融高频场景中扮演着关键的互补角色，且简单神经架构配合经典残差学习可以达到优于复杂架构的效果，同时大幅降低参数开销。

Abstract: Foundation models for time series forecasting demonstrate impressive zero-shot generalization but often underperform on specialized domains such as high-frequency finance. We present a comprehensive study of hybrid neural-classical correction for adapting frozen TimesFM (200M parameters) to stock return prediction during the volatile opening trading hour. We compare two neural correction architectures - AttnCorrect (multi-head self-attention, approximately 471K parameters) and GatedLinear (low-rank bilinear projection with gating, approximately 49K parameters) - each augmented with Random Forest residual learning. Through systematic ablation across 10 major technology stocks (NVDA, MSFT, AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL, AMZN, META, AVGO, TSLA, NFLX) spanning 2 million data points, we reveal critical insights: (1) The hybrid neural-classical approach achieves 0.597 pooled correlation and 6.4x mean per-day correlation improvement over frozen TimesFM; (2) Classical residual learning (Random Forest) provides the largest single-component contribution, matching or exceeding the neural correction component; (3) Simpler neural architectures surprisingly outperform complex ones when classical residual learning is removed; (4) Self-attention provides the largest neural-only contribution. GatedLinear+RF achieves best overall performance with 9x fewer neural parameters than AttnCorrect+RF. We report three complementary correlation metrics - mean per-day, cross-day cumulative, and pooled - to provide a complete picture of predictive quality. Our results provide practical guidance: effective foundation model adaptation requires careful integration of neural and classical components, with classical methods playing a crucial complementary role.

</details>


### [419] [Loss-Resilient Wireless Video Token Communication over Block Fading Channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08698v1)
*Bingyan Xie,Yongjeong Oh,Zihan Chen,Jihong Park,Yongpeng Wu,Wenjun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种抗丢包的无线视频Token通信框架WVTC，通过Token重要性评估、shuffled混合I/P-Token分组打包、基于信道状态的在线调度以及微调的detokenizer重建，在块衰落导致的丢包场景下实现了更优的感知质量与更平缓的性能退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频Token通信将视频内容表示为离散Token，但不同Token对重建的重要性不同且存在时间依赖。无线传输中的块衰落会导致多个重要或相关Token同时丢失，严重损害视频重建质量。现有方法未有效解决该问题。

Method: 1) 从Token内在预测结构评估重要性：结构I-token赋予高优先级，P-token重要性由时间邻域新颖度衡量；2) shuffled混合I/P-token分组打包方案，将结构锚点和相关时间区域分散到不同数据包；3) 仅基于当前块信道状态信息的在线调度器，综合考量包重要性密度、MCS相关解码可靠性、块容量和重要性集中度来分配数据包到衰落块；4) 接收端使用微调的detokenizer从幸存Token中重建缺失内容，无需重传。

Result: 数值实验表明，所提方法在递增丢包率下实现了更优的感知质量和更平滑的性能退化。

Conclusion: 通过Token级别的智能感知与调度，WVTC框架有效缓解了无线视频Token通信中块衰落导致的关联丢失问题，为面向语义感知的无线视频传输提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Video token communication represents video content as discrete tokens that differ in their importance to reconstruction and exhibit temporal dependencies. When these tokens are packetized for wireless transmission, block fading can cause multiple important or correlated tokens to be lost together, severely degrading video reconstruction. To address this issue, we propose a loss-resilient wireless video token communication (WVTC) framework. WVTC evaluates token importance from the intrinsic predictive structure of video tokens, assigning high priority to structural I-tokens and measuring P-token importance by temporal neighborhood novelty. A shuffled mixed I/P-token packetization scheme disperses structural anchors and correlated temporal regions across packets. Using only current block channel state information, an online scheduler jointly considers packet importance density, MCS-dependent decoding reliability, block capacity, and importance concentration when allocating packets to fading blocks. At the receiver, a fine-tuned detokenizer reconstructs missing content from surviving tokens without retransmission. Numerical results demonstrate improved perceptual quality and more graceful degradation under increasing packet error rates.

</details>


### [420] [FSTC-Encoder: Feature--Spatial--Temporal Correlation Learning for Generalizable RF Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08439v1)
*Jing Wang,Zhu Wang,Changlong Cheng,Yifan Guo,Yin Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FSTC-Encoder，通过特征、空间和时间的相关性建模统一异构RF感知表示学习，在不同设备、环境和RF模态间保持单一骨干架构，在多个基准上实现高领域鲁棒性、任务泛化性和模态可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构RF感知在特征结构、空间布局和时间尺度上差异显著，导致现有模型难以跨设备、环境和RF模态复用。需要一个统一的表示学习框架来弥合这些差异，实现跨场景泛化。

Method: FSTC-Encoder通过三个模块实现统一表示学习：结构感知特征编码适应不同信号结构；基于集合的空间编码聚合可变观测；层次化时间编码同时捕捉局部变化和长程依赖。骨干网络在不同感知任务和模态间保持不变，仅需调整特征配置和任务头。

Result: 在Widar3.0、CSI-Bench和XRF55上多因素跨域协议下达到92.15%平均准确率；在四个额外感知任务中三项排名第一；在WiFi、毫米波雷达和RFID上持续表现稳定；通过跨RF学习将跨模态性能差距从18.85%降至12.93%。

Conclusion: FSTC-Encoder证明了统一异构RF感知表示学习的可行性，实现了高领域鲁棒性、任务泛化性和模态可扩展性，为RF感知领域提供了一种通用的骨干架构方案。

Abstract: Heterogeneous RF sensing differs substantially in feature structure, spatial layout, and temporal scale, making existing models difficult to reuse across devices, environments, and RF modalities. We propose FSTC-Encoder, which unifies heterogeneous RF representation learning through feature, spatial, and temporal correlation modeling. Structure-aware feature encoding accommodates different signal structures, set-based spatial encoding aggregates variable observations, and hierarchical temporal encoding jointly captures local variations and long-range dependencies. Across sensing tasks and modalities, FSTC-Encoder retains the same spatial--temporal backbone architecture while varying only the feature configuration and task head. Across Widar3.0, CSI-Bench, and XRF55, FSTC-Encoder achieves 92.15% mean Accuracy under multi-factor cross-domain protocols, ranks first on three of four additional sensing tasks, remains consistently strong across WiFi, millimeter-wave radar, and RFID, and reduces the cross-modality performance gap from 18.85% to 12.93% through cross-RF learning. These results demonstrate that FSTC-Encoder achieves high domain robustness, task generality, and modality extensibility.

</details>


### [421] [FreSH: Frequency-Segmented Hierarchical Multi-Expert Framework for Multivariate Time Series Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08207v1)
*Pingping Liu,Muyao Wang,Zijian Zhang,Tongshun Zhang,Hao Miao,Guorui Xie,Qingliang Li,Qiuzhan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FreSH是一个面向多变量时间序列分类的频域分段层次化多专家框架，通过自适应多尺度分析、局部专家专业化与全局上下文建模的协同、自适应融合策略以及更稳健的优化目标，在30个UEA基准数据集和真实振动数据上超越SOTA方法，同时显著降低模型尺寸并提升计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多变量时间序列分类方法难以在捕捉多尺度复杂时间模式、处理类不平衡问题以及满足计算效率约束之间取得良好平衡，尤其是在细粒度表征学习方面存在明显不足。

Method: FreSH采用频域分段的层次化多专家架构，将时间信号按频率划分为多个片段，每个专家局部专精于特定频段的特征提取，同时通过全局上下文建模进行互补协调；引入自适应融合策略动态强调输入中最具信息量的成分，并采用更稳健的优化目标以提升在不同样本难度和类别分布下的学习稳定性。

Result: 在30个UEA基准数据集和真实世界振动数据的广泛实验中，FreSH在分类准确率上一致优于现有最先进方法，同时大幅减少了模型尺寸并提高了计算效率。

Conclusion: FreSH通过频域分段的多专家架构成功兼顾了强表征能力与计算效率，验证了将局部专业化与全局上下文建模相结合、辅以自适应融合和稳健优化目标的有效性，为多变量时间序列分类提供了一种新范式。

Abstract: Multivariate Time Series Classification (MTSC) demands models that can effectively capture complex temporal patterns across multiple scales while remaining computationally efficient. However, existing approaches generally struggle to reconcile fine-grained representation learning, especially under class imbalance and real-world constraints. In this paper, we present FreSH, a Frequency-Segmented Hierarchical Multi-Expert Framework designed to address these challenges. FreSH introduces a new perspective for MTSC by enabling adaptive, multi-scale analysis of temporal signals, allowing different aspects of the data to be modeled in a complementary and coordinated manner. By combining localized specialization with holistic context modeling, FreSH achieves strong representational capacity without incurring excessive computational overhead. An adaptive fusion strategy further enhances flexibility, enabling the model to dynamically emphasize the most informative components of the input. In addition, we incorporate a more robust optimization objective that improves learning stability across varying sample difficulties and class distributions. Extensive evaluations on 30 UEA benchmark datasets and real-world vibration data demonstrate that FreSH consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in classification accuracy, while substantially reducing model size and efficiency.

</details>


### [422] [CLAM: Causal Spatial Disaggregation to Infer Local Effects From Coarse Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08064v1)
*Gerrit Großmann,Sumantrak Mukherjee,Sebastian J. Vollmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CLAM方法，利用高分辨率上下文协变量，从粗粒度观测数据中联合学习因果机制与分解映射，实现局部因果效应的估计、反事实推理和结果分解，适用于公共卫生与环境政策等存在局部异质性的领域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从粗分辨率数据中学习细粒度空间模式具有挑战性，尤其在因果设置中，高分辨率效应必须从聚合的干预和结果中推断。已有方法将因果机制学习与分解映射分开处理，会遗漏两者间的交互信息。

Method: CLAM通过联合学习因果机制和分解映射，利用调节因果效应的细粒度上下文协变量，捕捉独立处理这两个问题时被遗漏的交互，实现局部效应估计、反事实推理和原则性的结果分解。

Result: 该方法能够在多种不同设置下可靠地捕获随空间变化的因果效应。

Conclusion: CLAM对粗粒度观测下的局部因果推断有效，尤其在公共卫生和环境政策等决策在宏观尺度制定但存在显著局部异质性的应用场景中具有重要价值。

Abstract: Learning fine-grained spatial patterns from coarse-resolution data is challenging, especially in causal settings where high-resolution effects must be inferred from aggregated interventions and outcomes. We introduce CLAM, a method for estimating localized causal effects from coarse observations by exploiting high-resolution contextual covariates that modulate these effects. By jointly learning the causal mechanism and a disaggregation mapping, CLAM captures interactions that are missed when addressing these problems independently. The method supports localized effect estimation, counterfactual reasoning, and principled outcome disaggregation, and reliably captures spatially varying causal effects across diverse settings. This is particularly relevant for applications such as public health and environmental policy, where decisions are made at broad scales despite substantial local heterogeneity. Code is available at https://github.com/gerritgr/clam

</details>


### [423] [Ground-Truth Neighborhood Regularization for Reinforcement Learning Post-Training of Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08010v1)
*Jianqi Zhang,Xingyu Zhang,Zeen Song,Changwen Zheng,Fanjiang Xu,Wenwen Qiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为Ground-Truth Neighborhood Regularization (GTN-R)的正则化方法，用于解决时间序列基础模型在强化学习后训练中出现的"次优崩溃"问题——即模型输出分布逐渐偏离真实值。GTN-R利用真实值作为参考定位高质量区域，引导模型概率质量向真实值邻域集中，从而提高高质量轨迹采样概率，改善预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）通过RL后训练可进一步提升下游任务性能，但作者发现RL后训练在部分预测区域会使模型输出分布逐渐偏离真实值（称为"次优崩溃"），限制模型性能提升。分析表明，初始阶段难以在真实值附近采样到高质量轨迹是重要原因。

Method: 提出Ground-Truth Neighborhood Regularization (GTN-R)：以真实值作为参考定位高质量区域，将模型的概率质量引导至真实值邻域。该方法作为正则化项可灵活集成到多种RL方法中用于TSFM后训练。

Result: 大量实验证明了GTN-R的有效性，能够缓解次优崩溃并提升TSFM在RL后训练中的预测性能。

Conclusion: GTN-R是一种通用的、可插拔的正则化方法，可有效解决TSFM在RL后训练中因次优崩溃导致的性能瓶颈，为RL后训练范式在时间序列预测中的落地提供了重要改进方案。

Abstract: Time series forecasting (TSF) plays an important role in a wide range of real-world applications. Recently, time series foundation models (TSFMs), pretrained on large-scale datasets, have demonstrated strong generalization capabilities and emerged as an important paradigm for TSF. Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has consequently attracted growing attention as a means of further improving their performance on downstream tasks. However, we find that, in certain forecast regions, RL post-training may gradually shift the output distributions of TSFMs away from the ground truth, thereby limiting their performance. We refer to this phenomenon as \textbf{suboptimal collapse}. Our analysis suggests that difficulty in initially sampling high-quality trajectories near the ground truth is an important contributing factor to suboptimal collapse. To address this issue, we propose Ground-Truth Neighborhood Regularization (GTN-R) for RL post-training of TSFMs. GTN-R uses the ground truth as a reference for locating high-quality regions and guides the model's probability mass toward the ground-truth neighborhood. This increases the probability of sampling high-quality trajectories, mitigates suboptimal collapse, and improves performance. Moreover, GTN-R can be flexibly integrated into various RL methods for TSFMs. Extensive experiments show its effectiveness.

</details>


### [424] [ZeroLock: Concurrent Memory-Efficient LLM Training via Modular Update Decoupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07974v1)
*Wentao Dai,Xuanran Li,Yuxiang Zhang,Ming Tang,Chao Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ZeroLock，一种无反向传播（BP-free）的边缘端 LLM 微调算法，通过局部目标构造将模型更新解耦为独立的块更新，打破 BP 的更新锁定机制，在算法层面提升吞吐量并降低内存占用，同时提供了首个针对此类局部目标构造方法在通用模型块划分下的理论收敛性框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘端 LLM 微调在保护隐私的同时适配场景数据，但现有基于流水线并行的方法依赖 BP 训练，存在更新锁定（update locking）的根本缺陷，导致严重的吞吐量和内存瓶颈。因此需要一种无 BP 的算法来突破这些限制。

Method: ZeroLock 通过局部目标构造将模型更新解耦为独立的块更新，从而打破 BP 的更新锁定。作者将局部目标映射到全局目标，提供了首个针对此类方法在通用模型块划分下的理论框架，并证明了 ZeroLock 具有 O~(1/√T) 的收敛速率，与 BP 仅相差多项对数因子。同时设计了包含早期转发和故障恢复技术的完整系统，并构建了真实原型。

Result: 在真实原型上的实验表明，与基于 BP 的基线相比，ZeroLock 将内存降低了 26.5%，吞吐量提升了 4.9%。

Conclusion: ZeroLock 通过消除 BP 的更新锁定，在算法层面改善了边缘端 LLM 微调的性能，实现了更低的内存占用和更高的吞吐量，同时具备严格的收敛性保证，为边缘计算场景下的高效模型微调提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) fine-tuning at the edge adapts the model to scenario-specific data while preserving privacy. Although existing studies proposed pipeline parallelism to address the limited memory and computing resources of edge devices, they commonly rely on backpropagation (BP) training, which has a fundamental limitation of update locking and could experience severe throughput and memory bottlenecks. In this work, we propose a BP-free algorithm, called ZeroLock, that decouples the model updates into independent chunk updates by local objective construction. It breaks the update locking of BP and hence can improve throughput at the algorithm level and lower memory usage by reducing activation storage. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first theoretical framework for such local objective construction-based approaches under general model chunk division by mapping local objectives to the global objective. We prove that ZeroLock has a convergence rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/\sqrt{T})$, which differs from BP only by polylogarithmic factors. We design a system for ZeroLock and build real-world prototypes, incorporating techniques such as early forwarding and failure recovery for efficient and robust implementation. Experiments on the prototype show that compared to BP-based baselines, ZeroLock reduces the memory by 26.5% and improves throughput by 4.9%.

</details>


### [425] [LUCID: Latent-Skill Unified Control via Imagined Dynamics for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07746v1)
*Cheng Guo,Mingzhe Ni,Angelo Cangelosi,Arash Ajoudani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LUCID提出一种分层模型强化学习框架，通过可复用技能和学到的动力学模型进行想象推演，实现长时域人形机器人全身操作（loco-manipulation），在多样化的多物体重新排列场景中超越基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时域人形机器人全身操作需要组合多种技能并做出可靠的高层决策，但现有方法依赖脚本化规划器、有限状态机或任务特定的模型无关策略来协调预训练技能，限制了处理复杂任务序列的能力。

Method: LUCID包含两个阶段：首先通过对抗模仿学习训练结构化的潜在条件低层策略；然后冻结低层策略，联合学习高层策略和宏动力学世界模型。世界模型预测由潜在决策引发的时间扩展状态转换，使高层策略可以通过想象推演（imagined rollouts）进行优化。

Result: 在多种模拟多物体重新排列场景中，LUCID相比基线方法显著提升了完整任务成功率和部分完成率，证明了其在复杂顺序全身操作任务中的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过分层模型强化的方式，LUCID实现了可复用技能与高层决策的有机结合，为复杂顺序的人形机器人操作任务提供了一种无需脚本化规划的有效解决方案。

Abstract: Long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation requires composing versatile whole-body skills and reliable high-level decision making. Existing methods often coordinate pretrained skills with scripted planners, finite-state machines or task-specific model-free policies, restricting their ability to handle complex task sequences. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{LUCID}, a hierarchical model-based reinforcement learning framework that plans over reusable skills through imagined rollouts of a learned dynamics model. LUCID first trains a structured latent-conditioned low-level policy via adversarial imitation and then freezes it while jointly learning a high-level policy and macro-dynamics world model. The world model predicts the temporally extended state transitions induced by latent decisions, enabling high-level policy optimization through imagined rollouts. We evaluate our framework across various simulated multi-object rearrangement scenarios. Experimental results show that LUCID improves the full-task success and partial-completion rates compared to prior baseline methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in complex sequential loco-manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [426] [Omni-modal decomposition autoencoders learn full-stack wearable disentangled representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07385v1)
*Ioannis Ziogas,Ensieh Khazaei,Bilal Taha,Aamna Al Shehhi,Ahsan H. Khandoker,Leontios J. Hadjileontiadis,Dimitrios Hatzinakos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了Omni-modal Variational Decomposition Autoencoders (OmniDecVAEs)框架，用于在多模态可穿戴计算中学习全栈式（full-stack）解耦表示。该框架通过扩展DecVAEs，利用模态条件的时间-频率潜空间、多视图自监督分解损失和共享非对称自编码器架构，统一处理分类、解耦表示学习、融合和生成建模。在多达30个模态的挑战性HAR任务中，OmniDecVAEs在活动和身份识别上分别提升1.01%和6.75%的准确率，重构MAE改善76.84%，MMD改善13.85%，仅需4.1M参数且具备实时推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法无法作为全栈式可穿戴处理器运行，即不能同时满足任务特定分类性能、解耦且可解释的表示学习、多模态融合以及高度异质多模态时间序列的生成建模。这一能力空白是推动本工作发展的核心动机。

Method: OmniDecVAEs扩展了DecVAEs框架，通过以下关键设计实现：(1) 学习模态条件的时间-频率潜空间，使每个模态获得解耦的潜表示；(2) 引入多视图自监督分解损失以鼓励表示解耦；(3) 采用共享的非对称自编码器（AE）架构，实现从任意数量模态的高效、可扩展的统一处理。总体框架能够在单一模型中同时完成分类、解耦表示学习、融合和生成任务。

Result: 在多达30个模态的omni-modal HAR基准上验证：(1) 与Transformer和VAE方法相比，活动识别准确率提升1.01%，身份识别提升6.75%；(2) 生成重构MAE改善76.84%；(3) 真实与合成数据分布相似性MMD改善13.85%；(4) 模型仅4.1M参数，具备模态不变的参数复杂度，满足实时边缘可穿戴需求。

Conclusion: OmniDecVAEs展示了作为轻量级统一模型应用于智能边缘可穿戴设备和临床医疗的潜力，通过增强的表示能力、模态不变的参数规模（4.1M）和实时延迟，在单一模型中统一了多种处理需求。研究结果强调了解耦全栈式表示学习在多模态可穿戴计算中的价值。

Abstract: Learning disentangled representations is a key requirement for developing versatile, general-purpose, and sustainable models in multi-modal wearable computing. However, existing approaches do not operate as full-stack wearable processors, i.e., they do not simultaneously address task-specific classification performance, disentangled and interpretable representation learning, fusion, and generative modeling of highly heterogeneous multi-modal time series. To address this gap, we introduce Omni-modal Variational Decomposition Autoencoders (OmniDecVAEs), a framework that efficiently learns multi-purpose representations in a unified and scalable manner from arbitrarily many modalities. OmniDecVAEs extend DecVAEs by learning modality-conditioned time-frequency latent subspaces through a multi-view self-supervised decomposition loss and a shared asymmetric autoencoder (AE) architecture. Results on a challenging omni-modal human activity recognition (HAR) setting with up to thirty modalities, demonstrate the ability of OmniDecVAEs to learn full-stack wearable representations. When compared to transformer-based and VAE-based methods, OmniDecVAEs full-stack disentangled representation properties lead to accuracy improvements of 1.01% and 6.75% in activity and identity recognition, respectively. Furthermore, OmniDecVAEs synthesize realistic omni-modal time-frequency data that manifest with enhanced reconstructions (mean absolute error improves by 76.84%) and distributional similarity between real and synthetic data (maximum mean discrepancy improves by 13.85%). Our results highlight OmniDecVAEs potential as a lightweight model suitable for intelligent edge wearables and clinical healthcare, unifying processing requirements and abilities in a single model, through its enhanced representational capacity, modality-invariant spatial complexity (4.1M parameters), and real-time latency.

</details>


### [427] [When GNNs Fail: Quantifying and Overcoming Temporal Correlation Volatility in Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07333v1)
*Chen Shao,Yue Wang,Zhenyi Zhu,Zhanbo Huang,Tobias Käfer,Zonghan Wu,Danai Koutra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TCV指标量化多元时间序列中节点间相关性的动态演化程度，并发现高TCV场景下主流GNN/Transformer模型性能下降严重，甚至不如简单的结构无关基线。为此提出GLIDE图神经网络层，包含基于路径的消息传递（D1）和静态/动态传播分离（D2）两种理论支撑的设计机制，在静态和动态两种设置下平均性能提升最高达45.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将多元时间序列建模为图并使用GNN进行预测的工作大多假设静态图拓扑，但实际中序列间的成对相关性可能随时间剧烈演化。作者希望系统地研究GNN在静态和动态场景下的表示能力，并指出当前架构在动态拓扑下的关键局限性。

Method: 提出Temporal Correlation Volatility (TCV)模型无关指标用于量化潜在结构的分布演化；在此基础上提出GLIDE层，包含两个设计机制：(D1) 基于路径的消息传递，捕获路径级邻域信息；(D2) 静态与动态传播分离，通过局部静态近似识别最优动态。

Result: 在合成和真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，GLIDE在静态和动态场景下平均性能提升最高达45.6%，最大单项提升达85.7%。

Conclusion: GLIDE能显著改善动态拓扑下的学习能力，同时在静态场景中保持鲁棒性。TCV指标有效建立了动态演化程度与模型性能退化之间的关联，为时间序列图建模中的动态性问题提供了新的理论视角和实用解决方案。

Abstract: Modeling multivariate time series by representing them as graphs, where individual series act as nodes and pairwise temporal corre- lations serve as edges, has gained significant traction. Recent advances in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have demonstrated strong perfor- mance by assuming a static graph topology and aggregating information from neighboring series. In this work, we investigate the representa- tional power of GNNs for forecasting under both static and dynamic settings (i.e., when pairwise correlations evolve drastically over time) and identify critical limitations in current architectures. To formalize this, we first propose Temporal Correlation Volatility (TCV), a model- agnostic metric designed to quantify the distributional evolution of these latent structures. We establish a clear connection between TCV and performance degradation, demonstrating that many popular models, including Transformers, generalize poorly in high-TCV settings and are often outperformed by simple structure-agnostic baselines. To address these limitations, we propose Graph Layer for Inference in Dynamic En- vironments (GLIDE), a novel GNN layer enhanced by two theoretically grounded design mechanisms: (D1) Path-based Message Passing, which captures path-based neighborhoods and (D2) Static and Dynamic Propagation Separation, which identifies optimal dynamics via local static approximation. These components significantly improve learning under dynamic topology while preserving robustness in static scenarios. Ex- tensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that GLIDE improves average performance by up to 45.6% across static and dynamic settings, with the largest gain reaching 85.7%. The source code is available at https://github.com/ChenS676/GLIDE.

</details>


### [428] [Synthetic LiDAR Data Generation and Deterministic Downsampling for Point Cloud Classification on the Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07106v1)
*Niclas Meyer,Stefan Reitmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向低功耗嵌入式处理器（Raspberry Pi 5）的硬件约束三维深度学习推理工作流，通过物理模拟生成合成LiDAR数据集解决CAD数据与真实传感器数据之间的现实差距，并集成基于特征驱动的Critical Points Layer（CPL）作为前端过滤器压缩点云，从而实现约50 FPS的实时推理和88.36%的分类精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三维深度学习框架部署到低功耗嵌入式处理器时面临两大瓶颈：空间数据的非结构化特性带来的计算负担，以及在神经网络推理之前通常需要的资源密集型距离排序算法（如基于距离的几何预处理）。此外，干净CAD数据集与现实传感器数据之间存在显著的现实差距（reality gap），直接迁移训练会导致分类精度大幅下降。

Method: 本文提出一个硬件约束工作流：(1) 使用基于物理的仿真构建合成LiDAR数据集，以弥合CAD数据与真实传感器数据之间的差距；(2) 集成一个独立的、特征驱动的Critical Points Layer（CPL）作为前端过滤器，替代传统的计算密集型几何预处理（如距离排序）；(3) 在Raspberry Pi 5的ARM Cortex-A76处理器上进行端到端性能剖析。

Result: 跨数据集评估表明，在干净CAD数据上训练的网络迁移到合成LiDAR传感器数据上时分类精度显著下降，证实了传感器感知训练的必要性。预训练的CPL可将原始1024点云确定性地压缩至40-60个唯一坐标。在ARM Cortex-A76处理器上，完整流水线达到约50 FPS的推理吞吐量，同时保持88.36%的实例分类精度。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了在边缘设备上实现确定性实时三维感知的可行性，通过传感器感知训练和特征驱动的点云压缩策略，有效解决了低功耗嵌入式环境下三维深度学习部署的现实挑战。

Abstract: Deploying three-dimensional deep learning frameworks to low-power embedded processors is bottlenecked by the unstructured nature of spatial data and the resource-intensive distance sorting algorithms often used before neural network inference. To address this gap, this paper presents a hardware-constrained workflow optimized for native execution on the Raspberry Pi 5. To account for the reality gap between noiseless, clean computer-aided design (CAD) datasets and real-world sensor data, we use physics-based simulation to construct a synthetic LiDAR dataset. Cross-dataset evaluations demonstrate a substantial drop in classification accuracy when networks trained on clean CAD data are evaluated on synthetic LiDAR sensor data, highlighting the critical need for sensor-aware training. To address the latency bottleneck of traditional geometric preprocessing on edge CPUs, we integrate an isolated, feature-driven Critical Points Layer (CPL) as a frontend filter. Our results show that the pretrained CPL deterministically compresses raw 1024-point clouds to a subset of 40 to 60 unique coordinates. When profiled on the ARM Cortex-A76 processor, the complete pipeline achieves an inference throughput of approximately 50 FPS while maintaining an instance classification accuracy of 88.36%, demonstrating the viability of deterministic real-time 3D perception at the edge.

</details>


### [429] [Recent advances in weakly supervised learning: New supervision paradigms, assumption relaxations, and practical solutions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06896v2)
*Wei Wang,Gang Niu,Masashi Sugiyama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文综述了弱监督学习领域的最新进展，重点介绍了三个方面的贡献：置信度差异二元分类问题及其一致性求解方法、基于更宽松数据生成假设的互补标签学习、以及用于部分标签学习算法公平与真实评估的评价框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习的成功依赖于高质量、良好标注的训练数据，但现实应用中往往难以满足这一要求。弱监督学习旨在利用不完整、不精确或不准确的监督信号来训练准确模型，然而现有方法在监督范式、假设严格性和评估公平性方面仍存在不足。

Method: 该章节从三个方向展开：(1) 提出置信度差异（confidence-difference）这一新的弱监督二元分类问题，并设计一致性（consistent）求解方法；(2) 针对互补标签学习这一弱监督多分类问题，提出基于比现有一致性方法更宽松的数据生成过程假设的求解方案；(3) 为部分标签学习构建一套评估框架，以促进该领域算法的公平和真实评估。

Result: 针对三个弱监督学习子问题分别提出了：置信度差异分类的一致性算法、基于松弛假设的互补标签学习方法、以及部分标签学习的标准化评估框架。

Conclusion: 本文通过引入新的监督范式、放宽假设条件以及建立评估标准，系统性地推进了弱监督学习在不同场景下的理论保障、实用性和可比较性。

Abstract: Deep learning has achieved great success in recent years thanks to the availability of high-quality, well-annotated training data. However, this requirement is often not met in real-world applications. Weakly supervised learning aims to train an accurate model with incomplete, inexact, or inaccurate supervision. In this chapter, we will discuss recent advances in this field, including new supervision paradigms, relaxed assumptions, and practical solutions. First, we introduce a new weakly supervised binary classification problem called confidence-difference classification and propose consistent approaches to solve it.
