### [454] [Retrieval-Augmented Vision Foundation Models for Robust Leukemia Cell Classification across Multiple Microscopy Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10657v1)
*Carlos Zamora,Hiram Zuniga,Ulises Orozco-Rosas,Kenia Picos*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段白血病细胞图像分类框架，使用预训练视觉基础模型在五个异构数据集上进行训练和跨域评估，对比三种编码器（DinoBloom、BiomedCLIP、CLIP）在多种适应策略下的领域泛化性能，并采用保留数据集协议诊断分类是否依赖数据集伪影而非细胞形态特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 白血病细胞图像分类面临真实世界中的领域偏移问题（如采集、染色、光照和中心协议差异），单一数据集训练的模型在真实临床场景中泛化能力差。现有方法缺乏对跨异构数据集泛化能力的系统性评估，也缺乏对"领域特异预训练是否必要"及"低成本适应方案是否可行"的量化分析。

Method: 采用两阶段流水线：Stage 1使用122,167张单细胞图像进行二分类（白血病vs非白血病）；Stage 2仅对Stage 1阳性样本有条件地进行亚型分类（ALL vs AML），使用69,400张单细胞图像。标签在五个异构数据集间进行统一协调以实现跨数据集训练，并在保留数据集协议下评估领域偏移泛化。流水线中对三种编码器（DinoBloom、BiomedCLIP、CLIP）分别使用线性探测、LoRA和检索增强分类（RAC）模块进行基准测试。

Result: 该框架量化了领域特异性预训练对领域偏移下性能的贡献程度，并评估低成本适应（LoRA）和检索增强分类是否可替代昂贵的领域专用预训练。保留数据集协议还作为诊断工具，揭示了分类性能何时来自数据集特定伪影而非细胞形态学特征。

Conclusion: 领域特异性预训练对跨异构数据集的泛化性能具有重要贡献，但低成本适应与检索增强方法可能提供可行的替代方案；保留协议为区分真实形态学学习与数据集伪影利用提供了诊断手段。

Abstract: Leukemia cell image classification is challenged by real-world domain shifts from acquisition, staining, illumination, and site protocols, causing single-dataset models to generalize poorly in real clinical scenarios. This work presents a robust framework for leukemia classification across multiple heterogeneous datasets using a two-stage pipeline with a pretrained vision foundation model. Stage 1 performs binary classification (leukemia vs. non-leukemia) and is trained using 122,167 single-cell images. Stage 2 is conditionally applied to Stage 1 positives to perform subtype classification into Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) and Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML), trained using 69,400 single-cell images. Labels are harmonized across five heterogeneous datasets to enable cross-dataset training, and performance is evaluated on a held-out dataset protocol to assess domain-shift generalization. Within this pipeline, three encoders are benchmarked (DinoBloom, pretrained on single-cell images; BiomedCLIP, pretrained on biomedical data; and CLIP as a general-purpose model) under linear probing, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and a Retrieval-Augmented Classification (RAC) module that retrieves the top-k most similar cell images to provide cytomorphological grounding. The objective is to quantify how much domain-specific pretraining contributes to performance under domain shift, and whether cost-effective adaptation and retrieval can be a viable alternative to expensive domain-specialized pretraining. The held-out protocol additionally serves as a diagnostic tool, revealing when classification performance is attributable to dataset-specific artifacts rather than to cytomorphological features.

</details>


### [455] [BreastMammo and DenseMammo: Benchmarks for Mammography Domain Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10271v1)
*Hongyi Pan,Gorkem Durak,Halil Ertugrul Aktas,Andrea Mia Bejar,Mustafa Ege Seker,Nebile Alibeyoglu,Rumeysa Guclu,Rana Gunoz Comert Bozkurt,Sibel Ozkan Gurdal,Neslihan Cabioglu,Beyza Ozcinar,Ravza Yilmaz,Vahit Ozmen,Erkin Aribal,Sukru Mehmet Erturk,Yalda Zafari,Mohamed Mabrok,Kayhan Batmanghelich,Mohammad Yaqub,Ziyue Xu,Ulas Bagci*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出两个新数据集（BreastMammo和DenseMammo）以及一个基于前景直方图匹配的域泛化框架，用于解决乳腺密度分类中因临床中心设备差异导致的跨域性能下降问题。Swin Transformer骨干在内部五折交叉验证中达到98.32%的AUC，在外部TNMammo和LUMINA数据集上显著优于MixStyle和DFT-based等主流域泛化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乳腺密度分类是乳腺癌风险评估的关键环节，但AI模型常因不同临床站点间的厂商特异性采集风格（域偏移）而难以跨中心泛化，现有模型缺乏多视角乳腺X光摄影研究所需的鲁棒性。

Method: 提出域泛化框架，采用仅前景的直方图匹配（foreground-only histogram matching）协议来消除来自不同临床来源的域偏移问题；同时引入两个新数据集BreastMammo和DenseMammo以支持多视角乳腺X光摄影研究；使用Swin Transformer作为骨干网络。

Result: 内部五折交叉验证中，Swin Transformer骨干在密度分类上达到98.32%的峰值AUC；外部评估（TNMammo和LUMINA数据集）表明该方法持续减少域偏移，显著优于MixStyle和离散傅里叶变换（DFT）框架等主流域泛化范式。

Conclusion: 所提出的前景直方图匹配域泛化框架能有效解决乳腺密度分类中的跨站点域偏移问题，在内部和外部数据集上都展现出优越的泛化性能，为多中心临床应用提供了可靠方案。

Abstract: Breast density classification is a critical component of breast cancer risk assessment, yet AI models often struggle to generalize across clinical sites due to vendor-specific acquisition styles. In this work, we introduce two new datasets, BreastMammo and DenseMammo, to facilitate robust multi-view mammography research. We propose a domain generalization framework that utilizes a foreground-only histogram matching protocol to resolve the domain shift issue arising from disparate clinical sources. Internal evaluation using a 5-fold cross-validation protocol demonstrates the efficacy of our approach, with the Swin Transformer backbone achieving a peak AUC of 98.32% for density classification. External evaluation on the TNMammo and LUMINA datasets demonstrates that the proposed approach consistently reduces domain shift, significantly outperforming prominent domain generalization paradigms, including MixStyle and Discrete-Fourier-Transform-based frameworks.

</details>


### [456] [Retrieval-Augmented Generation-Based Color Restoration for Low-Light Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08211v1)
*Li-Wei Lu,Shaou-Gang Miaou*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的通用后处理模块，将颜色恢复从低光图像增强（LLIE）中解耦出来，通过从外部高质量颜色知识库动态检索参考图像并注入其颜色分布来校正残余色偏，跨多种前端网络均有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低光图像增强方法虽能恢复亮度和结构，但输出仍存在系统性色偏（如绿色天空、黄色面部、白色物体偏暖）。作者认为根因在于端到端训练将亮度、结构和颜色耦合在同一网络中，导致颜色通道监督不足。因此需要将颜色恢复作为独立子问题处理。

Method: 将颜色恢复建模为构建在RAG之上的通用后处理模块，包含三个组件：(i) 基于VGG19中间特征的双索引FAISS检索器，利用全局均值和方差统计捕捉纹理与结构相似性；(ii) GlobalSPHistAdaIN，将参考图像的空间保留颜色直方图降为全局颜色向量，通过自适应实例归一化调制网络特征，避免依赖像素级对应；(iii) 残差公式，预测前端输出的颜色校正量。整体流程为：前端LLIE网络输出后，检索器从外部知识库检索参考图像，注入其颜色分布进行颜色校正。

Result: 在LOLv1、LOLv2-Real和LOLv2-Synthetic数据集上，该模块一致地提升颜色相关指标；将前端网络替换为CPGA-Net++、LLFormer、FLIGHTNet和IAT时均保持有效，验证了跨前端泛化性；消融实验表明VGG19双索引优于CLIP检索，说明颜色恢复依赖纹理和结构相似性而非高层语义。

Conclusion: 将颜色恢复从LLIE中解耦并作为独立的RAG后处理模块是有效且可泛化的方案。颜色恢复的成功关键在于纹理和结构层面的相似性匹配，而非语义级相关性，这为后续LLIE系统的颜色校正提供了模块化的改进路径。

Abstract: Recent low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods have driven brightness and structural fidelity close to that of normally-exposed images, yet their outputs still exhibit systematic color shifts such as greenish skies, yellowish faces, and warm-tinted white objects. We attribute this to end-to-end LLIE training coupling brightness, structure, and color within a single network, leaving the color channels weakly supervised. We recast color restoration as an independent sub-problem and decouple it from brightness enhancement, realizing it as a general-purpose post-processing module built on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Rather than relying solely on parametric color priors learned during training, the module dynamically retrieves a reference image from an external high-quality color knowledge base and injects its color distribution into a color-restoration network to correct residual bias. The design has three components: (i) a dual-index FAISS retriever built on intermediate VGG19 features, capturing textural and structural similarity through global mean and variance statistics; (ii) GlobalSPHistAdaIN, which reduces the reference spatial-preserving color histogram to a global color vector and modulates network features via adaptive instance normalization, removing dependence on pixel-level correspondence; and (iii) a residual formulation that predicts a color correction over the front-end output. Across LOLv1, LOLv2-Real, and LOLv2-Synthetic, the module consistently improves color-specific metrics, and it remains effective when the front end is swapped among CPGA-Net++, LLFormer, FLIGHTNet, and IAT, confirming cross-front-end generality. Ablations show that a VGG19 dual index outperforms CLIP-based retrieval, indicating that color restoration depends on textural and structural similarity rather than high-level semantics.

</details>


### [457] [$\texttt{DisMorph}$: learning to disentangle technical distortions from true biological change](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08173v1)
*Jingru Fu,Kathleen E. Larson,Douglas N. Greve,Bruce Fischl,Malte Hoffmann*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: DisMorph是一个基于纯合成数据训练的配准框架，将纵向MRI形变显式分解为技术性形变（如梯度非线性畸变）和解剖学形变，从而在纵向形态测量中分离生物变化与MRI系统畸变，提升测量准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纵向MRI用于研究衰老和神经退行性疾病，但MRI扫描仪引入的几何畸变（如梯度非线性畸变）会随采集系统和协议变化。现有配准方法将生物与技术效应混在单一形变场中，若畸变未完全校正，会导致下游形态测量结果产生偏差。

Method: 提出DisMorph配准框架，完全在合成数据上训练，将纵向形变显式分解为技术形变与解剖形变两个稠密位移场。训练中使用新颖的生成模型分别合成两种效应以提供解耦监督，并通过领域随机化增强跨协议泛化能力。

Result: 在三个互补场景中验证：1）已知真值的模拟数据上，解剖变化检测比传统配准更准确、更一致；2）仅含GNL畸变的真实图像对上，大部分几何变化被归因于畸变场，验证了无解剖变化时的特异性；3）纵向AD数据上，能检测AD相关脑区的解剖变化，同时识别标准校正后残留的畸变。

Conclusion: 通过将MRI诱导的畸变与生物变化在纵向形变中解耦，该方法为采集一致性难以维持的临床环境提供了更准确的纵向形态测量途径。

Abstract: Longitudinal MRI enables sensitive measurement of structural brain change for studying aging and neurodegenerative disease. Deformable image registration is a key tool for estimating such change by computing a dense deformation that captures geometric differences between longitudinal scans. However, MRI scanners introduce geometric distortions that vary across acquisition systems and protocols, such as gradient non-linearity (GNL) distortion. Existing registration methods estimate a single field that conflates biological and technical effects, potentially biasing downstream morphometric measurements if distortions remain (partially) uncorrected. We propose $\texttt{DisMorph}$, a registration framework trained entirely on synthetic data that explicitly decomposes longitudinal deformation into technical and anatomical transforms. It predicts two dense deformations, each encoding one effect. During training, a novel generative model synthesizes both effects separately to provide disentanglement supervision, while domain randomization promotes generalization across imaging protocols. We evaluate our method in three complementary settings. On simulated data with known ground truth, our method detects anatomical change more accurately and consistently than conventional registration. On real image pairs that differ only by GNL distortion, our method assigns most geometric change to the distortion field, demonstrating specificity in the absence of anatomical change. On longitudinal Alzheimer's disease (AD) pairs, our method detects anatomical change in AD-related brain structures while identifying residual distortion left after standard correction. By disentangling MRI-induced distortion from biological change in the longitudinal deformation, our method paves the way for more accurate longitudinal morphometry in clinical settings where maintaining acquisition consistency is challenging.

</details>


### [458] [Bit Allocation Transfer for Perceptual Quality Enhancement of Traditional Video Codecs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07799v1)
*Runyu Yang,Ivan V. Bajić*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种比特分配迁移框架，将神经视频压缩中学习到的感知重要性转化为传统视频编码器的量化参数（QP）映射，无需修改核心解码语法即可提升感知质量。在HEVC B~D数据集上，相比JM-19.0、HM-16.20和VTM-23.0分别节省20.20%、8.25%和8.37%的MS-SSIM比特率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统块级视频编码器（H.264/AVC、H.265/HEVC、H.266/VVC）依赖手工设计的率失真优化（RDO），主要最小化与人类感知质量相关性差的均方误差（MSE）；而神经视频压缩虽可轻松优化感知指标（如MS-SSIM），但计算复杂度过高，难以实际部署。两种范式之间存在鸿沟，需要桥接以提升传统编码器的感知质量。

Method: 在神经视频压缩框架（DCVC-FM）中，使用感知损失训练一个量化步长生成模型，该模型以原始帧和运动补偿预测为输入，输出量化步长映射。随后从该映射推导块级比特率比例，并转换为适用于传统视频编码器的量化参数（QP）映射，实现块级比特分配引导。

Result: 在HEVC B~D数据集上，该方法相比标准参考软件在MS-SSIM指标下实现比特率节省：对比JM-19.0节省20.20%，对比HM-16.20节省8.25%，对比VTM-23.0节省8.37%。使用预测帧时还能获得额外增益。

Conclusion: 该方法成功地将神经视频压缩模型隐式学习到的感知重要性迁移到传统视频编码器的块级比特分配中，在不修改核心解码语法的情况下显著提升了传统编码器的感知性能，为两种编码范式的融合提供了有效路径。

Abstract: Traditional block-based video codecs, such as H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC and H.266/VVC, rely on hand-crafted Rate-Distortion Optimization (RDO) processes that primarily minimize Mean Squared Error (MSE), which correlates poorly with human perceptual quality. While neural video compression methods can easily optimize perceptually aligned metrics like MS-SSIM, their high computational complexity limits practical deployment. This paper proposes a novel bit allocation transfer framework that bridges these two paradigms to enhance the perceptual quality of conventional video codecs. Specifically, we train a quantization step generation model using a perceptual loss within a neural video compression framework (DCVC-FM). The model takes the original frame and a motion-compensated prediction as input and outputs a quantization step map. We then derive a block-wise bit ratio from this map and convert it into a Quantization Parameter (QP) map for a traditional video codec. Experimental results on the HEVC B$\sim$D dataset demonstrate that our method achieves 20.20\%, 8.25\%, and 8.37\% bitrate savings in terms of MS-SSIM compared with the standard reference software JM-19.0, HM-16.20, and VTM-23.0, respectively, with additional gains when utilizing predicted frames. Our approach effectively transfers the implicit perceptual importance learned by neural video compression models to guide block-level bit allocation in traditional video codecs without modifying their core decoding syntax.

</details>


### [459] [LoRCA: LoRA Cycle Adaptation for Histology to HiP-CT Translation with DINOv3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10002v1)
*Yang Zhou,Edoardo Occhipinti,Banboye Kidzeru Elvis,Jishizhan Chen,Stathis Megas,Joseph Brunet,Joanna Purzycka,Theresa Urban,Hector Dejea,Sarah Amalia Teichmann,Menna R Clatworthy,Paul Tafforeau,Peter D Lee,Claire L Walsh*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出LoRCA（LoRA循环适应），一种基于循环一致性的风格转换框架，用于将H&E组织学切片翻译为HiP-CT（分层相衬断层成像）体积图像，以实现2D组织学到3D体积的配准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HiP-CT技术能以多分辨率对完整器官进行无损三维成像，为组织学提供体量级的器官上下文。然而H&E组织学与HiP-CT体积之间的非线性配准因色彩空间特征表示差异而极具挑战性。现有的合成-先-配准方法要么依赖人工解剖轮廓，要么缺乏语义约束从头训练，限制了其在软组织器官和新模态上的泛化能力。

Method: LoRCA基于共享的冻结DINOv3骨干网络，为每种模态配备专门的LoRA（低秩适配）适配器，学习模态特有表示，并通过解码器和对抗训练实现循环一致的风格翻译。冻结骨干充当结构锚点，防止内容漂移并保留预训练的语义提取能力。整个框架无需成对训练数据。

Result: LoRCA在Fréchet Inception Distance（FID）和结构保真度（互信息、Canny边缘保留）方面均优于CycleGAN。在手动对齐的HiP-CT和组织学测试对上，风格翻译后的图像在MatchAnything下产生更多特征对应，表明其有助于下游配准任务。

Conclusion: LoRCA风格翻译是2D组织学切片到3D HiP-CT体积配准的有前景的方向，既提升了翻译质量又保持了结构一致性。

Abstract: Hierarchical Phase-Contrast Tomography (HiP-CT) is a synchrotron based X-ray imaging technique that enables non-destructive, volumetric imaging of intact organs with multi-resolutions bridging 20 $μm$/voxel for whole organs to near-cellular resolution ($\sim$0.8 $μm$/voxel) in local regions. This offers the opportunity to bring volumetric whole-organ context to histology. However, nonlinear registration between H\&E histology and HiP-CT volumes is challenging due to the differences in feature representations of different colour spaces. Synthesis-before-registration methods have shown strong results in histology-to-MRI and histology-to-CT alignment. However, existing approaches either rely on manual anatomical contours or are trained from scratch without semantic constraints, limiting their generalisability to soft tissue organs and novel modalities. We propose LoRCA (LoRA Cycle Adaptation), a cycle consistent style translation framework built on a shared frozen DINOv3 with modality-specific LoRA adapters, learning modality-specific representations that are decoded and adversarially trained. LoRCA enables structure-preserving translation without requiring paired training data. The frozen backbone is intended to be a structural anchor that prevents content drift by preserving pretrained semantic-extraction capability. We evaluate translation quality using Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) and structural fidelity via mutual information and Canny edge preservation. LoRCA outperforms CycleGAN in both translation quality and structural consistency. As a preliminary indicator of downstream registration utility, we find that style-translated images yield increased feature correspondences under MatchAnything on manually aligned HiP-CT and histology test pairs, suggesting that LoRCA-style translation is a promising step towards 2D histological sections to 3D HiP-CT volumes registration.

</details>


### [460] [Implicit representations are dead. Long live explicit primitives!](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10001v1)
*Nil Stolt-Ansó,Maik Dannecker,Wenqi Huang,Andras Jakab,Daniel Rueckert*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文对显式高斯表示与隐式神经表示在医学影像中的应用进行了跨维度综合评估。实验表明，在2D显微镜组织学与3D肺部CT数据集上，高斯表示在重建指标上匹配或超越隐式方法，同时具有显著更低的优化时间和内存需求，且具备隐式范式难以实现的数学性质，为医学影像中更广泛的采用提供了有力依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐式神经表示尽管具有高保真度和紧凑存储，但其依赖全局多层感知机，导致计算成本高、内存需求大、优化时间长。随着医学影像趋向更高分辨率的三维体数据，这些瓶颈严重制约了隐式方法的应用。

Method: 首先从理论上概述显式高斯基元相较于隐式神经范式所额外具备的数学性质；随后在二维显微镜组织学图像和三维肺部CT两个数据集上，对不同压缩因子下的高斯表示与隐式方法进行系统的性能基准测试，评估重建质量、优化时间与内存需求。

Result: 高斯表示在所有压缩因子下均能匹配或超越隐式方法的重建指标，同时优化时间和内存需求显著更低。

Conclusion: 显式高斯表示结合其优异的数学性质与计算效率，为医学影像处理提供了极具吸引力的新方向，值得在未来研究中进行更广泛的采用和探索。

Abstract: Continuous parameterization of medical data has emerged as a powerful paradigm for resolution-independent image representation. While Implicit Neural Representations offer high fidelity and compact storage, their reliance on global Multi-Layer Perceptrons incurs sizeable computational costs, large memory requirements, and extensive optimization times. As medical imaging trends towards ever-more detailed, high-resolution volumes, these costs impose significant bottlenecks in the applicability of implicit approaches. Recently, explicit Gaussian-based primitives have revolutionized the representation learning paradigm by trading deep network evaluations for localized, rasterization-friendly primitives. In this paper, we present a comprehensive, cross-dimensional evaluation of Gaussian representations against implicit approaches for medical imaging applications. First, we outline a theoretical overview on the mathematical properties offered by explicit primitives beyond what is capable under the implicit neural paradigm. Subsequently, we benchmark the computational performance on two demanding image datasets: 2D microscopy histology and 3D lung Computed Tomography (CT). Our experiments demonstrate that Gaussian representations consistently match or surpass reconstruction metrics compared to implicit methods across all compression factors, while displaying significantly lower optimization times, and memory requirements. Together with the compelling mathematical properties offered by explicit primitives, these findings motivate the wider adoption of Gaussian representations and position them as an attractive direction for future research in medical imaging.

</details>


### [461] [Pre- to Post-Contrast Synthesis of Breast DCE-MRI using Latent Bridge Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10000v1)
*Sina Amirrajab,Zohaib Salahuddin,Henry C Woodruff,Philippe Lambin*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种潜在桥匹配（LBM）框架，用于从增强前磁共振图像合成峰值增强的乳腺DCE-MRI，以替代钆造影剂的使用。相比传统潜在扩散模型（从高斯噪声出发），LBM学习的是从增强前到峰值增强VAE潜在空间的条件桥，并通过潜在UNet进行迭代修正。肿瘤掩膜条件化的变体在MSE、FID和肿瘤SSIM等指标上均优于增强前条件化和LDM基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DCE-MRI是乳腺癌成像的核心技术，但钆造影剂的注射增加了扫描负担和患者风险，因此需要探索无需造影剂的替代方案，包括合成对比增强图像生成。

Method: 提出潜在桥匹配（LBM）框架：在VAE潜在空间中学习预对比与峰值增强latent之间的条件桥，取代LDM从高斯噪声出发的生成方式。潜在UNet从中间桥状态预测到峰值增强latent的残差修正，实现迭代细化并保持轨迹锚定于患者专属解剖结构。评估了两种条件化变体：预对比条件化和肿瘤掩膜条件化。

Result: 在91例DUKE验证集上，肿瘤条件化LBM相比预对比条件化，MSE从1.023降至0.940，FID从7.523降至4.716，肿瘤SSIM从0.355提升至0.429，且优于LDM基线。

Conclusion: 潜在桥匹配是一种有前景的预对比锚定虚拟对比增强方法，但需进一步验证泛化能力，并消除推理时对真实肿瘤掩膜的依赖。

Abstract: Dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (DCE-MRI) is central to breast cancer imaging, but gadolinium administration increases scan burden and motivates contrast-reduced alternatives, including synthetic contrast generation. We propose a latent bridge matching (LBM) framework for synthesizing peak-enhanced breast DCE-MRI from pre-contrast images in the MAMA-SYNTH challenge setting. Instead of starting from Gaussian noise as in conventional latent diffusion models (LDMs), the proposed model learns a conditional bridge between paired pre-contrast and peak-enhanced VAE latents. A latent UNet predicts the remaining correction from intermediate bridge states to the peak-enhanced latent, enabling iterative refinement while keeping the trajectory anchored to patient-specific anatomy. We evaluated two LBM conditioning variants on 91 DUKE validation cases. For the tumor-conditioned variant, tumor masks were used as conditioning inputs. Tumor-conditioning improved performance compared with pre-contrast conditioning, reducing MSE from 1.023 to 0.940 and FRD from 7.523 to 4.716, while increasing tumor SSIM from 0.355 to 0.429. The tumor-conditioned LBM also outperformed the evaluated LDM baseline on this validation cohort. These results suggest that latent bridge matching is a promising pre-contrast-anchored formulation for virtual contrast enhancement, while further work is needed to validate generalization and remove dependence on ground-truth tumor masks at inference.

</details>


### [462] [Robustness of transferability estimation metrics for medical imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09999v1)
*Niclas Claßen,Théo Sourget,Dovile Juodelyte,Rob van der Goot,Veronika Cheplygina*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文研究医学影像中迁移学习可迁移性估计（TE）指标的鲁棒性，发现目标数据集的微小变化（样本量、随机种子）以及评估指标的选择会显著改变参考排序，TE指标与真实参考排序之间的总体一致性较低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在医学影像迁移学习中，选择源模型至关重要，但已有TE指标在不同实验设置下报告结果相互矛盾。此外，大多数TE指标为自然图像设计并以准确率为优化目标，而医学影像通常需要更鲁棒于类别不平衡的指标。现有研究缺乏对目标数据集变化和评估指标选择这两个因素的系统隔离研究。

Method: 通过构建不同样本量和随机种子的微型目标数据集群体，将目标数据集变化作为孤立因素进行研究；同时改变用于获取参考排序的评估指标（包括适用于类别不平衡的指标），以研究评估指标选择对TE指标评价的影响。

Result: 目标数据集的小幅修改会改变源模型的排序；评估指标的选择会影响参考排序，进而影响TE指标的评测结果；总体而言，TE指标与参考排序之间的一致性较低。

Conclusion: TE指标在医学影像设定下的鲁棒性不足，实验结果依赖于目标数据集细节和评估指标选择。作者公开了代码、模型检查点和数据划分以促进可复现研究。

Abstract: In transfer learning, the choice of source model largely influences the performance on a target dataset. Still, selecting a fitting source remains a challenging task, especially in medical imaging where one has to decide between models pre-trained on off-the-shelf options, such as ImageNet, and domain specific datasets. Transferability estimation (TE) metrics address this problem by aiming to predict the best performing source model in a computationally cost effective way. However, previous work has reported conflicting TE metric performances due to differences in experimental setups. Moreover, most TE metrics are designed for and evaluated on natural images, while being optimized for accuracy, whereas in medical imaging metrics that are more robust to class imbalance are typically used. We study the impact of varying the target dataset as an isolated factor, by constructing miniature populations of different sample sizes and random seeds. In addition, we investigate the influence of the evaluation metric used to obtain the reference ranking. We find that small modifications to the target dataset change the rankings. Furthermore, we show that the choice of evaluation metric affects the reference rankings and therefore the evaluation of TE metrics. Overall, we observe a low agreement between rankings from TE metrics and reference. The code, model checkpoints and data splits used in this work are available through https://github.com/niclasclassen/robustness-of-transferability-estimation-metrics-for-medical-imaging.

</details>


### [463] [Structural Guidance for Unified Joint Demosaicing and Denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09995v1)
*Qixin Zheng,Ping Chen,Qiangqiang Shen,Haijin Zeng*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个结构引导的统一去马赛克与去噪框架，通过向CFA感知的图像恢复中注入预训练的结构先验知识，解决了现有统一恢复网络因仅依赖像素级监督而导致的边缘、重复纹理和摩尔纹处结构退化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一恢复网络虽然显式建模了CFA几何结构，但主要依靠像素级监督驱动，在边缘、重复纹理和摩尔纹区域因局部证据不可靠而容易产生结构退化。作者认为这源于缺少超出像素级重建监督之外的结构引导。

Method: 模型接收由原始马赛克、CFA掩码和噪声水平图组成的五通道观测。SwinIR恢复分支在CFA条件调制下重建像素细节，并行结构推理分支从稀疏伪RGB观测中提取互补结构线索。为弥合稀疏噪声传感器数据与自然图像预训练域之间的域差距，引入轻量可训练适配器后再进行结构特征与恢复特征的残差融合。共享解码器联合预测恢复的RGB图像和辅助干净马赛克，在图像域和传感器域同时提供监督。

Result: 在多种CFA模式和噪声水平上的大量实验表明，该方法相比最先进的统一方法和CFA特定方法均取得一致的性能提升，验证了适配的结构先验能够增强鲁棒的相机图像恢复。

Conclusion: 结构先验的有效注入和域适配是提升统一去马赛克与去噪性能的关键，本文方法通过双分支结构和适配器设计成功弥合了传感器域与自然图像域之间的差距，为相机图像恢复提供了更鲁棒的方案。

Abstract: Joint demosaicing and denoising is a fundamental step in camera image signal processing, yet remains challenging because different Bayer-like color filter arrays (CFAs) and sensor noise jointly corrupt both color sampling and image content. Existing unified restoration networks explicitly model CFA geometry but are still driven primarily by pixel-level supervision, making them prone to structural degradation around edges, repetitive textures, and moiré patterns where local evidence is unreliable. We attribute this limitation partly to the absence of explicit structural guidance beyond pixel-level reconstruction supervision. Motivated by this observation, we propose a structural-guided unified restoration framework that injects pretrained structural knowledge into CFA-aware image restoration. Our model receives a unified five-channel observation consisting of the raw mosaic, CFA masks, and a noise-level map. A SwinIR restoration branch reconstructs pixel details under CFA-conditioned modulation, while a parallel structural reasoning branch extracts complementary structural cues from a sparse pseudo-RGB observation. To bridge the substantial domain gap between sparse noisy sensor data and the natural-image pretraining domain of the structural encoder, we introduce a lightweight trainable adapter before residually fusing structural and restoration features. A shared decoder jointly predicts the restored RGB image and an auxiliary clean mosaic, providing supervision in both image and sensor domains. Extensive experiments across multiple CFA patterns and noise levels demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art unified and CFA-specific methods, indicating that adapted structural priors can enhance robust camera image restoration. The source codes and dataset are provided in the supplementary material.

</details>


### [464] [Knowledge-Guided 3D CT Generation: A Conditioning-Centric Taxonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09992v1)
*Francesca Pia Panaccione,Eugenio Lomurno,Matteo Matteucci*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种以条件（conditioning）为中心的3D CT生成方法分类系统，通过三个正交维度（外部知识类型K、知识集成范式I、生成架构A）构成的K x I x A设计空间来系统化整理现有文献，识别主流趋势与设计模式，并指出尚未充分探索的研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D CT条件生成的研究发展迅速，但方法种类繁多，缺乏统一的系统化比较框架，难以揭示关键设计选择（如外部知识类型、知识集成方式、生成架构）之间的关联，阻碍了领域内的横向对比与未来方向探索。

Method: 提出一个以条件为中心的（conditioning-centric）分类学框架，沿着三个正交维度对文献进行分类：外部知识类型（K）、知识集成范式（I）和生成架构（A），由此构建一个明确的K x I x A设计空间，并基于该框架对现有方法进行系统化整理与趋势分析。

Result: 通过该框架系统化了现有3D CT条件生成方法，识别了主流趋势和反复出现的设计模式，并定位了设计空间中未充分探索的区域，为未来研究指明潜在方向。

Conclusion: K x I x A分类框架为3D CT条件生成领域的系统化比较提供了统一视角，有助于理解现有方法的异同，并揭示了未来研究值得关注的空白领域。

Abstract: Controllable generation guided by external knowledge is a key requirement in modern generative deep learning applications, enabling the synthesis of samples with explicit constraints on semantic content, structural properties, and variability. In 3D Computed Tomography (CT), such control is essential for clinical applications, including data augmentation, privacy-preserving data sharing, and the simulation of specific anatomical or pathological scenarios. While research on conditional 3D CT generation has expanded rapidly, the diversity of existing approaches makes systematic comparison difficult and obscures fundamental design choices. In this survey, we propose a conditioning-centric taxonomy that organizes the literature along three orthogonal dimensions: the type of external knowledge (K), the knowledge integration paradigm (I), and the generative architecture (A). This factorization defines an explicit design space (K x I x A) that provides a unified perspective on prior work. Using this framework, we systematize existing methods, identify dominant trends and recurring design patterns, and highlight underexplored regions of the design space that point toward promising directions for future research.

</details>


### [465] [Spatial Masked-Set Learning for Sparse Multi-Shell Diffusion MRI Signal Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06958v1)
*Yousef Sadegheih,Pratibha Kumari,Dorit Merhof*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种空间掩码集合（masked-set）框架，用于稀疏多壳扩散MRI信号合成。该模型将观测信号视为无序集合，利用3×3×3局部邻域提供空间上下文，预测中心体素的径向6阶SHORE系数，并可解析解码以在任意q空间位置合成信号。在HCP100白质体素上，该方法在b=1000、10个梯度输入条件下达到2.70%的NMSE，相比最先进的连续dMRI信号合成模型实现了22.4%的相对误差降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稠密多壳扩散MRI能提供丰富的q空间信息，但采集时间过长。需要在稀疏采样条件下高效、准确地合成密集的扩散信号，以缩短采集时间同时保留丰富的扩散信息。

Method: 采用空间掩码集合框架：将观测测量视为无序集合处理，利用3×3×3局部邻域作为空间上下文，预测中心体素的径向6阶SHORE（3D-SHORE）系数；通过解析解码在任意q空间位置合成信号。训练策略结合了壳梯度随机丢弃（shell-wise gradient dropping）、密集信号监督以及旋转一致的SHORE目标，确保增强下稀疏输入信号与系数监督对齐。

Result: 在HCP100白质体素上，保留参考采集中有限子集的扩散加权信号进行评估。所提方法在信号NMSE上优于解析q空间模型和最先进的连续dMRI信号合成模型。在b=1000、10个输入梯度设置下达到2.70%的NMSE，相比连续模型有22.4%的相对降低。在FA指标上，解析模型仍具竞争力，尽管其在高斯密集信号NMSE上表现较差。

Conclusion: 空间掩码集合框架能有效从稀疏多壳扩散MRI信号合成密集信号，显著降低NMSE，优于现有解析模型和连续合成模型。同时提示不同下游指标（如信号NMSE与FA）对模型优劣的评估视角不同，解析模型在FA这一张量派生端点上仍具竞争力。代码已开源。

Abstract: Dense multi-shell diffusion MRI provides rich q-space information but requires long acquisition times. We propose a spatial masked-set framework for sparse multi-shell diffusion MRI signal synthesis. The model treats observed measurements as an unordered set, uses a local $3 \times 3 \times 3$ neighborhood for spatial context, and predicts radial-order-6 SHORE coefficients for the center voxel. The coefficients can then be decoded analytically to synthesize signals at arbitrary q-space locations. Training combines shell-wise gradient dropping, dense signal supervision, and rotation-consistent SHORE targets so that sparse input signals remain aligned with their coefficient supervision under augmentation. We evaluate on held-out HCP100 white-matter voxels by retaining limited subsets of measured diffusion-weighted signals from the reference acquisition. The proposed method achieves lower signal NMSE than both analytical q-space models and a state-of-the-art continuous dMRI signal synthesis model designed for arbitrary input and output q-space sampling. In the $b=1000$ setting with 10 input gradients, it achieves $2.70\%$ NMSE, a $22.4\%$ relative reduction over this continuous model. Fractional anisotropy on reconstructed $b=1000$ signals provides a complementary tensor-derived endpoint, with analytical models remaining competitive for FA despite higher dense-signal NMSE across the evaluated q-space. The implementation is available on \href{https://github.com/xmindflow/SHOREPred}{https://github.com/xmindflow/SHOREPred}.

</details>


### [466] [Longitudinal 3D Foundation Modeling for Neoadjuvant Breast Cancer Response Prediction from Serial DCE-MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09991v1)
*Fidel Omar Tito Cruz,Neda Ghafouri,Zengyan Wang,Pegah Khosravi,Yu Tian,Chen Chen*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种纵向框架，将冻结的3D基础编码器（Pillar-0）与时间动态网络（TDN）结合，利用四个临床时间点的DCE-MRI序列预测乳腺癌新辅助化疗后的病理完全缓解（pCR），在982名患者（I-SPY2与ACRIN-6698联合队列）上达到测试AUROC 73.6%、平衡准确率69.1%，证明纵向3D影像与临床数据融合可互补提升pCR预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: pCR是新辅助化疗（NAC）中的重要疗效终点，治疗过程中基于影像预测pCR有助于治疗反应评估。然而现有大多数影像学方法仅依赖单一静态时间点，无法捕获治疗过程中的动态变化，缺乏对治疗全程纵向信息的建模能力。

Method: 提出纵向预测框架：使用冻结的3D基础编码器Pillar-0提取每个时间点的体积影像嵌入，构建时间动态网络（TDN），将时间感知的体积嵌入与临床及治疗数据融合，基于治疗前至术前四个临床时间点的DCE-MRI序列预测pCR。

Result: 在982名患者（I-SPY2与ACRIN-6698联合队列）上评估，纵向3D影像与临床数据融合时表现优异（测试AUROC 73.6%，平衡准确率69.1%）。临床变量提供最强的单一预测信号，但纵向3D影像在与临床数据融合时提供互补信息，进一步提升pCR预测性能。

Conclusion: 纵向3D影像与临床信息融合能够有效预测乳腺癌NAC后的pCR，多时间点影像相对于单一静态时间点能提供更丰富的治疗变化信息，且与临床变量具有互补性，为治疗反应评估提供了有价值的深度学习方案。

Abstract: Pathologic complete response (pCR) is an important endpoint in neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) for breast cancer, and predicting pCR from imaging during treatment could support treatment response assessment. Many existing imaging-based approaches rely on a single static timepoint, which fails to capture changes that occur during treatment. In this work, we present a longitudinal framework that combines a frozen 3D foundation encoder (Pillar-0) with our Temporal Dynamics Network (TDN) to predict treatment response from serial Dynamic Contrast-Enhanced (DCE) MRI acquired across four clinical timepoints from pre-treatment to pre-surgery. The TDN combines time-aware volumetric embeddings with clinical and treatment data to predict pCR. Evaluated on 982 patients from the combined I-SPY2 and ACRIN-6698 cohort, the proposed model achieves strong performance across all reported metrics when longitudinal 3D imaging is fused with clinical data (test AUROC: 73.6%, balanced accuracy: 69.1%). While clinical variables provide the strongest individual predictive signal, longitudinal 3D imaging contributes complementary information when fused with clinical data, improving pCR prediction. Our source code is available at: https://github.com/omarftt/longitudinal_temporal_pillar.

</details>


### [467] [Algorithmic statistics of retinal images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09989v1)
*Loan Huynh,Ronald Zambrano,Layton Aho,Fabio Lavinsky,Gadi Wollstein,Joel S. Schuman,Andrew R. Cohen*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于归一化压缩距离（NCD）和各项异性结构增强滤波器的度量学习方法，用于量化并可视化3D视网膜OCT图像中的疾病进展，在预测视野功能变化方面达到约0.5 dB的误差，优于非度量的深度学习方法，并引入归一化压缩向量（NCV）作为特征集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有监督学习方法（如神经网络）是非度量的，其生成的特征或测量可能引入与潜在非临床生理差异相关的系统性失真。此外，3D OCT视网膜图像体积大、结构复杂且难以有效可视化，需要一种既能定量测量又能直观可视化疾病进展的方法。

Method: 采用归一化压缩距离（NCD）作为度量工具，结合各向异性结构增强滤波器对3D视网膜图像进行预处理，并通过NCD量化图像对间的结构差异。提出归一化压缩向量（NCV）作为特征集来测量和可视化图像集合中的视觉差异。该方法在青光眼患者和灵长类动物模型（通过眼压操控）上进行验证，并与深度学习非度量方法进行了对比。

Result: NCD测量的图像间结构差异与医生测量的视野功能变化之间的预测误差约为0.5 dB，精度优于非度量深度学习方法。NCV成功可视化并测量了中度非进展性青光眼患者及非人灵长类眼压操控模型中的变化模式。模拟实验证实了非度量嵌入特征（如神经网络产生）会引入类相关的统计失真。

Conclusion: 度量学习方法（NCD结合结构增强滤波）能够更准确、无偏差地量化和可视化3D视网膜OCT图像中的疾病进展，同时通过模拟验证了非度量方法在特征嵌入中引入统计失真的问题，强调了度量方法在医学影像分析中的重要性。

Abstract: There has been a tremendous amount of image processing and machine learning research to measure and classify disease progression from live optical coherence tomography (OCT) imaging of the retina. The images considered here are large, complex, three-dimensional (3-D) and difficult to visualize effectively. Many current supervised machine learning approaches, \emph{e.g.} neural networks, are non-metric meaning that any features or measurements generated can introduce systematic distortion that may be correlated with underlying non-meaningful physiological differences. Here we present a metric learning approach using the normalized compression distance (NCD) combined with anisotropic structure-enhancing filters to quantify and visualize the principal differences among a collection of 3-D retinal images. We validate the NCD-measured structural differences between pairs of images against the physician-measured change in visual field function, achieving a prediction error of $\sim$ 0.5 dB, more accurate than non-metric deep learning approaches. The normalized compression vectors (NCV) are proposed as a feature set measuring visual differences among a collection of 3-D microscopy images. The utility of the NCV for visualizing and measuring patterns of change is demonstrated for a human with moderate non-progressing glaucoma and for a non-human primate model using intraocular pressure setting manipulation. We conclude with a brief simulation of non-metric embedding features, \emph{e.g.} from neural networks, introducing class-correlated statistical distortion.

</details>


<div id='cs.HC'></div>

# cs.HC [[Back]](#toc)

### [468] [Stay or Stray - A Dynamical Systems Viewpoint of Popularity Bias](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10474v1)
*Sarvesh Shashidhar,Lankireddy Prabhat,Arpit Agarwal,D. Manjunath,Karan Bhukar,Tanmay Khandelwal*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 本文通过动力系统视角研究推荐系统中流行度偏见的形成机制，利用两时间尺度随机近似构建随机过程与常微分方程（ODE）框架，刻画其均衡点并推导流行度偏见涌现的充分条件，以及各用户类别对称保留的可行条件，并在合成数据与大规模商业音乐推荐平台的生产日志上验证了理论结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐系统中的流行度偏见已被广泛实证观察到，但其动态涌现机制尚缺乏理论理解。理解这一动力学过程是设计干预策略、保障小众用户推荐质量的前提。

Method: 将推荐模型更新与用户参与的耦合演化建模为随机过程，通过两时间尺度随机近似方法将其渐近行为归结为ODE框架；分析系统均衡点，并从理论上推导流行度偏见涌现与对称保留的条件；随后在合成数据和真实商业音乐推荐平台日志上进行实验验证。

Result: 刻画了动力系统的均衡点，给出了流行度偏见可证明涌现的条件，以及各用户类别对称保留可能成立的条件；合成数据与真实生产数据实验均验证了理论推导。

Conclusion: 该工作首次从动力系统角度为流行度偏见的涌现提供了严格的理论解释与条件刻画，填补了经验观察与理论机制之间的空白，并为后续缓解流行度偏见提供了可操作的干预依据。

Abstract: Popularity bias in recommendation systems arises when a majority user class generates disproportionate interaction data, causing the system to increasingly favour it while degrading recommendation quality for niche users. While extensive empirical evidence of popularity bias exists, the dynamics leading to its emergence are not well understood. In this work, we study the coupled evolution of recommender model updates and user engagement through the lens of dynamical systems. We formulate a stochastic process and analyse its asymptotic behaviour through an ordinary differential equation (ODE) framework grounded in two-time-scale stochastic approximation. We characterise the equilibrium points of this dynamical system, and derive conditions under which popularity bias is provably emergent, as well as conditions under which symmetric retention of all user classes is possible. We conduct experiments on synthetic data and real-world production logs derived from a large-scale commercial music recommendation platform to validate our theoretical results.

</details>


### [469] [Automatic Field-of-View Adjustment for a View-Expansive Microscope via LSTM-Based Gaze and Pipette Motion Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10401v1)
*Kenta Yokoe,Takuya Hara,Tadayoshi Aoyama*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于AI的自动视野（FOV）调节方法，结合视野扩展显微镜，通过LSTM模型根据移液管位置、速度和操作者注视位置实时预测并调节FOV大小，无需手动切换物镜。实验表明，该自动系统将ICSI任务完成时间从60.5秒显著缩短至48.0秒（p<0.001），使新手操作者达到与专家相当的工作速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICSI（胞浆内单精子注射）操作者在操作过程中频繁调节视野（FOV），这会中断工作流程并增加手术时间。传统显微镜需要手动切换物镜和调整照明以实现不同视野大小，降低了操作效率。

Method: 提出一种与视野扩展显微镜集成的AI自动FOV调节方法。该显微镜通过振镜和高速度视觉的多视角成像，用单个物镜同时获取大视野和高分辨率图像，免去物理镜片更换。利用长短期记忆（LSTM）模型，基于移液管的实时位置与速度以及操作者的注视位置，预测合适的FOV大小。模型使用一位具有5年以上显微操作经验的专家的ICSI操作数据进行训练。

Result: 对新手操作者的实验评估显示，自动FOV调节系统显著提高了ICSI操作速度，平均任务完成时间从60.5秒降至48.0秒（p<0.001）；同时新手操作者通过该系统达到了与专家操作者相当的工作速度。

Conclusion: 所提出的AI自动FOV调节系统能有效消除ICSI操作中手动视野调整带来的干扰，显著提升操作效率，并缩小新手与专家之间的操作技能差距。

Abstract: Intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) operators frequently adjust the field-of-view (FOV) during procedures, which interrupts workflow and increases procedure time. Conventional microscopes require manual objective lens switching and illumination adjustments to achieve different FOV sizes. We propose an AI-based automatic FOV adjustment method integrated with a view-expansive microscope. This microscope enables the simultaneous acquisition of a large FOV and high-resolution images using a single objective lens through multiview imaging with galvanometer mirrors and high-speed vision, thereby eliminating the need for physical lens exchanges. Our method utilizes a long short-term memory (LSTM) model to predict the appropriate FOV size based on real-time analysis of the pipette's position and velocity, combined with the operator's gaze position. The AI model is trained using ICSI procedure data from an expert with over five years of micromanipulation experience. Experimental evaluation with novice operators reveals that the proposed automatic FOV adjustment system significantly improves the ICSI procedure speed, reducing the average task completion time from 60.5 to 48.0 s (p < 0.001). The experiments also demonstrate that this improvement enables novice operators to achieve ICSI working speeds equivalent to those of expert operators.

</details>


### [470] [Divided Attention Amplifies the Importance of Expectation-Aligned Visualization Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10320v1)
*Jiho Kim,Anna L. Chinni,Karen B. Schloss,Michael Gleicher*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 本文通过两个实验研究了在单任务与双任务条件下，可视化设计是否与用户期望对齐如何影响其可解释性。结果表明，分散注意力会放大期望一致与期望违反设计之间的性能差距，并利用线性弹道累积器（LBA）模型对用户的决策过程进行建模解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究仅关注可视化解释作为用户唯一任务时的设计影响，但真实场景中用户常同时执行多项任务（如监控警报、回复消息）。这种分散注意力可能改变用户对可视化的解释方式，因此有必要研究分心条件下可视化设计的重要性。

Method: 设计两个实验，比较单任务与双任务条件下的可视化解释表现。实验探讨颜色、空间位置与语义概念之间已有推测映射对解释的影响，实验1在无限观看时间下进行，实验2在有限观看时间下进行。并使用线性弹道累积器（LBA）框架对用户决策过程进行过程导向建模。

Result: 分散注意力放大了期望一致设计与期望违反设计之间的性能差距，影响包括响应时间、解释准确度以及在时间约束下做出判断的能力。

Conclusion: 研究强调了在分心条件下将可视化设计与用户期望对齐的重要性，并引入了一种过程导向建模方法，以理解期望和多任务处理如何共同塑造可视化解释。

Abstract: Studies have shown that visualization design affects interpretability when visualization interpretation is the user's sole task. However, in real-world settings, users often engage with visualizations while performing concurrent tasks, such as when users simultaneously monitor alerts or respond to messages. Such divided attention may alter how users interpret visualizations, potentially increasing the importance of designs that align with viewer expectations. We investigated this possibility through two experiments comparing visualization interpretation under single-task and dual-task conditions. Specifically, we examined how well-established inferred mappings between color, spatial position, and semantic concepts affect interpretation when users perform a concurrent task, both with unlimited viewing time (Exp. 1) and under limited viewing time (Exp. 2). Our results show that divided attention amplifies the performance gap between expectation-aligned and expectation-violating designs, affecting response time, interpretation accuracy, and the ability to produce a judgment under time constraints. To explain these results, we model the user's decision-making process using a Linear Ballistic Accumulator (LBA) framework. Our findings highlight the increased importance of aligning visualization designs with viewer expectations under divided attention and introduce a process-oriented modeling approach to understanding how expectation and multitasking shape visualization interpretation.

</details>


### [471] [SocialFiVis: A Visual Analytics Sandbox for LLM-Grounded Multi-Agent Simulation in Social Finance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08497v1)
*Yi-Fan Cao,Qing Shi,Liangwei Wang,Leo Yu-Ho Lo,Lin Chen,Yuzi Han,Yang Wang,Kani Chen*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 本文提出SocialFiVis，一个基于IAD框架的可视化分析沙盒，用于模拟和探索社交金融（SocialFi）社区中治理规则、个体行为与新兴经济结果之间的非线性相互作用，支持反事实政策推演和系统级结果的可解释归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交金融（SocialFi）将在线社区转变为复杂的社会经济系统，其中集体决策塑造了兼具社会资本（如社区信任）和金融健康（如市场流动性）的"数字公地"。治理这类混合生态系统面临挑战，因为现实干预成本高且不可逆。虽然反事实模拟对探索替代治理策略至关重要，但现有方法无法捕捉治理规则、个体行为和新兴经济结果之间的非线性相互作用。

Method: 以制度分析与发展（IAD）框架为理论基础，综合文献和专家访谈见解。构建SocialFiVis可视化分析沙盒，包含：(1) 量化双轨数字公地的稳健模型；(2) 两阶段模拟引擎，结合LLM驱动的人物角色与基于机制的感知-推理-行动（PRA）运行时，模拟经验性地基于保留消息群体的异构、上下文感知代理；(3) 具有可解释推理路径的分层多视图界面，供社区运营者探索反事实政策并追溯系统级结果到个体行为理由。

Result: 通过两个案例研究、用户研究和后续访谈进行评估。结果表明SocialFiVis支持细粒度行为归因，并帮助解释新兴现象，如社会资本的结构性脱钩，以及局部治理冲击下消息成员的韧性。

Conclusion: SocialFiVis为治理SocialFi社区提供了一种可操作的反事实模拟工具，能够弥合宏观治理政策与微观个体行为之间的解释鸿沟，为数字公地的可持续治理提供了新的分析范式。

Abstract: The emergence of social finance (SocialFi) transforms online communities into complex socio-economic systems. Within these spaces, collective decisions shape a "digital commons" characterized by social capital (e.g., community trust) and financial health (e.g., market liquidity). Governing such hybrid ecosystems is challenging because real-world interventions are costly and irreversible. While counterfactual simulation is essential for exploring alternative governance strategies, existing approaches fail to capture the non-linear interplay between governance rules, individual behaviors, and emergent economic outcomes. To systematically unpack this complexity, we operationalize the Institutional Analysis and Development (IAD) framework as our theoretical foundation, synthesizing prior literature with insights from formative expert interviews. Built on this framework, we present SocialFiVis, an IAD-embedded visual analytics sandbox. It introduces a robust model to quantify the dual-track digital commons, coupled with a two-phase simulation engine. This engine combines LLM-derived personas with a mechanism-guided Perception-Reasoning-Action (PRA) runtime to simulate heterogeneous, context-aware agents empirically grounded in the retained messaging cohort. A hierarchical multi-view interface with interpretable reasoning pathways enables community operators to explore counterfactual policies and trace system-level outcomes back to individual behavioral rationales. We evaluate SocialFiVis through two case studies, a user study, and follow-up interviews. Results demonstrate that SocialFiVis supports fine-grained behavioral attribution and helps explain emergent phenomena such as the structural decoupling of social capital and the resilience of messaging members under localized governance shocks.

</details>


### [472] [Human-Guided Causal Knowledge Injection for Virtual Cells](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08430v1)
*Pengcheng Wang,Changjian Chen,Zhuo Tang,You Wu,Long Wang,Feng Yu,Kenli Li*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种人机协同的因果知识注入方法，用于虚拟细胞模型。通过基因相似性感知的因果图可视化（结合混合优化算法）辅助探索概念间因果关系与基因间相似性，并基于反事实分析策略（支持反事实可视化和因果路径可视化）验证和精化因果图。通过两个真实案例研究和领域专家反馈验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虚拟细胞利用机器学习模拟和预测细胞行为，是研究健康与疾病的关键计算框架。向虚拟细胞注入因果图可提升可解释性，但真实应用中因果图通常不可得。现有自动构建因果图的方法是无监督的，生成的因果图常含错误，亟需一种能验证和精化自动生成因果图的方法。

Method: 1) 开发了基因相似性感知的因果图可视化，采用混合优化算法帮助探索概念间的因果关系和基因间的相似性；2) 基于探索结果，设计了反事实分析策略，包括反事实可视化和因果路径可视化，以支持因果图的验证与精化；3) 整个流程实现人机协同的因果知识注入，将人工领域知识融入虚拟细胞模型。

Result: 通过两个真实世界案例研究验证了方法的有效性，能够提取具有科学意义的因果洞察，并获得了领域专家的积极反馈。

Conclusion: 人机协同的因果知识注入方法可有效提升虚拟细胞中自动构建因果图的准确性，通过可视化和反事实分析协助专家验证与精化因果图，从而增强虚拟细胞模型的解释性和可靠性。

Abstract: Virtual cells employ machine learning models to simulate and predict cellular behaviors, serving as a critical computational framework for investigating health and disease. Injecting causal graphs into virtual cells can improve the interpretability, but such graphs are usually not available in real-world applications. Recently, many methods have been proposed to construct causal graphs from data, which group genes based on their similarities to form concepts and extract their causal relationships. However, since this automatic process is unsupervised, the causal graphs usually contain errors. In this paper, we propose a human-guided causal knowledge injection method for virtual cells. We developed a gene-similarity-aware causal graph visualization supported by a hybrid optimization algorithm to help explore both the causal relationships between concepts and the similarities between genes. Based on the exploration, we further developed a counterfactual analysis strategy supported by a counterfactual visualization and a causal path visualization to help validate and refine causal graphs. The effectiveness of our method is demonstrated through two real-world case studies, the extraction of scientifically meaningful causal insights, and positive feedback from domain experts.

</details>


### [473] [PHOENIX: Fine-Tuned SLM-Powered Autonomous Satellite Lifetime Extension via Predictive Self-Healing and Multi-Agent AI Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07126v1)
*Sumaiya Islam,Harsha Kumara Moraliyage*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 本文提出PHOENIX系统，将一个微调的小型语言模型（SLM）部署在CubeSat星载嵌入式硬件上，实现星上连续故障推理，通过记忆系统复用历史修复经验，并在地面配置6个AI智能体在5-10分钟通信窗口内生成验证指令；利用扩散模型合成罕见故障训练数据，并在ESA异常检测基准上取得了初步结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CubeSat在低地球轨道上每96分钟轨道周期中有约85分钟无法与地面通信，导致故障在无联络期间持续恶化而无法及时发现和恢复，仅有48-65%的小卫星能存活超过两年，远低于2-5年的设计寿命。

Method: 将微调的小型语言模型部署在飞行验证过的Aethero NxN-ECM星载计算机上，实时监控所有传感器读数；采用记忆系统存贮历史修复记录以避免重复推理；每个轨道周期仅发送结构化健康报告而非原始数据；地面部署6个专用AI智能体在通信窗口内生成并验证指令；使用生成式扩散模型（DDPM）合成故障训练数据以弥补真实故障样本仅占0.57-1.80%的数据不平衡问题。

Result: 在ESA异常检测基准（14年数据、76个通道、118个标注故障）上报告了初步结果。

Conclusion: PHOENIX通过星上边缘智能推理与地面AI智能体协同，赋予CubeSat自主故障诊断与修复能力，有望显著提升小卫星的在轨存活率。

Abstract: Most CubeSats, small and low-cost satellites roughly the size of a shoebox, do not survive as long as they were designed to: a study of 178 missions found that only 48-65% remain operational after two years, against a designed lifetime of 2-5 years. The deeper issue is that a CubeSat in low Earth orbit (LEO) is physically unreachable from the ground for roughly 85 minutes out of every 96-minute orbit, so faults that start during that window go unnoticed until the next contact pass, by which point recovery may no longer be possible. We propose PHOENIX (Predictive Health On-orbit Edge Neural Intelligence eXtension) to give the satellite its own fault reasoning capability. A fine-tuned Small Language Model (SLM) compact enough to run on embedded hardware is deployed onboard the CubeSat, running on the flight-proven Aethero NxN-ECM computer, monitoring all sensor readings continuously, and resolving recurring faults using a memory system that stores past repairs so the same inference does not need to run twice. Once per orbit it sends a short structured health report to the ground instead of a raw data dump; six specialized AI agents on the ground read that report and generate validated satellite commands within the 5-10 minute contact window. A generative diffusion model (DDPM) creates synthetic training data because real fault examples make up only 0.57-1.80% of the dataset. We report preliminary results on the ESA Anomaly Detection Benchmark (14 years, 76 channels, 118 labeled faults).

</details>


### [474] [Switched Reading: Toward Seamless Visual-Auditory Switching When Reading Text in Augmented/Mixed Reality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06985v1)
*Kazuyuki Fujita,Yuto Matsui,Ikuru Sato,Guanghan Zhao,Yoshifumi Kitamura*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 提出一种名为Switched Reading的AR/MR阅读交互框架，支持用户在视觉和听觉模态间切换阅读文本，并探索了基于凝视的语音播放和对应感知过渡效果两种关键技术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AR/MR可穿戴眼镜允许随时随地信息交互，但当真实世界感知至关重要时，视觉显示可能不恰当。需要一种支持在视觉和听觉模态间灵活切换的阅读交互方式。

Method: 提出Switched Reading框架，包含两种关键技术：(1)基于凝视的语音播放和(2)对应感知的过渡效果。通过参数调优用户测试在MR头显上实现，并在虚拟现实中通过N=16的用户研究模拟模态切换来评估，最后实现步行阅读应用并收集用户反馈。

Result: 同时结合两种技术的条件在四种条件中最受青睐；基于凝视的语音播放减少了模态切换时的凝视偏移并比基于滚动位置的基线条件提高了阅读速度。

Conclusion: Switched Reading框架有效支持视觉与听觉模态间的灵活切换阅读，为AR/MR环境下的阅读应用提供了设计启示。

Abstract: Augmented/mixed reality (AR/MR) wearable glasses now permit information interaction anywhere, but visual displays can be inappropriate when real-world awareness is essential. We propose Switched Reading, a novel interaction framework for reading text in AR/MR that supports switching between visual and auditory modalities as needed. Specifically, we explore two key interaction techniques within this framework: (1) gaze-based voice playback and (2) a correspondence-aware transition effect. We implemented them on an MR headset through a parameter-tuning user test. Next, we conducted a user study (N=16) to investigate the impact of the two techniques on reading performance and overall user experience with simulated modality switching in virtual reality. The results show that the condition combining both techniques was the most preferred among four conditions. Moreover, we found that the gaze-based voice playback reduced gaze offsets when switching modalities and improved reading speed over the baseline condition using scroll position. Finally, we implemented a Switched Reading application for reading while walking and collected user feedback, yielding further design implications for practical use.

</details>


### [475] [CustomDance: Customized 3D Dance Generation with Coarse-to-Fine Human-Centered Interactive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06722v1)
*Xulong Tang,Kaixing Yang,Xiaohu Guo,Prabhakaran Balakrishnan,Rawan Alghofaili*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: CustomDance是一个粗到精的交互式3D舞蹈生成系统，通过三个相互连接的阶段（MLLM分析音乐与文本锚点、多模态检索器推荐舞蹈片段、音乐条件扩散修补器连接并细化片段），实现对用户多模态输入的全面且细粒度控制，在定量与定性比较中优于竞争基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D舞蹈生成方法虽能产生统计上合理的技术正确动作，但缺乏对用户多模态输入（如音乐或特定动作描述）的全面且差异化控制，导致生成的动作缺乏深度、表现力以及与用户创作意图的对齐。

Method: CustomDance采用三阶段粗到精范式：(1) 多模态大语言模型(MLLM)分析音乐和高层文本提示，识别关键时间锚点和创作线索；(2) 针对每个锚点，多模态检索器基于局部音乐和文本从舞蹈库中推荐高质量动作片段，为用户提供具体可预测的选择；(3) 定制的音乐条件扩散修补器无缝连接所选短语，并通过运动动态可视化支持用户迭代细化。

Result: 实验表明CustomDance不仅突出了AI辅助编舞范式显著的创作实用性和赋能潜力，而且在定量和定性比较中均优于竞争基线。

Conclusion: CustomDance验证了以专家编舞师工作流为灵感的三阶段交互式范式在实现定制化3D舞蹈生成方面的有效性，为用户提供了深度、表现力与创作愿景对齐的舞蹈生成能力。

Abstract: With the rise of AI-generated content (AIGC) and advanced techniques for 3D human representation, the task of generating 3D dance movements has become an exciting area of research. Despite significant advancements, current methods often fail to provide comprehensive and distinct control over various multimodal inputs from users, such as music or specific descriptions of desired movements. As a result, the generated motions may be statistically plausible and technically correct, but they often lack depth, expressiveness, and alignment with the user's creative vision. To address this issue, we present CustomDance, a coarse-to-fine interactive system designed for customized 3D dance generation. Inspired by the workflows of expert choreographers, CustomDance introduces a novel paradigm to AI-assisted choreography through three interconnected stages. First, a multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) analyzes the music and a high-level text prompt to identify key temporal anchors and creative cues for the piece. Next, for each anchor, a multimodal retriever suggests high-quality motion clips from a dance library based on local music and text, empowering the user with concrete and predictable options. Finally, a custom music-conditioned diffusion in-painter seamlessly connects the selected phrases, allowing for iterative, user-guided refinement of the final composition, supported by visualizations of motion dynamics. Our evaluations demonstrate that CustomDance not only highlights the significant creative utility and empowering potential of our AI-assisted choreography paradigm, but also outperforms competitive baselines across quantitative and qualitative comparisons.

</details>

### [476] [Multi-epoch ultraviolet observables for breaking the radius-albedo degeneracy in directly imaged exoplanets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06649v1)
*Suniti Sanghavi,Robert A. West,Pin Chen*

Main category: astro-ph.EP

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种从反射光直接成像观测中解除行星"半径-反照率简并"的方法，通过构建与行星半径无关的紫外波段可观测物理量（归一化光变曲线形状、紫外强度与偏振颜色、线偏振度），并结合GPU加速矢量辐射传输模型vSmartMOM，证明在SNR为5、20、100时可将半径推断中位数误差控制在精确度范围内，且该方法适用于Habitable Worlds Observatory（HWO）对近邻太阳孪生系统的观测计划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接成像只能测量行星在反射星光中的亮度，但亮度无法区分"大而暗"与"小而亮"的行星，即半径-反照率简并问题。这一简并严重限制了非凌星系外行星（尤其是HWO目标）的表征能力，因此需要构建与半径无关的观测物理量来打破这一简并。

Method: 从多历元观测中构建三个与行星半径无关的紫外可观测物理量：归一化400 nm光变曲线形状、紫外强度与偏振颜色、线偏振度。利用360-400 nm清晰谱窗（瑞利散射强且明亮紫外表面近似无色）约束大气柱量、表面反射率及观测相位。采用GPU加速矢量辐射传输模型vSmartMOM，在三种SNR（5、20、100）下测试这些无半径观测量的唯一性，并比较相位已知与未知两种情形，同时分析去除偏振测量及HWO内工作角限制下的性能差异。

Result: 在已知相位的六相位序列下，光谱偏振测量在SNR为5、20、100时分别给出9.5%、3.3%、0.45%的中位半径不确定性；相位未知时六次不同历元在低SNR下惩罚适度（14%），中高SNR下可忽略（3.2%、0.47%）。去除偏振测量会显著降低结果质量，尤其在HWO内工作角限制相位覆盖的模拟中。对于6和12秒差距的太阳孪生系统，六相位观测战役所需时间在数百小时间范围内，明确可行。

Conclusion: 该研究确立了从HWO反射光探测中获取行星半径的清晰观测路径：通过紫外光谱偏振测量与多历元相位覆盖即可打破半径-反照率简并，无需凌星事件，且观测耗时在可接受范围内。

Abstract: Direct imaging measures how bright a planet appears in reflected starlight, but brightness alone cannot tell whether the planet is large and dark or small and bright. This radius-albedo degeneracy limits the characterization of non-transiting exoplanets, including those targeted by the Habitable Worlds Observatory (HWO). From multi-epoch observations we construct ultraviolet observables that are independent of planetary radius: the normalized 400 nm lightcurve shape, the ultraviolet intensity and polarization colors, and the degree of linear polarization. In a clear 360-400 nm spectral window where Rayleigh scattering is strong and bright ultraviolet surfaces are nearly colorless, these observables constrain the atmospheric column, the surface reflectivity, and, when relevant, the observed phases before radius is inferred. Using the GPU accelerated vector radiative transfer model vSmartMOM, we test how uniquely these radius-free observables determine the scattering state at signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) of 5, 20, and 100. For the chosen six phase sequence, spectropolarimetry gives median radius consequences of 9.5%, 3.3%, and 0.45% when the phases are known. If the phases are unknown, six distinct epochs keep the penalty modest at low SNR and negligible at moderate-high SNR, with median consequences of 14%, 3.2%, and 0.47%, respectively. Removing polarimetry degrades the result, especially in the HWO simulations where phase coverage is restricted by inner working angle. For solar twin systems at 6 and 12 parsecs, the required six-phase campaigns fall in the allotted range of a few hundred hours, making this a clear observing path to planetary radii from HWO's reflected-light detections.

</details>

### [477] [Singularities in Soft Matter Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.11060v1)
*Vatsal Sanjay*

Main category: cond-mat.soft

TL;DR: 本综述探讨软物质中有限时间奇异性（如液线断裂时颈部半径趋零、曲率发散）的动力学，重点关注收缩区域在自相似重标度下的普适性、其所遗忘与保留的信息，以及分子/材料尺度截断如何最终替代理想发散，并讨论复杂流体与活性物质带来的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续介质描述在极小尺度下必然失效，但真实流体在奇异性出现前会被分子或材料物理接管。理解收缩区域在消失过程中遗忘什么、保留什么，以及何种材料长度/时间/应力截断发散，对于预测打印、涂覆、气溶胶等实际输出至关重要。

Method: 以液线颈部收缩为典型范例，采用自相似动力学框架分析奇点附近的标度行为；考察不同时间剖面经局部长度重标度后塌缩为同一形状的普适性，并分析该普适性对周围几何与驱动的依赖程度；将方法推广至应力集中、几何/序缺陷等广义局部化对象，并纳入复杂流体和活性物质的内禀时间尺度。

Result: 奇点附近的动力学常呈现自相似塌缩；在某些情形下塌缩具有充分普适性，使周围几何与驱动不再决定局部动力学。但实测输出仍可能受注入流动方式及最终替代理想发散的小尺度物理影响。复杂流体与活性物质的自身时间尺度改变局部平衡。

Conclusion: 奇异性揭示连续介质理论失效的边界，并表明小尺度截断如何设定实际可观测的输出（如打印、涂覆、气溶胶、可拉伸固体中的关键量）；该方法统一适用于界面外的应力集中与缺陷等广义奇异对象。

Abstract: When a liquid thread pinches off, its neck thins as it separates into two unconnected regions. Using continuum mechanics, we can predict that the neck reaches zero radius in finite time while its curvature grows without bound. Together, the vanishing neck and diverging curvature form a finite-time singularity. However, a real fluid does not realise these mathematical limits as molecular or material physics takes over once the neck becomes sufficiently small. Similar singularities arise throughout soft matter whenever a smooth continuum description is used at vanishing length scales. This review asks what the shrinking region forgets, what it retains, and which material length, time, or stress cuts off the apparent divergence. The dynamics near a singularity often become self-similar, with profiles at different times collapsing onto one shape when rescaled by the shrinking local length. Sometimes that collapse is universal enough that the surrounding geometry and forcing no longer determine the local dynamics. Nonetheless, the measured output could still depend on how the shrinking region is fed by the surrounding flow and on the small-scale physics that finally replaces the ideal divergence. Complex fluids and active matter change the same local balance by bringing their own timescales into the shrinking region. Beyond interfaces, the same logic applies when the localised object is a stress concentration or a defect in geometry or order rather than a moving surface. Singularities matter because they show where continuum theory stops being the relevant description and how the small-scale cutoff sets the outputs that count in printing, coating, aerosols, and stretchable solids.

</details>

### [478] [A reaction-diffusion system with nonconstant diffusion coefficients: exact and numerical solutions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.11172v1)
*Roman Cherniha,Galyna Kriukova*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 本文研究一类带有多孔扩散的Lotka-Volterra型系统（可作为经典Lotka-Volterra系统的替代模型），构造了多参数精确解族并确立了其性质，证明了在系数适当指定时系统拥有两个稳定的稳态点（尤其在捕食者-被捕食者相互作用模型下成立），并将精确解用于求解边界值问题，通过与数值解的对比验证了结果的正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典Lotka-Volterra系统在描述真实世界过程（如捕食者-被捕食者相互作用）时存在一定局限性，因此需要提出带有多孔扩散的替代模型，并对其精确解、稳态性质及边界值问题的求解进行系统研究，为实际应用提供理论支撑。

Method: 对含有多孔扩散的Lotka-Volterra型系统，采用对称/形式方法构造多参数精确解族；通过系数条件分析证明系统存在两个稳定稳态点；将精确解用于求解带零Neumann条件的边界值问题，并与在初始剖面引入小扰动后数值求解的同一边界值问题进行对比验证。

Result: 构造了满足零Neumann条件的多参数精确解族；证明在系数适当指定时系统具有两个稳定稳态点（捕食者-被捕食者情形成立）；精确解成功用于解决边界值问题；数值结果与精确解在初始剖面扰动足够小时以高精度吻合。

Conclusion: 带多孔扩散的Lotka-Volterra型系统是经典系统的有效替代模型，其精确解可作为边界值问题的基准解，数值模拟验证了精确解的可靠性与稳定性，为后续更复杂模型的研究奠定了基础。

Abstract: A Lotka-Volterra type system with porous diffusion, which can be used as an alternative model to the classical Lotka-Volterra system, is under study. Multiparameter families of exact solutions of the system in question are constructed and their properties are established. It is shown that the solutions obtained can satisfy the zero Neumann conditions, which are typical conditions for mathematical models describing real-world processes. It is proved that the system possesses two stable steady-state points provided its coefficients are correctly-specified. In particular, this occurs when the system models the prey-predator interaction. The exact solutions are used for solving boundary-value problems. The analytical results are compared with numerical solutions of the same boundary-value problems but perturbed initial profiles. It is demonstrated that the numerical solutions coincide with the relevant exact solutions with high exactness in the case of sufficiently small perturbations of the initial profiles.

</details>

### [479] [Preferential Attachment as a Simpliciality-Enforcing Mechanism in Hypergraphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09788v1)
*Jason LaRuez,Brendan Rooney*

Main category: math.AT

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个广义优先连接超图模型，其中超边大小和新节点数均服从任意分布，并解析地证明了稳态超度分布呈幂律，其指数仅取决于两者期望值的比值。模型可通过反向步进法从带时间戳的超图数据中直接估计参数，无需参数假设。应用非线性扩展模型于八个真实超图数据集，发现单纯性分数随优先连接强度单调增加直至凝胶化转变，从而确立优先连接是单纯性增强机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界的超图表现出高"单纯性"——超边的子集也倾向于作为超边出现——但这种结构的生成机制尚不清楚。作者旨在揭示驱动超图中单纯性形成的潜在机制。

Method: 引入广义优先连接超图模型，其中超边大小Y_t和每步新增节点数X_t均从任意分布中抽取；采用平均场近似主方程方法解析推导稳态超度分布；提出向后步进（backward-stepping）过程直接从未知参数假设的带时间戳数据中估计X_t和Y_t；并将模型非线性扩展到八个真实超图数据集。

Result: 解析推导表明稳态超度分布遵循幂律，其指数仅取决于比值p=E[X_t]/E[Y_t]，与底层分布形状无关。在八个真实数据集上的非线性扩展模型表明，单纯性分数随优先连接强度单调增加，直到α>1的凝胶化转变。

Conclusion: 优先连接被确立为超图中单纯性增强的机制。该模型无需参数假设即可拟合数据，为理解真实超图的高阶结构和单纯性形成提供了生成性解释。

Abstract: Higher-order networks, represented as hypergraphs, enable direct modeling of multi-body interactions of arbitrary size. Hypergraph representations of real-world systems have been observed to exhibit high \emph{simpliciality} --- the tendency for subsets of hyperedges to also appear as hyperedges --- yet the generative mechanisms responsible for this structure are poorly understood. We introduce a generalized preferential attachment hypergraph model in which both hyperedge size $Y_t$ and the number of new nodes per step $X_t$ are drawn from arbitrary distributions, and derive analytically, using a mean-field approximate master equation approach, that the stationary hyperdegree distribution follows a power law whose exponent depends only on the ratio $p = E[X_t]/E[Y_t]$, independent of the shapes of the underlying distributions. Crucially, both $X_t$ and $Y_t$ can be estimated directly from any timestamped hypergraph dataset via a backward-stepping procedure, enabling the model to be fit without parametric assumptions. Applying a nonlinear extension of the model to eight real-world hypergraph datasets, we find that the simplicial fraction increases monotonically with the strength of preferential attachment up to the gelation transition at $α> 1$, establishing preferential attachment as a simpliciality-enforcing mechanism.

</details>

### [480] [A Scale-Invariant Theory of the Universe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05929v1)
*Julian Barbour,Maria I. R. Lourenço*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文探讨了如何通过采纳莱布尼茨充分理由原则指导下的关系本体论，消除牛顿引入的绝对位置、方向、时间和尺度结构，从而将引力N体问题表述为仅依赖于无量纲比率的尺度不变形式，并论证了尺度不变流形V作为结构度量、形状排序和引力时间箭头核心量的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代物理学在取得巨大经验成功的同时，仍保留了牛顿引入的大量绝对的、不可观测的结构，且很少质疑其必要性。作者试图探究在多大程度上可以消除这些结构，以追求更经济的本体论。

Method: 作者依次消除绝对位置、方向、时间以及尺度，推导出引力N体问题的关系性表述。核心方法是引入尺度不变流形V，通过无量纲比率刻画物理上可观测的量，并利用该流形提供结构度量、形状自然排序以及涌现的引力时间箭头。

Result: 该框架统一了此前被视为不同的牛顿解类别，揭示了可能的新对称性，提出了基于永恒空间相关性而非时间演化的解释概念，并指向更经济的本体论。该原理可能对广义相对论和量子力学提供新视角。

Conclusion: 尽管在牛顿引力的语境中发展，本文提出的原则有望为广义相对论和量子力学提供新的视角，表明关系性、尺度不变的方法可能成为更基本物理理论的出发点。

Abstract: Modern physics has achieved extraordinary empirical success while retaining much of the absolute, unobservable structure introduced by Newton, largely without questioning its necessity. We investigate how far this structure can be eliminated by adopting a relational ontology guided by Leibniz's principle of sufficient reason. Removing absolute position, orientation, time and, finally, scale leads naturally to a formulation of the gravitational $N$-body problem where only dimensionless ratios are physically meaningful. Within this framework, the scale-invariant variety $V$ becomes a central quantity, providing a measure of structure, a natural ordering of shapes, and an emergent gravitational arrow of time. We argue that the resulting formulation unifies classes of Newtonian solutions previously regarded as distinct, uncovering a possible new symmetry, suggests a notion of explanation based on timeless spatial correlations rather than temporal evolution, and points towards a more economical ontology. Although developed in the context of Newtonian gravity, the principles proposed here may also offer a new perspective on general relativity and quantum mechanics.

</details>


<div id='cs.CR'></div>

# cs.CR [[Back]](#toc)

### [481] [On Understanding, Identifying, and Mitigating Vulnerabilities in Agentic Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10530v1)
*Md Jafrin Hossain,Mohammad Arif Hossain,Nirwan Ansari*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文通过PRISMA 2020系统性文献综述，从743条记录中筛选出85篇关于智能体LLM安全的研究论文（2023-2025），发现攻击研究以3.9:1的比例远超防御研究；提出四层架构（感知、大脑、行动、交互）分类法，映射13种漏洞类型；指出感知层漏洞主导（66%）而行动层漏洞仅占4.7%，与实际风险不匹配；识别出7个以遏制（containment）为中心的研究空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM已从无状态对话接口转变为具备多步规划、工具调用、代码执行和持久记忆能力的自主智能体。当这些智能体拥有真实世界权限（调用API、修改文件、查询数据库）时，一个被攻破的推理步骤就可能引发未授权数据访问、不可逆状态变更或级联故障，但安全研究社区尚未跟上这一发展步伐，因此需要系统量化该领域的现状。

Method: 按照PRISMA 2020指南，对六个数据库进行系统性文献检索，筛选743条记录并保留85篇论文（2023-2025），对这些论文进行量化分析和分类，构建四层分类法（感知层、大脑层、行动层、交互层）映射13种漏洞类型。

Result: 攻击研究远超防御研究（3.9:1）；感知层漏洞（提示注入、越狱、对抗扰动）占66%，而行动层漏洞（工具误用、代码注入、沙箱逃逸）仅占4.7%，与实际风险严重不符；代码执行安全占3.5%，工具增强型智能体占12%。

Conclusion: 智能体LLM的不安全性根源于架构耦合——弱隔离使得漏洞能够在各层之间传播。研究社区需要围绕遏制（containment）这一核心主题解决七个开放问题，将防御研究的重点从感知层转移到高风险的行动层。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have undergone a shift from stateless conversational interfaces to autonomous agents capable of multi-step planning, tool invocation, code execution, and maintaining persistent memory. When these agents operate with real-world privileges---calling APIs, modifying files, and querying databases---a compromised reasoning step can trigger unauthorized data access, irreversible state changes, or cascading failures, yet the security research community has not kept pace. To quantify the state of the field, we conducted a systematic literature review under PRISMA 2020 guidelines across six databases, screening 743 records and retaining 85 papers (2023--2025) on agentic LLM security. Attack research outpaces defense work by 3.9:1. Perception-layer vulnerabilities (prompt injection, jailbreaking, adversarial perturbations) dominate, accounting for 66\% of papers, while action-layer vulnerabilities (tool misuse, code injection, sandbox escape) appear in only 4.7\%, misaligned with real-world risk. Code execution security accounts for 3.5\%, and tool-augmented agents 12\%. We contribute a four-layer taxonomy mapping 13 vulnerability types across perception, brain, action, and interaction layers, and identify seven open problems centered on containment. Agentic LLM insecurity stems from architectural coupling, where weak isolation allows vulnerabilities to propagate across layers.

</details>


### [482] [Treating Statewide CORS Networks as Spatially Distributed Sensors for GNSS Integrity Monitoring under Unintentional and Deliberate Threats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08831v1)
*Minhaj Uddin Ahmad,Sagar Dasgupta,Muhammad Sami Irfan,Mizanur Rahman,Mashrur Chowdhury,Thejesh Bandi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本研究开发了一种基于图的网络一致性框架（NCF），将美国州级CORS网络视为空间分布式传感器系统，通过四种度量（邻域残差、空间梯度、残差、图平滑度）组合为网络一致性指数（NCI），利用ΔVTEC和ROTI可观测量监测GNSS空间一致性并识别局部异常，预示潜在完整性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 美国州级DOT越来越依赖CORS网络支持高精度GNSS定位与授时，但这些网络此前未被系统性用于区域完整性监测。需要一种方法利用现有CORS观测数据，识别环境（非故意）和网络攻击（故意）干扰导致的空间异常GNSS测量。

Method: 开发了基于图的网络一致性框架（NCF），对每个台站相对其空间邻域评估四种度量：邻域残差、空间梯度、残差和图平滑度，合并为网络一致性指数（NCI）。使用阿拉巴马州DOT维护的50个台站、连续两天四星座观测数据进行验证，采用垂直总电子含量变化（ΔVTEC）和TEC变化率指数（ROTI）作为空间相干可观测量。

Result: 框架量化了网络范围的空间一致性并识别出局部异常，检测到观测值与周围区域网络偏差的台站，提示潜在完整性问题。异常的根源（接收机故障、局部干扰、欺骗等）仍需进一步调查。

Conclusion: 本研究将州级CORS网络确立为区域GNSS完整性观测站，提出NCF和NCI用于基于图的空间完整性监测。交通机构可利用现有CORS观测实施该框架，以监测网络完整性并识别局部异常。

Abstract: State departments of transportation (DOTs) in the United States increasingly rely on statewide continuously operating reference station (CORS) networks to support high-precision Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-based positioning and timing for intelligent transportation systems. These networks also provide continuous observations that can support regional GNSS integrity monitoring. This study develops and demonstrates a framework that treats a statewide CORS network as a spatially distributed sensor system for identifying unintentional (environmental) and intentional (cyber) interference when GNSS measurements deviate from expected spatial patterns. We develop a graph-based Network Consistency Framework (NCF) that evaluates each station against its spatial neighborhood using four metrics: neighborhood residual, spatial gradient, residual, and graph smoothness. These metrics are combined into a Network Consistency Index (NCI). The framework is demonstrated using two consecutive days of four-constellation observations from 50 stations in the Alabama DOT-maintained CORS network, using changes in vertical total electron content (ΔVTEC) and the Rate of TEC Index (ROTI) as spatially coherent observables. The framework quantified network-wide spatial consistency and identified localized anomalies. Detected anomalies indicate stations whose observations deviated from the surrounding regional network, signaling potential integrity issues. Determining whether anomalies result from receiver faults, localized interference, spoofing, or other causes requires further investigation. This study introduces statewide CORS networks as regional GNSS integrity observatories and presents the NCF and NCI for graph-based spatial integrity monitoring. Transportation agencies can implement the framework using existing CORS observations to monitor network integrity and identify localized anomalies.

</details>


### [483] [CyberForge: Verified Vulnerability Injection at Repository Level for Cybersecurity Agent Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06471v1)
*Amine Lbath,Manan Suri,Aurelien Delaitre,Vadim Okun,Massih-Reza Amini,Ram D. Sriram,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: CyberForge是一个框架，通过向真实C/C++项目中注入漏洞来合成可执行的仓库级安全训练数据，构建了1034个经验证的漏洞语料库（覆盖80个项目、63个弱点类别），微调后的LLM智能体在SEC-bench补丁修复任务上提升+3.3至+14.7个百分点，并泛化到PatchEval等其他编程语言语料。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿LLM智能体在发现和修补真实软件复杂漏洞方面能力有限，攻击者只需找到一个可利用弱点即可得逞，而防御者需要持续发现并修补快速增长代码库中的所有漏洞。强大的防御性智能体可以缩小这一差距，但缺乏具有可复现构建和执行环境的安全训练数据是瓶颈。

Method: CyberForge通过向真实C/C++项目注入漏洞来合成训练数据，并进行动态验证：(1)注入后的构建必须通过项目的单元测试；(2)生成的漏洞证明（PoV）必须在注入构建上触发，而不能在干净构建上触发。该方法不受已知CVE数量限制，相比依赖历史CVE数据的数据增强技术更具可扩展性。

Result: 生成的语料库包含1034个经验证漏洞，覆盖80个项目和63个弱点类别，编辑局部性与真实CVE补丁在真实-真实噪声下限下相似。基于该语料库轨迹的微调在6种配置（3种模型规模和2个教师）下均提升SEC-bench补丁修复+3.3至+14.7点，31B学生达到其GPT-5.4-mini教师水平（72.7%对74.0%）。泛化到PatchEval（其他编程语言）时每种配置也均提升，31B学生超过其教师。

Conclusion: CyberForge证明合成漏洞注入数据可以显著提升LLM智能体的漏洞修复能力，且能跨语言泛化，为缓解安全训练数据稀缺问题提供了可扩展的路径。

Abstract: Despite recent advances, frontier large language model (LLM) agents remain limited in discovering and patching complex vulnerabilities in real-world software. Generally available agents can already aid attackers, who only need to find one exploitable weakness, while defenders must continuously identify and patch all vulnerabilities across fast-growing codebases. Stronger defensive agents would help close this gap, yet the scarcity of security training data with reproducible build and execution environments remains a bottleneck. We present CyberForge, a framework that synthesizes executable, repository-level security training data by injecting vulnerabilities into real C/C++ projects. It validates each instance dynamically: the injected build must pass the project's unit tests, and generated proof-of-vulnerability (PoV) must trigger on the injected build and not on the clean one. CyberForge is not limited by the availability of disclosed vulnerabilities, therefore it can scale in comparison to data augmentation techniques which rely on historic CVE data. The resulting corpus holds 1034 validated vulnerabilities across 80 projects and 63 weakness categories, with edit locality similar to real CVE patches under a real-versus-real noise floor. Fine-tuning on trajectories collected over this corpus improves SEC-bench patch repair by +3.3 to +14.7 points, in all six configurations of three model scales and two teachers, with the 31B student reaching its GPT-5.4-mini teacher, 72.7% against 74.0%. These gains generalize out of distribution to PatchEval, a corpus containing other programming languages, where every configuration also improves and the 31B student passes its teacher.

</details>

### [484] [A simple second-order nonstandard numerical method for a general class of dynamical systems and its applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09141v1)
*Manh Tuan Hoang*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 本文针对一类连续时间自治动力系统，构造了一种二阶非标准有限差分（NSFD）方法，同时保持系统解的积极性、平衡点集合及其渐近稳定性，并应用于两阶段结构化物种模型，数值实验验证了其优于标准二阶方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的一阶NSFD方法虽然能保持动力系统的关键特性，但精度有限；而标准的二阶数值方法（如显式梯形法）虽精度高，却无法保证解的积极性等动态一致性。因此需要构造一种既能保持系统本质性质（积极性、平衡点及渐近稳定性）又具有二阶收敛精度的方法。

Method: 该方法通过选择适当的非标准分母函数（保证二阶收敛性）和对右端函数进行加权离散化（保证动态一致性）来构造。利用右端函数的特定结构，采用简单的离散化替代以往常用的非局部离散化方法，简化了构造过程和渐近稳定性分析。随后将该方法应用于一个著名的两阶段结构化物种模型（含补充项），推导出简单的二阶NSFD格式。

Result: 成功构造了二阶NSFD方法，在任意有限步长下同时保持解的积极性、平衡点集合及其渐近稳定性。将其应用于两阶段结构化物种模型后，得到的二阶NSFD格式优于之前工作中的一阶NSFD方案。数值实验表明，该二阶NSFD方案在保持动态一致性的同时，优于标准二阶数值方法（显式梯形法）。此外，该方法可与Richardson外推技术结合以进一步提高精度。

Conclusion: 提出的二阶NSFD方法构造简单、适用范围广，可应用于理论和应用中广泛的一类动力系统模型，并在保持关键动态性质的同时实现二阶收敛精度，还能与Richardson外推结合进一步提升精度。

Abstract: In this work, we consider a class of continuous-time autonomous dynamical systems that model various important phenomena and processes encountered in real-world situations. We construct a second-order nonstandard finite difference (NSFD) method that simultaneously preserves two essential properties of the dynamical systems for all finite step sizes, namely the positivity of the solutions, the set of equilibrium points and their asymptotic stability. This NSFD method is constructed based on an appropriate choice of nonstandard denominator functions and a weighted discretization of the right-hand side functions. Under easily-verified conditions, the denominator functions guarantee second-order convergence, whereas the weights ensure the dynamic consistency. By taking advantage of the specific structure of the right-hand side functions, a simple discretization is utilized instead of the nonlocal discretization approaches commonly used in previous works. This simplifies the construction of the proposed NSFD method and, in particular, makes its asymptotic stability analysis easier. As an illustration and an important application, we apply the constructed second-order NSFD method to a well-known two-stage structured species model with recruitment. Consequently, a simple second-order NSFD scheme for the considered two-stage structured species model is derived, improving upon a first-order NSFD scheme constructed in a previous work. Numerical experiments demonstrate the advantages of the second-order NSFD scheme over a standard second-order numerical method, namely, the explicit trapezoidal method. The proposed NSFD method is simple and can be applied to a broad class of dynamical system models arising in both theory and applications. Moreover, it can be readily combined with the Richardson extrapolation technique to improve its accuracy.

</details>

### [485] [Testing dark matter models and modified gravity theories with spatially resolved HI observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07290v1)
*Federico Lelli,Antonino Marasco,Timothy A. Davis,Nathan Deg,Jonathan Freundlich,Gyula I. G. Jòzsa,Peter Kamphuis,Pavel E. Mancera Piña,Stacy S. McGaugh,Amidou Sorgho,Kristine Spekkens*

Main category: astro-ph.GA

TL;DR: 本文讨论了暗物质（DM）本质这一现代物理最重要的问题之一。星系平坦旋转曲线（尤其是来自21cm射电观测的扩展HI旋转曲线）在确立暗物质问题中发挥了关键历史作用，并继续作为测试星系形成模型、粒子暗物质模型和修正引力理论的重要工具。SKA天文台凭借其前所未有的角分辨率、灵敏度和巡天速度将彻底革新HI旋转曲线的研究。结合光学和近红外辅助数据，SKA-Mid AA4的HI巡天将实现三个主要突破：（1）获得1"-2"空间分辨率的HI数据，以前所未有的细节探测星系内部动力学（如尖点-核问题）；（2）从几百个天体的代表性样本扩展到数万个天体的统计样本，从而以空前的统计能力研究星系动力学标度律及其暗物质属性；（3）从z~0的星系扩展到z~1的星系，探测更早宇宙时代的暗物质晕，并探索约80亿年间动力学定律的红移演化。然而，海量SKA数据将对基于自动化动力学软件推导HI旋转曲线提出重要技术挑战。在SKA时代开发此类动力学软件对于实现区分暗物质问题不同解决方案等重大科学目标至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 暗物质本质是现代物理学最紧迫的问题之一。星系平坦旋转曲线（尤其是21cm射电观测的扩展HI旋转曲线）在确立暗物质问题中起到关键历史作用，是测试星系形成模型、粒子暗物质模型和修正引力理论的主要工具。然而，传统观测的样本量有限、分辨率有限、红移覆盖范围仅限z~0，限制了我们对暗物质属性的深入理解。

Method: 利用SKA-Mid AA4的HI巡天，结合光学和近红外辅助数据，通过三个维度推进研究：（1）获得1"-2"空间分辨率的内星系动力学数据，解决尖点-核问题；（2）将样本规模从几百个扩展到数万个天体，进行星系动力学标度律统计；（3）将观测扩展到z~1的早期宇宙，研究约80亿年间的红移演化。同时需开发自动化动力学软件以处理大规模数据。

Result: SKA-Mid AA4将以前所未有的角分辨率、灵敏度和巡天速度提供HI旋转曲线数据，实现从代表性样本到统计样本（数万个天体）、从z~0到z~1的跨越，并探测星系内部动力学细节。但大规模数据需要开发自动化动力学软件来处理和提取旋转曲线。

Conclusion: SKA巡天将为暗物质研究带来革命性突破，覆盖更高空间分辨率、更大统计样本和更早宇宙时代。然而，开发在SKA时代能处理海量数据的自动化动力学软件至关重要，这将是区分暗物质问题不同解决方案（如粒子暗物质模型与修正引力理论）的关键技术前提。

Abstract: Understanding the nature of dark matter (DM) is one of the most pressing questions of modern physics. The flat rotation curves of galaxies, especially the extended HI rotation curves from radio observations at 21 cm, played a key historical role to establish the DM problem and continue to be a major tool to test different galaxy formation models, particle DM models, and modified gravity theories. The SKA observatory will revolutionize the study of HI rotation curves thanks to its unprecedented angular resolution, sensitivity, and survey speed. In combination with optical and near-infrared ancillary data, HI surveys with SKA-Mid AA4 will allow us to (1) obtain HI data at spatial resolutions of 1"-2", probing the inner galaxy dynamics with unprecedented details (e.g., the cusp-core problem); (2) move from representative samples of a few hundreds of objects to statistical samples of tens of thousands of objects, allowing us to study the dynamical scaling laws of galaxies and their DM properties with unprecedented statistical power across different cosmic environments; (3) move from galaxies at z~0 to galaxies at z~1, probing DM halos at earlier cosmic epochs and exploring the redshift evolution of the dynamical laws across about 8 Gyrs. The massive SKA data, however, will pose important technical challenges for the derivation of HI rotation curves with automated kinematic software. Developing such kinematic software in the SKA era will be crucial to reach major scientific goals, such as discriminating between different solutions to the DM problem.

</details>
